He put on the bait and tossed the fishing line. Soon after, the fish began to nibble. The next step was to pull hard and land the fish.
The fish were dragged out to the surface in clusters and the couple that were watching from afar were surprised and approached him.
“Wow. He caught them again.”
“He’s really good at it.”
Reverse cleared his throat trying to keep calm, but his face was already blushed with happiness.
“A-hem! This is a piece of cake.”
He loved the feel of the fishing rod and was even more happy that the fish were his to keep.
Rainbow carp!
Landing a rare species increased luck by 1. He fished all night long and headed for Bingryong Square.
Countless users were sitting in the square as open street vendors.
In the Bingryong Square, a variety of items were being sold, from common tree berries to expensive weapons over 10,000 gold!
Reverse sat down relaxed and opened a street stall.As time passed he worried about the freshness of the fish declining.
Therefore, he began calling out to customers which he would usually never do.
“Hmm-hmm. Selling Fish. Delicious fish caught by the river!”
The fish was a common ingredient, but the large ones were popular.
The users that were passing by stopped to take a look.
“They look fresh and sizeable. How much are they?”
“I’m not sure. Make an offer.”
“How about 2 silver?”
Reverse was stunned for being so happy about catching fish worth 2 silver each.
“There’s my cost of labor too.”
“Nah, that would be a bit overpriced. I will give you 3 silver at most.”
“Not bad a price… Alright.”
Each fish sold provided him an income of several silvers.
Reverse fell into a fantasy of becoming rich in Royal Road. The rainbow carp was sold for 5 gold, making him more content.
“Maybe fishing is my job of aptitude. There is such joy in sitting under a shade and facing the nice breeze.”
That very day he purchased a bamboo fishing rod for 1 gold.
In the daytime, he completed quests and spent time at the beginner training dojo. At night, he fished.
Like the saying, “Converts are the worst”, he became head over heels for Royal Road.
Reverse sighed in regret every time he walked the streets of Morata.
“For me to have started this so late despite having invented it… This is a different level from watching through the monitor. I would have started on the first day of Royal Road if I knew it was this fun.”
***
Seoyoon was involved in affairs for governing the empire.
The new provincial lords were short in ruling the cities, so she provided the needed support and at other times devised collaborative development plans of several villages.
It was a difficult time, but she put in her best effort to establish the foundation of the Arpen Empire.
“Chwiik!”
The Orc lord Seechwi!
She who had treated Seoyoon for a long time made a visit to the Earth Palace.
“Seoyoon! Chwiik!”
“Yes.”
Seoyoon replied and smiled brightly.
It was because she knew how hard Seechwi tried to break down the wall in her heart.
“You’re so beautiful when you smile like that. Chwiik!”
Seechwi snorted in joy.
“The reason I came here. Sh-chwiik. I think I have to. Chwiik. Head to the east. Sh-chwiik!”
“By east you mean… Orcland?”
“Yep. Chwiik!”
“Isn’t it dangerous there due to the Red Dragon?”
Seechwi wasn’t planning to go for no reason.
‘Red Dragon… Just maybe, there is a secret relating to the orcs.’
In Orcland, the regions were a mixture of barren lands and grass fields, and the rest of the lands were occupied by the orcs.
For the Orcs, there was a saying that was passed down as a legend.
- We will become extinct. Chwiik. Only by extinction, Chwiik. We will be liberated from the curse. Sh-Sh-Chwiik!
A curse bestowed on the Orcs!
No one knew what it was exactly, but there was a crucial concern for Orc users.
‘The Orc is really fun in the beginning. Fast growth. What after that, though?’
The Orc does not become stronger after a certain point.
They cannot build intelligence and form societies, let alone find jobs in architecture or the arts field.
Orc towns and forts were merely villages built by stacking rocks.
Many races in the Versailles Continent had potential and the Orcs were regarded as the abandoned race.
Too many Orc lords realized the harsh reality and left for vacations.
A self-inflicting insult was widely spread among them that the Orc race was great for tanning by the beach.
“Red Dragon. Maybe it is not a coincidence. Chwiik! Something. Chwiik. I want to try… If something happens to me.”
“Yeah. Don’t worry. I will certainly help.”

chapters.title: Chapter 584: (582) Volume 54, 6 - The way of the desert (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Volume 54, Chapter 6 - The way of the desert (Part 1)
Weed saw the sigil of the murderer and sighed.
“The brothers are dead…”
He did not mean to lead them to a certain death, but they died anyway.
He would normally account for the worst scenarios, but this was definitely impossible to predict.
‘It’s not the worst thing that could happen anyhow.’
He gained a level and accomplished the genocide combat accomplishment.
His status as a murderer would disappear while doing quests, and the entire scene was broadcasted live so no one will think badly of him.
Weed who had defeated the sandstorm walked over to Geumchi5 who was a total mess just from observing.
“Well done, youngest one.”
“It’s nothing. This kind of thing is a breeze.”
“Yes. Of course.”
Weed brought out bandages and wrapped it around Geumchi5 and the apprentices with rockbottom health points.
They boasted about their recovery even with fatal wounds and some of them were actually hanging on the cliff.
“Consuming some food will help you recover faster.”
“I am not hungry.”
“This is dried eel.”
“Mmm. Very savory. You got any more of these?”
These apprentices didn’t run from raining lava but could not hold back on dried eel and shared among themselves.
They had nowhere to use the excess stamina, but they would not turn down good food!
The users that were hiding around the desert rose to their feet.
“Oh… He’s good at wrapping bandages too.”
“You have to be at that level to be called the best in the continent.”
The response from the desert users were different from how it was before.
Their eyes were beaming with surprise and admiration.
“I am Barova. Weed-nim. It is an honor to meet you.”
“Yes. Glad to meet you.”
Weed exchanged simple greetings with the desert users. Many of the users present were around level 500.
To be active in the desert, the user will generally be high-level and hostile. They were well-behaved having seen Weed in action.
‘When I rule the desert, these users will become the tribal chiefs.’
Weed put on his business smile.
“I think it’s beyond coincidence for us to have met, so will you join me in a hunt?”
***
Hunting hell, an infernal hunting hell!
Weed reminisced the days as the Great King of the Desert and hunted alongside the users.
“We are the Zenkoba Tribe. To you we swear our loyalty. Every single drop of blood that runs through be will be shed for you.”
As he met with the different desert tribes, the influence in building the Pallos Empire grew.
The users that have proceeded with the quest for the Pallos Empire could be disappointed, but as it stood, Weed was already in control of the North and the Central Continent.
He also took in the tribe warriors from Geumchi and the apprentices.
His faction and influence was outstanding, and the seeds of the Pallos Empire that spread across the desert regions were also in his hands.
The southern desert also seemed to fall into his hands in a natural flow of events just moments after its birth.
“Are you the warrior who put the Eye of the Sun to rest?”
“That is so.”
The Sun Tribe deemed to be the most powerful in the desert visited him after 3 days.
The tribe that it self-claimed to be warriors of warriors and the descendents of the Pallos Empire.
“We heard the stories, but we only believe in what we see with our own eyes. If you seek a duel with our warriors, follow.”
The Newcomer in the Tribe
The Sun Tribe does not accept just anyone.
If you seek to be a magnificent desert warrior, you must become the youngest one in the tribe and learn from various teachings.
Follow the Sun Tribe and participate in the hunting.
Difficulty: A
Requirements: Warrior class job quest
Rewards: Advancement into desert warrior
‘Desert warrior… It ain’t easy earning the nice job classes.’
Weed had no plans of settling for the desert warrior.
‘The warrior class needs combat achievements in order to acquire good jobs. The sandstorm was quite a struggle, but I’m well off in terms of sword techniques, stats and equipment. I’m better in a real competition.’
While all the ruckus was going on with Kaybern, he did not want to waste any time.
‘I guess it is what it is. I can just hunt my way after this.’
He processed the situation for a moment and nodded.
“Alright. I will go with you.”
[ You have accepted the quest. Spirit increased by 1. ]
***
Darius, the lord of Castle Patton!
In the past, he committed evil deeds without restraint, then betrayed the Hermes Guild and sided with the Arpen.
“Oof. That was the best decision ever. A man’s got to have the right connections.”
“I agree, lord Darius.”
Darius failed to hide his satisfaction in his castle raised in the Northern Continent.
It was located between Castle Vent and Mordred, had decent transportation system and also possessed rich-soil lands that was providing an increasing amount of harvests.
“How are the farmers?”
“They are gathering up. I believe this is the effect of building reservoirs early.”
“The price of the crops will increase because of Kaybern. We will be able to sell at higher prices. This is seizing the opportunity.”
“Increasing price of consumables goes against the laws of Arpen.”
Darius frowned at the words of the internal affairs manager.
“It is irritating with so many regulations. If it was Haven Empire, we would have made 10, 20 times more profit with the excuse of lacking supply.”
“But, aren’t there a lot more users that will make the purchase? The merchant associations willingly buy in bulk.”
A smile painted Darius’ face again.
“That’s right. Business and population is all you need for a city.”
Just a bit of investment over Castle Patton and new inventions brought instantaneous response of the users. Tens and thousands of users moved in each week, and there were even more merchants and travellers, giving him joy in ruling the city.
Technology, production and taxes were undeniably influenced by population.
He had wiped his past completely and was now living the life of the lord.
Darius in his office took out the crystal ball.
“Let’s see what our dear majesty is up to.”
His other hobby was watching footage of Weed from time to time.
“I took the best rope up. Just a moment later in turning to Arpen and I wouldn’t be enjoying this luxury in the lord seat.”
If the Hermes Guild were to crumble and Weed control the entire world, nothing could work out better for him.
At a point in time in his life, he was infamous for his evil deeds, but he thought of it as a childhood misconduct.
“From now on, I will maintain my good reputation and live as the lord. Lord of Arpen… How great is that?”
In the crystal ball, footage of Weed joining with the Sun Tribe and running east of the desert was shown.
“I’ve been there as well!”
Darius sprang out of his seat.
After Weed had raised the Pallos Empire, the revival of the desert region began.
Shortly after that, he considered the request of the broadcast station and organized a squad for a trip to the desert.
“Heated Desert. That’s the place where the desert worms spawn, yes? A bit more east and the bigger ones come out.”
The squad at the time battled against 3 desert worms.
A gigantic worm that moves beneath the sands.
Weed once transformed himself into a squishy worm but it was surely a tricky opponent to face.
‘Enormous amount of health points and endurance. It swallows anything that comes in its path. Bursting out from the ground without notice is a problematic trait as well.’
When it was beneath the sands, it was hard to pinpoint its location and let alone attack.
If it were to surge all of a sudden and take a mouthful, the victim would meet certain death unless he was a warrior or a knight!
The worm was a subject of fear for the mages and priests that positioned in the rear.
‘I have heard countless times that worms are not to be hunted. However, I had no other choice but to fight it due to the broadcast.’
Darius’ squad fought formidably in its early encounter with the 3 desert worms. However, another showed up, devouring an archer and a mage.
That was just the beginning of a nightmare.
The desert worms that felt the trembles of battle gathered from a 5 kilometer radius.
They sprang everywhere from the sands and devoured the users.
Gulp!
They swallowed users whole and drained their health points and mana.
“Run! Fall back!”
Darius chose to retreat, horrified like he was in hell, but the battle extended for a long time and the desert worms were on a rampage.
Less than a dozen managed to escape the area.
The tension beat just about any horror film and the footage hit over 50 million views.
Darius could not forget such a gruesome failure.
“He’s going to that place? Along with the desert tribe members?”
He thought it was illogical but could not foresee the outcome because it was Weed.
***
Weed followed the Sun Tribe and got the broadcast station to live cast the scene.
- Seoyoon: This is the habitat of desert worms. Be weary of the tremors. It’s best if you take your shoes off.
Seoyoon delivered information as she observed the live cast.
- Mapan: The desert worm, apart from its rotten meat, sells for expensive price! The feelers are used for making fire type magic scrolls nowadays and are on the rise on the price range.
Mapan also filled in with information about market price.
Weed was quite familiar with monsters of this type since he came across the Death Worm and Squishy Worm.
‘The Sun Tribe. I wonder how you all fight.’
He was following in a relaxed manner.
“Sprint!”
The camel began racing through the desert at the shout from the tribal chief.
All in view was the ocean of sand roasted hot by the sunlight.
It was almost a boring and peaceful view, but something occurred the next moment.
- Chuuuuuack!
As they passed through the sand hill, the desert worms popped out from the ground!
The tribe warriors responded swiftly.
“Scatter and advance forward!”
The warriors mounted on camels split to the sides and attacked the desert worm.
7 of them fell off from their camels, but they succeeded in hunting the desert worm with a quick retaliation.
‘The reaction was fast. They fight well.’
Weed deemed the Sun Tribe to be as formidable as the usual warriors he came across back in his days as the Great King of the Desert.
In those days, he cast them away as soon as they fell even an inch behind because he was all about saving time.
Gathering and training the elites in endless hunting was after all that.
The forces under his direct command were elites that could conquer the continent, so they were not to be compared to.
A warrior with an intimidating face and white cloth wrapped around his head approached Weed.
“Newcomer! Tend to the wounded.”
“So I shall.”
Weed went over to the wounded and wrapped them with bandages rubbed in healing herbs.
“Ah… That feels great.”
“With a bit of rest, you will be able to fight again.”
“Thanks.”
[ Friendliness has increased. ]
The wounded warriors each taught him a skill of their own.
“I can’t really call this compensation, but do you know how to put power in your sword?”
“I wish to learn.”
“It is to strike down with the energy of the sky. It is quite the tricky skill, but repeat it a few times after I show you.”
Weed copied the footwork and the waist movement of the wounded warrior identically.
Blink!
[ You have acquired the passive skill, Warrior’s Descending Strike.
Warrior’s Descending Strike, Novice, 1 (0%): Striking down on an enemy increases attack power by 2%. ]
He picked up a few vital skills learned by warriors.
In the desert, he could not pick up defensive skills but he learned plenty of offensive skills.
‘It’s enjoyable to look after these warriors. Unfortunately, I won’t have the time to cook for them.’
Weed thought about the time in Litbar demon lair where he looked after the Rosenheim Kingdom soldiers, but that was just for a moment.
An A rank quest.
It would not end with just caring for the behinds as the intern of the Sun Tribe.
‘It’s manageable so far… But the deeper we go into the Heated Desert, the desert worms will appear by the dozens.’
Then it would be a terrible scene of hell!
Judging by the navigation path, he had to survive while protecting the Sun Tribe.

chapters.title: Chapter 585: (583) Volume 54, 6 - The way of the desert (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Volume 54, Chapter 6 - The way of the desert (Part 2)
Weed knew what was going to happen next, but he stayed firm and tended to the wounded.
“Have you heard of Teppy? He’s the most skilled warrior in our tribe. The Sun Tribe are led by truly powerful warriors.”
“Yes. I see.”
He talked with the wounded soldiers and obtained some basic information.
‘It will be much more advantageous if I summon the undead… Then again, I will need to fight like a warrior in order to become friendlier with these people.’
Weed’s combat power came with a trait that multiplied several fold the dirtier he fought.
He had to charge through the desert worms without the use of Undead Summoning or curse spells that specialize in large-scale battles.
‘The situation calls for this…’
Weed quietly took out a sculpture while following the tribe.
“Sculptural Destruction Technique! All of this shall turn into power.”
[ You have activated Sculptural Destruction Technique. ]
His art stat was over 3800.
The hard-earned art stats that he accumulated through intense grinding were all converted into strength.
‘This is reassuring.’
Weed felt power boiling within his entire body.
The Sun Tribe utilized mobility of the camels in their battles.
Since they were never stationary, it was easier to distance themselves against the surprise attack of the desert worms and was also quicker to aid those in danger.
‘They surely live up to their reputation. They excel in hunting, the best in the desert.’
They were a warrior tribe that used swords, throwing spears and bows.
They had no priests or mages, but they had a great combination of attack and defense and quickly took down the desert worm.
The butchery of severing the bones, meat and the skin of the desert worms followed right after.
“We will keep going. Youngest one, look after the wounded.”
“Yes. I will.”
Weed began to think more formidably about the quest as he followed the tribe.
‘It will be better if the desert worms attack all at once. One or two are being taken down quite easily. If we continue to move like this… We will be stuck in the middle of the desert worm nest.’
The huge failure of Darius’ squad had led to users avoiding the desert worm territories completely.
Eventually even the merchants took the long route and the desert worms starved.
*Glurp!*
The desert worms were creatures with a greedy appetite to begin with.
The animals roaming the desert were scarce, and they found it hard to thrive given their hunger.
Now that a large number of prey appeared, the reckless desert worms came forth and the rest stayed in position. It was to prevent even a single prey from escaping.
Weed gazed far into the desert and noticed the sands creeping.
It could have been the winds, but the range of the movement was very wide.
‘This is going to be quite challenging… But, that’s where the fun is.’
***
Yoo Byungjoon was observing Weed through the monitor with a cup of cocoa in his hand.
“He’s in for a checkmate.”
The more he felt joy in Royal Road, his regret grew bigger of not having started earlier. Furthermore, he felt doubts about his own life.
‘Countless people… They acknowledged me for creating this new world. Royal Road bestowed heavenly joy to some of them.’
However, the creator of said world merely observed everyone in it having fun.
‘Weed. I even pledged to inherit all my fortune to him once he became the emperor that united the continent…’
Yoo Byungjoon pondered about how it would have been like if he started Royal Road early.
He knew lots of leads about quests, jobs and treasures.
‘I would have gotten more powerful much quicker than the rest. If I did play Royal Road, there wouldn’t have been Bard Ray, or Weed for that matter.’
Of course that would be unfair, but what would be exactly fair in this world?
The life of the creator enjoying his privilege would be very enjoyable indeed.
His whole life he thought he was oblivious to women, but spending time in Versailles continent, he witnessed many beautiful women.
‘I don’t know what I did with my life.’
Yoo Byungjoon was full of regret, but he would not break his pledge in passing all that he owned to the emperor that united the continent.
It wasn’t something that was announced officially to the world and he could cancel it anytime, but that was the goal he bet his life on.
He realized that what he did was absolutely insane, but that in itself was also one of the footprints in his journey. It was extremely likely that Weed will unite the entire continent but…
“I wish he breaks his back doing it.”
***
It was the middle of the vast desert.
The Sun Tribe kept advancing and Weed picked up plenty of skills used commonly by the warriors.
“That’s enough. I already acquired it.”
“Is that so?”
The warriors backed away awkwardly.
The warrior guilds in the continent tend to teach their own, original skills.
The guilds each had one or two kinds of shield blocks, but the effectiveness were pretty much the same.
There were users that travelled across the continent to learn skills that were 3, 4% more effective, but the skills would even out once they’re mastered.
The tribal warriors spoke.
“It seems you have learned just about all the skills. Then, how about a weapon sparring against me? With skills restriction.”
“Sounds good.”
Weed looked around once and accepted.
Thousand warriors of the Sun Tribe were taking a moment to rest.
The sands were creeping up closer from afar.
‘A duel in the middle of the desert worm nest… At that speed, they will ambush us in a few minutes. This could be a part of the quest as well.’
Weed began his battle against the tribal warrior.
They went around in a circle and pointed their weapons against the opponent.
*Clash!*
They came in contact within an instant and swung their sword and scimitar.
The tribal warrior wielded the scimitar with great strength and nimble speed.
Weed easily deflected with his own mighty strength and dominated.
There was such an easy path to victory and not one moment was spared for hesitation.
“I, I have lost. What fierce power!”
[ Desert warrior Palong has acknowledged your strength.
He was defeated under absolute power.
Fame is increased by 600 due to combat achievement.
Strength is permanently increased by 1. ]
The combat achievement was sweet!
“I am next!”
Another warrior came forth to challenge.
‘Restricting skills and fighting with weapons. They are testing me for my fundamentals with the sword.’
The duel would be difficult for others, but for Weed it was like cutting bread.
He could win in a weapon fight in a breeze, but he even had increased strength through the Sculptural Destruction Skill!
“K-ugh. Splendid sword technique. I cannot even hope to win against it.”
[ Desert warrior Beten acknowledge your strength.
He is amazed by the incredible movement of the sword.
Fame increased by 600 due to combat achievement.
Agility is permanently increased by 1. ]
‘This is great! Although we might take a huge blow from the desert worms if I am too engaged in the duel.’
Weed quickly continued his duel with the warriors while the desert worms were approaching from afar.
“Next. Come at me!”
[ Strength is increased by 1. ]
[ Agility is increased by 1. ]
It was a blissful situation with increasing stats.
Weed saw opportunity and relaxed himself. When he won with sheer sword technique, a message alert popped up.
[ Sword technique proficiency is increased. ]
‘This is a disappointment.’
Sword proficiency could be mastered later by clobbering on monsters.
For another user, the sword technique mastery would be an incredible achievement, but not for Weed.
He consistently leveled up his sword skills despite the penalty of being a sculptor that had a slower proficiency growth in combat type skills.
On top of that, he grinded intensely for stats and secret sculptural techniques.
Usually, the enemies he faced were higher level than himself and the proficiency growth for sword skills was quick.
‘Skill proficiency comes later. Stats are the priority right now. It’s easier to fight against these warriors that are above the normality. Their movements are orthodox.’
Weed read the opponent’s aim and deflected it with sheer strength just by the shoulder movement and the direction of the scimitar swing.
His body moved on its own from the highly attained sword technique and experience.
He advanced before the opponent began attacking and he reached the weak point before it became exposed.
He utilized speed and power over technique, struck hard and dominated his opponents.
“Next, next!”
Weed rapidly built up his combat achievements.
In the Sun Tribe, warriors capable of battle were around several hundreds. Even so, the fate of this blessed moment was predetermined.
The desert worms were approaching and he had to maximize his gains as quickly as possible.
‘One would be in for heavy losses if he lacked knowledge about this region or does not take notice of his surroundings because he is too immersed in the duel.’
Carelessness from the sweet satisfaction will lead to an abrupt strike by the desert worms.
In fact, the desert worms were already half-way while the duels were happening.
“Hold on. I now wish to fight against Teppy.”
Weed proposed a duel to the champion of the Sun Tribe.
Teppy was a muscular warrior with a tanned copper tone body. He was watching while sitting on the sand and stood up.
“You want to go against me? I was getting bored watching. This will be fun!”
A duel against Teppy wasn’t all that special.
It was not like his level was over 500, and the basic combat pattern of the desert warriors were similar.
However, much like the knights the desert warriors showed their true strength not on foot, but on camels.
Weed struck down on Teppy’s head with his scimitar thinking that this was the final fight.
“K-ugh. I have been defeated.”
[ The champion of the desert acknowledged your strength.
He was defeated by extraordinary power.
Fame is increased by 1,300 due to combat achievement.
Strength is permanently increased by 3. ]
He gained 15 stat points through the duels, which was a satisfying accomplishment.
That being said, he wouldn’t have acquired them if he could not defeat the warriors.
“Now. Let us all get ready for battle on our camels.”
“What do you mean by that?”
“Desert worms are approaching from all sides.”
“…!”
Teppy and the tribal warriors scouted the surroundings after hearing Weed.
A sand figure was squirming beneath. They knew too well it was a trait of the desert worm.
“Damn…”
“It’s an ambush!”
Weed spoke to the panicking tribal warriors.
“Calm yourselves. They sense vibrations. Hold your positions and take out your weapons. Slowly get on your camels and get ready for battle.”
“Still, there are too many of them. How about we escape quickly?”
Teppy raised his weapon and opposed.
He was a brave warrior, but over two dozen worms were already within range of their bows.
Hundreds of worms crawled beyond that line.
They had no other choice but to worry about the annihilation of the tribe.
Weed grinned and spoke.
“I will lead the fight.”
In all consideration, he didn’t have to treat these warriors carefully like he did with the Rosenheim Kingdom soldiers.
‘It will be difficult protecting all these warriors, but there was no mention of that in the quest.’
The content just specified hunting alongside the Sun Tribe.
Even if they ran from this spot, it was highly possible that the quest will complete if the continued the hunt elsewhere.
After all, the requirement was to participate in the hunt and accomplish combat achievements.
‘That’s not worth my time, and this is the desert.’
The desert should be treated in its own way, and that was to go hard at it without a care in the world.
Warriors will overcome and become more powerful and the weak will die.
That was the tradition he established when he raised the Pallos Empire during his days as the Great King of the Desert.
“I’ll go first.”
Weed took off on his camel towards the trembling sands.

chapters.title: Chapter 586: (584) Volume 54, 6 - The way of the desert (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Volume 54, Chapter 6 - The way of the desert (Part 3)
The burning desert sands split as the ugly desert worm popped out.
A gigantic worm!
With countless razor sharp teeth, the desert worm lunged head first.
- Kuaaah!
Its mouth was wide open as if it wanted to swallow everyone at once!
Weed was already prepared.
“Moonlight Sculpting Blade”
A beam of light extended from the Loa Sword and cut into the eye of the desert worm. The next instant, it passed through the dimensional gate that was floating around.
It disappeared in front of the desert worm’s mouth and reappeared in the rear.
“Heat Strike!”
Weed utilized the skills he learned from the desert warriors and slashed the worm in a flash.
[ Scorching impact!
Enemy’s health points decreased by 93,907.
The heat lingers and applies 3% additional damage per second. ]
The desert worm had low defense but a lot of health points.
- Kuaaagh!
The desert worm squirmed, flaking its flaming body.
“Lightning Scar!”
Weed used various attack spells on the worm and worked it down.
Since it wasn’t going to die any time soon, it was a good target for him to use many spells and practice them.
‘Rapid Slash. This is quite useful even though it’s only a basic skill. The burst damage will be very significant against large monsters.’
He used the skills archived in his head and assessed them in detail.
He was taking his time taking down the worm unlike his usual hunts.
*Creep-creep. Squirm-squirm.*
While Weed was confronting the desert worm, the sands nearby moved closer.
‘I knew it all along.’
Sensing the prey’s movement, they approach slowly for the surprise attack.
Then all of a sudden, they emerged and struck. This was the trait of a desert worm.
“Haaaaa!”
[ You have activated War Cry.
Attack power is increased by 100% for 20 seconds.
Endurance is increased by 80% for 5 seconds. ]
It was a warrior-class skill!
Weed roared and raised his attack power. Then, more worms swarmed towards him as they were unable to resist the scent of such strong and tasty prey.
At least a dozen worms that were surrounding the desert warriors broke off formation.
In an instant.
- Kyaaa!
- Kuaaaagh!
The desert worms emerged simultaneously from the front, back and sides with their mouths wide open.
It was breathtaking ambush attack that they’d been waiting for.
“Lava River!”
Weed swung his sword and activated his skill. The earth fissured and lava surged within several dozen meters.
The destructive power was incomparable to the time he put the sandstorm to rest!
“Wow… That’s…!”
“That is the skill from the desert’s folklore.”
It was only for a short moment, but he could hear the awe from the warriors of the Sun Tribe.
‘I guess I have to thank Bard Ray.’
The force of the skill was more powerful given that he had used Sculptural Destruction Skill to significantly increase his strength.
Though, the real factor was the Goblet of Flames.
[ Goblet of Flames : Durability 30/30.
A goblet instilled with the essence of fire. There are stories of collecting lava flowing deep beneath the earth where no human has traveled and also rumors that the goblet is instilled with flames that survived for a million years.
In other words, it was an artifact instilled with a legend.
Darkness, no matter how big, will be defeated if the power of the goblet is drawn out.
Requirements : None.
Option : Possession increases all stats by 53.
Maximum health points and mana increased by 70,000.
All skills related to fire will be 200% more powerful.
Effects of combat skill increased by 35%.
Near immune to fire damage.
The holder can use the ‘Goblet’s Tranquility’ every 10 days.
Special : A legend is sealed inside.
There are 7 options yet to be identified.
Tranquility of the Goblet : Summons a river of flowing lava or an erupting volcano that wipes out all enemies. ]
The element of fire was most common among desert warriors.
Warriors did use earth type skills and a rare number of them also used water type skills.
These were skills that increased defense or recovery rate.
The ice element froze monsters and slowed them, thus they were also common. But, when it came to pure damage, fire was the best.
“I will roast everything!”
Weed’s lava river swept away the desert worms, both those that had surged up above the sands and the ones hiding underground.
Like a ferocious current, the raging lava river covered the worms.
[ Lava River was activated.
Lava flows in a radius of 86 meters and wipes out all enemies! ]
The Lava River sustained for over a minute and applied consistent damage.
Weed got the drop on the worms and exploded with the Lion Roar.
- Attack at once! Fight to your heart’s desire!
The skill increased his commandship and leadership.
“Wahh!”
The warriors of the Sun Tribe that were watching in surprise instantly ran forward.
They struck down mercilessly on the scorching desert worms with their scimitars.
Warriors were indeed simple minded beings.
Even in his days as the Great King of the Desert, he would dash out on a rampage first and the desert warriors with increased morale joined alongside him, displaying the best efficiency in fighting.
The desert warriors had affinity with fire and were bestowed with additional attack power.
“Hooorah!”
Teppy focused his attack on a single desert worm.
That moment, more desert worms sprang from all directions with rumbling screeches!
River of crimson lava flowed above the heated desert.
On top was an intense battle where Weed, the tribal warriors and the desert warriors were in one huge entanglement.
***
As Kaybern roamed and destroyed the cities, a wind of change brewed in the North.
- Can you picture the North after losing Morata? How about the Earth Place? What will happen to us if we lose it?
Someone spoke out in the Bingryong square.
It was a big disadvantage not having one decent metropolis in the vast Northern Continent.
As the Earth Palace reached completion, the downtown area in the vicinity grew exponentially, and Morata was a metropolis unparalleled in history.
In production, trades, population, it dominated over just about any city in Central Continent in all aspects.
- Because of this, Kaybern will target Morata soon!
The Northern users were afraid.
They were just put away down the list of destruction simply because Castle Aren or Free City Somren had higher development.
It didn’t change the fact that Morata was also a city in danger.
Losing Morata meant more for than losing any other city.
Morata was the heart of the North, the hope of countless users and also their home.
The users that grew up ever since Morata was a small village and before Arpen Kingdom even existed, did not want to lose their cherished memories.
“If Kaybern shows up, let us all stand!”
“Of course. We must step up. However, realistically speaking the black dragon will kill us all and turn Morata into ruins. There will be nothing left in Morata when we return. Then, that leaves us with one option.”
They came up with a solution in hopes of protecting Morata.
- Population Dispersion Policy!
The plan was to scatter the concentrated population of Morata to the outskirts of the North.
“Let’s go. For the sake of our home.”
“We must leave.”
The users loaded their luggage on wagons driven by bulls and scattered across the entire Northern Continent.
Many shacks were dismantled and the production facilities were also transferred to other cities and villages.
Roads were constructed, and trade cities formed by the riversides where ships travelled. Ultimately, the functionalities were dispersed well into other locations.
Most users left on their own will, but the fundamental facilities, residing population and Morata’s role as a production and trade hub were maintained.
Furthermore, tourists and users from the Central continent were visiting on a consistent level.
***
The Earth Palace.
The brightest among the vast human resources of the Grass Porridge Cult gathered.
Several thousands were economic specialists and management consulting in real life.
Only those with a doctorate degree or experience working in a renowned company for over a decade gathered in the palace.
“Much hope lies in our analysis. I can’t stress enough the importance of determining which city will fall under the attack of Kaybern.”
The elder of the economics stepped forth and spoke.
Since then, all members began a meticulous assessment of information.
They were to analyze the development, population, expansion, commercial facilities, technology, number of artisans, trades, tourism, agricultural production, reputation and influence of all metropolitan cities of the Versailles Continent.
“There must be a pattern. Our job is to find it.”
The cities that were targeted and destroyed up until now, and the cities with high chance of destruction. Many things had to be confirmed, but they soon came up with an estimated conclusion because it wasn’t difficult for these experts.
“We still lack sample data. The data will reach perfection the more progress Kaybern makes, but as of now Morata will be targeted in at least a month, 2 months at the latest.
Probability leans towards a month.”
The event which the Northern users were most afraid of was soon going to take place.
***
Weed used the Dimensional Gloves and whipped through the battlefield against the desert worms. The various items including the Goblet of Flames boosted his attack power.
The Sun Tribe being the elites of the desert were successful in holding their own.
92 casualties.
It was minimal sacrifice given the desperate battle above the heated desert.
Tribe Intern Complete.
You have led the Sun Tribe and completed the desert worm hunt
The tribal warriors are in admiration of your power and courage.
[ You have accomplished the combat achievement ‘Bloody battle against the desert worms’.
All stats are increased by 2.
Strength is increased by 5.
Agility is increased by 1. ]
[ Reputation is increased by 5,000. ]
Quest completion!
Weed did not forget to apply bandages and medicinal herbs on the wounded.
“Ugh!”
“Endure the pain.”
Unlike his words, he wrapped the bandages roughly around them.
He could bind down wounds with his eyes closed and was even capable of reviving them from the brink of death.
Then, Teppy approached Weed and said:
“Our tribe overcame a difficult battle with your aid. I represent the tribe and pay respect to you, the warrior of warriors.”
The Sun Tribe warriors in mild condition had also gathered around him.
These warriors did not have courtesy like the knights in the Central Continent. However, these warriors of the Sun Tribe will join Weed when he calls for battle no matter where it may be.
That was the way of the desert!
Teppy handed another scimitar that he carried on his back.
“You are qualified to be the warrior acknowledged by the desert. You shall be free above the vast sands.”
*Blink!*
[ You are able to advance into the class ‘Desert Warrior’. Special skills will be unlocked upon advancement.
Strength and stamina will improve quickly while roaming in the desert.
You will acquire simple, but deadly sword techniques.
Movement speed will increase while riding on camels.
Desert Warrior is an advanced class of the warrior.
Will you advance now? ]
Weed got the chance to advance but was very disappointed.
‘Such difficulty on a quest, and all that for just the Desert Warrior?’
Desert Warrior was already a class that was obtainable within cities such as Metafeia once the qualifications were met.
He was bound to do many things in the desert and had to equip himself with higher strength, but this wasn’t what he expected after saving an entire tribe.
‘No. I shouldn’t be disappointed. The Desert Warrior class is only the basic title for working in the desert.’
The Warrior of the Sun was only a class given to the champion of the desert, so this definitely was not the end of his journey.
‘There will be more to offer.’
Weed decided not to think too deeply about it.
“I appreciate it. The desert is an honorable place for the warrior.”
[ You have advanced into the Desert Warrior.
You have obtained a higher class of the warrior.
You are now able to learn combat skills specialized in fire.
Maximum health points increased by 25%.
Maximum mana increased by 10%.
News of your combat achievements spread further across the continent.
Effects of faith decreased by 5%.
While roaming the desert, maximum health points is increased. Strength and stamina develop rapidly. ]
The job was an excellent combat type class.
They are often compared to the Martial Artist class that allows a wider range of skills, but extensive growth in the desert will lead to huge accumulation of strength and stamina.
A small side effect was the dark skin tan due to the blazing sunlight.
Weed snuck a question.
“Is there something else that you might want to tell me? Perhaps job classes… Or job classes. A worthy job class.”
“There is. The way I see it, you are the most skilled warrior in the desert. Too big a presence even for our tribe to bare.”
His senses that he developed through the years of Royal Road hit the mark.
Teppy pointed to the east with his scimitar.
“Ride the camel straight in that direction and you will come across the Altar of the Sun.”
“I’ve never heard about the Altar of the Sun.”
“It is a place held sacred by our tribe. Take this. You may only enter if you possess this Fragment of Sun.”
*Blink!*
[ You have obtained information about the Altar of the Sun.
The vast southern desert.
This is a place where the warriors that uphold the sun conduct their sacred ceremonies.
The most powerful warrior in the desert can be reborn into the Warrior of the Sun through this ceremony. ]
[ You have acquired Fragment of the Sun. ]
Weed grasped the fragment with his hand. The stone fragment was hot with peculiar symbols drawn on the surface.
“Identify!”
[ Fragment of the Sun : Durability 13/40.
This is fragment said to be a part of the sun.
Unknown power is sleeping within. ]
‘Hmm. It’s different. I did advance into the Warrior of the Sun in the past, but it wasn’t like this.’
During his days as the Great King, he battled to become more powerful without a moment to spare in looking over quests and findings.
He used fire skills as a Desert Warrior, and one day the advancement occurred all of a sudden with a notification saying that he had been enlightened about the power of the sun.
‘A ceremony to become the Warrior of the Sun. This is the real way. This feels like inheriting an official class with full fledged powers.’

chapters.title: Chapter 587: (585) Volume 54 7 - Half Elf Vishur (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Volume 54 Chapter 7 - Half Elf Vishur (Part 1)
While Weed was roaming in the southern desert region, the users were busy.
They went through data analysis and adventures in search of the Half Elf Vishur, knowing that any lead would make them famous.
- I am LeBoy, an adventurer. My current location is the Averian Forest, classified under the 10 forbidden territories.
I suspected from the beginning that the forest would be the location of Half Elf Vishur’s whereabouts. There were a few regions that I couldn’t enter back when I scouted Averian, so I came to check on them.
Then, I discovered the maze entrance under a huge tree with five-colored leaves.
I am uncertain if this is Zode, but it is massive and I have yet to figure out the exit.
The new post was responded with great interest of other adventurers.
- I am making my way there now.
- Brother… I shall be there soon.
- At last, new information!
Adventurers moved quickly to the Averian Forest.
The forest was one of the 10 forbidden territories, but it was located on the territory of the old Rasal Kingdom, frequently visited by warriors and adventurers.
The Jigolaths, Grapass, and Desert of Tranquility were cleared by Weed, and the forbidden territories were setting other adventurers into crazed ambition.
Posts continued for 3 consecutive days.
- I am inside the maze under the tree of five-coloured leaves. This place is very strange. The area is vast and the traps are high-class made of lumber. Unfortunately, almost all of the adventurers that I came with are dead.
- There are engravings of some sort on the walls. I thought them to be traps… But, they are vivid and beautiful. They seem to have been engraved with a sword.
- This is Haruna. There is a citrus scent that is barely noticeable unless you are an elf. It seems to lead to a path, but there are many monsters and traps. I’m pretty certain that an elf passed through this area.
- Adventurer Chase. I am reporting my findings for the last 2 days. The dungeon seems to be divided into 3 sections. Each section seems to be designed with distinct tracks that leads to the exit… So far, I found the exit to the first section.
Over a thousand famous adventurers in Royal Road made their way inside the maze. Weed was able to collect information while roaming the deserts, and meanwhile there continued to be reports of other mazes.
However, these mazes were cleared within 2 days or were found to be unrelated to Half Elf Vishur.
“As of now, the maze of the Averian Forest is most suspicious.”
Weed rode his camel to the east desert and arrived at the Altar of the Sun.
The Sun Fragment only grew hotter as he travelled through the barren sand hills until he reached a place where the land split apart like a fissure.
*Swaaaash!*
The desert split, revealing an altar with pure white pillars and stones.
The Fragment of the Sun and the altar were emitting light in unison.
*Blink!*
[ Great Discovery!
You are the first to discover the hidden relic of the desert, the Altar of the Sun.
This is a site of the warrior raised above the location where the intense heat of the sun dwells. There exists a legend that tells of the most outstanding desert warrior that goes through a ritual and obtains the power of the sun.
- Reputation increased by 5,550 from the adventure.
- You have gained a level.
- You discovered a hidden historical site. Unique experience grants 3 additional points of strength and agility.
- Reporting precious findings will result in additional rewards. ]
Altar of the Sun.
The sun was high up above the sky, and the sands around the altar were set aflame.
There were red, round boulders placed on the altar, each surrounded by warrior sculptures as if they were standing guard.
The sculptures had been chipped away by the winds and sand, barely retaining their forms.
[ The warrior who seeks the power of the sun. Stab through this boulder with your sword. ]
“I have come this far, and this better not be a trap.”
Weed examined the surroundings with great detail.
It was better safe than sorry!
The old altar seemed to be legitimate and the Sun Fragment reacted.
Moreover, the sculptures certainly had weathered away with time.
“Identify!”
[ A piece crafted long ago in unknown times.
It is instilled with the power of the sun.
It requires restoration due to damage by natural causes.
A treasure of the desert.
Artistic worth: 3,610 ]
“Alright. This is the real deal. Just to be safe though…”
Weed, prepared to escape at any time, pulled out the Loa Sword and stabbed through the boulder.
At that very moment!
The sun radiated blinding light and the fiery sands retreated in all directions.
With the altar in the center, flourishing light pillars took form, connecting the sky and the earth.
***
The scene of Weed advancing into the Warrior of the Sun was being broadcasted live through the broadcast stations.
- That’s crazy.
- Wow… I wonder what job class he is doing all that for?
- Isn’t it for the Warrior of the Sun? The job that is only bestowed to one person.
- Seems like it. Given the content of the quest and all…
The discussion boards of the broadcast stations were being bombarded.
The live chat rooms between viewers were raging.
- It looks like he’s trying to obtain the job that he had before. He has experience in it too.
- It may be his return to the days of the Great King of the Desert.
- Back then, he conquered the Central Continent in the era of war. I wonder what he’s going to conquer now?
- He wiped out just about all the opposing factions. All that is left is Kaybern.
- There are still some remnants of the Hermes guild. Seems like people forgot about them.
- I am looking forward to the war against the Black Dragon. At first I thought that we had no chance… but now, doesn’t he have a decent shot?
- As a person who converted jobs a lot… A job class change doesn’t make you extremely powerful. For the moment, you can’t do a decent job in anything.
- Sculptor Master, High Necromancer, Warrior of the Sun. This guy is truly walking the Royal Road.
- If he’s walking the Royal Road he must be near its end.
- As expected of Weed.
- I bet Bard Ray is going mad just watching this.
***
Bard Ray stood by the shoreline village in the Northern Continent for the Ironblood Warrior job class. He was diligently carrying out quests.
[ Gather the clam shells. ]
[ The mystery of the pearl. ]
[ The red conch. ]
[ Fishing memories. ]
‘What kind of quests are these?’
He had carried out many combat quests, but such miscellaneous errands were too particular and difficult for him.
“Human. I cut contact with the humans for ages. Ar-pen Empire? Is that a kingdom raised by humans?”
The Barbarians knew nothing about the Haven Empire nor the Arpen Empire.
The village was isolated, rendering Bard Ray’s reputation useless. He hurriedly called for adventurer Lantos from the Hermes Guild.
“Don’t worry. I will show you what an expert adventurer is capable of.”
Lantos was a user that trained under the ambitious support of the Hermes Guild.
The Hermes Guild was specialized in conquer and combat, but there were countless mystical existences laying dormant in the Central Continent.
Lantos was the best pick especially in excavating treasure or equipment.
“Do you have a knack for fishing? You have to catch the fish with yellow gills and blue scales.”
“For sure. I picked up a bit.”
“What’s the skill level?”
Lantos responded while scratching his cheek.
“Intermediate level 3. As you know, fishing is not an essential skill for an adventurer. Fishing is for fishermen and navigators that like to enjoy their time in relaxation.”
Adventurers were roamers of the continent.
Users like Chase and Spenson reached advanced levels on fishing. At a spectacular view, they sat idle and cast their fishing rods, easing away the tenseness from the adventure.
Lantos was also an adventurer, but he was an expert of search, excavation and trap disposal.
“Leave it to me. I will tell you what real adventures are like.”
They cast their lines for 3 straight days and managed to complete the quest.
The Barbarian amazon baked the fish in the bonfire as soon as she received them.
“That took quite the time. I don’t know if I’ll be able to recollect the taste from before.”
Sizzle-sizzle.
The fish was well on its way.
Bard Ray and Lantos blankly stared at the cooking fish.
If it was Weed, he would have sat beside her, humorously asking what the taste was like.
He would go the extra mile, offer his salt for cooking, disguising the plain, cheap salt as an expensive, special salt, only to retroactively charge her 200 gold for its use.
They spent two more days doing four quests, raising the friendliness to receive their next quest.
“If you’re a warrior, you have to experience difficult battles. Can you go to Romdal Island and defeat the monsters in the area?”
“That’s easy for me.”
Bard Ray received the quest with a calm tone.
‘The Ironblood Warrior appeared several times in history. They say he withstood against several dozen thousands of enemies.’
Bard Ray already mastered the Dark Knight and collected various secret sword techniques. He had confidence in his own skills.
‘I have enough offense. If I focus on defense, not one user will be able to defeat me. Weed is not my rival in a face-off battle. My ultimate goal will be to withstand the dragon.’
***
Weed moved to the Central Continent after advancing into the Warrior of the Sun.
His physical abilities and growth rate were reinforced when roaming in the desert, but he was too busy to stay in one region.
He also picked up ultimate skills such as the Blade of Demise, and the skill had such destructive power that other secret sword skills could not be compared.
[ You have entered an unknown dungeon.
This is the dungeon under the tree in Averian Forest.
The secrets of this place haven’t been revealed yet. Therefore, you must be careful.
Roaming around lost will lead to abrupt dangers.]
An unknown dungeon!
He arrived in expectation of finding Half Elf Vishur’s tracks.
A long-ear female user was waiting as he walked through the entrance.
“I’m Haruna. Nice to meet you. Weed-nim.”
“Yes. The pleasure is mine.”
“We adventurers uncovered half of the dungeon. I will lead you as far as I can.”
“Thanks.”
Dirt and tree roots covered the walls.
The dark cave was lit by bright crystal spheres set up on the ceilings and walls by the adventurers.
Haruna walked softly with the tip of her toes, but she was fast, being an elf.
“It’s such an honor for me that you are here.”
“I appreciate your assistance.”
“We can pass through the first section in about 25-minute walk. The tree roots shift after a certain time, so we must hurry while the path is open.”
“I am alright with walking faster.”
The majority of Elf users were beautiful.
Based on her real-life looks, she had a lean figure with clear skin.
Even so, he treated Haruna like she was a rock.
He saw Seoyoon day and night, so no other women felt attractive to him.
‘I don’t know if my sister can even hope of getting married…’
Yurin’s appearance made him worry about her future!
As they walked along, they encountered the other adventurers.
“Weed-nim! I’m Dante.”
“It’s been so long.”
“Haha. It’s so great that we get to venture together.”
He came across the adventurers in the maze and moved along with them.
Dante was envied and also was treated with jealousy just for having connections with Weed.
Having countless achievements in the Versailles Continent under his belt and rising to be the Emperor of the Arpen Empire put Weed’s reputation on a new level.

chapters.title: Chapter 588: (586) Volume 54 7 - Half Elf Vishur (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Volume 54 Chapter 7 - Half Elf Vishur (Part 2)
“This is the entrance to the second area.”
The place he arrived at with Haruna was entangled with tree roots.
It was a narrow passage for barely a single person or elf.
Once they got through it, the passageway became wider again, but no one could ever find it without paying close attention.
“From here on, we could not diffuse all the traps. Monsters spawn on occasion as well.”
The first area was cleaned out by the adventurers, but the second area was still in progress.
The adventurers scouted meticulously the countless branches of paths, looking for the way through.
“Chase-nim!”
“Oh… Weed-nim has arrived. Ha-ha-ha.”
He met up with adventurer Chase and began scouting the second area.
“I am drawing a map. This is a considerably large dungeon, but with a thousand users it should be finished by night time.”
“I see. I am grateful for your assistance in stopping Kaybern.”
“I will gladly take it upon myself. As an adventurer, I know very well how much Weed-nim went through for the Versailles Continent. You stepped forward to the difficult tasks when no one else could, like the Embinyu Cult, and even now you are under hardship trying to lead us all.”
A long compliment.
Anywhere he went, he was used to hearing such a level of praise.
‘I need to speak more humbly at a time like this.’
Weed moisturized his lips with his tongue.
“Hmm-hmm. I am merely doing what I wish to do. I thought I had to stop the Embinyu Cult for the people.”
“The world will be at peace if Weed-nim rules over the Versailles Continent.”
“Of course. People living in happiness is my goal.”
It wasn’t a complete lie.
It was just that his real objective was ripping off taxes from the happy folks.
He exchanged short greetings with adventurer Leboy and other famous users.
“Aren’t you exhausted?”
“It’s nothing. The dark, murky dungeons are my home. The scent of trees is pleasant and I have many friends at the beer parties I host often. Of course, as long as it doesn’t affect the adventures.”
The adventurers were sincerely enjoying confrontation with monsters and diffusing traps.
Each adventure was never guaranteed success, nor did they receive big rewards.
It was a job that could not be pulled off unless they themselves found passion in it.
“Moving forward, the Arpen Empire will greatly expand the quest rewards.”
“For real?”
“Yes. The excavations from historical sites and mines to various types of adventurers will be supported.”
Weed’s words held great weight to them.
It was difficult to go back on words once spoken, but he was absolutely certain that these adventurers will make him incentives beyond the investment.
‘They will fail at times. They will be rewarded if they succeed. But, failing has nothing to do with me.’
Successful stories make people forget the fear of failure and bare hope.
Great cities crumbled due to Kaybern’s activity, and regions that were invaded by monster invasions were going out of count.
Each broadcasting station was weary of the Versailles Continent’s demise, but there was a stir of unexpected change.
- This is Morata. I am running a fruit store. What is going on right now? I have to close by noon, by then the goods will be sold out.
- This is Puhol Waterpark. I thought this wasn’t the time for a party but… This is insane! The rich folks of the Central Continent are streaming in.
- All the cottages far from the waterpark are all sold. Further lot-outs are resulting a steep increase in price.
- You know the high quality equipment were released into the market after the Hermes Guild and the Haven Empire dipped following the Garnav Plains… I thought the market value of equipment would plummet, but it’s way high again.
- The dungeons and hunting grounds are cluttered with users.
- The cities are also very populated. There’s a swarm of people no matter where you go.
The cities were ruined and the natural disasters reduced crop production.
The haven-like Versailles Continent fell into great danger and chaos. However, the activity of users increased significantly.
- I can’t really explain it, but it seems like Royal Road has become more enjoyable.
- There’s so much I want to do and so much I have to be doing as well.
- The times are dangerous, but it’s great. I think I’ve gone a little crazy. Ha-ha.
The farmers tended to the crops and put their best efforts to reduce the damage from the black rain.
The merchants roamed the continent on their wagons and supplied the declining necessities. The users of other job classes became livelier as if they woke from a long sleep.
In the face of danger, people seemed to enjoy themselves even more.
They were actively out hunting, producing, collecting and enjoying vacations.
The cities were destroyed, but the users without a home weren’t necessarily gone for good.
Castle Evaluk and the Free City of Somren were being repaired by the local citizens and users.
“Morata was raised from ruins. We can do it too!”
“Let us stand again. The Arpen Empire will support us.”
The users refused to give up.
They would have laid low and quiet, doing their own thing at times of peace, but now they were building homes and constructing roads on the ruins.
Dain spent her entire savings and invested towards the restoration, news of which spread and the users that took goods out of the treasury came to return them.
“I would like it to be used for the restoration. I am not famous in any way, but I am a user of Evaluk.”
The power of the people was assembling and the Arpen Empire was growing exponentially despite the threat of Kaybern.
- Seoyoon: The income for the Arpen Empire has increased a lot this week.
The interstellar amount of investment committed by Seoyoon began taking effect in conjunction, forming a huge economic value.
Common villages advanced into cities with more than 30% increase in all kinds of production.
The roads were well set, and cities with large sums of land doubled their expansion of production.
There was quite a handsome amount of money that had been earned by the Central Continent users over some time.
Even though the Hermes Guild exploited them heavily, the money earned by users hunting and trading scaled and stacked up with time.
For a long time, they could only hide the money away from the tyranny of Haven Empire, but now they were bold in their spendings.
- Now is the time. Though it seems like a crisis… Once we get over this, the Arpen Empire will develop rapidly.
- As long as it’s not the great cities prone to the dragon. Just the medium cities. Especially the vacation spots, they’re worth the money.
- I am an expert real estate speculator. I never worked and lived off speculating all my life. This is the chance. A little too late and the prices will skyrocket. Then, I assure you that I won’t even be able to afford a hut.
- Transportation, hunting, trades. Invest in lands that are developed in all three. Land doesn’t lie.
The price of land was increasing exponentially even in the Central Continent.
The investment of the Arpen Empire surely sparked fire.
The funds that were suppressed up until now were being released at once and people were surprisingly very hopeful about the situation.
- Weed-nim will certainly defeat the dragon.
- He doesn’t have to. One city destroyed at a time… I can live with that.
- Let’s push forth with new cities. Construction at its finest!
- The dragon will have a limit too. I mean, how long will it take for it to destroy all the cities in the continent?
- It’s a given fact that more cities are being built than that are destroyed.
- Monsters too… Though they multiply, it’s not too bad once you get used to it. You can grow even faster by hunting. Cities will not be invaded in turn.
The users were growing used to the city destructions and monsters roaming in huge numbers.
- The Arpen Empire. Weed-nim is a development expert. So, our trust in him can go a long way.
- Even if a great city crumbles, the nearby regions develop even more. Overall, it’s a positive result.
- Stock market, coins. No need for all that. Your answer is Royal Road. There is no other place as fun and instantaneous in rewards.
- Looking at it long-term, it is definitely going onward and upward. Drive!
The users were investing passionately and were trouble-free in their growth.
The Haven Empire slowly fell apart, concerned with the declining tax income every month. The Arpen Empire was the exact opposite.
The large-scale investment and user activity increased tax income by 200% every week.
It was a recovery of tax income that suffered before, but now it was at an unbelievable level of growth.
Weed became excited and announced his development plans.
“I will construct 12 waterparks all across the continent. Skyscrapers? Great Landmarks? I will build all of them.”
He was different from the common politicians that threw a bunch of empty promises during elections.
Weed was a man who stuck to his word, and he was well prepared.
He conquered the buildings, vast plains, mountains, woods and fields near rivers that were owned by the Hermes Guild and took control for free.
It was all to promote development plans and increase real estate worth based on the incredible property assets under the empire.
Houses, cottages and hotel business increased the count of lot-out and the resulting funds could be re-invested into the empire.
As the people said, apart from the great cities prone to the dragon’s attack, medium cities of trades and transportation had a chance to develop greatly.
- The investment plan also covers the monster fortresses. I think he just blurted out without looking at the situation. Is he in his right mind?
- You don’t know what the higher-ups are thinking. If they eradicate the monsters, they can all turn into amusement parks.
- An awesome theme park.
- The people who know what Puhol used to be will have no doubt about the future.
- Do tourist attractions have much to it, really? It’s a tourist attraction if people can go and have fun. It doesn’t matter what it used to be.
- The plans for the volcanic island in the east sea is even crazier. This is a volcano that erupted last month.
- Wow… That’s going to be one decent springwell.
Weed never stopped to think that hunting diligently and establishing public security was all there was to governance.
“As the emperor, I have to plant dreams in their heads. So that the people can be hopeful.”
He reacted sensitively to the users’ change in attitude,resulting from the investment of the Arpen Empire.
He was also concerned about how to exploit the users even in the desert!
All the studies on real estate speculation became the foundation in his development plans.
“I am going to lure out the real estate investments. Once the massive funds are released, they will serve as the key to a rapid development of the empire.”
People do not hesitate to pull from their pocket for their fantasies.
The gut feeling that things will turn out well and you’ll be behind everyone else. The ache lower in the stomach is human psychology when you sense that your neighbor or your friends will earn good money.
“Happiness doesn’t come from the money that I have this instant. I can be happy knowing that there’s money streaming in from now on.”
It was all a political move that he hoped would pay off based on real estate!
A plan that will transform all the weakened cities into the glory of Royal Road’s early flourishing days.
The production will go up a notch and trades will occur much more frequently. Moreover, the users shall willingly step up to do something with their own hands.
“Governance doesn’t come from honesty or diligence.”
Weed thought that politicians who go by the book will never gain the trust of the people or succeed.
Any pep talk about honesty was rather painful to the ears.
Anyone can tell another to follow the rules and live with an honest attitude, and it makes it all the more annoying.
After all, where is the fun in the honest life!
“I will raise skyscrapers. Construct roads. The value of land will increase enormously, so hurry up and buy them!”
“Wahhh!”
“I will make sure that everyone can earn as much as they want.”
“Hurray, Weed!”
In the real world, the side effects of real estate was immense.
When house values are going up, it is synonymous for the construction business as well and more job opportunities. However, the higher house values can become a burden for the average person.
If they worked all their lives and saved the money and we’re still unable to buy a house, they would be bound for grievance.
Even the government could not meddle with housing price!
“When it gets to that, I can tax them for property ownership as an excuse to reduce house prices.”
Politicians also knew that increasing property tax had a huge effect, but they simply could not do so.
Bluntly speaking, even if they do proceed, the money will not be their own, therefore it was a difficult policy to pull off. However, the emperor of the Arpen Empire was Weed!
He promoted real estate, causing a huge boom of investment into the development of the empire. Then, the money from increased tax income will all be his own.
The gullible investors that will jump in for the hope of earning some money, will be ripped off here and there!
“Economic development will revolve around me. Yup. That’s the way it will be.”

chapters.title: Chapter 589: (587) Volume 54 7 - Half Elf Vishur (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Volume 54 Chapter 7 - Half Elf Vishur (Part 3)
“We did it!”
The entrance to the second area of the maze was successfully cleared before nightfall, thanks to the efforts of the adventurers.
The third area was far bigger with monsters and traps waiting.
“Can Weed-nim take the lead from this point?”
LeBoy asked carefully.
The adventurers led the exploration, but they were ready to become supports.
They wished to see the skills of Weed, the best adventurer in the history of Royal Road!
“Mmm…”
Weed was not entirely confident that he could outdo the best adventurer group in the Versailles Continent.
‘A maze… Mazes cause a lot of problems, but to my surprise, the solutions were often in simple places.’
In other cases, doors never opened without the possession of an item that acted as the key.
‘I could step forward and solve this, but is there a need for me to do that with over a thousand adventurers here?’
There was a time and place to act out.
It was a waste of talent to leave these adventurers of various exploration skills and experiences.
Weed wet his lips with the attentive gazes of the adventurers.
“Your accomplishments brought us this far. I have faith in all of you, so I will wait as long as it takes.”
“…!”
“I expected nothing less!”
A few words of acknowledgement.
Though it is small, some put their lives on the line for the ones that put faith in them.
“I understand. I will do it.”
“Me too.”
The adventurers blazed up for competition.
They set out on to clearing the third area and ran the risk of danger. Weed returned to the monster eradication forces that patrolled between Central and the Northern Continent.
The archers and mages catching their breath during their meal were dazzled.
“He’s back already…”
“I want to go back to school now.”
“This is worse than overtime at work.”
“Ooof, my back.”
Weed could not slack on the job given the broadcast that was monitoring him all day long.
Two straight days!
After that, the adventurers succeeded in clearing the maze.
- Haruna: This place was maze Zode! I found the Half-elf Vishur right now. She has been turned into a dried-up tree.
Weed returned to the maze through Yurin’s Paint Teleportation instantaneously.
Over a thousand adventurers were put into this maze, and over two hundred lost their lives due to a risky but swift exploration. However, they died honorably with a smile on their faces.
“I heard that there is an unbelievable special for today?”
“You got it. The adventurers that set out to stop the Black Dragon Kaybern. The very adventurers who are in search of the Half-elf hero Vishur succeeded in exploring the maze in Averian Forest.”
“I heard the continent’s best adventurers went on with the exploration.”
“As you have seen through the live cast, the brave adventurers overcoming the traps and the monsters inevitably caused the viewers to grin in anticipation.”
“Alright, then. Here is Weed who has just arrived at the maze.”
Maze Zode’s exploration, without a doubt, was being broadcasted live on the major broadcast stations.
Weed was led by the adventurers until he found the sword scars on the wall.
“What are these?”
“We’ve been doing some research ourselves, but we don’t know yet. It is definitely not a map, and neither the archaeologists nor glyph analysisits returned anything.”
“Hmm. The sharp traces seems to be just simple sword swings.”
Weed saw that the sword traces were visible on both walls, the floor and the ceiling.
He stood there for a good minute or two and got lost in his thoughts, then abruptly shifted his hands onto the Loa sword.
*Slaaaang!*
With a sound of purity, the sword slipped out of the sheath.
“Let me look around for a bit.”
“What? Oh, yes, of course.”
The adventurers were clueless, but they stepped back.
“Is it right around here?”
Weed stood at where the sword path began and started to swing his sword.
It was a difficult task to execute a complete sword technique based solely on the traces on the walls, floor and ceiling.
Without an incredible spatial understanding and swordsmanship, it was impossible to pull off.
*Swish-Sheeek!*
Weed’s sword followed through a beautiful trajectory like it was dancing.
Of course, he had no clue to the stance of the sword technique, but his body synced itself to the flow of the sword.
*Blink!*
[ You have learned the sword technique of Half-elf Vishur.
You have learned the secret technique, Sword of Regeneration.
This sword technique, born from observing nature has excellent abilities in defense and recovery.
When active, maximum health points are increased by 250%.
Physical recovery is enhanced in locations imbued with the power of nature.
Defense is increased by the influence of the nearby plants.
With each skill level, health points of the user and allies recover 20% faster to a maximum of 800%.
All effects are doubled for elves. ]
The secret sword technique was an unexpected gain.
‘Now it becomes a lot easier to withstand boss monsters. When things go bad, I can spread out the Sword of Regeneration and buy time. With that being said, that’s not my style.’
Even so, he thought there were many uses for it.
If he was to drop in the middle of a massive horde of monsters, he could hold his ground with the Sword of Regeneration.
It would give him time to stack lots of corpses for an explosion or summon the undead!
‘It is an excellent sword technique for devious plans.’
Weed couldn’t be any happier.
“T-That sword technique was truly beautiful.”
Adventurer Chase blurted out in surprise.
The nearby adventurers had their jaws dropped with blank stares as if they had just witnessed something unreal.
Weed replied like it was no big deal.
“It called the Sword of Regeneration.”
“Sword of Regeneration? Is that a skill?”
“Yes. The secret of the sword technique was right here.”
Weed’s words fed straight through broadcast and brought a massive, hurricane-like impact.
“Secret Sword Technique. That is insane.”
“Coordinates are there. I am picking that up ASAP.”
“Wow… He discovered the secret sword technique and learned it instantaneously.”
“Did it take like 5 minutes total?
“See it. Observe it. Obtain it.”
“That is swag. That’s Weed level!”
However, the following scenes on the screen turned the viewers miserable.
In maze Zode, there was a cluster of adventurers which each had a name for themselves in Versailles Continent.
The average level was over 300, and the users in 400’s became the center. There were adventurers in the 500’s as well.
Those adventurers’ eyes popped out after hearing the secret sword technique and immediately tried to imitate him.
“So, this is like…”
“Uh-hm. Why is it so difficult?”
The adventurers awkwardly swung their swords and wobbled.
It was near impossible to recreate the sword technique just by observing the markings on the walls like Weed did.
One moment of distraction and the sword will lose its way. Moreover, it was no ordinary technique balancing shift in the lower body, waist and shoulders.
“To do this in a single try just by looking…He’s a monster.”
“That makes no sense. He’s just so gifted.”
“No wonder he beat even Bard Ray.”
The adventurers couldn’t do anything other than to look at him with envious eyes in agreement.
“Let us hurry.”
Weed moved on gracefully, and his mundane response became a sensation on the live broadcast.
“For Weed-nim, Sword of Regeneration could be just that…” “That man right there is the God of War. Do not forget. Write it down.” “Wasn’t he already powerful enough with his Undead Summoning? Seriously, he has the highest combat level…” “The higher the level, the easier it is for the holy knight to beat the necromancers. It’s ultimately just based on effectiveness. The stronger the power of dark magic and the undead, the more holiness the knights can bring out.”
Honestly, the holy knights were waiting for a mission to taking down Weed.
Holy knights receive god’s blessing and additional stats when they defeated evil powers.
The effects of holiness were immense, allowing them to take down undead two tiers higher than themselves.
“So, who is the holy knight that can win against Weed?” “That’s the loophole.” “There is none…” “Just exactly which holy knight will charge at Weed? Wow… He has my sincerest respect for his courage.” “Penetrating through the army of skeletons, just to encounter zombies… Behind all that are Durahan, screaming ghosts, death knights, doom knights and even the bone dragon. After defeating all that, the final boss is Weed.”
Jean did an interview too. “We are necromancers, but he is Weed. Even in this very moment, he is becoming more powerful.” “He is hunting non-stop after Kaybern’s appearance. He is never satisfied with his mediocre level. I bet that in the future, he will be capable of summoning the legendary undead.” “Well, the funny thing is that he is now a warrior. This continent is fortunate that he didn’t continue to level as a necromancer.”
Weed continued to walk and scouted the surroundings, but no more sword markings were found. ‘Hmm. That’s a shame.’ Difficult mazes often had hidden treasures or secrets. Now that a secret sword technique was uncovered, there wasn’t anything else left. “Over here.”
At the end of the maze led by the adventurer, was the half breed of human and elf, the Half-elf Vishur, who was transformed into a dense, dry tree.
“Not even the priest’s restoration spell could wake her. We are thinking that it may need some kind of treasure or clue.”
Haruna explained the situation, but Weed had a lead of his own in his head.
‘That’s simple. The Sword of Regeneration that I picked up in this maze would be the key.’
There was no need to think of alternatives when he had a solution that required just a little bit of thought.
“I think I know how to proceed.”
Weed drew his sword and began wielding it around.
He was going to recreate the sword technique inscribed on the walls.
It wasn’t easy remembering the path of the sword, but he took a look around just before.
Like musicians recreating the scores in their head, he did the same with the flow of the sword.
A gentle sword technique that cut through the wind.
Despite only have done it once, the movements became more natural with harmony in strength and speed.
It was a level of skill reached with not just battles against monsters, but also consistent training of sword movement.
Blink!
[ You are re-enacting the Sword of Regeneration. ]
- Sword of Regeneration ranked up to Novice level 2.
The attack power of the sword technique is enhanced.
Health points of the user and allies are recovered 20% faster.
Skill proficiency is increasing at a rapid rate.
- Insight is increased by 5.
Sword of Regeneration was a skill and a sword technique.
Executing the sword technique consisting of a set of movements raised the skill level.
Weed noticed Vishur in the form of a tree slowly coming to life and continued the sword technique.
The sword technique was cast the second and third time, the sword path becoming even more elegant.
Blink!
[Sword of Regeneration ranked up to Novice level 3.]
[Sword of Regeneration ranked up to Novice level 4.]
It was still at a novice level and didn’t have significant meaning, but indeed the skill was leveling up rapidly.
Half-elf Vishur regained her health points and slowly opened her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 590: (588) Volume 54 8 - The Plan of the Dwarves (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Volume 54 Chapter 8 - The Plan of the Dwarves (Part 1)
“That is my sword technique.”
Weed stopped the swing of his sword and walked closer to the Half-elf.
“You are right.”
