Volume 56 Chapter 8 - The End Of The Quest (Part 1)
“As I thought, the next target is Morata.”
Weed returned to the secret storage of Agoldia.
From here on out, time was of the essence!
The dwarven warriors were ready after sufficient rest; Kracore, the final boss of the dungeon remained.
Aid was supplied by the Mapan Council in order to defeat Kracore.
Weed took out a green bottle and applied it to the Loa sword.
“Put this liquid on your weapons. The more the better.”
“What is this?”
“What an awful stench. Is it poison? Using poison in battle is a disgrace to dwarves.”
Brockhand and the dwarves rejected the idea.
Their pride as dwarven warriors could not accept such a tactic.
The players of the Mapan Council who came to deliver supplies watched in concern.
The obstinance of dwarves wasn’t easy to break.
Weed grinned.
“This isn’t poison.”
“Then?”
“This is made from Upulechika leaves. It prevents the cell regeneration of Kracore and destroys them.”
“Ah, it was a flower?”
The dwarves acknowledged it begrudgingly and rubbed the green liquid on their weapons.
“Just like that? It convinced them?”
“What? How is that different from poison? It’s the same thing.”
Upulechika was a beautiful but vile poisonous herb.
It was a plant that only grew in the deep swamps of Tulen.
For typical monsters, its effects were mild paralysis, but for specific monsters, the paralysis was boosted significantly.
“I have to hand it to him, I almost got convinced too.”
“Honestly, same. His brazen tone of speech made me accept it.”
“That’s Weed-nim. They say that even Mapan-nim learned the basics of trade from Weed-nim.”
Weed led the dwarves quickly into the room of Kracore.
“If it gets too dangerous, trust your comrades and back away. We must face Kaybern. We cannot die in a lowly place like this.”
“I got it.”
“Everyone, be careful.”
The final boss!
Weed took the nervous dwarf warriors to the final boss room.
Kracore was a 55-meter tall lump of growths.
The space was large as a town square with dwarven crafted equipment scattered all over the floor.
< Primal fear!
You have encountered a being of overwhelming power. >
< You feel overwhelmingly intimidated. Terror has instilled into your mind.
Your Willpower and Spirit withstand it. >
Weed’s fighting spirit remained unhindered unless he was under a presence like a dragon, so nothing felt special.
Though the dwarves were considerably weary.
‘It looks like a clump of flesh. But it is an incredible creature. And we still have to face Kaybern in a few days…’
The pink, round cell chunk even seemed a little adorable.
- I have waited for ages. New visitors.
- You all will become a part of me.
From the body of Kracore split cell masses the size of knuckles which developed quickly into the forms of the ferocious beasts that roamed Agoldia.
- Go!
On Kracore’s command, the predators sprang from the ground!
Beasts four to five meters tall charged fearlessly forward.
“Defense formation!”
Weed ordered the dwarves who formed a line of defense with the room entrance behind them.
“Hoorah!”
“Lift your shields! Strike down with your hammers!”
The dwarves put their shields forward and built a protective wall. Not a moment later, the sharp claws and body slams rammed against it.
“Dwarves. Pull out your swords, spears, and shields!”
“The greatness of our kind!”
“Kracore. I will avenge our kin, who were sacrificed for your wretched conduct!”
The dwarf warriors roared as they clashed their sword and shield against one another.
A powerful buff that shrouded their comrades!
“We will lure one at a time and take it out.”
“Fend them off comrades! Shield battalion!”
Weed observed the status of the dwarves, but even without his meticulous command, they seemed to be able to hold their own against the creatures of Agoldia.
The beasts empowered by Kracore were constantly evolving.
Their size kept growing and so did their power, but it was still manageable for the dwarves to hunt.
Kyaaarrgh!
Gwwaaaak!
With each swing, the animals screamed.
They were savages created from the cells of Kracore and therefore possessed heightened defense and recovery, but at the same time, they were severely affected by their greatest weakness - poison.
‘Kracore. Cell-type monster. It takes its own cells to create monsters. Most attacks to its main body are absorbed.’
Some people said that Kracore was able to recreate any monster it had absorbed once before.
It could easily produce Wyverns, griffins, and even giants.
Once it neutralized the opponents, it latched onto them. It stole their bodies and exercised terrifying control over them.
Since Kracore was the ruler of Agoldia, there was a lot of data about the monster that was preserved.
- We, the Levenche Guild will be the first to hunt Kracore!
It was before the Hermes Guild united the Central Continent.
The Levenche Guild with a mediocre reputation attempted the raid during their Agoldia adventure and were massacred.
They had no clue that Kracore was so powerful. They were dragged away by the predators and monsters and were consumed by the main body.
In reality, there were reasonable suspicions that Kracore pretended to be weak in order to lure prey, hence baiting the Levenche Guild.
‘This one is clever. It doesn’t die easily which makes it even trickier.’
The danger of Kracore had just begun.
Just a portion of its body could reproduce the cells into an enormous army.
The 55 meters of flesh meant that it had the ability to reinforce units endlessly.
Moreover, bigger lumps of cells could reproduce highly advanced monsters.
‘It isn’t the boss monster of Agoldia for no reason. For now, it is trying to wear out the dwarves in a dragged out battle.’
Its intentions were quite obvious.
It did not want to spend more cells and therefore planned to exhaust the dwarves and feed on them one by one.
‘There are two ways to victory. Keep defeating the cell army and weaken the main body, or go straight for it instead.’
Weed assessed that he could not afford to spend any more time before the fight against Kaybern.
“Sword of Radiance!”
He slipped between the dwarves and advanced with rays of light.
“Weedhand!”
“It’s dangerous. Return quickly!”
Weed ignored their concerns and pushed forward rapidly.
“Krrng!”
“Kwaaagh!”
The beasts pounced from all directions.
Slash!
Weed passed through the dimensional gate and swung his sword.
He pooled all his Art stats into Strength with Sculptural Destruction and attacked with venomous poison applied.
Fever, paralysis, confusion, bleeding: a four-piece set!
The poison was even more powerful than the one he offered to the dwarves.
“Team 1, 2, 3, and 4. Charge while maintaining defense formation!”
The dwarves with shields up ran further.
“Team 5 to 20. Scatter and engage in skirmishes. The target is the main body of Kracore!”
“Hoooyah!”
The dwarves clustered in defense spread at once.
Weed saw his chance, despite the numerous beasts and protective forces remaining.
Weed thought of his days as the Great King of the Desert.
‘These dwarves have high defense. They will survive just about anything.’
He threw his subordinates into the middle of battle. The survivors only became stronger than before!
< You have slain Cell Logger. >
The Loa sword cut down the beasts cleanly, however, the corpses with their cell core intact revived as smaller and weaker forms. The Kracore cells transformed into goblins and dwarves.
“You cannot defeat us.”
“Kracore-nim will absorb all of you and attain more power.”
Weed looked at them and clicked his tongue.
“Having to kill them over and over. So annoying.”
They had the appearance of goblins and dwarves, but their bodies were tainted blue.
The poison had taken effect.
“I have no time to meddle with you scum.”
Weed travelled between dimensional gates and broke through enemy boundaries ever so lightly. Each spatial travel was intercepted by a rapid beast attack, but he ignored or deflected them and sprinted full speed towards Kracore.
- Defend!
Kracore was cowardly.
It avoided fighting firsthand and also feared being attacked and losing cells!
Due to its massive size, escape was not an option.
“Sword Charge!”
Weed activated a warrior skill and slashed through the animals with pure strength.
He bypassed the monsters in a split second and arrived before Kracore.
“Sword Cloning Skill!”
Weed’s body multiplied into 50 copies as he activated his skill.
“Holy Fire.”
Froom.
All the clones ruthlessly slashed Kracore’s body with flaming swords.
- Kuuuuuaaarrrgh!
The colossal cell clump was set ablaze and screamed painfully.
“Radiant Sword!”
Weed did not hesitate as his clones were dissipated by the savage beasts and cut down with a blazing sword.
- This pain…! I cannot bear it.
The cells of the giant Kracore split into lumps and turned jet black.
It was an indication of an insane monster about to come forth!
“I will slice you into pieces so you can never divide.”
- Dwarves! You will all be absorbed by me!
***
- Battle between Weed and Kracore!
- Amazing. Was Weed this powerful?
The broadcast stations were live streaming Weed’s battle.
Undivided attention was focused on Morata where the fate of the continent was to be decided. Furthermore, Weed’s adventures guaranteed high viewer count.
Kracore became seven spiders with 32 legs, known to be troublesome even among monsters of Agoldia.
Weed cut down the spider webs and engaged intensely with them.
- Oh Joowan-ssi. Weed-nim wielding the flaming sword looks very spectacular.
- He utilizes skills whenever he needs them, but he can fight well with just basic sword techniques. This is his forte.
- Isn’t proficiency with weapons a common trait among high-level players?
- Weed is on another level. His skills are to the extreme. His understanding and strategy in battle is the pinnacle of his field.
- He won even against Bard Ray-nim, officially making him the most powerful player.
- I think God Warrior Bard Ray still has an edge in terms of basic combat abilities… But Weed did not miss an opening and exploited it.
Oh Joowan tried to comment on Weed’s battle like he always did. But something was off.
He swung the sword and moved much more lightly, turning the battle into a comfortable one.
He slipped past the swift movement of the spiders and their spewing attacks of poison and webs and countered. Do Chanmi also realized it.
- It might sound strange, but his swordsmanship is so choreographed. Weed-nim seems so relaxed. Could it be that even Kracore is a breeze for him?
- It doesn’t seem that way. Kracore is truly formidable. They have been in battle for over an hour now.
- Ah! The attacks are like a tide…
- Cells separated from Kracore’s body and turned into monsters once again. This situation is difficult to describe. Cockroaches the size of rhinos? Those things are charging at Weed all at once
The commentators concentrated on the footage. It looked that Kracore’s army was unstoppable, but Weed was slipping out craftily.

chapters.title: Chapter 641: Volume 56 8 - The End Of The Quest (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Volume 56 Chapter 8 - The End Of The Quest (Part 2)
The battle against Kracore waged on.
The monster was tenacious and putrid, but with each exchange, it lost more cells.
Whenever Weed attacked, it lost portions of its army and its main body, slowly weakening over time.
- Losing my body like this… It’s infuriating… Still, I cannot lose to the likes of you!
“You were pretty persistent. But it wasn’t good enough.”
In the extensive battle, he discovered Kracore’s weakness.
Fire, poison and divine power. Weed was able to slowly force the monster to confront him directly.
Weed was prepared every step of the way and with each sword attack, a part of Kracore’s cells burned away completely.
The dwarves, also backed away from the confrontation, scrambling for purchase on floor that was slippery from the stray cells of Kracore.
- Mortal Explosion!
In the brink of danger, the cells on the ground latched on and attempted to absorb him, forcing him to retaliate with his skills.
“Sandstorm of Ruins!”
The final skill of the desert warrior.
The room was spacious, having been the final boss room, but the skill was nevertheless extremely dangerous to use inside a dungeon.
“Everyone on defense!”
“Fall back!’
The dwarves raised their shields and huddled low. Their equipment was arranged with high magic resistance in preparation for the dragon.
Even so, the damage still inflicted that remained only barely tolerable.
The ground split apart and the sandstorm brewed.
With Kracore at the center, the storm swept the surroundings and knocked away the cell monsters.
“Sword of Regeneration!”
After the end of the storm, Weed activated the Sword of Regeneration and focused on defense and recovery with the dwarves.
< God Warrior Batali’s blessings are bestowed upon you.
20% of lost health points are recovered.
Health recovery is increased and you become immune to pain.
Armor penetration will be based on the damage inflicted on the enemy! >
God warrior Batali’s blessing applied when it became available.
Kracore gradually dried out over 10 hours of battle.
Weed reflected upon himself just as the battle came to an end.
‘There was a lack of attack power. Kracore’s physical defense was especially high. The dwarves didn’t get to commit fully… But I had no choice but to drag it out. We won this with the god’s blessings and equipment.’
If he had led a mage force against Kracore, the battle would have been swell.
Magical attacks would have froze and burned away the cells, dealing serious damage.
He did not get the chance to use necromancy, but he felt the need to learn more combat skills for a variety of situations.
‘In that aspect, it is true that the Hermes Guild is strong overall.’
In the fight against the dragon, the best of both the sword and magic were to be mobilized.
Excluding the dwarf warriors, there were a swarm of players who wished to participate and was likely not to be an elongated battle.
‘If we fight with the dragon as long as we did here, there won’t be much left of Morata.’
At last, Weed gifted Kracore its eternal rest.
< Agoldia’s past overlord, Kracore has been vanquished.
You have gained a level.
Great combat achievement increased reputation by 5,230.
Charisma increased by 2.
Strength increased by 2.
Perseverance increased by 3. >
“Urgh. That was a tough fight.”
“Still, you are amazing, Weedhand!”
“I knew you had this.”
Weed tended to the dwarves after the fight.
The fight with Kracore’s monsters resulted in 15 casualties!
4 among the lost were drained by Kracore and lost health points and Strength.
“We have to treat the badly wounded first.”
Weed wrapped bandages with the other dwarves.
They were tough warriors and if they didn’t die at the end of battle, they survived in most cases.
Kracore left an ingredient for a rare potion that permanently increased maximum health points by 3,000.
There was no other loot, but that alone was sufficient!
He was able to recover the dwarven made equipment as well.
Blink!
<The Lightning Crown complete.
The secret storage of Agoldia created for future insurance has been recovered by the dwarves.
The heavily equipped dwarves will no longer fear Kaybern.>
< 15 dwarves died. Additional rewards are applied!
Maximum health points of all dwarves increased by 7%. >
Weed’s attention was fixated on the crown decorated with jewels.
It was behind Kracore which kept stealing his gaze in the midst of battle.
Finally, he obtained the Lightning Crown into his possession.
“Hoo… It is done. Identify!”
< Lightning Crown: Durability: 110/110. Defense: 79.>
The dwarves excavated the jewels of power, lightning and dominance from the deepest layers of the earth.
“This power is too risky for us to keep in our hands.”
“No, it gives us a chance to free ourselves from the dragon’s oppression.”
Long ago, the blacksmiths gathered the powers sealed inside the jewels and forged the crown.
“Now will we be able to confront Kaybern?”
“It’s not enough. We need the artifact of our kind, the Brazier of Sacrifice.”
“The brazier… is not within our reach.”
“Unfortunately, this crown must be kept away in secret until the day we find it.”
“Where do we hide it?”
“Deep underground.”
< You have recovered the Lightning Crown hidden away by the dwarves.
Requirement: Dwarves only.
Level 1,190. >
< Savior of the dwarves.
Attribute: Maximum health points, mana and stamina doubled.
Physical recovery rate increased 300% during battle.
Combat abilities unaffected by severe wounds.
The first wearer is permanently granted 30 points in all stats.
Grants a shield that negates up to 800,000 ranged damage.
Grants the title ‘Leader of Dwarves’.
Nullifies Dragon Fear in a 30 meter radius.
Exhausting the three jewels in the crown will bring new abilities. >
< Jewel of Strength.
Grants 2,000 Strength for a day.
Max damage of all skills enhanced by 50%.>
< Jewel of Lightning.
Summon the most powerful lightning in exchange for health points.
Movement speed increased by 250%.
< Jewel of Dominance.
Enhances physical abilities of the user and nearby dwarves by 30%.
Leadership over dwarves reaches maximum level.
No longer intimidated by the dragon. >
“This is just amazing.”
Weed’s time invested in recovering the crown was well worth it.
If it weren’t for the dwarves-only restriction, it would have been one of the best items to ever exist.
One of the dwarf warriors spoke.
“Weedhand. The warriors will be waiting for battle. You are worthy of leading us all. Binehand-nim, the respected elder has the flag of retaliation. Pay a visit.”
< Obtain the Flag of Retaliation!
Visit Binehand, the dwarf elder who has been waiting for a long time and find the flag with 67 mountain peaks.
All dwarves across the continent must be assembled for the fight against Kaybern.
Difficulty: Race Quest
Requirement: Dwarf.
Reward: Flag of Retaliation. >
“I understand.”
Weed accepted the quest lightheartedly. However, he was not interested in any more race quests. Simple quests he could complete, but he had to let go of time consuming quests.
Gathering the warriors from each village would take a great length of time.
- Mapan: Weed-nim, congratulations on the quest completion. I have confirmed the intel from Knatul and Malin.
“Where are they?”
- Mapan: First, Knatul is in the northern glacial region.
***
Weed exited the dwarf secret storage and used Yurin’s Paint Teleportation Skill. He travelled as far north as he could and rode on Wy-3 who was waiting for him.
“Let’s make haste.”
- Kuaaat. Where to?
“Just keep flying north. No thinking involved.
- What’s going on?
“You have to keep flying until you pass out. Don’t worry though. I need to use you for so much more. I won’t let you die.”
- Kuaaat!
Wy-3 fought against the cold winds and flew north like a bullet.
Then Wy-3 became exhausted and he had to transfer to Bingryong.
“Take good care of the dwarves for me.”
- Pale: Yes. I will wait for you at Morata.
The dwarves inside the secret storage were to be taken to Morata by the assault squad and the Mapan Council.
Once Weed arrived at the cold glacial region, the avian guides greeted him.
- Bodam : This way, Weed-nim!
A sparrow wearing a thick fur coat led the way.
They encountered an ice village of barbarians living on the white snow plains.
“We are here.”
Weed riding on Bingryong arrived at the sky of the barbarian village.
On the ground were the barbarians with spears looking surprised.
- The temperature is just right. I like this place.
Bingryong watched over the snow field pleasantly.
“I heard that the glacial storm brews in the east.”
- I wish to go. I like cold places.
“Take a trip once we are done. Cool your body off.”
- Thanks, master.
The weary barbarians had large halberds, hammers and throwing spears in their hands.
Weed slowly descended towards the village entrance with Bingryeong.
“Human! This place is prohibited.”
They were closed off against outsiders.
The barbarians were about to break out any moment, but soon the half-elf Vishur appeared on Wy-2 and they dropped their guard.
- Gwaat!
Wy-2, who brought Vishur, wore a fur coat but the coat was covered with fresh ice.
- Master. I’m about to pass away.
“I’m here. You won’t die in a place like this.”
Weed started a sizable campfire with holy fire. Wy-2 wobbled closer and warmed up.
“I’m the only one who cares for you, do you see?”
- Thanks. I thought I was dead for sure.
“The one who cares for you in your most difficult time is your lifesaver. Be good to me.”
- I got it. Gwaat.
Wy-2 rubbed against him as a show of affection.
Meanwhile, Vishur conversed with the barbarians.
“In accordance with our historic pact, we wish to combine our powers to face Kaybern.”
“The shackles of our tribe…”
“After we defeat Kaybern, I will help you no matter the sacrifice.”
“So be it.”
The 3 meter tall barbarian hero Knatul agreed to join forces.
The information on the fairy knight Malin was lacking, but the fairy world was small.

chapters.title: Chapter 642: Volume 56 8 - The End Of The Quest (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Volume 56 Chapter 8 - The End Of The Quest (Part 3)
Haruna confirmed based on the report on fairies from Stain, an adventurer.
“They appear when you drink flower wine made with a special recipe at a place with great scenery. The deeper the scent, the more likely they are to come bearing gifts for the honest and reputable players.”
Weed returned with Vishur and Knatul to a small lake near Morata and drank flower wine.
One, two, three glasses.
They fished and sewed while drinking and soon they noticed a peculiar sound.
Buzz-buzz.
“You there. That is some fine drink.”
Malin of the fairies arrived like a fly.
“The revenge that will not subside with time. Kaybern is on the move.”
“I will gladly fight.”
He too decided to join the Half-elf Vishur.
< Find companions of war complete. >
Barbarian Knatul.
Fairy knight Malin.
Upon a historical promise, they joined the fight against Black Dragon Kaybern.
Human, Half-elf, Barbarian, Fairy knight.
The heroes of four nations shall share the same fate.
< The quest rewards +4 to all stats. >
< Reputation increased by 10,000. >
The quest was finally complete!
It was rather simple but it was a quest that could only be accomplished with specific information.
The four heroes gathered to defeat the dragon.
Fairy knight Malin enveloped himself with a mystical light and spoke.
“To confront the dragon, we have to stop its magic.”
Barbarian Knatul continued.
“Is that possible?”
“There are several methods. If you consume secret potion that can only be forged at the Fairy Lake, you can reduce the amount of magic damage you take.”
“We must scavenge them.”
“I know the recipe. But the Fairy Lake is overtaken by the demons. We must gather the materials and head to the lake.”
Blink!
< The secret potion of Sabrina Lake.
The curious fairies created many arcane items.
One boasted of above all was the potion that granted resistance against magic!
With it, the player can withstand the most powerful magic spells.
The recipe requires 32 different materials.
Barny’s Red Medicinal Herb, Stone of Alaksium, Moss of the Green Skull, Coral of Turtle Island, Crescent Moon of Kundan, White Fox Tail, Snail Shell of Nemo…
Find all these ingredients and chase out the demons from the Fairy Lake.
Malin will craft the secret potion.
Difficulty: Crafting quest.
Reward: Secret Potion of Magic Resistance.
Quest requirement: Enter the fairy world. Must be guided by a fairy knight. >
Weed sent a whisper message instantly.
“Mapan-nim, how many of these can you find?”
- Mapan: Coral of Turtle Island? I can get this with pirates and divers. I heard the snail shell is extremely rare… I have one or two in stock. Hold on. I will ask if there’s more.
Mapan being a merchant was knowledgeable about countless ingredients.
- Mapan: Moss of the Green Skull can be found in infected corpses. Bahabam dungeon. They are found in that location only on days with the thickest fog. Many of these items only drop once every month. I expect it will take about 3 months to find the other ingredients.
“What if we purchase them from other players?”
- Mapan: I wonder if the Hermes Guild has any of them in stock. Anyhow, items like the Crescent Moon of Kundan aren’t well known, and other items drop at a drastically low rate even in boss monster raids. I can even see ones without a known origin.
“So we can’t collect them all in a week’s time.”
- Mapan: 3 months would be enough to search the entire continent thoroughly. The assault squad can provide assistance as well.
Weed regrettably assessed that the Savior quest had to be put on hold.
‘The squad will be a great help, but I guess I will have to do without them.’
Even if they collected all the ingredients, they still had to take over the lake from the demons.
From this point on, he decided to prioritize the battle against Kaybern over the Savior quest.
***
The Earth Shadow party succeeded in transporting the World Tree to the Central Continent.
“Thank you, Pale-nim.”
“It’s nothing. It had to be done.”
The squad led by Pale protected them from the skies.
Huge mobs of monsters swarmed the party at times, but Weed insisted.
- Weed: Please succeed with this quest.
It was highly possible that Kaybern was linked to the Elven race quest.
That being said, even if the elven warriors joined forces, it would be difficult to assemble them on time at Morata.
Still, if the World Tree was to root properly and bring more elves into the world, the benefits would be massive.
Prospering forests and increased yield of delicious fruits alone was already a jackpot!
Elrix was to plant the World Tree again and that was at one of the forbidden locations, in proximity of the Aberian Forest.
The border of Tulen and Rasal!
Elrix dug deep into the ground with a shovel.
“I will plant it now.”
“Hold on. I don’t know if it’s necessary, but it might do some good for the tree.”
Ben poured the special fertilizer that he bought from the merchants.
“I put in plenty.”
The sapling of the World Tree was planted.
It was quiet for a few seconds, but soon the tree branches began climbing to the sky.
The rich branches spread wide and the roots pushed deeply underground.
The nearby scenery transformed accordingly.
The dry grass turned green and flowers bloomed.
The soft winds carried fresh aromas.
Red, white, evergreen.
Flowers of various colors and trees if many kinds flourished in the forest.
“Woah!”
“What in the world…”
“I feel like I’m witnessing a season’s change all at once.”
The Earth Shadow party and the assault squad members enjoyed the luxury of the earth’s gift. The flowers wilted and the leaves fell, but soon bloomed again and formed thick forests.
< The World Tree Restored complete.
The World Tree has returned to its home.
The elves, protectors of the forest will regain their lost powers.
The ancient elven magic is unlocked. Affinity with spirits and fairies is heightened, allowing summoning of the spirit king and the fairy king.
New job classes: Forest Kin, Forest Hunter, World Tree Warrior, Keeper of the Forest can be obtained.
The influence of the World Tree’s growth effect will expand the forest territory rapidly.
All elves receive the blessing of the World Tree and have heightened abilities in the forests.
Vision improved by 100%.
Movement speed increased by 30%.
Maximum health points increased by 50%.
Plant and Earth magic spells are enhanced.
The elves will gain more advanced ability effects depending on the growth stage of the World Tree. >
The Aberian forest underwent a transformation as well.
Vicious monsters thrived in Aberian Forest.
The green aura of the World Tree covered the trees and branched out endlessly to the forest.
The ash-colored grass revived and the trees bore new branches, adding to the abundance of the forest.
Herbivores began sprawling and the high elves thought to have disappeared returned.
They scavenged the tree branches on the ground and built shabby huts.
The high elf village was being established.
This was the power of the World Tree that purified Aberian Forest, one of the 10 forbidden locations!
If the World Tree grew and returned to its prime, the elves could take its branches and roots and spread the forest to anywhere in the world.
The prosperity of the forest meant that everyone knew that the elves would bring a total resurrection of their own civilization.
- I’m going to make an elf account right now.
- Elves are the way to go.
- Those who have played as elves until now won the lottery.
- The elves have so many advantages even now… Now the World Tree?
The viewers were talkative.
The World Tree had been returned home, but the quest was still unfinished.
- More earth essence is required to erect forests. The monsters must be cleared.
The World Tree assigned a quest to eradicate monsters in the region with the high elves.
The assault squad members accepted the quest, but there was one more task.
The World Tree spoke to the Earth Shadow party.
- You must meet with Dragon Ratuas.
Silver Ring was astonished.
“The Blue Dragon?”
- Yes. You must retrieve an item and deliver my message.
Elrix sighed secretly.
“Hey all. You’re all going to accept this, right?”
The quest related to the dragon. The hardships involved were obvious, but knowing his comrades, they had no reason to turn it down.
“Of course.”
“I’m doing this for sure.”
Elrix was the same. One disappointment, if there were any, would be that he could miss the war against Kaybern at Morata.
***
Weed resided at Morata since the day he stopped the Savior quest.
Hunting and leading the dwarves were important, but he had to plan for the war.
‘I need to consider as many scenarios as I can. The dragon has to be lured into a position favourable to us.’
The worst case was the dragon refusing to descend to the ground.
If it were to spam breaths and magic attacks from above, just who could win against it?
‘There’s no solution. Aerial fight is a guaranteed loss. If that happens, everyone needs to retreat. The only fighting chance we have is on the ground.’
Kaybern had to be dragged down somehow.
The Hermes Guild too sent contingents to assist in the construction of defensive camps.
Arkhim made a proposal while examining the map of Morata.
“Magic corps have to be stationed in several locations within the city.”
“Would magic attacks work against a dragon with high magic resistance?”
“The damage will mostly be mitigated… But there are many other spells that mages can use. They can assist warriors with flight or acceleration spells. We have many mages in the guild that are willing to fight.”
The Hermes Guild’s mages, summoners, and spirit callers were assigned a building as their residence.
Gaushu, Hyler, Calcus, Gross, Crebulta and the others who excelled in Garnav Plains; the ex-commanders arrived with forces under their direct command.
Weed’s request for the Hermes Guild was 10,000 troops willing to use the Brazier of Sacrifice, but far more guild members were making preparations.
“Is there a reason for us to go this far?”
“I was also surprised to see this many volunteers.”
Arkhim smiled bitterly.
“They wished for the achievement for the dragon hunt. The mages could raise their soul level.”
“Soul level?”
“If one becomes an advanced mage, their high magic power unlocks the link to the soul. It is said that their magic level could increase and their incantations could be realized faster…”
“So, in order to raise the soul level, they have to hunt powerful monsters.”
“That’s correct. Normal monsters don’t grant it. For a mage, the dragon is the ultimate offering. If a dragon dies nearby, they could even absorb a portion of its mana.”
The job class expected to be the most powerful when Royal Road was just released was the mage!
When there was a lack of information among players, absurd rumors about mages such as being capable of blasting an entire mountain with a single spell spread out to the community and it was rare to find someone who was not hyped up.
Correspondingly, mages were difficult at lower levels but packed boastful attacks.
The fact that magic spells were hard to learn and that mage equipment was expensive were both relieved by the indomitable destructive force of the job class.
Presently, the mages weren’t all that popular, but the mage corp of the Hermes Guild was undoubtedly the best in the continent.
“Anyway, it will be a great asset for the Hermes Guild to step up like this.”
“Thank you for addressing it.”
Arkhim and the other ex-commanders appeared before the citizens of Morata and made a public apology.
They acknowledged that they were responsible for the rise of Kaybern and that they will do everything in their power to stop the dragon.
It was an inevitable course of action given that the Hermes Guild wanted to be active even in the Central and Northern continents.
Weed did not take their apology to heart.
‘What is the point of making a grave mistake and apologizing for it later?’
Once a villain, always a villain.
Even so, if they had any worth to them, he had to exploit them. Statistically, there would always be too much scum to count in the world.
“I am reassured that the Hermes Guild is on our side.”
“Ha-ha. Let us move on from the past.”
Weed and Arkhim exchanged eye contact and grinned.
‘The idiots who tried to cut off my living…’
‘The Hermes Guild’s greatest enemy!’

chapters.title: Chapter 643: Volume 57 1 - In Morata Part 1
chapters.content:
Volume 57 Chapter 1 - In Morata Part 1
KMC Media broadcast Bard Ray’s adventure to become an Ironblood Warrior.
- It is now known that a new job class can be obtained by climbing the ice wall and traversing the glacial region. The Ironblood Warrior. I am sure some of you already know about it.
- It is a special combat type job class. Their iron-forge endurance means they could survive no matter the damage…
- Ha-ha, that is an over-exaggeration. But it is true that the Ironblood Warrior possess incredible defense. It’s a job class born from a harsh environment.
- Is it similar to when Weed-nim became a Sun Warrior by putting an end to the storm in the desert?
- I suppose you can see it that way.
The prime of Hermes Guild had long been over, but the viewer rating was high for Bard Ray’s job class. On the screen, Bard Ray was visible from afar climbing the glacial wall.
- It seems to be a challenge just to climb the wall.
- It looks like his feet can’t find purchase.
- It will be slippery and sharp. He needs to form his own path up. Judging by the flapping of his clothes, the winds seem to be rough.
- I’m getting chilly just by watching.
- He has to climb with his bare hands and with Strength or Perseverance that is too low, it is a dangerous quest that could result in a fall to oblivion. Players with acrophobia should not dare try this.
Bard Ray’s cloak started to flutter outrageously when he reached about a third of the way.
From there he took off the cloak and though it wasn’t noticeable on screen, his body struggled to fight through the strong winds.
‘One wrong step and I’m dead.’
Bard Ray advanced up the ice wall as clear as a mirror.
His stamina was draining and he had to maintain his concentration so he would not slip. In this manner, he managed to complete the wall climb and thought to himself that the hardest part was over.
‘Finally, I did it.’
His fingers were frozen solid without any sensation and so were his legs.
‘Now, I have to get as far as I can.’
He certainly desired the Frost Sword from the quest reward.
Bard Ray bowed his head down against the blades of wind and began walking forward.
To think that each step with a frozen body would be so difficult.
He realized quickly that the Ironblood Warrior required extraordinary perseverance.
‘People will be watching me live… If I die here, it would be a total humiliation.’
***
Morata’s fortification!
Miblos and Pabo collaborated with the Northern architect association.
The architects engaged in an extensive discussion with the blueprints of Morata.
“City protection and the dragon hunt must take place simultaneously. They are difficult objectives to pull off at once.”
“It would be better if the fight can occur outside the city.”
“That would be most hopeful… But judging by the turn of events, our chance is with the dragon descending in the centre of the city.”
“Assessment of structures in proximity, the Bingryong Square will result in the least damage. How about we lure the dragon here?”
“The Wyvern Square is also not a bad choice. The market is nearby but the location will take less work for reconstruction.”
The architects were overloaded with designing and construction at the same time.
It was uncertain how much time would be granted from raising walls around Morata and fortifying the structures.
If a mass-scale magic spell were to be cast over the city, the buildings would crumble like haystacks in the wind.
For the architects the situation was the most extreme and the worst, which stirred up their deepest passion.
Miblos stared at the map of Morata and soon raised his head.
“What is Weed-nim’s final comment?”
Pabo spoke solemnly.
“He informed me that he will support whatever decision we arrive at.”
“Even if all of Morata will be destroyed?”
“The architects will not be questioned under any circumstance. He will provide everything required for the preparation of war and will take responsibility for the entire process and outcome himself.”
“Huh. For him to have such faith in us.”
Miblos was well of age and he was sincerely touched by Weed trusting him despite his seniority.
It was a different level of respect from back when he was in the Central Continent taking subcontract jobs.
The other architects nodded in agreement.
“As expected of Weed-nim.”
“That’s a tough decision. He knows the importance of architecture hence the reason for his faith in us.”
“There’s no need to talk about anything else. You need only look at one man to realize why the Arpen Empire is flourishing.”
Weed’s reputation was high overall and he was treated with absolute respect especially from the merchants and architects.
“What about the participation from the Blacksmith association?”
“The dwarf blacksmiths are actively providing for us.”
“What of our iron supply?”
“It’s not plenty, but not lacking either. About 3,000 steel buildings can be raised before D-day.”
The architects carefully organized several plans.
Borrowing from the artists diverting the dragon’s attention with fake artwork, they planned to build metal buildings; buildings that would attract the dragon and withstand average magic and physical impact.
Their purpose was to get Kaybern to waste its attacks so that the vital structures would not be attacked.
Miblos drew a line through the important locations in Morata.
“This is our final line of defense. We have to protect this no matter what. After the war, for Morata to be restored, there must be at least a third of the city left.”
“I agree.”
“Near the Great Library, nothing else shall be done except for raising walls so that we don’t attract its attention. The other buildings must be targeted.”
“Let’s proceed with that. Also, we need to record the most accurate map and the original form of the buildings… just in case.”
The air in the room was heavy.
They had to account for Kaybern coming out ahead in this war and razing Morata completely.
Miblos spoke.
“There is actually not much we can do. We can minimize the damage to the city and provide accessibility to the players engaging in this war. Even if all our efforts are in vain, we shall not give up.”
***
Weed heard about the news from the Earth Shadow party from Mapan.
“They’re in for a rough time.”
- Mapan: Given that it’s a quest from Ratuas, it will prove to be quite difficult. Still, they are excellent adventurers so it will be worth the challenge.
“Please help them out whenever you can.”
- Mapan: Sure! The council will provide our utmost assistance.
“If the Morata defense plan were to fail, we will need the ingredients for the secret potion.”
- Mapan: God forbid that happens… But we will prepare for the worst.
Weed also received reports regarding the World Tree and that a quest appeared for all elves across the continents.
It was about acquiring a new job class, proceeding with the quest, scavenging ingredients and nurturing the World Tree.
The elves would be granted more powerful abilities based on the growth stage of the World Tree. For the entire elven race, a profound objective of the World Tree’s development had been created.
‘The elves too will be subject to all sorts of hardship.’
Weed felt the quest difficulties of Royal Road firsthand.
The elves, despite their beautiful appearance and unique advantages, were far from the boundaries of player interest.
Their health points and stamina were below average.
As hunters they possessed uncomparable proficiency with bows, but they also had the penalty of nausea from excessive killing.
That being said, such penalties did not apply when defending forests.
‘For the World Tree to grow and the elves to become more powerful… Mmm, it means there will be a huge danger that comes with it.’
Nothing came by for free. Whenever the World Tree advances a growth stage, it will require a tremendous amount of resources and that would result in another crisis.
‘Just like how Kaybern burnt down the World Tree, it will become a target of other monsters and demons. Anyhow, the elves will be happy for now.’
The objective of growing the World Tree came with a guaranteed reward.
The elves were already plant-loving beings, so the players who chose to play as an elf would feel a sense of accomplishment in the process.
“The iron walls are way too weak! Which architect association is responsible for this?”
“The buildings over here? Just give them up, you fool. You can’t protect all of them. And why are you trying to protect the shantytown?!”
“The struts are here. Whoever needs them please come and take them.”
“Grass porridge, porridge! Crab grass porridge!”
The influx of players into Morata continued. A huge construction was taking place, but many novice players decided to stay inside the city.
It was all to witness up close the historical battle against Kaybern.
Weed thought of the dangers but did not convince them to do otherwise.
‘Even if we are defeated, I must show them how we fought this war.’
It was all a huge disappointment without spectators!
He was not planning to lose without returning some severe damage.
Along with the Grass Porridge Cult and the Hermes Guild, he formulated strategies to defeat Kaybern every night.
At first their relationship was rather detached, but soon they were a collective whole with a common goal of defeating the dragon.
Weed led Arkhim and the others around Morata.
“As you know already, there are many variables in war. Morata is a major city and so we must change our tactics depending on the direction the dragon will come from.”
Even if they were to succeed in luring the dragon into the city, it would be a miracle to fight in the most desirable location. Therefore, bait was needed and that was strategically complex to arrange.
“There is only one opportunity. Maybe two at most. When the fight breaks out on the ground, we must prevent it from flying again.”
“I will keep that in mind.”
The commanders imprinted the view of Morata vividly into their minds; the locations for ambush and the tertiary locations for different situations.
The war in Garnav Plains was one that started abruptly with no countermeasures.
‘I’m sure it will be different this time.’
‘Weed, the Hermes Guild… so many players have lined up to use the Brazier of Sacrifice. I think we have a fighting chance.’
The commanders did not want defeat, but wished to recover their recognition.
Even though their grudge against Weed was grave, the joint operation at Morata changed their minds greatly.
‘There is no need to be so aggressive up front, even if the situation turns us into enemies again.’
‘Like the fall of Hermes Guild, Arpen will not last forever. I’m sure the foundation is weak for this empire as well. It’d be wise to sit back and wait.’
‘Great performances during the war will be recognized by everyone. That’s what is important.’
The commanders roamed Morata and felt Weed’s popularity with their own skin. But they knew the course of history in Royal Road better than anyone.
Even the once unstoppable Hermes Guild crumbled.
They believed that if Arpen were to fall in the future and chaos stir again, their shining performance would prove to be a meaningful asset.
The flames of ambition did not go out easily once lit.
Weed observed the commanders and smiled brightly.
‘They’re filled with greed and because of it, they are so much more obedient.’
He wished for a better future turn of events but for the time being, he was determined to exploit them as much as possible.

chapters.title: Chapter 644: Volume 57 1 - In Morata Part 2
chapters.content:
Volume 57 Chapter 1 - In Morata Part 2
Bard Ray fought against the fierce cold winds in order to obtain the Ironblood Warrior job class. He crossed the iceland and withstood monster attacks with his body.
The unique trait of the Ironblood Warrior was that they became even more fortified when fighting powerful enemies in extreme environments.
‘I want to forfeit.’
Bard Ray wanted to quit more times than he could count, but he kept walking.
He recalled the scenes of Weed walking across the desert and becoming the Sun Warrior. His competitor had accomplished a very similar feat.
His body was wracked with intense pain like hundreds of rats were burrowing inside his flesh, but his pride drove him forward, step after step.
He remembered the times he lived through, how he had been praised as the God Warrior.
‘I will do this. I will finish it even if it costs me my life.’
He continued on for the sake of becoming the Ironblood Warrior. He felt he was at his limit, but a scrap of strength remained inside him and urged him forward. Only when huge flakes of snow began to fall upon him, did he feel true despair.
‘This is crazy… Just…’
He lowered his head and kept his pace. Thick packs of snow formed on his head and shoulders, but he did not have the power to brush them off.
At first the snow was around his ankles, but now it was above his waist, crushing his will once again.
‘This is truly insane. Would the deserts have been easier than this?’
The wind, like blades, carved at his flesh and seemed to cut to his bones.
He could only believe that Weed’s quest to walk across the hot desert had been easier.
‘Keep going. One step and another. I cannot afford to collapse here.’
A part of him felt relieved that the broadcast station was live streaming the scene.
If it weren’t for the station, he would have quit long ago.
It was a first for Bard Ray where a quest wasn’t about fighting incredible monsters, but pushed him to transcend his own limits.
< Perseverance increased by 1. >
Since it was the path to advance into the Ironblood Warrior, alerts about stat gains popped up on occasion.
‘Just a little more… Just until today.’
Bard Ray dragged his feet onwards. Even the commentators in the station were heated.
- That is Bard Ray for you. Typical players wouldn’t have made it as far as he has in such a crude environment.
- It’s all frozen. The only edible thing around is snow.
- He can’t even walk properly. God Warrior Bard Ray. We always saw only the extravagant side of him but in his heart he had such immeasurable will.
The response from the viewers was also positive about Bard Ray’s new appearance.
It was a chance to look at the human side of a man who once stood above the Hermes Guild.
- Amazing. I won’t be able to get anywhere near what he’s doing.
- I am watching as I am bathing in a hot tub at Puhol Waterpark. I feel like I should be out there hunting at least one monster.
- Wow… The people in the highest ranks in Royal Road have extraordinary determination.
- He was walking straight until yesterday. Now he’s dragging his feet. Was he injured or something?
- He looks completely wasted. Even his armor is frozen.
- Look at the scenery up ahead! An ice lake appeared, then a mountain behind it!
The viewers were impressed by the scale of Bard Ray’s effort.
The broadcast stations got a great hit from a show for which they had had little expectations.
The view rating of Morata’s war preparation and Bard Ray’s adventure were evenly split!
Morning, lunch, dinner, late night and onto dusk.
Bard Ray ceased to stop. He felt like if he stopped to rest, he wouldn’t be able to continue.
‘Weed, Weed, Weed, Weed…’
If Weed didn’t exist, he would have given up earlier.
Miraculously on the 5th day, massive icebergs were afloat in the far ocean.
Bard Ray walked almost unconsciously and he bashed against something in his way.
Ptch.
He was too exhausted to think about where he was walking.
Blink!
< You have arrived at the location of the Frost Sword.
A legendary find!
You have discovered the Frost Sword before it was lost beneath the ocean.
This sword was pinned to the icelands for almost a thousand years and was imbued with the aura of ice.
This sword only acknowledges one master. >
< The adventure discovery increased Reputation by 8,500.
All stats increased by 4.
Willpower increased by 10. >
Bard Ray grasped the Frost Sword. His arm, shoulder and body froze instantly.
C-c-c-crack!
The pain was immense, wiping his mind completely.
< Release me from your grasp. >
Echos from the Frost Sword travelled inside him.
Bard Ray was able to make up his mind even in pain.
‘I must not let go of it.’
Each step added up had brought him to this place.
If he were at that moment to have let go, all would have been for nothing.
His consciousness was fading, but his heart did not have a hint of renouncement.
His honor disappeared the day he lost to Weed. In order to regain his pride, he could endure far more severe pain.
Significant time lapsed. On screen, only a minute had passed, but Bard Ray contemplated countless times.
His body was completely covered in ice and he was on the brink of freezing to death.
It was a different feeling from the times when he was farming for equipment in the Hermes Guild.
‘With this sword… Honor, will be mine again.’
To become the strongest man in all of Versailles, he was willing to pay any sacrifice.
At long last…
< The sword has chosen a new master.
Stamina has been replenished.
Exhaustion, Coldache, Freeze have been lifted. >
Fatigue disappeared.
The thick sheets of ice on his body melted away and transformed into dense muscles.
< You have advanced into the Ironblood Warrior.
You have survived the harshest environment and possess unbreakable willpower. Your advancement is complete. Your fortified body knows no fear.
Protect your comrades and lead battles to victory.
You must overwhelm all battles. >
< Physical abilities are enhanced by 20%
Endurance is greatly enhanced according to current Strength stat.
The more powerful the enemy, the greater the enhancement bonus.
All status effects are overcome more quickly.
Recovery rate increased.
Willpower can heighten magic resistance.
Increases combat effects of allies by a flat rate. >
Bard Ray let out a light sigh. Only then he knew that his adventure was over.
***
It was two days until Kaybern’s attack on Morata!
Bard Ray arrived at the northern gate of Morata via the teleport gate.
“It changed beyond my imaginations.”
He had heard from Arkhim but could not spare the time to watch the news.
The scenery had transformed completely from when he stepped out of the city gates to become the Ironblood Warrior.
The walls were reinforced by double and triple layers; residential areas were deconstructed and remaining buildings were patched securely with steel and rocks.
Countless structures similar to the goddess statue and the Light Tower were visible.
“It’s Bard Ray!”
“Oh, it is really him!”
The players cheered at the sight of Bard Ray. They too had waited for his return.
After all, the fight against Kaybern would have been quite empty without his presence.
Though he had lost to Weed, his honor as the God Warrior did not dissipate.
Some players still assessed that Bard Ray was stronger than Weed.
“Welcome. I will show you how much Morata has changed.”
Bard Ray looked around Morata with Arkhim’s guide.
“Indeed it seems there has been a lot of change. With only a glimpse I can tell that it is an entirely different fortress.”
“The bond between the Northern players and their ability of quick construction is worthy of praise.”
It took them less than a day to construct shelters and defensive walls.
Beginning after breakfast, the first structures were complete around lunchtime.
The supply transport, design and construction seemed to have been carried out by different minds but the results were satisfactory.
They were excellent in haphazard but rapid construction.
“Where is the expected location of the fight?”
“The dragon’s lair is located to the south, so we predict that it will come from the same direction. Still, it would be favorable if the battle can take place in Bingryeong or Wyvern Square. We have put the bait in place.”
“Bait?”
“The dragon destroys the most noticeable and the most expensive valuables. So, we crafted some traps.”
“Let’s go see them.”
Bard Ray took a closer look around Binryong Square and was convinced.
There was a sculpture of the black dragon that spanned over several hundred meters!
It was yet to be complete, but it was so realistically detailed and yet somehow a bit uglier.
Furthermore, it was a depiction of the dragon getting its butt whacked by a goblin, a creature that the dragon didn’t even consider as a life form.
“This… This will surely enrage the dragon. What if it fires magic spells or breath from afar?”
“That is our concern, but the Mapan Council and the northern merchant councils offered their assistance.”
“In what way?”
“They plan to stack piles of gold in the town square.”
If the dragon were to see the treasure, it would never destroy them.
Even the Light Tower, the arts center and goddess statue were to be dressed with gold in the hopes of avoiding the dragon’s attack.
“The dragon will certainly destroy the statue of mockery. If it goes as planned, we will seize our opportunity in either Bingryeong or Wyvern Square.”
“Everyone will commence the attack at the town square.”
“Yes. Fortunately through negotiations we retained our command over our guild forces.”
Arkhim asked that if the war began, they were granted the authority to fight independently.
Weed agreed to the proposal.
It would have been a handsome sight to lead the Hermes Guild members, but truthfully they were a hassle to lead effectively.
Unlike the Northern players used for human wave tactics, they were elite players with impressive combat abilities.
He thought that the Hermes Guild hunting the dragon on their own accord was much more advantageous.
“Granted. But I am sure the dragon will ascend when it’s in danger.”
“It is vital that we prevent its flight, but for the worst we have prepared Mule’s griffin strikers for an aerial fight. We have to put an end to the fight that very day.”
Bard Ray observed the preparations in Morata and was filled with excitement for the day of war.

chapters.title: Chapter 645: Volume 57 1 - In Morata Part 3
chapters.content:
Volume 57 Chapter 1 - In Morata Part 3
The great lords of the Arpen Empire gathered in Morata the day before the war.
The Hermes Guild deployed its core forces and Bard Ray arrived as well, hence the lords also brought the majority of their own troops to make up the numbers.
“We will do our best.”
“We hope you know that the Black Lion Guild always acts for the good of Arpen.”
“We shall put everything on the line to win this war.”
“All of our main forces from Lion Star have been summoned. Our castle is empty because defeating Kaybern is more important than anything else.”
The great lords paid attention to the public consensus and competed against one another in swearing their loyalty to Weed.
“There is a lack of iron arrows.”
“Yes. Given the scale of this war, it is inevitable… ah! We will fill up the supplies. Fortunately, we may have stock.”
“We also require food supplies. The players in Morata need to be fed well, don’t they?”
“C-Certainly.”
“It will be difficult to transport food from so far away, so it could be better for you to provide financially instead.”
“That will be taken care of by Cloud Guild.”
This was the reason the great lords hated coming to Morata.
The feeling that they were going to be stripped of all their fortune when they meet Weed!
They looked around Morata and were surprised a second time at the scale of the Hermes Guild forces at work.
Even the broadcast stations were streaming the scene live.
- Destroyer Tristan. He missed the spotlight in the war in Garnav Plains… But he is under the 1st legion, infamous for killing over 1,000 players.
- The crossbow warrior Ultar! Though he lost the duel against Weed, no one can underestimate his power.
- Yes, he is truly incredible. It seems that the Wolf Knight Cavalry has also realigned its forces.
- Mage Precker is also visible. He is overlooking Morata under the flight spell along with Mage Caddler.
The high rankers of Royal Road arrived and 30,000 magic troops were stationed in vital points within Morata.
The number of siege weapons and magic traps under installation was unimaginable.
The Arpen Empire fortified Morata, but the Hermes Guild also stepped up eagerly and made genuine preparations for the dragon hunt.
The great lords of Arpen watched over the giant project and were astonished by the Hermes Guild’s capability and even felt a sense of danger.
Sherwood spoke.
“I don’t know why they are going this far… but if we end up defeating Kaybern, the negative perception of the Hermes Guild will die down significantly.”
“However, if the crisis subsides, the Arpen Empire will become even more powerful. While the overthrown Hermes Guild advances 10 meters, Arpen will go 200 meters.”
Carlise objected, but the other great lords thought otherwise.
Roam explained prudently.
“We must address it from the perspective of the Hermes Guild that has been suffering. If they lead the war against the dragon, they will be recognized as the core faction that assisted Weed. Also, they can maintain their reputation as the most powerful independent faction. They will rise to be a competitor to the Arpen Empire.”
“Our competition?”
“I say that because it looks like they have put aside their hostility against Weed and the Arpen Empire for the time being.”
The fall of the Hermes Guild that reigned over the continent.
The Hermes Guild heads, who were informed of Lafaye’s concerns, decided collectively to collaborate with the Arpen Empire to maintain their gains on one hand and to prepare for the future of the Hermes Guild on the other.
Draka, who in the past led the Imperial Army during the invasion of the Northern Continent, had earned the right to speak.
“For now, let us forfeit all interests and honor to Weed. Although he was an enemy, Weed completed seemingly impossible quests and accomplished various achievements. His influence is deeply rooted in the people which means we cannot bring him down.”
“Are you suggesting that we live as bottom feeders under Weed?”
“As Arpen climbs even higher, there will be more opportunities for it to crumble. Let’s not go against the tide, stop trying to do the impossible. Until Weed self-destructs, until Arpen becomes divided on its own and gives us a chance to strike, we help him.”
Thus, to bend and assist had become the compass of the Hermes Guild.
Though disgraceful, history proved that sometimes it was the best option.
The Hermes Guild, with a changed attitude, had become the greatest threat to the great lords.
Carlise struck the table with his hand.
“This is not good. The revival of the Hermes Guild, our long time enemy, is bad. It is also a pressing issue that will make the expansion of the empire more difficult.”
The most powerful guild factions within the Arpen Empire were themselves.
They planned on splitting the profits among themselves in their own league, but the Hermes Guild came in uninvited.
***
11 hours until Kaybern’s attack.
Morata had been completely fortified by countless players. The Hermes Guild and the assault squad went to their stations.
Weed stood on top of the tower of Black Giant Star and imprinted the scenery of Morata, for what could be the last time, in his mind.
“Here’s your lunch.”
“Take your sweet potatoes.”
He saw food being passed around to the players.
“We cannot back down now.”
Neither the Hermes Guild nor the assault squad could back down now.
Every measure that could be taken against the dragon was already in place. Even so, the result would only come after the war.
“With this, all of the powerful players in Versailles are here.”
Weed deemed this fight to be one where he would have no regrets.
If they were to lose even with the participation of the Hermes Guild, then it had been inevitable all along.
“Is this the end of peace or a new beginning?”
It was the last day of history, but truthfully he didn’t have much on his mind.
Struggles were only exhausting when they caught you by surprise.
“Are the preparations complete?”
By Weed’s side was Seoyoon.
She too spent a long time in Morata. This time around she prepared the defenses, but even when Weed was busy travelling around the continents, she cared for the development of Morata more than anyone.
Though it was barely noticeable in such a big city, she planted flowers and trees herself.
“Yes.”
“Let’s go on a date then.”
Weed planned for an outing with Seoyoon the night before the dragon’s arrival.
Spending a couple of hours anxiously could not assure victory over Kaybern.
The best way to spend possibly the last night in Morata!
It was a date with Seoyoon.
***
The dark alley of Morata.
There was a pub in the cheapest old neighborhood that only sold beer.
“You still haven’t decided?”
“I don’t know.”
“Not sure if there is a need for us to step in.”
Volk’s words shook the heads of the other men.
They were the dark gamers who earned money through Royal Road!
The Kaybern hunt had been a hot topic among them since a week ago.
- Weed is going to hunt down Kaybern at Morata.
- Everyone knows that.
- You’re going to need faster intel if you’re a dark gamer.
- Will he succeed or not?
- I want to bet against him… Darn it. Maybe Weed can pull it off.
- Honestly, we are in the dark. We do hunt a lot but we distance ourselves from hunting boss monsters because of inefficiency.
- Weed, too, is one of us who earns money through Royal Road, so I hope he will succeed.
- That’s like a part-time cashier worrying about a CEO. Welp.
Comments were posted restlessly among the dark gamer association.
A huge debate fired up as to whether or not Morata was suitable as the battleground.
- It is a vast city. The dragon can fly anywhere and the players will be distressed because of the buildings.
- It is a tricky location when it comes to withstanding the dragon’s magic attacks. How on earth are they going to deal with fire magic?
- I agree. I think they should have organized a counterattack on the lair.
- You are senseless, probably because you are a lone dark gamer. The lair will be covered with magic traps and what about the swarming monsters? Ulta Mountain Pass is covered with monsters.
- A counterattack on the lair is impossible. At Morata, they can prepare with less worry and receive support from players.
- Novice players aren’t considered help. They are all ants to be squashed under the influence of Dragon Fear.
The choice of Morata as the location of the assault was deemed not the best option but it was reasonable enough to be accepted by the public. It was because it was realistically difficult to devise a special response protocol in the next city on the target list.
- Analysis report. What is Kaybern’s worth? I have calculated it by market value.
- The continent plunges into chaos. It will be difficult to earn a living in such desperate times.
- Money is what matters. Which hunting ground is the most efficient?
There was earnest analysis and information as well. Among them were A level posts only accessible for the top tier dark gamers.
- Kaybern hunt. Will it go as planned?
- The multiplying monsters are causing a decline in the market value of equipment.
- Destruction of cities. That is not a problem that can be left alone for long. Establishments aren’t built overnight.
- Royal Road is our workplace. I have to feed my child.
- What if we join the Kaybern hunt too?
Recently, the number of dark gamers had risen to over a million. What was even more intimidating was that these gamers were all high-level!
If the Hermes Guild and the dark gamers were to spark an all-out battle, it would be a formidable match. That being said, it was impossible for dark gamers like them to band together.
- Kaybern hunt. Have you forgotten the basic principle of dark gamers?
- First, don’t trust anyone. Second, give as much as you take. Third, money is the only thing you can trust.
- Those same principles have protected us. The other players do not like us rising to the top.
- Isn’t Weed reliable? He has provided a lot for us.
- Let me clear this up. It is true that the Arpen Empire is convenient for our means of living. However, we return the favor by hunting and completing quests.
- I also think that I am doing my fair share. What’s more, didn’t we participate in the battle against the Hermes Guild?
- We can’t really say that it was participation… We just blended with the winning side and hunted down the Hermes Guild members.
The dark gamers debated the Kaybern hunt. Still, the poll was one-sided in favor of sitting back and observing over fighting alongside Weed.
They had too much at stake for them to fight against such a dangerous being such as the dragon.
“We just need to get rid of Kaybern. Kaybern is the only problem. The Arpen Empire will soon unite the entire world… Hunting and tourism will boom.”
“Well, we aren’t sure about that.”
At the pub, Volk attempted to convince the other dark gamers to assist the Arpen Empire, but he failed repeatedly.
“Hey, Volk.”
“Yes, I’m listening.”
“There are many of us still scattered across the continent. They aren’t even at Morata.”
“We don’t know how many of us are here.”
“Yeah. Roamers without a destination; that is who we are. We belong in the hunting grounds, not the cities.”
The dark gamers in broad terms were just people working in the same field. They kept their whereabouts secret.
“Even if they are at Morata, there will only be a few of them. There are none among us who would use the Brazier of Sacrifice for the safety of the continent.”
“I am aware.”
“Then how much of a help will we be? There’s the Hermes Guild after all. On top of that… It is questionable if Weed will offer us any seats when we join him. Weed and the Hermes Guild will do well on their own. It is right for us to observe the situation, though we may become the hyenas.”
The dark gamers who arrived in Morata also had an objective.
The moment the mighty Kaybern is depleted of its strength and falls, they aimed to steal the kill.
“Hah. It will be beneficial for us to join the Kaybern hunt.”
“It will not happen no matter how hard you try. Just give up and watch.”

chapters.title: Chapter 646: Volume 57 2 - Doomsday Part 1
chapters.content:
Volume 57 Chapter 2 - Doomsday Part 1
Hegel, Bella, Rumi, Celcia.
The students of the Virtual Reality program brought a bunch of new recruits to Morata.
“As you all know already, this is the birthplace of the Arpen Empire.”
Hegel raised his chin and began his speech.
“The 2-3 meter radius around the Black Giant Star? Yeah, this is a historical site. This place existed since the days of ruins; it was one before it became a developed city.”
The 80 freshmen of the VR program were listening with glistening eyes.
Many of them knew a lot about the city, having started Royal Road in Morata but they had alternative goals.
Paella with long waving hair past her back raised her hand.
“You there, go ahead.”
“Hegel sunbae-nim, does it mean we can see Weed sunbae-nim today?”
“Uhh… About that.”
Hegel hesitated to answer.
It was true that he was acquainted with Weed and took classes together, but now it was difficult to get in touch with him.
‘Seriously, I call him every day and leave texts, but he never answers them.’
Weed’s worth skyrocketed and even the broadcast stations contacted him with care.
Producers could not dare contact him even with urgent business and, instead, the job had to be escalated to the board of directors. Hence it was difficult to get a hold of Weed.
The truth was that Hegel’s constant calls and messages already got him blocked.
“Tsk-tsk. You had it coming.”
“We haven’t seen oppa in so long too, so how can you bring a crowd of newcomers and ask him to spare us some time when the war is tomorrow? Let’s just tour around Morata and leave it at that.”
Bella and Rumi scolded him and tried to wrap up the situation, but Paella raised her hand yet again.
“Then… Can we see Nide sunbae-nim?”
“Nide?”
Hegel was rather thrown off at the mention of his friend’s name.
“What about that guy?”
“He’s like so famous nowadays!”
“That idiot?”
“Yeah. I want to see Nide sunbae-nim!”
Nide was the famed heroic thief who robbed Kaybern’s lair along with Weed.
Weed was a legendary individual in the eyes of the freshman and so were his comrades.
“You really want to see Nide? No joke?”
“Yes! Sunbae-nim.”
“Does everyone else want that too?”
“Of course! I really want to meet him.”
“We want to see him!”
The freshmen were shouting in unison. Hegel sighed deeply and whispered to Nide.
“Where you at?”
- Nide: Hmm? I’m in Morata for the fight against Kaybern tomorrow.
“Come to where I am.”
- Nide: Where? Are you in Morata too?
“In front of the Black Giant Star. I’m wearing a shining winged armor so you will notice me right away.”
- Nide: I’ll be right over.
Hegel kept on exhaling, feeling an uncomfortable tightness in his chest after the conversation.
It was like he had been robbed of something that was meant to be his.
Moments after, Nide walked out the entrance of Black Giant Star.
“Hegel!”
“Kyahh!”
“It’s really him!”
The freshmen were in joy seeing him walk from a distance.
The cloak worn by Nide surprised not just the freshmen, but Hegel as well.
It looked like it was made from a mystical material, flocking on its own and stealing the crowd’s attention with its obsidian gloss.
Hegel felt like he shouldn’t ask but he wanted to relieve his curiosity.
Nide was a higher level than him to begin with and being a thief granted him great equipment, but he was curious about this new cloak that he saw for the first time.
“What’s that cloak? I have quite a bit of gold saved up. How much is it worth?”
“Price? It’s not for sale.”
“Then where did you get it?”
“I got it from Weed-hyung after helping him out on the lair raid.”
“Ho.”
“I picked it because it was alright, but it turns out this thing attracts quite a bit of unwanted attention. Still, it boosts movement speed and has a flight skill. Its defense and magic resistances are high too.”
“Could it be that this was made from…”
“Yep. It’s made of the Black Dragon’s scale.”
Nide’s honest words smacked the back of Hegel’s head.
“Sunbae-nim!”
“Can we get some autographs?”
“Can you tell us some of your adventure stories?”
The freshmen that had looked up to Hegel were leaving his side for Nide.
***
“We have today’s special dish. Let’s use all of the expensive ingredients of Morata!”
“Woahh!”
Chefs gathered at the town square.
Barberota on the full course, Mihael on the seafood, Sanjelly on roast meat and Moku on the desserts.
They were all experts in their own fields and it was tough to say who was the best. Nonetheless, the famous chefs over the continents all assembled at Morata.
Continental Cooking Competition
Hosted by the Arpen Empire.
Sponsored by the Mapan Council, Gamong Council, Undefeated Council, Anything Cheap Council.
It was a so-called cooking tournament.
The winning prize was 5 million gold and promotion to a lord seat of the Arpen Empire.
There were countless cooking competitions in the past run by judges of questionable tastes, but the rules were simple for this tournament.
- The tournament will commence the night before Kaybern’s attack.
The tournament will begin after sunset and continue until the next morning.
The guests served with a dish can give a rating between 1 and 5.
The chef with the most points will be the winner!
All the chefs had to do was cook delicious food with the provided ingredients.
“So, all it takes is to just cook all night long and get the most votes?”
“Yeah. But it is better the more you sell, so I think it comes down to popularity.”
“Fame is also a skill. If they try out the food and it turns out bad, they won’t vote for the dish.”
“Like disappointment after visiting a restaurant that you were told was fantastic?”
“Right. Fame will only be a contributing factor early on. People won’t crowd over bad food when the good dishes are just within reach.”
“I guess that’s true.”
The players could purchase the food cooked by the chef of their choice.
The cooking of delicacies from all across Versailles began simultaneously.
The huge fire show from the chefs attracted a huge crowd of players.
“The smell is amazing.”
“I didn’t get to eat this level of food even in Castle Aren.”
Before the war with the dragon even the Hermes Guild had roamed freely.
Just the forces of the Hermes Guild alone numbered well over 300,000. The best dishes worth several hundred gold were things that they could afford and food was an extremely important matter. Delicious and nutritious meals greatly enhanced Strength and Stamina during combat.
Boemong bit off the marinated boar skewer.
“Could it possibly be that Weed hosted this event so that we get well-fed for the fight?”
Slaughterer Calcus, too, had a hankering for meat. He tasted the stirred beef of Morata that melted away in his mouth.
“It seems that way. The event offers money and fame for the chefs and provides the best food for us players.”
Crebulta who led the 7th legion back in Garnav Plains was also with them.
“K-hh. This is pretty nice. I’m feeling energized. But will this bring our chances up by even 1% against the dragon? It seems meaningless to me.”
The commanders predicted that the effects would be minimal as they weren’t dealing with a typical monster. Still, they were optimistic about the morale boost. They themselves were able to break away from the tension before the war.
Boemong grabbed another boar skewer and spoke.
“Don’t you think the prices are pretty high around here? 10 gold for a skewer?”
Crebulta laughed and replied.
“We are just before the war. The merchants could sell a bit higher than usual.”
The Hermes Guild members felt cheated but accepted the circumstances and spent well.
***
Every street in Morata was brightly lit with torches and magic lanterns.
The shantytown also hosted what could be the final event and the people cleaned out their belongings in their homes.
“Whew. This has prints all over it…”
“You had it for long?”
“Nah, I bought it used and it’s covered with the prints of its past owner. I didn’t even get to use it much.”
The players at every shantytown were moving or selling their furniture and household goods.
Through the wide open gates, the players who have yet to visit Morata flooded inside.
“This is truly an awesome city. I’ve only come after so long… I should have bought a house here.”
“There’s a different festival going on at every townsquare.”
“Well let’s go to any one of them quickly.”
The players enjoyed the busy night.
At Light Square, the bards opened a masquerade.
Marey, deemed to be Versailles’ best bard!
He and 1,000 other players played their instruments.
At one side, the mages and priests emitted rays of light into the sky. With light and music, anywhere was the stage.
“Let’s party!”
The players shook their bodies and danced.
The war was only several hours away, but they seemed to have lost all sense of it.
Even the assault squad members and the Hermes Guild members who had hunted until now blended together and shared the joys of the night.
“Hmm-hmm! Sorry about that.”
“You have to look around buddy… Hello, Carlise-nim.”
“Hi. You are here too, Lancelot-nim.”
“I thought it would be a waste to just sit and wait for the war.”
“I hope you have some fun…”
“To you as well, Carlise-nim.”
The town square was so packed that players accidentally stepped on each other’s feet.
The leader of the Black Lion Guild and the commander of the Hermes Guild that had deep grudges against one another bumped shoulders, but they were quick to slip away.
It was not the point in time where they could put their feelings before the rules of the Arpen Empire and it seemed all they wanted this night was to be at ease and enjoy the festival.
The Light Square entertained the players in Morata as if it put them under a spell.
“Shall we dance for one song?”
“But there are so many people around.”
At one corner of the town square was a man under an orc mask with protruded teeth and a woman with a cat mask. It was Weed and Seoyoon.
They walked the streets of Morata, hidden behind their masks.
“No one will recognize us.”
“I’ve never danced before.”
“Just let your body flow with the music. You have great athletic senses. I think you will catch on fast.”
“I’m not good at exercising either.”
“You’ll be fine. Seeing you clobber those monsters, I’m sure…”
“What?”
“You were light and swift.”
Weed grabbed her hand and entered the townsquare.
They offered themselves to the light and the music.
They blended with the crowd and danced awkwardly but freely. It was the happiest moment.
Weed pulled Seoyoon’s hand and at times he hugged her closely.
“How is it?”
“It’s not bad.”
“Should we do this more often?”
Seoyoon nodded wordlessly. The musicians continued to play but they could hear the heartbeats of their partner.
Seoyoon was wearing a common traveller’s outfit and more than half her face was covered by the cat mask. Even then, Weed could tell by the corners of her mouth and the little of her expression that he could see just how happy she was.
‘Is this true love?’
Weed thought he was learning emotions. From the first time he met her, his feelings were expressed from the tone of his voice, facial expression and actions.
Though no one told them about happiness, they were sure in this hour that they were happy.
Even if Morata were to be reduced to dust by Kaybern, this moment would last in their memories forever.
Weed wrapped his hands lightly around her waist and danced.
‘It’s fortunate that I can’t see her face.’
Seoyoon’s eyes were glimmering like gems under the torchlight.
He was sure that he would lose his mind to her beauty.
A song, and the next.
Like they had forgotten the concept of time, they held hands and danced.
Players kept crowding into Light Square and soon the place became too packed to dance.

chapters.title: Chapter 647: Volume 57 2 - Doomsday (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Volume 57 Chapter 2 - Doomsday (Part 2)
“Let’s have a look around.”
“Sounds great.”
They headed over to the Bull Square where all the cooking was taking place and fed themselves with all kinds of dishes.
“They are so delicious.”
“The octopus dish is really good. Let’s vote for this place.”
“Alright.”
They joined the line after line, tasted the food and voted.
“Due to the fairness of the contest, anonymous votes are not accepted.”
They were restricted by the Mapan Council merchant hosting the event.
“Please provide your names.”
“Weed. This is Seoyoon.”
“Would you mind repeating that?”
“Weed and Seoyoon.”
“Do you take me for a…”
The merchant who was about to blow steam was silenced by Weed who lifted his mask slightly.
“Y-Your highness.”
There was no reason for Seoyoon to lift her mask, but she did it anyway after Weed.
“I am Seoyoon.”
“Gasp.”
The merchant, after seeing Seoyoon’s face up close, was about to pass out!
“Hey, what’s going on?”
“What is it?”
