Taking the hit from the breath straight on made survival unlikely even if players had raised their levels via the Brazier of Sacrifice. But, running was also not much different.
“Attack, attack with everything you have!”
Boemong screamed frantically and swung his dual-edged axe down on the dragon’s ankle.
The short moments after casting dark magic spells and Dragon Breath was when the dragon was in its most vulnerable state.
Bard Ray and the warriors also lifted their swords and slashed the dragon.
“Cut off its wings!”
Thousands of warriors commenced the attack on the dragon’s humongous body.
The violent attack from the guild members drove the dragon that was preparing a breath attack into a rage.
***
Weed watched the war from afar and was amazed.
“They put up one hell of a fight.”
The battle of the Hermes Guild unfolded with many spectacular moments.
Could any other group engage in such a stormy battle against the dragon?
Their sworn loyalty for Bard Ray raised their morale greatly. Even with shattered armor and deep wounds, they continued to fight.
Of course, their having used the Brazier of Sacrifice was the ultimate reason for their resilience.
“The planning went smoothly… Things went well for now.”
Their plan was to use Morata as bait and lure the dragon to the ground.
After they wore out the dragon so that it resorted to its dark magic, the main forces would be sent in! With the warriors of the brazier as the core, they would proceed to slay the dragon.
“Certainly, I don’t think there would be any better method of dealing with a dragon.”
If it were Weed, it would have been difficult to arrange such a strategy.
A considerable number of the Hermes Guild members had to give up their lives and that was only possible because of their firm system of command.
That was a different scale compared to novice players rushing in, who had very little to lose.
“If I brought just dwarves to confront the dragon, it would have been an unwinnable battle.”
The Hermes Guild forces, at least 10 times more in number, used the brazier and had plenty of support.
“If they can keep this up, it is very likely that Morata will become Kaybern’s grave.”
Weed, on the other hand, felt a bit disappointed.
It was because the dragon was caught in a trap and could not exert its full combat abilities.
Incomparable to humans, it was an unstoppable mage and a giant creature!
Even so, it was unable to display its true power.
Pale: Weed-nim, I think the Hermes Guild is going to succeed in the dragon hunt.
“It does seem that way. But that’s a dragon. It won’t go without a fight.”
Weed felt disturbed with the battle turning out seemingly all too well. In his life, the times when he had such a feeling led to the most dangerous turn of events.
“Something is very fishy…”
Pale: Is it that damned fate theory that you always speak of?
“I am not sure yet. It isn’t me that’s fighting, but the Hermes Guild.”
Weed thought that Kaybern falling in the hands of the Hermes Guild was the best outcome.
If the dragon is taken care of, there could be nothing that threatens Versailles for quite some time.
“But, why does it feel so off?”
Pale: Kaybern is getting ready to fire its breath.
Weed was not surprised by it. It was an anticipated method of attack and the response from the Hermes Guild was excellent. Even with the breath attack, they will continue to fight but minimize their losses. Despite their capabilities, he couldn’t remain a bystander.
“The dragon is a being that has never been hunted down. Just in case, have the assault squad ready to engage.”
Pale: Understood.
“We don’t know just how advanced Kaybern’s dark magic is nor do we know for certain how this battle will turn out, so we must not let our guard down.”
Weed wanted the war to end with him not using the brazier if possible.
After all, human desire had no limits.
With this battle, if his level does not decline, the gains would be tremendous.
‘It would be just Bard Ray and the Hermes Guild doing all the work. This is the perfect scenario imaginable.’
It was sly and would result in a loss of honor, but stealing the final blow was a given.
***
Smokey black breath poured out of Kaybern’s mouth.
It swallowed the guild members in front and swept the buildings.
- Die!
The Black Dragon turned its head and spread its breath wide.
The Hermes Guild members tried to avoid it like jumping locusts, but they were too close.
“Evade to the side!”
“Fly up to the sky!”
The players who got away from the radius were also still in danger.
The earth melted and buildings fell apart.
The dragon’s breath was so powerful that a portion of the city disappeared without a trace.
It was difficult to calculate the damage taken by the Hermes Guild members that were close to the battle zone.
The dragon showed its power to its content by killing at least thousands.
“Push on!”
“The Horn of Advancement!”
However, after being exposed to fear repeatedly, one could grow used to it and overcome it.
The players who survived Kaybern’s breath had every right to claim that privilege.
They could desire the combat achievements that would be awarded for slaying the dragon and be known as the greatest hero.
If they could accomplish what even Weed and Bard Ray couldn’t do, their name would spread across the world.
The users of the brazier wanted victory over death.
Krobidyun and Jean and the other necromancers intervened in the battle.
“Everyone, get away. Corpse Explosion!”
“Wake, restless vengeful spirits. Take your revenge on the living and your murderers! Dead Rise.”
The bodies of the guild members who died from the breath triggered a chain explosion and doom knights began to rise from the ground.
“What the hell are you doing?”
“The wounded could have been swept by the corpse explosion!”
The spectators from afar were full of questions, but the explosion too was one of the devices for the Kaybern hunt.
Life Siphon from the Dead was the dragon’s most powerful recovery spell.
With its merciless attack it slaughters humans and absorbs massive amounts of health points from their dead bodies.
It was on another dimension compared to the puny amount of health points drained by the necromancers.
In the Morata Defense meeting, this was one of the topics that required countermeasures.
“The problem is that the dragon will continue recovering its health pool. No casualties is impossible while fighting against the dragon. Even if all the players use the Brazier of Sacrifice, death will be inevitable.”
“We could kill the dragon by enhancing our attacks and kill it before it gets the chance to recover… But even if we concentrate our attacks, it will be extremely difficult in such a small window.”
“The dragon’s magic resistant is innately high, so we must rely on the warriors but it will take time.”
Weed suggested a simple solution to Arkhim and Myul’s concern.
“Dark magic has a fatal weakness. We just need to exploit it well. Much like a necromancer spell, Life Siphon of the Dead requires corpses. So, we just have to blow them up.”
“Ah…”
The corpses could be purified with divine spells,but that was a much simpler method.
The general consensus deemed that the necromancers were useless in the fight against the dragon.
“Corpse Explosion! Corpse Explosion!”
The necromancers were forced to learn Corpse Explosion.
To reduce damage to the vicinity, it was better to have the novice players take part.
They blew up the corpses immediately and prevented Kaybern from recovering.
The grounds closest to Kaybern with dead guild members were especially dangerous.
Krobidyun and Jean used Undead Summon to raise doom knights in locations with many corpses.
- Master, I am at your orders.
- I am searching for the enemy.
The Doom Knights under the necromancers’ command attacked Kaybern.
They served as distractions from the front where it was most dangerous.
The Hermes Guild members only focused on the battle.
With Bard Ray leading them, they were pouncing on Kaybern that just used a breath.
‘I can do it.’
‘I can succeed in this dragon hunt.’
All of the Hermes Guild members fighting head to head alongside the support units, the assault squad that had not yet engaged and the observing players suddenly felt that victory was obtainable.
“Life that sprouts. Show me all that exists in your boundaries. View Life Force!”
Krobidyun confirmed that Kaybern’s health pool was at 54%.
- Krobidyun: It is at half health. If we keep this up, if we keep attacking, we will win!
The hearts of the guild members were completely filled with fighting spirit.
To win against the mighty dragon.
All firepower was concentrated and it wouldn’t be long before the remaining half is depleted.
Bard Ray: The world had forgotten. We are the Hermes Guild!
Bard Ray’s message appeared in the guild channel.
“Huuuwah!”
“Hermes Guild for eternity!”
The guild members in the dragon hunt all shouted in unison and charged.

chapters.title: Chapter 655: Volume 57, 4 - The Great War (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Volume 57, Chapter 4 - The Great War (Part 3)
“Why are they like that all of a sudden?”
“Their morale is at its peak. The vibe is real.”
Neither the assault squad nor the spectators knew the reason, but they had a good idea.
It was the appearance of Bard Ray’s personal guards.
Though their melee combat with the dragon had left their armor fractured and broken, they were pushing forward under the countless arrows and magic attacks.
The heroic display was totally expected.
- I will make you mere humans pay for challenging me. Howling Rage!
Kaybern’s body turned dark red and began emitting incredible power.
The Hermes Guild members on the front lines pressuring it with their shields were the targets of its attack.
As its tail whipped, their shields and armor were torn like pieces of paper, causing guild members between the levels 400 ~ 500 to die. The results were consistent with its foreleg kicks and headbutts.
“What is this? It suddenly became outrageously powerful!”
“K-ugh! Shields press closer! Don’t give it any room to move around or we are all in danger!”
Even the warriors over level 1000 who used the brazier were severely wounded or decapitated by its attacks.
“It’s too strong!”
“We can’t block it, so don’t confront it.”
With every struggle from Kaybern, thousands of shieldmen were pushed away in fear.
It pressured the Hermes Guild with its phenomenal physical strength.
What happened here?
Weed asked the channel with the crucial members of the Morata defense.
Arkhim: I’m uncertain. It became very powerful after casting a spell.
Ultar: It is still manageable. If we continue as we had before, the front will hold the line and we will be able to go for its rear by circling around left and right. If we can win, the losses must be accepted.
Grenol: We must push forward and block off the front as well. We must not let the dragon have an open path!
Max: Assemble the shield units. We must corner Kaybern completely.
A rather unsettling atmosphere dominated the conversation among the commanders and soon, Weed received the response to his question.
After careful observations, we determined it to be a magic spell that enhances strength.
It was Dain’s answer.
She too was watching from somewhere in Morata.
Weed felt a bit awkward having not spoken to her in such a long time and spoke in a polite manner.
Did it cast the spell on itself?
Yes. Though the scale is different, there is a similar spell in the Shaman moveset. With that kind of power however, it has to be dark magic.
But it doesn’t seem as though that it offered any sacrifices.
I believe it increases strength based on the number of enemies and the cumulative damage taken.
Once it was empowered by magic, Kaybern’s physical prowess was dreadful.
The outrage of a dragon over hundreds of meters tall paved the humans to the ground and caused a massacre.
It was truly a scene of a calamity.
“Uwaaaagh!”
“It’s too strong.”
Players fell like rain running down the dragon’s back and wings and got kicked in mid-air.
‘We just have to take the beast down. Even with this many casualties, if we kill the dragon…’
The Hermes Guild was united in a single idea. Kaybern’s health points are roughly at half.
Having used the brazier that cost 50 levels, one death wasn’t any more significant, so an all-out attack was the only answer.
“We must keep up the attack. There is no room for hesitation.”
Bard Ray was still mounted on the dragon’s back.
Despite the dragon’s tough movements, he spent all his stamina and mana to throw out a barrage of skills.
Over a hundred guild members were attacking alongside him and they too were in a state of frenzy. The healing and buff spells from the priests were concentrated on them.
“Just a little further! The dragon is dying.”
“The end is almost here. Everyone pull out all you’ve got!”
The commanders roamed the grounds and shouted.
The players standing on top of the enraged dragon had no time to look around, but they could hear the sounds from their comrades.
The users of the brazier too occasionally died under the dragon’s feet or spells. However, many were too deeply drenched in bloody madness to notice the increasing casualties.
Slater: We can kill it.
Heroid: Our attacks are working. Keep attacking. We are so close to the success of this hunt.
There was no need for second thoughts.
They themselves knew that their berserk state was the only thing that would help them win.
Towards the end of combat, the great city Morata would be left in severe destruction.The piles of Hermes Guild bodies had no pity.
They had lacked companionship to begin with, but now that they all saw the great achievement of hunting down the dragon right before their eyes they were even more callous.
Krobidyun: The dragon’s current health points are at 39%.
Kaybern was taking damage to its health points despite its overwhelming defense and magic defense
Lamifter: I think we can actually pull this off.
Boemong: For sure. Kaybern will die today.
Gaushu: Everyone hold your stations! The offense must continue until the end of this war.
Krobidyun: I will take care of the corpses as soon as they spawn.
The spectators of Morata were getting worked up.
“There, the Hermes Guild is going to take it down.”
“It looks like it. Nice. Bard Ray really is awesome.”
“Wow, the Hermes Guild is showing its class. The dragon is incredible too.”
“I wanted Weed-nim to defeat the dragon. Still, I don’t need to worry about Versailles falling anymore.”
“That goes the same for me.”
The Absolute Solar magic was long gone and the fire burning down the buildings were almost all extinguished.
The only thing left was to push the dragon to its end.
Weed wasn’t the least excited watching the scene.
‘But this is the dragon. It seems all too easy for it to end like this.’
There was no need for complications.
He did think that it was all because the Hermes Guild forces were extremely well prepared.
The dangerous plan of luring the dragon into Morata succeeded in the end.
Ranged attacks against a dragon were considered to be not the most effective, but the cumulative damage would be significant.
The decapitated players were recovered quickly under the concentrated healing from the priests. The users of the brazier survived resourcefully and led the battle well.
If it weren’t for them Kaybern would have gone on a rampage without a leash.
‘I need to prepare for Kaybern’s final moment. I need to get closer for the last hit.’
***
“Ch-eeeek!”
Seechwi.
She had discovered the existence of the demon king Cletta and had become very famous.
“Is there anything we could help you with?”
“Ch-cheek!”
The adventurers who returned from the Ring of Fire joined with her in Orcland.
“The Flames of the Champion. Ch-k! We will head there. Chu-ek!”
“Understood. We will figure it out together.”
Seechwi knew that even if they succeeded in hunting down Kaybern at Morata, it wasn’t the end. In order to stop Cletta, they had to take care of the Red Dragon as well.
‘If Kaybern disappears, the possibility of Cletta spawning would be near zero… It would be difficult for Landony to retrieve all the sealing stones.’
Seechwi, instead of rushing to Morata to be of little help, decided on travelling to the Flames of the Champion with a composed mind.
It was a massive fortress defended by patrolling orcs.
“Human. Ch-k!”
“You guys. Smell is bad. Ch-chik!”
The adventurers alongside Seechwi were frowned upon, but they were used to such treatment.
“Don’t worry. We just have to cover up the scent.”
The adventurers rolled on the ground and wore old animal hides so that their scent didn’t disturb the orcs. Truthfully, the orcs were not that sensitive.
“By chance have you seen Landony…”
“Do you know anything about a sealing stone…”
“What is the origin of this city?”
The adventurers diligently gathered information. The orc players were aware of Seechwi’s fame and so they were quick to offer assistance and with their help; they were able to collect the rumors rapidly.
The battle arena in the Flames of the Champion!
Every two years, there is a tournament held to pick the king of the orcs.
When the orcs fall in danger, the great tribal leaders appear.
They will uphold a special ceremony at the battle arena as they promised Batalli.
“The orc warriors fight and the last one standing becomes king.”
“That king reigns over all orcs.”
“Also, the survivor absorbs the soul of the dead orcs and the power of the losers to be reborn as the orc hero…”
Orc hero!
The king who appears at the crisis of the orc tribe is awarded with immense power.
It was that same orc king that would fight against Landony and prevail.
The adventurers were quite skeptical about it.
“The orcs develop the slowest compared to other races.”
“It can’t be helped since they have harsh appearances. If Weed-nim didn’t play as Karichwi, it would have been much worse.”
“The overall standard of orcs is on the low end, so even if they find a king in the arena, I assume that it would be impossible to fight against Landony.”
“The tournament is still a year away. No one can tell for certain what will happen during that time. Also, we have orc Karichwi.”
The adventurers nodded in agreement.
They also thought that it was natural for orc Karichwi to appear and rule over Orcland.
“The competition among the orcs will become intense.”
“Wouldn’t it be worth a shot? Since it is for the dragon slayer achievement.”
“Elves, Dwarves and Orcs. They are all excited. The humans had their cities ruined.”
“I don’t think we need to divide this up into which race is favored the most. Isn’t it true that humans are the most developed of all?”
The adventurers were trying to round up additional information.
They would be grateful for any information on Landony, and there was a chance they could bump into a rare quest at the Flames of the Champion.
“Ch-eek! Ch-k!”
“Dragon! Dragon is coming. Ch-Ch-Chik!”
The orcs at Flames of the Champion were scrambling everywhere.
“No way…”
“Coming here?”
The adventurers panicked and ran over to the fort walls with the other orcs.
An enormous crimson dragon had risen over the horizon.
“It’s real!”
“Landony!”
The Red Dragon flew through the curtain of clouds.
“Chhhhh-eeek!”
“This is, this is bad. Ch-ch-ch!”
The orcs on the wall shouted frantically.
The orcs felt their throbbing hearts but soon felt something strange.
The Red Dragon wasn’t headed towards the orc fortress.
It was flying from the east to the northwest.
It was visible from the fortress, but it flew right past.
“What? Is it to chase down another orc tribe?”
“Then that’s fortunate…”
“It’s trying to recover the sealing stones. But, there is the special orc tribe in that direction… Could it be…”
Adventurer Andol imagined something in his head and shivered.

chapters.title: Chapter 656: Volume 57, 5 - Red Dragon Landony (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Volume 57, Chapter 5 - Red Dragon Landony (Part 1)
Whilst all attention was focused on Kaybern in Morata, shocking news was delivered.
Mapan: We are in trouble. Landony is flying this way.
Mapan’s words froze Weed who was comfortably watching the battle.
The Red Dragon? Here?
We’re not 100% certain. But, it is heading north of the continent and there’s a high possibility that it is headed to this location.
The news was delivered by the orcs and the adventurers at the Flames of the Champion.
Many players were gathered in Morata, but others in many other locations around the continent witnessed the Red Dragon in flight.
Currently, the Red Dragon is travelling through the central area of Litton. Then, it will traverse the Neria Sea and enter the Northern Continent.
The Hermes Guild members in battle could be seen hesitating for a moment.
Weed who was filled with desire for the last hit was also thrown off.
It’s unlikely that it would come all this way to kill some orcs in the north. There are only a few cities worth destroying…
There will be a motive for the dragon’s movement. We did not uncover all there is to it… You must also take into consideration that Landony and Kaybern grew up together.
Of course.
Weed could do nothing but agree with adventurer Chase.
As it stood, it seemed that Kaybern, in the midst of battle, likely called for Landony that was much like a sibling,
Swift Coldwind: Given the Red Dragon’s current speed, it will take about 15 to 20 minutes for the dragon to cross the Neria Sea and make its arrival.
Arkhim: If Kaybern and Landony join forces, that will be disastrous.
Calcus: Two dragons instead of one is catastrophic. The Red Dragon is considerably more powerful than the rest.
Lamifter: Landony is on its way! What do we do?
Crevolta: Bard Ray-nim! Your orders!
Even in this moment, Bard Ray was fighting valiantly by leading his forces against Kaybern.
He had no attention to spare on chat messages and his actions were already representing his will. He bet everything on the battle.
Regardless of Landony’s arrival, he did not plan on stopping the fight.
“If so…”
Weed realized that it wasn’t the time to be idly observing the Hermes Guild.
He had to be decisive before any more time was wasted, and only he could combine the forces of the Hermes Guild, the assault squad and all the players in Morata.
It wasn’t just the warriors and knights of the Hermes Guild in the engagement.
Archers, mages, bards, priests, shamans, architects, and more.
Players of various job classes were involved in the battle against Kaybern.
It was of utmost importance that he directed their minds in the right way.
“I have to make the most optimal decision.”
Weed announced the message as the emperor of the Arpen Empire.
It was not just players in Morata, but all players on Arpen Empire territory across Versailles were able to hear the message.
- First of all, I give my thanks to the Hermes Guild for their great sacrifice in battle.
To start, he honored their efforts with his priceless words.
As you all may already know, it seems that the Red Dragon Landony is about to arrive in Morata. I do not know how much worse the situation will become once that happens.
He spoke honestly about the added difficulty to the battle.
A lone dragon and a pair of dragons were completely different concepts.
Moreover, the Red Dragon was incapable of using dark magic, but in terms of pure strength it overpowered all other dragons.
The thought of the Black Dragon and the Red Dragon casting spells simultaneously and ravaging the ground was horrendous.
Hence, if the Hermes Guild understands the situation, it is now necessary that all players in Morata join forces in the Kaybern hunt.
Weed had no choice but to forfeit his chance on the last hit.
Morata was already half ruined and there would not be a second opportunity to have the Hermes Guild fight for him.
The guild too was unable to back down. They were on the brink of succeeding the first dragon hunt, and stopping the battle because of Landony was nonsense.
Our objective is to hunt Kaybern down before Landony’s arrival. Then we will proceed to slaying the Red Dragon as well.
Weed’s offer caused a stir within the Hermes Guild.
Heroid: Backing away now would be the worst. Weed’s offer sounds quite reasonable.
Crebulta: If we accept Weed’s proposal, we will be able to succeed in the hunt. The timing is cutting it quite close and it will only get more difficult once the Red Dragon gets here. We might be wiped out.
Heiller: We made it all happen until this point but now you want other players to get a free ride? You’re telling us we should give them a share of the dragon?
Gaushu: Then do you have another suggestion? Fight or retreat. The choice is one or the other.
Calcus: How about we end this hunt just on our own? We are not far.
Heroid: It might still be possible. The timing is a little tight…
Boemong: We have to decide now. The Red Dragon is flying as we speak.
Chaos waged among the Hermes Guild members.
Even the commanders could not come to a collective agreement and the guild members hesitated as well.
“If Landony gets here, aren’t we all done for?”
“Yeah. Even if we slay Kaybern, we are all dead meat once Landony arrives.”
A considerable number of guild members who had not used the brazier wanted to flee the scene. On the other hand, many saw that it was all possible if they killed Kaybern and Landony in order, though it would be too big of a bite off the apple for just the Hermes Guild to handle alone.
“Bard Ray-nim! What are you going to do?”
In such a crisis, only Bard Ray was capable of choosing the direction for the Hermes Guild.
After losing to Weed, his influence decreased but the God Warrior Bard Ray’s shadow still spread thick over the entire guild.
“We fight. We slay the dragon.”
Bard Ray always led the Hermes Guild to victory. For him, running was not an option unless he was defeated.
The hesitation and contemplation of the Hermes Guild disappeared.
The commanders and guild members decided to follow his choice.
Understood. We agree to Weed-nim’s terms.
***
Weed watched the battle for a moment.
Bard Ray and the guild were fighting even more crazily than before. If they fought with some composure before, now they stood at the edge of a cliff.
“They became strong.”
Bard Ray’s combat videos on the hall of fame had a clean style to it that was similar in all them. However, his fighting on the back of the dragon felt like a torrent of his emotions.
He was smashed by Kaybern’s wings; struck by magic that left his armor half exposed, but his concentration was manifest in swinging the Glacial Sword.
The dragon’s back was frozen.
This sight raised the hopes of the Hermes Guild.
Bard Ray clinging to the dragon despite the dragon’s violent shaking made the people watch with sweaty palms.
“They were criticized for so many things… But I suppose there isn’t any combat force as good as they are. I better start too.”
Weed arrived at Yellowy Square and got the dwarves to use the Brazier of Sacrifice.
“K-uhh. Just what I was waiting for.”
“Brethren. Cheers. The time has come to hunt Kaybern.”
The dwarves drank a glass of dark beer that could be their last, and they activated the brazier. The short limbed dwarves were lit up and turned into even more of a dense, muscular form as they lifted their weapons.
Weed too, stood in front of the brazier.
“Now I have to use the brazier…”
In that moment, the bulb lit in his head!
‘But I wonder if I have to use the brazier to its full extent?’
He had a flashback of his life like when he fell in grave danger.
His days of youth when he lived in sorrow, the past when he lived like a house centipede.
There were so many events in his life, and he always kept his senses sharp so that he wasn’t exploited by anyone.
‘But what if I tweak around? Just a little. Like burning only 20 or 30 levels.’
Just until a little while back, he thought that it was unquestionable to use the brazier in order to stop the dragon. His level would decrease greatly, but it was a loss necessary to hunt the dragon. He dragged even the Hermes Guild into the plan, ensnaring the fate of the dwarven race and the future of Versailles.
‘That is why if I hold back a bit on the brazier, no one will know.’
If he shows a weak side while fighting Kaybern, everyone would be suspicious. However, would anyone detect a small discrepancy among the thousands upon thousands of players in a huge mess? If he were to somehow get caught in one of the dragon’s attacks, it would be dangerous but wasn’t a problem as long as he avoided it in time.
‘The broadcasts will focus on me. It will be hard not to notice anything wrong.’
Weed thought there was no way of getting away without using the brazier. Unfortunately, he had to equip himself with the legendary items left by the dwarves.
***
While Weed was plotting his dark scheme, the battle between Kaybern and the guild waged on.
Ranged units began providing support. The assault squad prepared for aerial tactics.
The assault squad led by Pale finally mobilized.
The mages and archers of the squad commenced the attack and players began taking flight.
The warriors had worked jointly with the avian in the main battle against the dragon.
During that battle, the avian were overwhelmed by fear and could not approach the dragon, so the warriors arrived using flight spells.
“Descend!”
“Commence operation.”
The assault squad members were weaker than those in the Hermes Guild, but they had prepared for the dragon hunt for a long time.
They wore high magic resistance equipment and chose weapons that complimented their skills.
A deathblow!
They were willing to exhaust all their health points and stamina with their weapon swings.
The attack from the Hermes Guild was intense and the addition of the assault squad heated up the battlefield.
Barbarian Knatul, fairy knight Malin, Half elf Vishur. The heroes of each race also entered in battle.
“Everyone, keep it up! Our bodies know no limitations!”
Knatul shouted and encouraged the warriors with courage and strength.
Malin used magic to augment the abilities of his comrades as Vishur charged towards the dragon, grasping a dagger in both hands.
The assault squad was relentless just like the Hermes Guild and never stopped their advance even when they were blown away by magic attacks.
“Lift your swords! A second later and that beast may die before we get there.”
Geomchi, the instructors and the 500 apprentices jumped in as well.
The sturdy, muscular, sword-wielding men gathered to hunt the dragon.
It was miraculous that they had just observed the Hermes Guild fight until now without rushing out there!
For these men, an incredible amount of food and liquor was required.
“We are on the move! We won’t even get a grain of bean if we are late.”
“Hahahaha! Let’s go, let’s go!”
“Isn’t this the real showdown with the dragon?!”
“This is a fiesta!”
They activated the Brazier of Sacrifice unconditionally and immediately.
Even if their levels were to suffer, it was well worth it for a wild battle against the dragon.
Some of the players that followed Geomchi and the apprentices closely also used the brazier.
“Oh darn. I think I’m going to regret this later…”
“Let’s do it anyway. We might take a chunk off the dragon.”
“Yeah… I guess that’s true.”
Around 1300 players participated in the use of the brazier.
It was not an easy decision to make since it dropped their levels by 40 or 50.
They led the charge and clung onto the dragon, intensifying the heat of battle.
“Chop it into pieces!”
“Plow through the magic and don’t st… K-agh!”
“Just push through with your body!”
The Hermes Guild however wasn’t about to let the assault squad take the lead and they fought with a renewed vigour as players from all across Morata flew over to join the fight.

chapters.title: Chapter 657: Volume 57 5 - Red Dragon Landony (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Volume 57 Chapter 5 - Red Dragon Landony (Part 2)
- Humans, your final acts of resistance are laughable.
Kaybern stood high among the ruins and took on the attacks of thousands with its bare body.
Even while taking immense damage, it prepared the offerings for his dark magic magic ritual.
- You will never prevail! Evil Divide!
It was one of the most wicked dark magic spells.
It was activated through a sacrifice on an ordinarily unimaginable scale as well as the offering of the caster’s own body.
Kaybern’s enormous figure dissipated and split into three. Then heaven and earth became shrouded in dark auras and the earth itself was consumed by the growing storm, surging toward the dragon’s form.
Bard Ray and the Hermes Guild members were thrown off their feet and the players who were unable to escape had their health points siphoned off.
“Our attacks aren’t working. Fall back!”
“Do not become an offering to the dark magic!”
The guild members at once retreated to a safe distance. Then Krobidyun’s terrified voice alerted the chat screen of the Morata defense force.
Grovidun: Evil Divide. What the hell. Have you read about that spell?
Bard Ray: What is it?
Grovidun: To put it simply, it’s a cloning ability.
Jean: Is it a recreation of the Sword Cloning Technique?
Grovidun: It is similar, but it’s on a different scale. Kaybern has divided into three copies of himself.
Arkhim: What do you mean by three?
Grovidun: Until that spell ends, Kaybern is not a lone being. Attack, defense, health points, magical abilities; every one of them is identical in ability to his original form.
A long silence drowned the chat screen of the defense force.
It was a statement that no one wanted to believe, but it was soon confirmed by Mapan.
I have read over the information from the Great Library. I had gathered info on dark magic spells in advance. Evi Divide is said to be able to create a minimum of two clones up to a maximum twelve.
“…”
The Hermes Guild members froze in their spots, and so did Weed who was standing beside the Brazier of Sacrifice.
Bard Ray: What about their weaknesses? Do the clones have any weaknesses?
Grovidun: There is no such thing. We must kill all three.
Calcus asked hoarsely as he witnessed the dark storm get pulled into the dragons.
Calcus: No weaknesses at all?
Krobidyun: As with all powerful dark magic spells, it does have a drawback. I’ve read that after the spell ends completely, the caster could suffer from hysteria or suffer loss in maximum health points and mana.
Weed sighed after hearing the explanation.
The Red Dragon’s flight had already produced one crisis on top of another, but now they had three Kayberns to deal with.
“This is outrageous.”
The situation had become so dire that maybe they had to consider abandoning Morata and retreating.
***
“Extremely powerful indeed. Hermes Guild! I want to give them a round of applause.”
“The forces led by Bard Ray still remain strong. They confronted the dragon valiantly.”
“They may commit to a final throwdown before the Red Dragon’s arrival. Joo-wan-ssi, what makes this battle different from the one back in Garnav Plains?”
“It is all in the preparations. I noticed especially the warriors and their equipment. They went all-in for attack damage and magic resistance for this fight.”
“Isn’t it bad with such low melee defense?”
“They compromised on what they could. In exchange, the shieldbearers took on the role of the tank and maximized the guild’s hunting efficiency.”
The commentators of KMC Media broadcast the battle stream against Kaybern and turned up the heat. It was the battle between the players and the dragon with Morata as the backdrop! There was much to see and many spectacles to draw in crowds and create commotion.
Via the players on the ground, the broadcasting cameras were capturing the live footage of the Red Dragon mid flight.
“That is the Red Dragon with its wing spread wide. Its assumed destination is said to be Morata.”
“We are receiving news that Kaybern’s health points are near depletion. If they fight strategically, they could take down Kaybern.”
“As you all may know, victory is not the issue. The fate of Versailles depends on this battle.”
Just when there was hope of the Hermes Guild members valiantly hunting down the dragon, the viewers saw Kaybern cast a spell and watched the live stream be obscured by the aura of darkness that it rolled over the earth and sky.
“What is that spell?”
“It seems to be dark magic. It doesn’t look so good.”
“We have an urgent report. According to the reporter on site… It is a dragon multiplying spell.”
“Multiplying?”
“Yes. Until that spell is gone, there will be three Kayberns.”
“That is just ridiculous…”
“Magic? Physical abilities. You can’t tell me they are all identical.”
“They are… We are literally dealing with three dragons.”
“If three dragons each cast their own spell during the battle… That is absurd.”
“The duration could be short.”
“It is said to last until the end of battle.”
“…”
As Kaybern became three beings, the commentators were at a loss for words.
Just one was tough enough, but now they saw no hope whatsoever.
The viewers discussion board was also in an uproar.
* Crazy. What in the world…
* Versailles is finished.
* Dragons… They are beings that should have been left alone.
* This is the worst situation ever caused by the Hermes Guild. This is their fault for destroying the dragon’s egg.
* That is not important anymore. If we can’t stop the dragon, Morata is finished.
* It’s all over. The real estate of this great city will plummet!
* Is Royal Road going to disappear?
* I am on vacation at Bellenos. It should be relatively safe here, yes?
* If the monsters multiply, no place will be safe.
* Let’s go to the port city where we can hold our ground.
* The answer to this are the islands. Building a house on a lone island and living alone.
The atmosphere was that of despair!
The prices of items on every auction site crashed and so did the prices of homes.
***
The fog of dark magic lifted, and the three Kayberns simultaneously triggered Dragon Fear.
- Humans, your time in this world is over.
- Beings that do not deserve to exist. Disappear.
- Only annihilation is left.
The dragons roamed independently and unleashed their AOE spells over the cities and players. Even the Hermes Guild members were quick to flee whenever they cast a fire magic spell or unleashed dark magic.
“Damn it…”
Even Bard Ray grit his teeth and couldn’t process this unreal situation. However, they had come this far and were out too far in the water to turn back now.
“Hermes Guild, attack! Do not back away.”
The Hermes Guild bet everything on the battle against time. The 300,000 guild members in Morata all sprang into battle.
“We too will assist the Hermes Guild.”
The assault squad led by Pale also eagerly joined forces and began fighting against the three Black Dragons.
***
Weed was uniquely relaxed after the appearance of three Black Dragons.
“Hmm. It isn’t easy as I predicted. Yeah. Nothing is free in this world.”
Once the dark magic spell activated, he was astonished but quickly composed himself.
Mapan: Evil Divide. According to the records, this is an ultimate spell of dark magic. What’s for certain is that in using that spell, Kaybern had depleted his sacrificial offerings for dark magic and should have consumed a great amount of mana.
Krobidyun: They each have 16% mana left.
“A dragon should put up this kind of struggle. If it died like that, I would have been disappointed.”
Weed thought optimistically and ended up tossing all 50 levels into the brazier.
From level 539, he reached a temporary level of 1,039!
[The Brazier of Sacrifice has set aflame your hidden potential.
When the fire goes out completely, your level will be decreased by 50.]
It was now all or nothing.
As the Hermes Guild and the assault squad committed to an all-out offensive, the field could not be missing the Arpen Empire’s emperor.
“Yeah. This way, it’s more exciting. This scale is appropriate for a dragon.”
Weed ran to the scene of battle. The three Black Dragons were skirmishing with almighty presence. The region was reduced to dust and unrecognizable. The dragons pressured the Hermes Guild members and the assault squad.
Weed shouted.
“I will take command of this battle from here on out!”
One shout was enough to draw the attention of the Hermes Guild and take charge of the assault squad. He could have just utilized the dedicated chatting channel for the core commanders, but he had to grasp the minds of even the common guild members and the squad.
“It’s Weed!”
“The God of War, Weed has appeared.”
Their expectations for Weed was nothing less than victory!
Weed wanted to pull up a song to further boost their morale, but with the race against time he refrained and shouted quickly to make consecutive call-outs.
“These are three Black Dragons that are weakened with low mana. The assault squad takes the one on the left and the Hermes Guild takes the center.”
His first command was designed to restore organisation.
If the squad and the Hermes Guild cluster over one another, having to be mindful of another group could hinder their combat abilities.
On top of this, he added a comment that would set fire to the public.
“Assault squad to victory! You all have rested until now, so you must hunt this near-death dragon before the Hermes Guild.”
“Let’s go!!!”
“If Weed-nim leads us, of course!”
“Waaagh! What a good day to die!”
The assault squad members were tempered through hell training. With Weed’s presence, they were full of courage in their advance towards the dragon.
They who had felt hesitant and lacked faith in the future of the Central Continent, were reinvigorated by the chance to win against the Hermes Guild in combat achievements.
With that said, the eyes of the Hermes Guild members also changed drastically.
“Hunting down the dragon before we do?”
“Even if Weed leads them. We are the ones who fought until now and yet these schmucks…”
They had scratched the pride of the most powerful force, the Hermes Guild.
It was a childish taunt, but possibly the most sensitive.
“All attack. We will slay the dragon in the middle at once.”
“Commence the attack.”
The guild members began the assault.
They spent their saved mana and stamina, activating their skills with passion.
It wasn’t about the success of the hunt, but the concern of not losing to the other party.
“The dragon is also exhausted.”
“Concentrate the magic spells at its head!”
Kaybern’s stamina also declined and its mana was spent.
The Hermes Guild members climbed aboard its wings ruthlessly and also attacked its tail and back.
“Whoo…”
Bard Ray was a bit uncomfortable seeing the Hermes Guild follow Weed’s command, but soon jumped into battle himself.
What they needed was victory and what was more important was maintaining his title of the God Warrior.
“Their reaction is just too good.”
Weed was quite surprised to see the Hermes Guild follow his orders so well.
“As they say, the smart and strong know how to behave.”
If it was himself, he would have tried to trick his way out of this mess. But these players were serious and doing the best they could to prevail.
“We did get off on the wrong foot, but it doesn’t seem like they’re that bad in nature.”
Weed decided to take on the dragon on the left with the dwarves.
“Alright, it is time to slay Kaybern. Still, take care of yourselves. We must survive at all costs. For the children and wives waiting back home.”
“What? You mean my grim faced wife and good for nothing children?”
“Well then survive so you can enjoy as much beer as you want.”
“If it’s for that, I will be careful.”

chapters.title: Chapter 658: Volume 57 5 - Red Dragon Landony Part 3
chapters.content:
Volume 57 Chapter 5 - Red Dragon Landony Part 3
“Damn it, sh*t. Curses!”
Hegel blurted foul remarks as he ran.
B-boom! Boom!
Fire rounds bombarded the very road he was running on.
“Just what is Weed-hyung thinking, trying to pick a fight here?!”
The more he thought about it, the more insane it seemed.
But, all players in Morata were already mobilized and the Black Lion Guild too was triggered.
Carlise: All Black Lion Guild members attack the dragon on the left alongside Weed-nim.
It was an abrupt order by the guild master.
As soon as they exited the building to join the battle, they saw three Black Dragons in the midst of a merry path of destruction.
All of the Hermes Guild, the assault squad and the dwarves were pouncing on the humongous dragons.
Roam: Roam Guild too, commence an all-out attack. Do not lose.
Sherwood: We will also fight with our pride.
Gunt: The dragon will die by our hands. Warriors, raise your swords!
Mihel: Today we will slay the dragon and begin a new page in history!
The major lords themselves with weapons sprinted towards the dragons.
The battle waged hazily.
A sense of urgency that could scorch everything in existence grew among them.
The other prestigious guilds were mocked for years because of the Hermes Guild. They bided their time, allowed themselves to be insulted and blamed themselves.
Weed ultimately had stimulated competition.
If the Hermes Guild slays the dragon, they will accomplish the greatest combat achievement.
To be thinking about just Hermes Guild, have you forgotten our contribution to the Arpen Empire?
I sure do, but the players look up to the Hermes Guild even now. Oh how powerful they are. This world is always about competition, isn’t it?
K-ugh. We will advance as well.
The prestigious guilds. It was now impossible to allow their greatest enemy, the Hermes Guild, to go rampant so freely.
“But why?”
The bottom feeders in the guild like Hegel did not know the reason and just had to blend with the crowd.
“I’ll get a head start.”
“Nide!’
In his vision was thief Nide hopping over the fences and debris like in a movie.
“What good is a thief going to do in battle…”
As the ridicule went on, three daggers from Nide’s hand stuck into the dragon’s body.
Nide climbed on the rope attached to the ends of the daggers and traversed to the dragon.
“Damn. I’d say I’m one of the strong ones, but these guys are just monsters.”
Hegel just kept on running with his sword in hand.
The streets of Morata were demolished and scarred, remnants of buildings scattered over the earth.
“Get out of the way. Move!”
The wounded players crawled to make way for others to fight the dragon.
The closer he got, the higher he had to lift his head to see the dark figure of the dragon high up in the sky.
“It’s too big.”
Hegel was intimidated. It looked like the players of each guild were already crowded near the dragon and no room for him to shine.
“Then… Whatever!”
Hegel ran hoping to do at least something.
The dragon’s obsidian leg was unfortunately coming down to stomp him.
You’re in danger. Grab the rope!
Where is the rope…
Whip!
The rope wrapped around his waist and yanked him into the air.
“Ugh. I have acrophobia…”
Hegel complained, oblivious to the fact that he was almost killed a moment ago. Then he met eyes with the dark waving eyes
Kaybern!
Hegel’s floating body had been lifted to the face of the Black Dragon.
“What the heck… Huh?!”
Pat.
Hegel mindlessly landed on the nose of the dragon.
“Nide, you crazy bastard! Why here of all places!”
***
“What’s he doing over there?”
Weed caught a glance of Hegel sitting on the dragon’s nose and swinging his sword.
Hegel lacked the swordsmanship and the equipment to cut through the dragon’s thick scale.
“Sword of Taran!”
It was funny to see him swinging in a flounder but doing his best, and this display boosted incredible courage in the other players.
“Even that coward Hegel is fighting.”
“That punk. To climb up there… Is he a genius or out of his mind?”
“Just wait. We’re climbing too!”
It was the moment where the fear dwelling inside the players was completely erased.
The Black Lion Guild and the other guilds took control of the ground and opened a path for the dwarves to climb.
“The humans are assisting us. Let’s go, Einhand.”
“I’m Brockhand from the Rock Liquor Storage, you damn dragon!”
“The shining axe of Letonya, Pavahand is here!”
- Dwarves, how dare you lowly pests make way to this place!
Kaybern was enraged, but the dwarves with their stubbed legs repressed their fear and scurried over.
[Dwarf Pavahand activated the Earth Trembling Call.
Endurance is enhanced.
Movement speed is increased by 20%.
All elemental resistances are enhanced.
When near other dwarves, defense-enhancing effects multiply.]
Each and every dwarf was hero level!
They began thrusting their spears and hacking with their axes.
Some were kicked while climbing the legs or flung off the tail.
- Provide healing and blessings to the wounded dwarves.
- Understood!
Weed asked Irene who led the priest unit. From then on, light waves of healing and blessings sparked on every dwarf.
“As I predicted.”
He confirmed that the three dragons were completely swept up in the raging tides of battle.
People thought of competition as something exhausting, but then there was nothing like it that drove them to such exhilaration.
‘Now, I can’t just leave the Hermes Guild to sweep this dragon hunt into their pocket.’
It was time for Weed to step in.
It wasn’t enough to leave the dragon hunt to the dwarves and the guilds.
“Sculptural Destruction! All shall become power!”
Weed converted all his Art points into Strength and shouted.
Just for this battle, he destroyed one of his masterpieces.
“I am Weedhand!”
Kaybern’s clone reacted immediately to Weed.
- You rat! So that is where you were hiding!
In such a dire situation, it still wanted revenge for the robbery of its lair.
- Imprisoning Fire!
Boiling heat surged from deep in the earth.
“Aggh!”
“It’s fire. Dodge it!”
The players of the Loam Guild scrambled. Weed tread over the ocean of fire and picked up a spear on the ground. It was a decent spear dropped by someone in the Loam Guild.
“Spear Throw!”
It was a Novice level 9 spear throw.
“K-agh!”
Hegel hurriedly crouched and avoided the projectile.
It targeted Kaybern’s head but bounced off the dragon’s forehead.
- Worthless dwarf!
Though it didn’t inflict any damage, it sure brought on the dragon’s wrath.
- I swear I will butcher you like a swine.
Kaybern began charging at Weed, ignoring all the players on the ground.
Hegel too in that moment held onto Nide’s ropes, hopped off the nose and was rescued.
- Binds of Pain!
[You are suffering from curse magic.
Fighting Spirit endures the pain.
Health points decrease by 5,400 each second.
The Lightning Crown resists the rooted status.]
This time, the rooting spell was used first so he couldn’t escape.
The dark aura grasped his ankles and legs, but the Lightning Crown negated it.
- Arcane Blast!
Dozens of light rays rained down from Kaybern’s body.
It was unidentified, but a magic spell of great altitude!
“Four-legged Sprint.”
Weed kicked off the building and threw his entire body.
C-c-c-c-crash!
As the roads and buildings got destroyed in a wreck, he travelled through the dimensional gate and avoided the spell successfully.
He couldn’t prevent some attacks but they were deflected by the passive barrier of the Lightning Crown.
“Is this it? This is so mild for a dragon. Maybe you’re the weakest dragon of them all!”
Trash talking every chance he got was essential!
- Kraagh! You will never be forgiven.
Kaybern’s chase shook the earth.
‘A dragon does not carry out an efficient battle. It cannot bear the presence of something that angers it.’
The circumstance was different from when he was dangerously luring the dragon alone.
The dragon was under the attack of the dwarves and other players during its frustrated chase.
“Come at me, you smoked mutt!”
- Hell Fire!
The ultimate fire magic spell. The ground fissured, giving way to raging strands of fire.
The thirst for vengeance seemed so great, having to use an ultimate spell that consumes a huge deal of mana.
‘I can deal with that.’
Weed possessed high magic resistance, holy fire and the Goblet of Flames.
The fire type spells that Kaybern liked to use were most comfortable for him. He suffered little to no damage.
‘Still, it isn’t so dumb because it’s a dragon. It does not repeat a fire magic spell. In any case, I have no time to poke around.’
Weed passed through the dimensional gate and pulled out an axe from behind his back.
[You have equipped the Dragonslayer Axe.
Stats decrease by 10 points at random.
Maximum health points and mana are increased 3x.
5% of damage dealt is converted into health points.
All stats are temporarily increased by 150.
Ingrievous wound!
You may inflict additional damage.
Damage inflicted by axes increased by 80%.
Attack cleave range increased.
Critical strike rate increased.
Great damage reduces recovery rate and inflicts damage over time for 20 seconds.
Defense penetration!
Each successful consecutive strike reduces defense by 15.
Heavy strikes have a chance to inflict permanent defense reduction or lead to armor break.
Reduce the monster’s Fighting Spirit.
Summon Rock Shield skill now available.
Power of axe skills deal double damage.
Rate of skill acquisition during battle is increased.
Attack damage of all nearby dwarf warriors is enhanced.
Strength and Stamina boosting skills have been fully mastered.]
A long status message appeared.
Having converted all Art stats into Strength, his attack damage was the highest in all of history. Moreover, the additional effects of the Dragonslayer Axe were applied.
[You have engaged with a dragon.
Attack damage is enhanced.
Magic resistance increased by 49%.
When taking damage, health points are recovered 150% faster.
You gain immunity to curses and negative status effects.
You are now able to use penetration, break and crushing attacks.
When standing on the ground, you are immune to knockback.]
Weed held the most awesome weapon crafted by the dwarves and their sacrifice.
“I will crush you into pieces.”
Stomp-stomp-stomp!
Kaybern too approached with its jaws stuck out.
- I will swallow you down at once!
Weed saw Kaybern in proximity and leapt into the air.
“Basher!”
It was the most common axe skill.
Devastating strike!
A force that could change the terrains has been inflicted on the enemy.
Strike of vengeance!
Attacks against a dragon deal 300% damage.
The dragon was capable of ignoring just about any attack and could kick or bite an enemy.
Weed’s axe pounded the dragon’s head and forced it back.
- I will kill you! I will make sure of it!
Kaybern cried vengefully right in front of him.
Weed smiled brightly.
“Now we’re talking!”

chapters.title: Chapter 659: Volume 57, 6 - Blue Dragon Latuas (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Volume 57, Chapter 6 - Blue Dragon Latuas (Part 1)
The Hermes Guild knew how to display their combat strength without leaving any regrets.
“Protect Bard Ray-nim!”
“Advance fearlessly. We are the Hermes Guild!”
The Hermes Guild members relished in the frenzy of battle alongside Bard Ray.
Kaybern brandished its tail, but even more players followed, pushing forward through the bombardment of magic spells. Their clothes and faces were scorched like coal as they pushed forward in spite of the poison hanging in the air.
What was fearsome was their concentration on battle! Amid the chaos, they cast powerful skills in sequence and whittled down the dragon’s health points.
Calcus: The left leg is weak.
Pindeg: The scales on the underside of the right wing were also destroyed. Physical damage is going right through it.
They shared the weak points of the dragon, fighting with great adaptability.
- Humans! You shall not prevail against me!
Kaybern let out a scream-like roar.
The dragon hunt took place with great performances from those who used the Brazier of Sacrifice.
“We will take care of its rear. Front lines, hold against the attacks!”
“Strike the head. Harass it so it cannot use any more magic spells.”
The Hermes Guild was a complex tangle of different interests based on the origin and area of each player. But at this very moment, their wills joined as one.
Gaushu: The wings were ruined, weakening the dragon.
Lamifter: We need to concentrate our attacks somehow and take quick care of it. Mage units advance from your current positions.
The mages emerged from their hideouts and ran forward.
They chanted their magic spells before releasing them in Kaybern’s direction and assisted in the attack.
The spells exploded like fireworks against the Black Dragon’s hide. The dragon still possessed high magic resistance, but they did reduce its health points.
Pale: Our objective is the dragon on the right.
Python: I have waited for this moment. Let’s go!
The players of the assault squad charged at the dragon. But, there were a considerable number of squad members still waiting inside the buildings.
They observed the Hermes Guild’s fight with admiration and even felt angry about themselves.
“I honestly don’t have the guts to fight like them.”
“It looks so dangerous. So many people are dying.”
They planned to be the heroes of the dragon hunt, but most of them were intimidated by the way the Hermes Guild fought.
They chose to form small groups and watch instead.
“The Hermes Guild is putting up a great fight. It’s better this way as it has a higher chance of succeeding.”
“And Morata will suffer less destruction.”
“Damn it. It still feels hard to accept. How much work have we all done to hunt the dragon?”
“You’re right. We did an incredible job.”
“Hey man, the Hermes Guild volunteered to use the brazier and fight first, so we just have to sit back and let things take care of themselves.”
The assault squad members realized that their own power was not as significant. The Hermes Guild was doing so well that their participation had little meaning.
“Here we thought we would save the continent with our hands, but we’re just a crowd.”
“This place is the safest. Let’s go help them out when it becomes really dangerous.”
“I guess you’re right.”
While the squad members were hesitating, the battle waged on.
Vishur, Knatul and Malin were extraordinary and countless others showed their skills.
“Players of Castle Vent. All advance for war!”
Oberon also used the brazier and tackled the dragon. The dwarven followers tailed behind him. The observing players further lost the will to engage. The danger of the situation was emphasised by the fact that Kaybern’s resistance brutally reaped the lives of player after player.
The repeated sense of defeat they experienced while residing in the Central Continent was oppressing them.
“Morata is in an irrecoverable situation. Let’s just get out of here.”
“Really? You think it’s alright?”
“Yeah. The novice players are doing that already.”
“People are going to bash on us if we get caught.”
“They’re all swamped. If we change clothes, no one will know.”
The novice players that stayed inside the city to spectate had begun exiting through the gate as the battle grew more intense.
The assault squad members eventually changed into cheap travelling attire and escaped through the gates of Morata.
***
Weed, who was playing the role of bait, restlessly assessed his surroundings.
Morata’s urban district was half destroyed in battle.
The 3 and 4-story concrete buildings that had dominated the skyline had disappeared among the sonic explosions, and there was no more meaning to putting the fires out now, given the state of the city.
“Corpse Explosion!”
“Corpse Explosion!”
The necromancers were busily taking care of the corpses.
Swift Coldwind: Landony has crossed the Neria Sea and arrived in the Northern Continent. Given its route, it is heading straight for Morata.
The dwarf warriors one sidedly attacked the dragon that was chasing down Weed.
“The dragon is getting away!”
“For dwarven pride!”
The dwarves Carlisle and Roam clung desperately to the back of Kaybern’s head.
They had put their lives on the line for this battle. Oddly, the dragon did not take notice of them which allowed them to attack freely.
- How dare these earthworms…!
Kaybern stopped in its tracks and was about to lash its tail at the chasers.
“Your enemy is me, Weedhand!”
Weed also slowed his feet to turn the dragon’s attention back to himself.
“Sword Cloning Technique!”
He quickly drew the Loa Sword, producing 50 clones as he ran towards the dragon.
- I will murder you first. Breathing Flames!
Kaybern welcomed him with a trail of fire from its mouth.
It was not just thejust a the dragon’s firebreath, but one of the ultimate fire magic spells!
Clones have dissipated.
Weed advanced in a zigzag movement while the clones melted.
The Crown of Lightning formed a barrier that blocked the fire magic spell.
He kicked off a nearby boulder and leapt close to the dragon’s head.
- I have you this time!
Kaybern’s claws were ripping through the air.
In the most dire moment, Weed activated a Sculptural technique.
“Time Sculptural Technique.”
The final secret technique of the Sculptural arts.
The world froze and the dragon was no different.
A quiet world with all sounds entirely silenced.
Everything occurring in Morata stopped at once like a miracle.
The explosions and general chaos of the war, even the rain of fire falling from the sky.
The city looked like a symbol for the end of the world, even Weed with his limited emotional sensitivity could appreciate its tragic beauty.
The time energy that he had accumulated up to 90,000 was diminishing rapidly.
‘I never got to refill properly after I won against Bard Ray.’
Weed moved 20 more meters and approached close to the dragon’s face.
Hegel did not accomplish it, but he was different.
“Here, take it!”
Weed pulled out the Loa Sword and thrust it inside the dragon’s eye. Then, time was set back on track.
Kraaaaaagh!
The Loa Sword penetrated the dragon’s eye! The holy flames activated and spewed out spouts of fire everywhere.
[Critical Strike!
You have destroyed one of the dragon’s eyes.
You have reduced the dragon’s health points by 563,974.]
***
“Keep pressing forward.”
“Front line, don’t avoid it! Hold your grounds and look for an opportunity! If you don’t die in a single attack, your health will be restored.”
“Long spear unit, advance!”
Under Arkhim’s command, the Hermes Guild began to push back the dragon with overwhelming force. The Hermes Guild charged like a swarm of bees.
Thousands of troops were waiting to charge, and in the outskirts an outstanding number of players were providing assistance.
Kaybern’s defense and magic resistance was indeed incredible, but thousands of arrows and magic spells were being poured down upon it in an endless stream.
Bard Ray who had been fighting on top of the dragon’s body with the Glacial Sword from the start was still clearly visible. A phrase came out from someone’s mouth.
“God Warrior!”
The nickname originated from back when he conquered the Haven region and expanded his faction to the Central Continent; they had cheered on the God Warrior who had won battle after battle.
“God Warrior! God Warrior! God Warrior!”
That title spread among the Hermes Guild like a contagion. Soon a huge crowd had joined the chanting.
God Warrior, Bard Ray!
He, wearing winged armor, along with his personal guards flew through the sky and attacked the dragon’s body directly. He was hit by friendly fire but endured through it with the healing spells from the priests.
The sight of him attacking the dragon despite all the pain and wounds was that of the absolute and unstoppable Bard Ray that the Hermes Guild cherished.
“God Warrior! God Warrior! God Warrior!”
The morale of the Hermes Guild reached its peak. They volunteered to be in the world’s most difficult battle. Their esteem was surging so high that it blew away the loser’s mentality that they had developed after their defeat at the battle of Garnav Plains.
Arkhim shouted.
“Everyone fight with the will to forfeit your lives! Today, we will become legends!”
The Hermes Guild wildly pounced at the dragon. The faction existed only for Bard Ray and his power. The dragon’s body was cut all over.
- Mere humans!
Kaybern roared and whipped its tail. Dozens of knights were struck away but more charged while blowing horn flutes.
The players watching from the buildings far away spoke.
“Don’t you feel like shouting God Warrior too?”
“The stories about Bard Ray are true. He fights like he’s crazy.”
The hearts of the Hermes Guild members were fueled with Bard Ray’s passion.
- Thorn Wall
The dragon raised a wall weaved from steel thorns, but the players broke through with their bodies and took one more step after each tail whip, advancing slowly.
For the death of every 10 Hermes Guild members, the dragon’s health points decreased correspondingly.
Krrruuuuuah!
Kaybern began to scream in pain.
The sleek obsidian scales were completely ruined, incapable of deflecting the weapons of the attackers. The dragon was unleashing magic spells in all directions, but the humans that survived with little health quickly recovered and re-engaged.
The legacy of the invincible Hermes Guild was unfolding once again.
- Humans! Curse you all and this city.
Kaybern, upon dropping below 7% of its health points, spread its right wing wide. The badly wounded left wing only spread halfway.
That moment, each commander shouted.
“It’s flight!”
“The dragon is trying to escape to the sky!”
Even if it did, they could chase with flight spells.
However, it was difficult to continue with the same concentrated firepower that they could muster on the ground.
“All attack! Spend all your mana!”
The Hermes Guild members that could still hold onto their weapons threw themselves into battle.
They were unhindered by the dragon’s resistance and magic spells, and they tossed the net that they had prepared.
So many weapons found their homes all over the dragon’s body over the course of battle and the net tangled on top!
Kuuuuaagh!
It was a net crafted by Dragore himself with thread that never breaks, scavenged by the Hermes Guild. Zephy, being a fisherman had not participated in battle. Instead he roamed around and strung Kaybern’s legs to the net, preventing the dragon from taking flight.
On Kaybern’s back and head were Bard Ray and the warriors of the guild.
- A bunch of humans cannot stop me.
The dragon began floating along with the thousands of players holding tightly onto the net.
5 meters. 10 meters. The Black Dragon slowly rose to the sky!
Arkhim: Mage unit, attack at once!
Lamifter: There are too many allies in the blast range.
Bard Ray: It doesn’t matter. Fire!
Magic spells flew in from all over Morata and were directed towards Kaybern.
The Hextech Cannon was also fired.
“Kill it!”
“This is the end.”
The players riding on top of the dragon also committed to the frenzied attack. They didn’t have any moment to check the kinds of spells flying towards them.
“Power of Birth, The Dark Knight Strike!”
Bard Ray used a chain of skills. His body was worn out, having withstood the attacks from Kaybern and the other players.
If it was his former self, he would have slipped out of the battle once he dropped to around half his health points and taken a rest.
After becoming the Ironblood Warrior, he could take a lot more damage, it wasn’t strange at all if he already died.
The healing spells of the guild were concentrated on him, but there were many grave situations like being slammed by the dragon’s tail.
The lizard’s health points are less than 2%.
As soon as Krobidyun spoke, the attack of the Hermes Guild entered what could be perfectly explained as a berserk state. Each and every one of them spent all their stamina and mana for skills.
“Intoxication of Pain!”
It was a skill he learned by becoming an Ironblood Warrior.
It was one of the secret techniques of the warrior, drawing out high attack power based on the missing health points. Its downside was the amount of stamina it consumed upon casting, but when would he ever use such a skill if not now?
Bard Ray struck his sword downwards, directly into the dragon’s brow.
“Die, you loathsome lizard!”

chapters.title: Chapter 660: Volume 57, 6 - Blue Dragon Latuas (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Volume 57, Chapter 6 - Blue Dragon Latuas (Part 2)
“Wa-hoo!”
Geomchi roared in excitement as he charged the dragon.
“Finally I get a round with that creature!”
“You look happy, master!”
Geomchi2 and the instructors followed along with their swords unsheathed.
The feeling of running through a ruined city against a gigantic dragon was indescribable.
“Yeah. You’re damn right.”
“It’s a magic spell!”
- Roaring Thunder!
Craaack!
Thunder struck down from the sky and killed off all the warriors within range.
The storm cloud gathered rapidly and thunder shot down in random bursts across a radius of 1 km!
It was not only the warriors but also the buildings in Morata that became targets.
Nevertheless, the Geomchis thought it was cool to charge in as a group.
“Do not break away from the formation!”
“That is the master’s orders. Stick close!”
With Geomchi in the lead, the apprentices spread out behind him in a fan-shaped position!
“They’re out of their minds!”
“So reckless.”
The assault squad members were shocked, the actions of true romantics were difficult for them to understand.
- Bone Grasp! Pillar of Flames!
They were hindered by skeletal hands that rose from the earth as well as surging fire blasts, but they ran straight through them.
“They’re just going in a line.”
“I never thought I would see something like that even in a dragon hunt.”
Geomchi and the apprentices climbed on top of the dragon, sustaining casualties along the way.
“Kill it!”
“Chop it into pieces!
“Shred it down!”
After using the brazier, their level ranged from 800 to 900. They were warriors who were extremely proficient in attack damage.
[Critical Strike!]
[Critical Strike!]
[Critical Strike!]
The attacks following the brawny charge were dreadfully powerful, dealing incredible damage at such a short range.
Their attack power was high, but it was their pinpoint accuracy that concentrated their attacks between the dragon’s scales and cracks in the skin.
“This is the Single Point Attack!”
“Single Point Attack!”
“They’re focusing their attacks on a single area!”
They attacked the Black Dragon’s most vulnerable area and crushed the dense scales.
When the dragon was distracted with the assault squad in front, they inflicted a huge amount of damage.
Ta-ta-ta-tap!
Geomchi3 clambered atop the dragon from its tail, before forward across its back and onto the head, where he stopped and hung on with all his strength.
“Hahahahaha! I have arrived!”
Geomchi3 relentlessly struck down his sword.
Krrruuuuuuuh!
Kaybern’s anger turned towards the man who hung on its head.
“Keep cutting through them. Scales are meant to be crushed.”
“U-wuh! Woah! Oo-wah!”
“We are the lunatics in the hood!”
It wasn’t that the entire assault squad was passive and timid.
They were just behaving because of the Hermes Guild, and frankly speaking, they were daunted. Weed told them to grow their primal instincts in the Southern Desert region, and this could be clearly seen from how eager Geomchi and his apprentices appeared.
“We should provide assistance. They are fighting well, so instead of direct attacks on the dragon, focus on creating distractions.”
“Yes. Understood.”
Pale fired arrows with the archer unit.
“Fire!”
Fire arrows, Smoke Arrows, Odorous Arrows, Paralysing Arrows, Poison Arrows.
Various types of arrows were fired to annoy the dragon.
They didn’t have the guts to try and inflict damage through the dragon’s thick scales from such a distance.
All they could do is aim at the body and distract it.
Several arrows inside Pale’s quiver were special.
[Death Arrow!
When it strikes the target directly, it inflicts up to 100,000 damage.]
There were only five of these arrows in the world.
Only through the completion of the archer quest involving the World Tree could one obtain this priceless arrow.
Weed spoke to him before the battle.
“Do not use it early, just hold onto it. It would be best for me to get the kill… But Pale-nim, you should also aim for the last hit.”
“The last hit?”
“The final lethal blow. If you slay the dragon, you will obtain a special combat achievement.”
The honor of the dragon slayer.
Pale did not think that far, but if he were to succeed, it would be an amazing accomplishment.
‘For that moment, I am saving this arrow.’
He had a sense of appreciation for Weed. Who else would give him such advice?
He took reference of the Hermes Guild that engaged in battle first when he decided on the tactics for the assault squad.
The mages and archers were providing ranged support and the warriors were fighting as the core, restlessly engaging in melee combat.
Certainly they were weaker than the Hermes Guild and they were definitely weaker than Weed who was fighting alongside the dwarves and other prestigious guilds.
Kaybern activated the Light type ultimate magic spell.
- Destruction of Light!
Streaks of light descended onto the earth as if the sky had exploded.
The brilliant flashes could be seen from far outside the city.
It turned players of level 300 to 400 into ashes.
“Hiyahhh!”
“Kill it, now!”
“My body is on fire… Ahh. It’s my first time getting skewered by light.”
“A hole through my eternal heart. K-hahaha. I am the one and only Geomchi500!”
Geomchi, the apprentices and the assault squad members could not equip high magic resistance equipment as the Hermes Guild did. Weed tried to distribute his cherished equipment to Geomchi and the others, but they outright declined his offer.
“It is not our style to fight with multiple stacks of armor.”
They were sword fanatics and were dying as a result from Kaybern’s magic, but the atmosphere they created was still rather inspiring.
Knatul bravely diverted the attention of the dragon while Vishur inflicted damage with Elemental Spirits, magic spells and arrows.
Fairy Knight wielded the sword that cut through dimensions which completely ignored defense and made short work of Kaybern’s body.
“Hu-hahaha. The dragon will fall by our hands.”
“Master! This is such a glorious moment.”
Half of their forces were already dead.
“If we take a blow and return two in exchange, we are the winners.”
“You are right, master!”
“One on one isn’t the only kind of fighting.”
“Mob fights are the real fights.”
Oberon drew the dragon’s attention from the ground. He led the warriors at the front line and incited the dragon to attack him. Many were stomped to death but they succeeded in drawing the dragon’s aggression so that the attacks of the other groups could land more easily.
If it weren’t for them, Geomchi and the apprentices could have been wiped out after just a few magic spells.
“We will be victorious!”
Oberon shouted and boosted their morale. That moment, shouts burst from the ranks of the Hermes Guild.
“The dragon is dead!”
“Bard Ray-nim hunted the dragon!”
The players in Morata instantly turned towards the dragon marked by the Hermes Guild.
Bard Ray stood on top of the dragon’s head with his sword stuck through it. His cape was flucking in the wind. The enormous Black Dragon slowly crashed to the ground.
“Yes! We defeated the dragon!”
“We won.”
“Now there are only two left.”
***
The Earthly Shadows party, composed of Silver Ring and Elrix, acquired the items needed for the quest.
“Let’s hurry.”
“The Promise Necklace. I didn’t think we would obtain it so early.”
“I never thought the Hermes Guild would help us out.”
The information provided by the Hermes Guild was a great help in regards to scavenging items related to the dragon Ratuas. With butterflies in their stomachs, they travelled instantly to the entrance of Gregodal Mountain Pass with Yurin’s Painting Teleportation.
“Thank you.”
“No problem. Please go ahead and tend to your task.”
“You are really kind.”
Ben smiled as he, Elrix and Yurin quickly climbed the trail. To meet the dragon Ratuas, they had to travel by foot from this point.
‘She’s really cute.’
Glance.
While making haste, his feeling of interest made him turn around to see Yurin, noticing a great wolf that appeared in front of her.
After Kaybern’s activity, monsters roaming further afield became more frequent, but Gregodal Mountain Pass was one of those places that had been dangerous to begin with.
‘I have to rescue her.’
As Ben was about to stop, he saw her pull out a huge club from her back.
“Huh?”
Yurin had no interest in swords or spear techniques.
Although she never had much desire for battles, she had become powerful enough to take care of monsters while painting.
The wolf pounced at Yurin and that moment, her club danced skillfully.
Crack! Whimper! Woop!
“Ben? Get on your way!”
“Uh. Y-Yeah…”
Ben refused to believe what he just witnessed and kept on the path.
A lich with a skull staff was on the side of the road.
- Human. This is where the great Ratuas-nim resides.
Elrix put his hand on his chest and bowed politely.
“We have come to meet Ratuas-nim.”
- Ratuas-nim does not meet with lowly humans.
“Here… I have something he will be interested in.”
Elrix showed the Promise Necklace and was granted permission by the lich.
- You may see him. Follow me.
The Blue Dragon Ratuas. Unlike the other dragons, he did not show himself to the outside world and made no contact with any adventurers or race.
The past incident of Weed meeting him and returning with Hellium was a legend among adventurers.
“I am in the presence of the dragon himself.”
The Earthly Shadow party was able to meet the massive Blue Dragon inside the lair.
- Humans. I hear you have brought something I want.
“That is so.”
Elrix carefully offered the Promise Necklace.
- Do you have any idea about what this is?
“We do not.”
The Earthly Shadow party obtained the Promise Necklace from the Reindeer Dungeon.
It was not by hunting down the boss monster, but rather it was an item hidden in the corner of the dungeon.
[Promise Necklace
It is sealed with a unique magical property.
It is a token representing some kind of promise.
Durability: 10/10.]
They only speculated that they would be able to learn about it as they proceeded with the quest.
This necklace is the token of my oath.
Crack!
The Promise Necklace woven of marbles shattered into pieces.
[Something that the Dragon Ratuas Seeks - Complete.
Latuas had made a promise long ago to his friend Uthkelanta.
“I will protect the living on this land as a favor. When the world plunges in danger, I will save them.”
It was a promise with the Silver Dragon Yuskellanda. Ratuas’ noble oath will be maintained to the end of time.]
[You have leveled up.]
[Your friendship level with Ratuas increased.]
[The dragon has taken an interest in you.]
[Reputation has increased by 20,000.]
That instant, a mysterious scene played out in front of the Earthly Shadows party members…
***
From the dark, crimson rift spawned an endless stream of demons, and the Silver Dragon stood in their way, defending with magic.
- Drink the dragon’s blood!
- Devour its bones and gorge out its eyes!
The Silver Dragon faced the attacks of the demon soldiers with wind and defensive magic spells. More and more demons spawned from the rift, leading to the appearance of demon warriors and the mutilation of the Silver Dragon’s body.
- Revive.
Each time the Silver Dragon fell in danger, it recovered its own health.
The sun rose, the sun set.
The war waged for days.
Finally, like an army of ants taking down an elephant, the demon soldiers penetrated the Silver Dragon’s barrier and pierced its body.
The footage ended as the bloody Silver Dragon fell powerlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 661: Volume 57, 6 - Blue Dragon Ratuas (Part 4)
chapters.content:
Volume 57, Chapter 6 - Blue Dragon Ratuas (Part 4)
A crowd of players followed in the wake of the dragon that was chasing Weed.
“Chasing Light!”
“Rage of Boiling Blood!”
“Awaken, Berserk, Madness!”
About 10,000 players approached faster than the Black Lion Guild and the other guilds, casting ranged skills as they came in.
“What, who are they?”
“They’re so strong.”
Even the players of the prestigious guilds were surprised. Wherever they came from, they surely possessed skills that exceeded their own. They used unknown skills and wielded high quality equipment.
‘The dark gamers.’
Weed realized instantly after seeing the new players on the ground.
‘Then it’s a race against time.’
