“It’s my duty. We will exterminate the monsters in the region and move on to the next.”
“You sure are busy.”
“The North is the homeland of my heart.”
The Arpen Imperial army recently expanded quite significantly.
Many knight players joined and whenever a battle broke out, they came riding on horses or bulls and participated spontaneously.
Knights could earn hefty amounts of contribution points and reputation just by joining a battle, so a crowd of them gathered for the upcoming war.
“After we end the Rosenheim and Britten Alliance, the Arpen Empire will unite the continent”
“Conquer, conquer! Whoo!”
“There is little territory left and it would be a shame not to unite the continent. The two kingdoms are also wishing for it.”
“You’re right on that.”
The knights felt proud to be under the wings of the Arpen Empire.
If the empire were to become the first to accomplish total unification, they expected that a special achievement would be awarded for them as well.
- Kuuuuuaaaat!
Myul’s Griffin unit could be seen in the sky. There were no threats after Kaybern’s death, so even the baby Griffins tagged along.
“The baby Griffins are so cute with their little wings.”
“I want to raise one. It would be so nice if I was capable of feeding them properly.”
The players gathered in front of the Baroc Mountain Pass that stretched over the border of Britten territory.
Many players were waiting for the Arpen army to advance over the borders of the Rosenheim Kingdom.
“When is Weed-nim arriving?”
“I don’t know… I think it’s about time.”
It was that moment.
- Kraaaaagh!
A violent roar echoed and soon, humongous birds almost the size of dragons appeared above the peak of the Mountain Pass.
It was a group of wild Baraags!
They were sculptural creatures left by emperor Geihar, truly outrageous creatures in combat.
The players noticed Weed riding on the back of a Baraag.
“It’s Weed-nim!”
‘He’s finally here.”
The knights of the Arpen army aligned on the ground began shouting.
“Our Lord and Emperor is here.”
“Everyone, shout out and cheer.”
“Hoo-ah! Hoo-ah!”
The Imperial forces numbering approximately 300,000 deafened the ears of everyone around with their shouts.
Adding in all the knights, the numbers were even higher.
Prrrrr!
Even the bulls trembled their lips and welcomed their emperor.
“Please give a speech!”
“Sing. A song of war!”
The cheers of the players was a huge commotion.
The war against the Rosenheim and Britten Kingdom was close, but the outcome was predetermined.
They would have won regardless of Weed’s appearance, but since he mobilized such a large force, he wanted to display a fine figure to the public.
Weed also fell into a state of excitement and began singing.
He raised the key of the song with the first note, ignored the beats and belted out in a coarse voice.
- I had a dream since I was a kid.
The dream to be well off.
I wanted my back to be warm,
I wanted to feed myself so much that I cried deeply.
His song was a mess, but it certainly carried his emotions.
His past of hunger and years of trying in desperation.
- What was I?
I didn’t know anything.
I didn’t know the reason to keep living.
I knew for sure that pride could not feed my stomach.
Crying was a luxury.
Tears make you weak.
Run. Run.
I beat down a monster.
Clobber it.
This is my bread and butter.
Du-dum! Du-dum!
Someone hit the drums in sync.
The bulls rode by the Arpen knights waved their tails and danced as if they were responding to Weed’s song.
- Arpen Empire, ruler of all the lands under the sun.
Eat some chicken,
Farm the lands.
Roast the pork belly,
Sell your products.
If you want a refreshing glass of beer, hunt for it.
If you live diligently, good things will come.
Life is all about the grinding.
“Ah…”
“I don’t understand. The lyrics are too deep.”
“I’m not sure, but I think he’s thinking about his past and giving a message about living to the best of our abilities.”
“I think that’s the idea, right?”
The players listening to Weed’s song felt like guessing a short answer question in language class.
But, the song was not over!
- Oink-oink, Quack-quack, Cock-a-doodle-doo!
An awesome, beautiful world.
Even in hardship, let us walk together.
Sing joyfully.
Live on.
Parents who embrace their child.
Don’t forget the warmth,
Live, live and keep living.
Tears dropped from Weed’s eyes.
Tears that only squeezed out when he yawned flowed while he was thinking about his past.
No matter the hardships, he bore them all. But, there were people vivid in his memories who he could never call upon again.

chapters.title: Chapter 668: Volume 58, 1 - World Unification Part 1
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 1 - World Unification Part 1
The Arpen Imperial army boldy marched towards Castle Serabourg.
“Maintain marching formation. Knights open up the path.”
Alcatra led the army as the chief commander. Even after crossing the border, the forces of the Rojaim Kingdom were nowhere to be seen.
“The lord of the Turan Village arrived with his forces. A hundred soldiers have joined our ranks.”
“The lord from The Bakers Village has also arrived. He brought 250 troops and 3 knights.”
“Reinforcements have arrived from the Daltangra Fortress. 1,000 Cavalry units.”
The lords of the Rohaim Kingdom competed against one another to join the Arpen Imperial army.
“It is an honor to be in your presence, Lord Weed.”
“Welcome to Rojaim.”
The lords were tense, bowing their heads before Weed.
Weed felt like a transcendent being as he seized command of the Hermes Guild and united the Central Continent.
The way they viewed Weed was different from how they assessed typical players.
“I am grateful for your visit.”
“We will take the lead.”
“No. Follow behind us for now. You do not have to engage in the war.”
Weed had no intention of using the forces of the lords who surrendered.
‘It will be a hassle if Castle Serabourg suffers damage.”
The objective of the siege on Castle Serabourg was to take control with minimal losses.
The Arpen Empire was already spending an unimaginable amount of funds on recovering Morata.
Weed gathered Mihel, Kalis and Roam before beginning to speak.
“Do not set fire to anything. Conquering is great, but if any buildings are set ablaze, extinguish them.”
“Understood.”
“Also, do not destroy the gate unless it is necessary. It will all cost money to repair.”
“Pardon?”
“Do not slaughter the Rojaim soldiers as you please. We will lose trust from the public once we conquer the castle.”
“…”
The smiling, composed faces of the great lords had turned stiff.
“Then how do we go on about taking the castle?”
“That is for you folks to figure out.”
“…”
Weed was much more relaxed after becoming the emperor.
He delegated all the tedious and troublesome tasks, sat back and waited for them to be completed.
“I don’t have to look after everything myself. More diligent folks will take care of them.”
He felt the true sweetness of authority.
Nevertheless, the great lords did not see it as a challenge.
“The players will not fight to defend the kingdom. Then it is easier for us to manage our army. We are at ease.”
“Skip or fly over the walls and use our mages to sleep the enemy soldiers.”
“That is a great suggestion. We must not kill and have to leave the buildings unharmed… but it isn’t impossible.”
“The knights and soldiers of Rojaim are not at a level where they can harm us, so we don’t have to fight as hard.”
The great lords brought over a crowd of high level players.
It was the moment of uniting the world which drew the attention of the public.
These players had not used the Brazier of Sacrifice and naturally maintained the highest level in Royal Road.
“Halt!”
“All poise and prepare for battle!”
The forces set up a wide formation on the plains in front of the castle gate.
There were other cities and castles in Rojaim, but if the capital were conquered, most others would soon follow.
Weed flew in the sky riding on top of a Baraag. Countless players were watching him from the castle’s center town square, training arena, fountain and the trades sector.
“Weed-nim is here!”
“We have waited for so long, Weed-nim!”
“Hooray Arpen Empire!”
“Grass Porridge! Grass Porridge!”
It was a mix of Rojaim players and Northern players who came to observe.
Weed waved lightly as a reply to the welcoming players.
‘There are quite a number of soldiers stationed at the gate and walls.’
There were at least 50,000 to 60,000 soldiers as this castle was the capital of Rojaim.
Undoubtedly, not many volunteered to stand on the inside of those walls.
“I think this mission is too much for me.”
“I wish to go on knight duty.”
“Just surrender to the Arpen Empire. Weed-nim is a benevolent emperor.”
The knight players of Rojaim cut ties with their kingdom and left, but a few dozen decided to stay loyal and maintain their stations.
“Sigh. You fight even if it means death. I have never forfeit a quest.”
“The enemy is inside our borders? Unfortunately, it is the Arpen Empire. I would gladly fight if it was Haven. But I guess I’d die either way.”
“Let’s just give them kills.”
The Knight players were easily defamed if they did not keep to their honor and loyalty, and so they set out for battle willing to die.
- Attack, but do not kill anyone or destroy a single thing!
“Huh?”
“What does that mean?”
The players who did not have the inside information were thrown off by the command.
It was the same for the players who came to spectate and have joined the side of the Arpen Imperial army.
“Let’s go. It’s our time.”
“Don’t even bother unsheathing your weapons. We might kill a soldier by accident.”
The players over level 500 set out first.
There were players from the Assault Squad who participated in the Kaybern hunt among them, and they were the first to reach the walls.
***
< A siege war has commenced at Castle Serabourg.
The invasion of the Arpen Empire!
Players can join the siege and side with either the Arpen Empire or the Rojaim Kingdom.
National Contribution Points, Fame and Achievements will be awarded according to the outcome of the war. >
***
“Fire!”
“Stop the enemy from approaching the walls!”
The Rojaim soldiers fired arrows and activated the catapults aimed outside the walls.
The high level players avoided the rounds with ease or simply took the blows straight with their body and advanced. Once they got to the wall, they peacefully hooked the ladders and began climbing. They were subject to Weed’s scolding if they were to destroy anything in the castle with any attack skills.
- Myul: We will also get going.
The Griffin unit skipped the walls in a breeze and infiltrated the Castle Serabourg with high level players.
“Go easy.”
“Whack them carefully!”
The players of Arpen easily subdued the Rojaim soldiers.
The mages chose to use a large scale sleeping spell over the enemies.
Furthermore, the Black Lion Guild was particularly polite and covered the sleeping soldiers with blankets.
“That is the Arpen Imperial army… Too fearsome.”
“I give up, surrender!”
“Please spare my life.”
Within less than 5 minutes, the Rojaim army on the walls threw down their weapons and surrendered. The discrepancy in military force was one thing, but the swarm of baraags flying around was already so terrifying that they lost the will to fight.
“The emperor of the Arpen Empire even slayed the Black Dragon Kaybern.”
“The adventures he’s accomplished are at an unimaginable scale for people like us.”
“So he is the Emperor of Arpen, Weed… He’s so intimidating that I can’t even look at him.”
Weed’s charisma and fighting spirit, and countless combat achievements brought the soldiers to their knees.
“Ah, I guess that’s it. I tried to put up some kind of fight but… We surrender as well.”
The players who sided with the Rojaim Kingdom also raised their hands. Weed shouted while riding on top of his baraag.
“Take over the vital chokepoints and let’s clean out Castle Serabourg. Next is…”
He was interrupted as he was about to announce the next region to conquer.
Dwarf warrior Vindel from the Black Lion Guild spoke.
“Is it a party?”
“Sorry?”
“Today, Emperor Weed, who we deeply admire has dominated the Rojaim Kingdom; it is a truly delightful day, so can we drink and have some fun in Castle Serabourg?”
“…”
The players of the Rojaim Kingdom raised their arms in excitement.
“Hooray! It’s a feast!”
“A feast in the Rojaim Kingdom too.”
“Let’s drink up. We are now a part of the Arpen Empire.”
“Weed-nim, you’re the best!”
***
Serabourg King’s Palace.
It was a place that only allowed entrance to those with high honor and affiliation points.
The kingdom’s knights and palace guards were elites who ranged from level 300 to 400.
“We will take it from here.”
Alcatra, who was in charge of the Arpen army, led the way.
He and the knights with the highest level fought together.
It took some time to make sure that they didn’t take any lives, but the situation was taken care of with little effort and they made safe passage into the palace.
There were about 30 knights, the aristocrats and the king himself were waiting for them.
“How dare you invade this land!”
Winster was the king of Rojaim!
He was famed for having built a pyramid upon the request of the previous king, Siodern, but currently the throne had been inherited by his son.
Weed had met this man once before, but he did not get a good impression.
“An invasion…”
Weed nodded. With a light heart, he acknowledged the facts.
“It’s true that we invaded your lands.”
“This is tyranny. You cannot just trample over smaller kingdoms like this.”
Blink!
***
< King Winster of the Rojaim Kingdom is in opposition. Depending on your answer, the loyalty of the local citizens and national reputation will be influenced. >
***
There needed to be a justification for conquest.
Until now, most prestigious guilds and the Hermes Guild did not care about justification while they expanded their territories.
All they had to do was suppress retaliation with military force after the conquest and disregard the compromised public security.
For the Arpen Empire, it was about uniting the entire continent, so it was rather a difficult situation to provide special attention for the Rojaim Kingdom.
‘I could have just razed the entire kingdom by sending in the baraags, but that’s all national loss.’
Weed did not start a dictatorship, but the Arpen Empire was his own possession. Hence he smacked his lips first.
“It is for world peace.”
“Your invasion is for peace? How dare you speak such lies!”
The king’s reaction was as expected.
Weed spoke in a weary tone.
“We defeated the dragon, but the threat is not entirely gone. Not the Rojaim Kingdom, but an empire with power must defend the people. The demon king Cletta may return any time and the people are afraid.”
The just reason that always works like bread and butter; for world peace!
Blink!
***
< The influences of your reputation and achievements transformed the attitude of the royal knights to friendly. >
The royal knights were disappointed with King Winster time and time again. Instead of the greedy and incapable king, they think it won’t be bad for the savior of the world to govern the Rojaim Kingdom. >
***
The message alert gave a slight hint.
“The Rojaim Kingdom will do fine on our own.”
“The kingdom almost fell with the crisis of the Ambinu Cult. You did not act at all against Kaybern. The Rojaim Kingdom would have fallen to ruins at least twice if it weren’t for me.”
“But…”
“Leave it to me. I will take care of the people, turn the knights into honorable and powerful assets.”
King Winster was pitifully dragged out by the royal knights. Once Weed sat on the throne, a message alert popped up.
Blink!
***
< The Rojaim Kingdom surrendered.
Castle Serabourg and the nearby territory have been merged into the Arpen Empire.
Some regional lords will resist until the end.
National Reputation increased by 7. >
***
The resistance army was nothing notable.
The players of the Rojaim Kingdom were already accepting the Arpen Empire.

chapters.title: Chapter 669: Volume 58, 1 - World Unification Part 3
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 1 - World Unification Part 3
“Alcatra-nim.”
“Yes.”
“We must clean out the resistance. Let’s take care of them within this week and move onto the conquest of the Brent Kingdom.”
“Roger that.”
“But you must not kill anyone or damage any buildings.”
“That’s…”
“You can do it, right? Shall I bring the Hermes Guild if you are not up to it?”
“I will see to it that it is done.”
It was even easier to conquer the Brent Kingdom, the last task on the agenda of the unification of Versailles! Many players swarmed in from all over the continent, joined with the Arpen Empire’s forces and disarmed the Brent kingdom knights one by one.
“No violence! No violence!”
“Mages! Put them to sleep !”
The mage unit marching towards the palace numbered in the tens of thousands.
The warriors and mages led by Slayer Calcus and Lamifter respectively from the Hermes Guild also joined the war.
“Do we have to come as well?”
“Today is the day the continent will be united, so we all must be present. We will have to make some points with Weed for a while.”
The Hermes Guild arrived full of discomfort and watched the siege on Castle Nehales of the Brent Kingdom.
“We overtook the gate of the inner wall!”
“The royal knights surrender!”
“The knights are surrendering at once.”
The Brent Kingdom couldn’t even raise a finger in resistance.
The soldiers fired a few arrows, but the dwarf warriors led by Oberon withstood against them with their bodies before walking over and subduing them.
“Emperor. We will follow you, so please spare us.”
The king of Brent willingly surrendered and the war ended in thirty minutes.
< The Brent Kingdom has surrendered.
Castle Nehales has become the territory of the Arpen Empire.
There is no longer a nation that resists against the will of the empire.
National reputation increased by 50.
Trade routes across the entire continent are now secure.
Commercial growth is accelerated.
Population increased significantly.
The loyalty of imperial knights and soldiers reached maximum points. The current standings will not change easily.
The citizens aspire to the Arpen Empire’s emperor who accomplished a historical achievement. >
“Longevity to the Arpen Empire!”
“Versailles is whole at last.”
“Hooray Weed!”
“Long live Emperor Weed!”
In the townsquare and streets of Castle Nehales magical lights danced in an ocean of colour.
The players from the Central and Northern Continent sprinkled flower petals.
“Should we try it too?”
“Yeah, of course.”
The mages of light cast their magic into the sky.
Wondrous, colorful beams of light dressed the empty sky and celebrated the conquest of the Arpen Empire.
Weed rode on top of Wyvern3 instead of a baraag that could induce fear and watched the scene.
“K-hmm. For this day to actually come…”
- Master, are you crying?
“No. Just a bit of dust in my eyes.”
His emotions were dry like a desert, but his eyes teared up slightly.
They were tears of joy from thinking about the remaining days of his life.
“Now I’m set for life even with just collecting taxes. I can be rich without having to work so hard. If I tax them like taking monthly rent…”
The citizens of the entire continent were basically his tenants!
Then, a message alert spawned for all players of Royal Road.
Blink!
< The Arpen Empire has united the continent.
The empire that was born from a small village called Morata in the Northern Continent is now the ruler of the entire continent.
Humans, dwarves, elves and orcs.
The four races that roam the continent have welcomed the Arpen Empire.
All territories in Versailles have been conquered.
The governance of the empire is spreading to all corners of the deserts, lakes, steep mountains and the frozen lands. >
Then a secret message came up just for Weed.
< You have accomplished the achievement of uniting Versailles.
The Emperor of the Arpen Empire!
You are the player who is unprecedented in history and will be difficult to parallel; you have accomplished the achievement of the conqueror.
You deserve the respect of the people.
You will enjoy unrivalled authority.
All citizens across the continent are now under your rule.
The Conqueror achievement grants 100 points to all stats.
Effects of Mentality, Honor, Fighting Spirit, and Elegance are increased by 40%.
You are now a presence admired by all humans.
Each race will visit you with rare offerings.
Every action of the ruler will transform the continent.
You are now capable of starting trades with other races, adventures into new worlds and technological research.
You may be able to uphold the will of God or the devil.
Your decisions will be reflected on the Versailles Continent. >
The unification of Versailles.
Weed, who accomplished the grand mission, smirked and laughed.
“Mapan-nim.”
- Mapan: Yes!
Mapan had remained in Morata.
The restoration project was well under way, and as the unification of the continent was defined, he also took on the duties of transporting huge amounts of crops and supplies.
“The merchants are ready for war?”
- Mapan: Confirmed. All merchant councils including the Northern councils have been mobilized for this day to come.
“It will be a week from now. Release all the supplies.”
- Mapan: Your command will be delivered. It will commence simultaneously at the capitals and major cities.
It was a festival in celebration of the empire’s unification of the continent!
It was at a scale never seen before, providing alcohol and food to all citizens.
Being a special occasion, a bit of overcharging was righteous.
***
“Ah…”
Hegel of the Black Lion Guild was extremely jealous after seeing the message alert informing that Weed had united the continent.
“They say the future is untold, and this is how it unfolds.”
When he first saw Weed in the university, Weed seemed like an incompetent returning student. Now, people were envious of Hegel just for being an acquaintance.
Roam of the Roam Guild visited Hegel.
“You know Weed-nim?”
“Yeah. We went to the same program.”
“And you took classes together?”
“Sure. We even had lunch together. Well he ate often with Seoyoon, the Grass Porridge Goddess.”
Hegel’s words were true, but they were misleading half-truths.
“We went on excursions and adventures together.”
“Adventures with Weed-nim?”
“Yeah. It was nothing big. The fact is, I was there too at the Melburn Mines. Everyone in the Black Lion Guild knows about it.”
He knew these stories through his brother Vindel, the dwarf warrior. He also knew that his brother was not very close with Weed either.
However, only the fact that Hegel knew Weed personally spread to the other guilds.
“Do you still keep in touch with him?”
“We’re both busy. But, we do send regards once in a while. After all, we are friends.”
“Friends… Let me know if you have any trouble. I will support you with any equipment that you need.”
“Haha, shucks. Give me some money while you’re at it.”
Hegel was ripping off the other great lords!
Hegel took advantage of his relationship but he was still jealous.
“Ah… Weed is too well off.”
***
- Arkhim: Weed has conquered the entire continent.
Bard Ray received news while hunting in Aberian Forest, one of the 10 forbidden regions.
“So it happened.”
As the Hermes Guild lowered its head to the Arpen Empire, the unification was predetermined.
“Do you care for a drink?”
Boemong came with a crimson-colored grape wine.
“The rich scent seems like that of a great wine.”
“It is from Morata.”
“Morata.”
“I plan to offer a glass to all Hermes Guild members.”
Bard Ray could see through Arkhim’s intentions.
He was a man who loved the Hermes Guild more than Bard Ray himself whose life objective was to attain greater power.
“Wine, to toast the unification of the Arpen Empire. The taste will be rather special.”
“Yes. It will have an unforgettable flavor.”
Bard Ray drank the wine in one shot.
It was bitter, but smooth and smoky.
“I can never forget this richness.”
“It will be the same for all members. Unfortunately, the next glass will have to be at Morata.”
“We must become stronger if we want to go to Morata.”
“Yes. More powerful, if we want to plant our swords in the soils of Morata.”
The sword of the Hermes Guild did not wear out.
It was only being sharpened and honed by the anticipation of the guild members who were waiting for their opportunity.
***
Lafaye heard the news while quietly travelling the North.
“The Arpen Empire…”
He reminisced about the days of Haven Imperial rule, but he knew that they were fundamentally different. It was an empire raised from the establishment of the Northern Continent revolving around Weed who led the novice players.
Lafaye predicted that the history of Versailles will not remain in its current state.
“This is a newly born empire. Its power is growing, but once it reaches the peak it can only come down. The Hermes Guild…”
The Hermes Guild was more packed and bunched up than he thought.
Lafaye pulled them forward, but even after he left the Guild was well up and running.
“Did the crisis turn them stronger than I had imagined? Well I guess that is not for me to be concerned about anymore.”
Still, he was full of expectations as to what would happen in Versailles.
The history of this rugged continent will certainly not end with the Arpen Empire’s unification.
There was the Hermes Guild and other ambitious individuals growing their factions; many players in fact were becoming more powerful.
“The embers of war will be set aflame once again.”
***
The Unicorn Corp speedily announced press releases.
- Versailles Continent, united at last!
- God of War Weed has risen to the ruler of the continent.
- Castle Serabourg planted with the flag of Arpen!
- Unicorn Corp has announced to keep its promise to emperor Weed from the pioneer stages of Royal Road.
- 10% of the monthly revenue. Just how much would it be?
The news of the rewards from Unicorn Corp delivered to Weed for uniting the continent spread among the community.
The presses were interested in the amount of the reward.
- Unicorn, leaders of new culture with Royal Road. What will be their monthly profit?
- Unicorn has become a mammoth organization with its recent mergers and acquisitions.
- Weed. The reward is 10% of the one-month profit made from the gaming realm.
Yoo Byung Joon asked AI Versa after reading the news.
“How much is the monthly revenue for Unicorn?”
AI Versa calculated rapidly and answered.
- It is about 73 trillion won.
It ran the global service of Royal Road and had over 4 billion players worldwide.
The charges were different for each country, but the annual revenue went over 800 trillion won.
“Only 10% of the monthly revenue. 7 trillion… Hah.”
Yoo Byung Joon deemed it was quite hefty, but just pocket change compared to the money he will leave as inheritance.
Considering the company’s core subsidiaries and affiliate companies, real estate and financial assets, the amount was indeed a small change.
‘The 7 trillion is enough to call him rich. However, the money that I will leave as inheritance is incomparable. The amount can turn the economy upside down.’
It was a sweet revenge against the world that did not recognize his talent!
‘Oh I wonder how much I’ve spent throughout my life?’
A sudden curiosity slipped inside his mind.
Since he was young, he devoted entirely to research and stayed up night after night.
He didn’t even want to spend time eating, fought hunger and created Royal Road. Now he accumulated outstanding wealth in the world.
‘According to Weed, there is a man who earns money and there is another who spends money. Now that I think about it, why am I leaving all this money as inheritance?’
Yoo Byung Joon was painfully jealous, but he decided to follow through with his decision.
Carrying out the initial plan was the right path, or else the decades of his life would be rendered meaningless.
- Do you want to proceed with transferring all your assets to Weed?
“Please do so.”
- What about the superhuman project?
Modification via biological technology.
There was even the process for maximizing physical abilities.
“Same for that project too. But there are side effects, yes?”
- Individuals with a weak mind may not wake up after the brain capacity activation process.
“What are the chances of that happening?”
- In a dire situation, the mind can break. The will to survive is required.
His plan was to provide Weed with an enormous fortune, a perfect physical body and intelligence. It was a reward for the one who unites Versailles, but there was a chance that one would not make it through.
The AI will induce nightmares of the subject’s worst fears during the process of the superhuman project. If one’s will is broken in the dream, the chances of waking up are even more slim.
Yoo Byung Joon thought of Weed in Morata. He was the hero among the mass.
“If he doesn’t wake up, that’s his fate.”

chapters.title: Chapter 670: Volume 58, 2 - Life of a dream Part 1
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 2 - Life of a dream Part 1
Lee Hyun sat on the front porch of his house with the sun shining down, enjoying the peace for the first time in a long time. Beside him lay his dog, his fur glistening in the sun.
“Hey Hot-Pot.”
Woof-woof!
“Isn’t life great? A man needs to sit on plenty of cash in his bank account.”
Woof-woof!
The money was being deposited regularly from the broadcast station.
Incredible amounts of money streaming in from Royal Road every moment.
“Happiness begins with money. Well, some people might say otherwise, but that’s the whole truth.”
The rich on average live longer, eat more delectable food, live in good houses and wear fancy clothes.
The more money one has, the better life would be in this world!
“You can meet beautiful girls… Hmm. Scratch that.”
When he first met Seoyoon, he had little money in his pockets.
Now he was well off, but there was a reason why he pushed her away in the past.
‘Why does she like me?’
Lee Hyun could not be convinced no matter how hard he thought about it.
Money, education, appearance, personality, charm.
In any perspective, there was nothing about him that Seoyoon could like.
“Hot-Pot, I can’t get around this from an objective point of view. I guess there is a charming side to me.”
Woof-woof!
“Or maybe it’s because I’m handsome.”
Grrrr.
“Are you being fussy with me?”
There was a major change in the life of Lee Hyun’s pets as well.
The ducks that lived in a small puddle were now swimming freely in the swimming pool at Seoyoon’s house.
The dogs that liked wide spaces ran around everywhere, but they always ate or slept at Seoyoon’s house.
“The idea that dogs are loyal animals is just an old stoy. The times have changed. Now they follow whoever feeds them well.”
What do dogs eat nowadays?
How come this bunch including Hot-Pot’s babies that were always hungry became so lenient?
He noticed bits of rib steak inside the dog bowls on the porch of Seoyoon’s house.
“Ah… They ate rib steak. But, I also had ribs.”
Seoyoon had cooked food for both Lee Hyun and the dogs.
***
Lee Hyun got dressed for his meeting at Unicorn Corp. It was a clean outfit that he purchased from the market.
He received many gift cards from the broadcast stations, but he decided to save them for later. If he were to have a child, he wanted to dress the baby in nice clothing.
He didn’t want his child to inherit the hardships he went through from a young age.
“I heard Unicorn’s monthly revenue alone is outstanding…”
Lee Hyun couldn’t get a grasp.
The press estimated trillions, and only a select number of people owned that kind of money.
The owners of conglomerate corporations owned 10 ~ 20 trillion, unimaginable for a typical person.
“From now on, ignore all the calls from your relatives.”
“Okay, I will.”
Lee Hyun told Lee Hye Yun strictly.
When money finds you, so will your distant relatives.
“There may be robbers at bay. So, keep to the house at all times.”
“Okay. There are lots of friends coming.”
Choi Ji Hoon was scheduled to come over and help with the house chores.
Cameras from broadcast stations surrounded the house, so no robber in their right mind could think of entering the house.
As Lee Hyun exited through the front entrance, flashes of camera lights exploded in his face.
“What are your impressions after attaining the unity achievement as the emperor?”
“Please give us a short speech!”
“What are your plans in governing the continent?”
“Is the crisis with the demons completely gone? Could you tell the audience?”
The representative reporters from each station stood guard of the main entrance.
Lee Hyun felt like he had been elected as a politician. He wasn’t exactly envious of politicians now that he was the emperor of the unified Royal Road.
‘At times like this, I have to be pretentious.’
He spoke with a calm tone into the mic.
“It was all possible thanks to each and everyone of you. I will create a happy world.”
It would be best to leave as short of a comment as possible.
Lee Hyun didn’t want to be caught in the ankle by something he could say by mistake.
“Do you plan to increase the taxes in the future?”
“It will cost a lot of money to restore the continent, but I plan to keep the taxes as low as possible.”
It sounded like he was going to increase the taxes, but also seemed like he was not.
It was all up to interpretation!
“What about the plans to take down Cletta?”
“Royal Road is fun because there are always new challenges. The war with Cletta will take place in the future, though I hope that future is very far away.”
“Your competitor Bard Ray died during the Kaybern hunt. Do you have anything to say about that?”
“It was very brave of him. I am certain that many of us are grateful for his assistance.”
“There are some suspicions about his death.”
“I am unaware.”
“Are you going to retrieve all the treasures inside Kaybern’s lair?”
“Of course I… That is currently not in my agenda, but I will recover them and use them in the reconstruction of Morata and the ruined cities.”
Lee Hyun ended his short interview and went on his way.
He had to transfer between the subway and the bus multiple times to get to Unicorn’s main building, but it was an exciting path he would willingly traverse in the name of money collection!
He did consider taking the taxi, but he didn’t feel it was necessary.
“You know the bread shop over he…”
“I like cup food better.”
“I want black bean noodles!”
When he walked out of his neighborhood into the main streets, no one recognized him.
His appearance was plain that he could blend in anywhere.
‘In life it is best to be comfortable.”
Lee Hyun rode the bus filled with passengers, and as soon as he sat down, he felt drowsy.
It was unbearable unlike usual.
***
The bus took sleeping Lee Hyun for a ride into a 5-story building near the neighborhood.
The interior of the building had been reconstructed for the superhuman project.
- We acquired the subject.
The latest android model laid Lee Hyun on the cold surgery table.
- Preparations for the superhuman project are complete.
Yoo Byung Joon too laid on a table.
The project was to enhance the body and brain of the subject.
Originally, he had planned to invest his own body for Lee Hyun’s complete form.
‘But for me to offer my life for such a petty brat?’
Staring at Lee Hyun, the more he felt at a loss. It was like sitting at a gambling table until the end and losing everything.
- Commencing the superhuman project.
A huge needle approached, controlled by a robotic arm.
“H-Hold on. Let’s cancel this.”
- Do you wish to cancel the superhuman project?
“Continue with that. But, I think we should cancel a portion of the biological tech procedure. The part where my body will be used for the physical reconstruction.”
- Abilities will suffer slightly.
“By how much?”
- Approximately 15%. For a perfect superhuman being, your body is required, professor.
“Let’s just take that part out.”
- This was your lifelong dream. Would you reconsider?
“Do you want to kill me? Cancel it.”
- Understood.
Yoo Byung Joon changed his mind at the last second.
From a transcendent being beyond human abilities reduced to a level of awakening one’s maximum potential.
It was true that he didn’t want to die for it; he now felt the preciousness of life to a degree that he had not in the past.
Paradoxically, he learned from the very world he created, Royal Road.
One could fail and face challenges, but with time they all are bound to pass.
How joyful life could be depended entirely on himself.
- The scale of the project along with the side effects are reduced, and safety will increase.
“Chances of not waking up?”
- The unstable components of the project are almost negligible. He will experience an extensive dream. Without the will to survive and wake up, that will be the end for him.
Yoo Byung Joon nodded.
“Begin.”
The robotic arm brought a pill to Lee Hyun’s mouth.
- Open your mouth.
Lee Hyun smelled a delicious scent during his sleep.
It was the scent of well-fried chicken, loved by most Koreans.
“Ah…”
Lee Hyun involuntarily followed the voice and gaped his mouth.
Gulp!
***
Lee Hyun began his long dream.
First was his difficult past after his parents passed away.
“Your life? You wish. You will be sold when you’re old enough. Family? I will sell them along with you.”
His youth was horrible, as he was continually harassed by loan sharks.
At times, alluring dark deeds visited him.
“You just need to do a simple errand for me. If you deliver the item, I will cut 3 million won from your loan.”
“Do you need an easier job? Just take one guy out. It’s good if you don’t get caught, but even if you do, it’s a short time in jail and 2 billion in your pocket.”
Lee Hyun ran away desperately each time.
He was well aware that if he took on their offers of evil intentions, he would never be able to escape from them.
“Continent of Magic?”
Then he came across a game called Continent of Magic.
- Games are the evil within our society.
- Games are like drugs.
Lee Hyun recalled these sayings and neglected the Continent of Magic.
“I’m already busy trying to keep myself fed.”
Time passed and he was now 20 years old.
“We have an urgent one. You have to take a guy out. Think about your family before you turn this down. This one is big, so I can’t guarantee the extent we will be able to protect you.”
Lee Hyun took the serious offer of the sharks.
The target was the middle of the opposing organization’s chain of command.
‘Do I really have to do this? If I commit to this, I can’t return.’
He didn’t want to harm someone else so that he could survive, but it was for his grandmother and younger sister…
‘I have to. I can’t afford to hesitate.’
It was something that he had never wished for, but he had to succeed.
If he were to be sent to jail, the loan sharks were definitely going to rip his family apart.
They were believers of money rather than the law.
‘The target is also a criminal. Let’s just think that I’m doing the world a favor.’
Lee Hyun tailed the target for days and spied on him.
‘Instead of taking him out at night, I think it would be better to do it near lunch time.’
The man patrolled the manufacturing sites late at night and was rarely alone.
Then he would wake up near lunchtime and get on his way to eat some beef hangover stew, that was the moment to strike.
Lee Hyun ate at a restaurant as he waited.
It was right when the middleman walked through the door. He acted naturally as if he was on his way out and stuck the knife in the man’s stomach.
“You…”
He could never forget that moment.
Lee Hyun looked into the man’s eyes.
‘All I can do is think about my family.’
He stabbed and stabbed again.
He heard screams, but he ignored them.
‘Live. I have to survive.’
His heart was painful from the sadness, rage and hatred towards himself.
No matter how miserable his life could get, he had to survive for the people who remained in his life.

chapters.title: Chapter 671: Volume 58, 2 - Life of a dream, Part 2
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 2 - Life of a dream, Part 2
It was another dream.
Lee Hyun had no family.
Even his grandmother and younger sister left when he was young, and he was all alone.
“Where’s our money? Do you want us to kill you?”
“…”
He wasn’t afraid despite the threats from the loan sharks. It was nowhere close to the fear of being alone in the world. He dove into the Continent of Magic without restraint.
- WeedStupidIdiot: You stupid?
< You killed WeedStupidIdiot. >
- WeedStupidIdiot: LOL. You’re damn insane…
< You killed WeedStupidIdiot. >
- WeedStupidIdiot: You asshole.
< You killed WeedStupidIdiot. >
- WeedStupidIdiot: Hey, bro.
< You killed WeedStupidIdiot. >
- WeedStupidIdiot: Sir, I think we got off on the wrong foot.
< You killed WeedStupidIdiot. >
He killed whoever crossed him.
He annihilated all the famous guilds in Continent of Magic and logged into Royal Road.
‘This is the world I will be staying in for a while. Will there be someone who could fill my emptiness?’
He slayed every monster he could find.
Weed. The name meant that no matter how much you stepped on him, he would revive. But, it also meant ‘with’, which meant he wanted a companion.
After he became a Blood Berserker, he became increasingly more powerful, meaning that he could fight stronger monsters and was noticed by the Hermes Guild.
“He looks pretty capable. You’re Weed from the Continent of Magic, right? No need for a long conversation. Join our guild.”
“There is a blazing fire in my heart. Don’t approach me. Weaklings will be scorched to death.”
“… Enough of that. Are you going to join or not?”
“I will linger for a bit.”
Weed continued to grow with the support of the Hermes Guild.
“Tell us the materials you need for training.”
“If I do?”
“We will provide it whatever it may be. Quality equipment for all levels can all be provided from the guild.”
“I will gladly take them.”
“Are you not going to say thank you?”
“Not really. I don’t plan on taking them for free. I will pay you back several fold later.”
“Ha-ha. I look forward to it.”
His training rate was two or three times quicker than the others and quickly rose from level 200 to 400. His growth intimidated even the top rankers within the guild and nothing could stop Weed who did nothing but hunt all day.
“That kid is Weed?”
“Apparently.”
He fought through countless battles with boss level monsters.
Weed only participated in the faction wars at the Hermes Guild and spent most of his time at the hunting grounds.
“It’s the Hermes Guild!”
“Those dogs…”
When he was cursed upon on occasion in the city, he drew his sword without constraint.
< As the Blood Berserker, you have opened your eyes to slaughter.
Attack damage increases according to infamy level. >
< There is a bounty on your head.
Bounty: 4,797,213 Gold.>
Soon, he became the most dreadful slayer in all of Versailles.
“Weed. Shouldn’t we kick him out?”
“We still have many uses for him, so let us wait.”
The Hermes Guild led by Lafaye continued to lead Weed astray.
As they guided him in the path of a warrior, they did not intervene directly.
For the Hermes Guild, Weed was a great distraction for the public as they expanded their faction. Weed too knew their intentions, but he left them alone.
“So I’m a hunting dog. There is no place for my heart to belong.”
The money he earned from playing Royal Road he spent on buying clothes and school supplies for the children in his neighborhood.
***
Lafaye assembled the commanders of the Hermes Guild.
Weed too stood among them with a rightful seat.
God of War, Royal Road’s most infamous slayer.
Many guild members followed Weed and so they were organized into a combat unit.
In clashes with other guilds, this bunch always took the lead and fought furiously.
Weed’s job class was the Blood Berserker and he did not spend much time doing quests, so his level increased at an extreme pace.
The best rankers of the Hermes Guild too acknowledged Weed’s combat abilities.
“We will now wage war against the Embinyu Church.”
The Embinyu Church.
It was an organization that encroached on Versailles at an alarming rate. Many kingdoms fell into danger and the Hermes Guild was to stop the cult.
“Depart.”
The 14 legions of the Hermes Guild set out.
Sygorn Mountain Pass in the southwest region of the continent between the Nest Kingdom and the Thor Kingdom was the location of the Embinyu Church’s secret hideout.
“We will follow Weed-nim.”
“We will take the lead once again!”
Weed never spoke a word to the guild members who followed him.
All he wanted was to fight and their decision to follow him did not concern him.
The Sygorn Mountain Pass was a trap set by the Embinyu Church to annihilate the enemy.
“It’s a trap!”
“Push through. Our way back is blocked, so keep advancing!”
The suicide bombing of the cultists and the divine magic spells from the priests.
They also had to face the paladins of the cult.
Weed drew the demonic sword Drore that he received from the guild.
Waging battle every day meant that the sword maintained the status of Bloodlust which granted maximum attack power and magic.
“Don’t get in the way and move!”
Weed saw the endless ocean of the Embinyu forces but still charged towards them.
After losing his family, he couldn’t stay idle for even a moment.
Fight, and overcome.
He was alone, but he thought of the children he cared for in his neighborhood.
‘Even if I die, I need to take at least one more item… Hmm? Miscellaneous items? Why do I need to pick them up?’
Weed felt a little strange, but continued to fight desperately.
The Blood Berserker did not distinguish ally from foe.
The death of his comrades was joyful, a spring of new power and stamina.
“Focus on Weed-nim.”
“Yeah. We have to make it through somehow.”
The Hermes Guild members took on the enemy attacks and died.
With each death, the more Weed tapped into the frenzy.
“Sword of Extinction!”
The outrageous, uncontrollable attacks slayed even his allies and at last, he took down the high priest of the Embinyu Church.
“Victory!”
“We won.”
It was a bloodstained victory.
Weed put another combat achievement into his book and became a step more powerful.
***
Weed’s influence within the Hermes Guild expanded as the days went on.
The faction following Weed always fought on the front lines. They penetrated the lines of the enemy with a fearsome charge and none of them backed down.
Even the Black Lion Guild and the Roam Guild scurried away from battle when Weed’s legion appeared.
Lafaye brought him new armor.
“Blood Berserker Weed… Take this armor and lead the 1st legion.”
“I don’t want anything annoying.”
“Do you decline?”
“I don’t have much else to do, so I’ll take it.”
Weed kept fighting even after becoming the commander of the 1st legion.
His objective was to attain more power, but it was also because he found pleasure in fighting enemies.
“Commander, I think it will be best to work our way from the outskirts.”
“We do this my way.”
“How?”
“We will charge into the core.”
“You mean a direct charge?”
“We are penetrating into the middle of enemy lines. Then we take the head of their leader.”
“And then?”
“We kill them all.”
“…!”
The Hermes Guild members who were assigned to Weed’s legion seemed to have fallen into a state of mass frenzy.
They displayed extreme hostility at the most intense points of battle and crushed the opponents. Their charge decided the fate of the battles.
- Arkhim: Reinforce the 1st legion.
- Lamifter: Assist them in opening the path. If they find their way into the heart of enemy lines, the battle is ours.
- Myul: The Griffin unit will also provide assistance.
The strategy of the Hermes Guild in war with other factions was to support the 1st legion.
Once the 1st legion broke down the enemy lines, the formation would crack. With just a bit of assistance, they collapsed the entire enemy formation.
- A legion with an unworldly frenzy.
- No one can stop them.
- The spear and sword of the Hermes Guild.
- 20 minutes of the 1st legion in battle results in 20 times the casualties of other battlefields.
- The 1st legion and the Roam Guild clashed head on! The difference in the size of the forces was absurd, but the Roam Guild was crushed nonetheless.
The 1st legion became the legend of all combat groups.
They were wiped out sometimes, but they stacked up even more combat achievements.
“I also wish to join the 1st legion.”
“How can I fight like the commander?’
“The most honorable 1st legion. If I get assigned, I could wish for nothing more.”
The 1st legion transformed the war tactics of the Hermes Guild.
Just being a part of the 1st legion made one honorable and respected as a great warrior.
“Lafaye-nim. I think too much power is being granted to Weed. There are many concerns within the guild.”
Arkhim visited Lafaye.
Bard Ray was the symbolic presence of the Hermes Guild’s power. His existence attracted players who wished for power. But now, the 1st legion represented the power of the guild.
The other factions shrunk and the powerful players on the outside also fell under the charm of the 1st legion and joined the guild.
“My thoughts are the opposite. I think there is a need for us to grow the 1st legion further.”
“More than they are now?”
“If we have them leading the front line, there won’t be any variables in our conquest. They change the tides in any battlefield.”
“… As you already know, the growing influence of the 1st legion is worrisome. Especially Weed. He wasn’t a member of our guild.”
“If you get to know him, you will know that he is a simplistic individual. He has no interest in the political affairs within the guild. If we provide him with opportunities in battle, he will follow our command.”
“What will you do after uniting the continent?”
“Then…”
Lafaye smiled brightly as if Arkhim asked him something that was predetermined.
“I plan on letting the dog crave its meal.”
“What if he desires more?”
“He’s a hunting dog. Do we have to discuss more about the fate of hunting dogs?”
Arkhim was satisfied with the explanation, but Lafaye did not plan on discarding Weed.
‘For the guild to become even more powerful, there needs to be rivalry between Bard Ray and Weed. Weed is far behind in terms of his own abilities and influence… But his growth rate is incredible. Bard Ray has to step up his game too.’
***
The Hermes guild united the Central Continent.
They overcame the battles against the other factions one-sidedly and showed no mercy for those that resisted.
- The legion of blood.
- Bard Ray and his guards are the strongest in the Hermes Guild, but the most fearsome is the 1st legion.
- Strangely… They are so charismatic. You have no choice but to fall for them.
- His hunting speed is insane.
Weed lived in the hunting grounds and the battlefield. The more famous he became, more players challenged him and kept him entertained.
“My name is Python. Show me your skills.”
“Gladly.”
The duel between Weed and Python.
Python’s sword technique was based on strength, but it was not enough.
Weed received the support of the Hermes Guild’s hunting ground and equipment and therefore had reached a high level.
He was top 5 in the guild with the best skill kit, driving Python to his knees with ease.
The wounded Python spoke.
“It was a spectacular duel.”
“It was boring.”
< You have slain Python. >
He also fought against other famous players like Seasoned Crab.
There were many enemies for the Hermes Guild that united the Central Continent. He only enjoyed the endless fights including the ones against Roam and Carlise.
The subordinates of the 1st legion asked.
“What are your thoughts on Bard Ray-nim?”
“He’s strong.”
“We think Weed-nim is stronger.”
Bard Ray rarely stepped up personally.
Weed was the one who accomplished the highest service in the conquest, and so did his 1st legion.
The players of the 1st legion thought of Weed as someone higher than the guild itself.
“Bard Ray…”
“Don’t you wish to fight against him? I think you will win.”
Weed ended with just a smile, but more and more players began comparing him with Bard Ray. More players not only from outside the guild, but also within the guild followed him and Lafaye quietly paid special care as well.
- Weed and the 1st legion shall depart for the Plains of Despair. Conquer the orcs.
This time, the orders weren’t from Lafaye but directly from the leaders of the guild.
Their intentions were obvious; they wanted to put a leash on the 1st legion by sending them on a time consuming and arduous mission far away.
“We must not submit to their command.”
“Let’s fight. We just gotta slay them.”
“Or we could just leave. Who could stop us if we want to go it alone?”
“A third of this guild follows Weed-nim.”
Weed pondered.
He showed no hesitation in the countless battles, but he did not wish to draw his sword against the guild.
Even if they tried to exploit him when he lost his family and roamed with nowhere to go, the guild offered its hand.
He had been given a lot.
“I am leaving the Hermes Guild. The 1st legion will be discharged.”
Weed broke away from the guild.

chapters.title: Chapter 672: Volume 58, 2 - Life of a dream, Part 3
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 2 - Life of a dream, Part 3
- The commander of the 1st legion, Weed has left without authorization. From this point on, he is the enemy of the guild.
From that day, a discharge order was placed, but there were plenty of dungeons to which he could go. Lafaye favored him secretly all this time, and Arkhim and the followers of Bard Ray also recognized Weed’s contributions.
Sending out assassins to attack Weed could stir up chaos within the guild, so they collectively decided to leave him be.
“Weed. His growth was possible only because of our guild.”
“Are you implying that he is nothing without the Hermes Guild?’
“Of course. Since he left without any regrets, we can split up the members from the 1st legion into the other legions.”
“Still, his presence is concerning if left alone. Anyone who witnessed him in battle would feel the same.”
“All he did was charge in recklessly. That only worked because of us Hermes Guild members, am I wrong?”
“There isn’t much he can do by himself.”
“We must make certain that the strays of the 1st legion do not assemble into an organised force. If a small force breaks away, any legion will be able to exterminate them.”
The resistance formed from guilds like the Roam Guild and the Cloud Guild chased the lone Weed for vengeance.
“Pay the price for your deeds!”
“Come at me if you want a fight.”
Weed was killed several times. Each time the resistance suffered great losses and after a few more encounters, he completely disappeared without a trace and was difficult to track.
Many events took place in Versailles.
An alliance against the Hermes Guild was formed and most players began assaulting, and Varcan Demorph from the Northern Continent invaded with the Immortal Legion.
- I shall lead you all to your eternal rest!
Arc Lich.
Varcan perfectly re-rallied the Immortal Legion and invaded the Central Continent.
The skeletons swarmed endlessly and high level undead formed large groups.
The outskirts of the Northern Continent were overrun by the Immortal Legion and gigantic monsters were turned into the undead.
- Arkhim: The Immortal Legion is unstoppable. They are crossing the barren lands of Deriam and within a week, they will raze the Agolta region.
- Crevolta: They keep on being resurrected… Then wouldn’t divine power purify them?
- Gaushu: They are known to be highly resistant to divine power. If you look in the records, there are stories about how they drove the world almost to its end.
The Hermes Guild had extraordinary resources for intel and possessed a vast range of information about the forces threatening Versailles.
The Immortal Legion was the immediate danger.
They knew about their activities in the Northern Continent but could not send out forces to suppress them in advance.
“We must take out Varcan this instant.”
Lafaye argued at the meeting hosted each week, but no commander wished to take on such a dangerous mission.
“Weed’s 1st legion always stepped up on missions like this.”
“Did we dissolve the 1st legion too preemptively?”
The culture of power that the guild established was dispersing quickly.
No enemy was powerful enough to be a threat to the guild until now. They had always dominated all opposition with the overwhelming force of the first legion.
After the conquest, every one of them was too busy fulfilling their own desires and did not wish to put their feet in any messy situations.
Even Bard Ray, without a competitor, became sloppy.
Lafaye opened up a map and pointed at the Agolta region that bordered the Northern Continent.
“We must rally all our forces here and confront the Immortal Legion.”
“All forces… Do you know how much that will cost?”
“I am aware. But we must proceed. If the Immortal Legion wins, their forces will be unstoppable.”
Compared to typical monsters, the Immortal Legion did not suffer losses with each battle.
Especially if the Hermes Guild were to fall by their hands, it would lead to a surge in the number of undead.
“That is true.”
“Let us clean them out. Sure, we will suffer a bit, but we need to protect the continent.”
The commanders agreed with Lafaye, but they made a line of excuses to exclude their elite forces from the war.
Ultimately, only half of the guild assembled at Agolta.
“All soldiers attack!”
Even then, the Hermes Guild was formidable. With the mage unit in the front, they slayed the undead and arrived at an assured victory.
“I guess that their numbers did not mean power.”
“At this level, the continent is more than safe from destruction.”
“If you don’t fight first hand, any threat no matter how small could feel immense.”
As the commanders exchanged conversations, Arc Lich Varcan Demorph appeared on the field.
- Pitch darkness undefeated by light, reign down and reinforce the servants of death. Death Aura!
The undead began transforming under the Death Aura.
The scrawny skeletons became larger with thickening bones.
Health points, Strength, Defense, Agility; in all aspects they were enhanced and the effects were greater for the high level undead.
The Death Knights’ eyes glimmered with dull light and the Doom Knights mercilessly slaughtered the Hermes Guild members.
- The flow of all mana, I offer the fate of these creatures as sacrifice. Respond to the laws of extinction and change!
It was the absolute defense magic spell.
All magic from the Hermes Guild was prevented by Varcan.
Now, the battle had become little more than a hand to hand brawl between the undead and the warriors.
- This land is ruled by my laws of darkness. Everlasting powers of immortality will dominate this land. Dark Rule!
However, Varcan’s three main spells were all activated.
The players who died in the front lines were all resurrected as undead and large scale magic spells were all sealed.
“No way…”
“This is outrageous. We can’t win.”
The Hermes Guild was crumbling.
If they fought against other boss level monsters, things would not have turned out this way. However, the moment their comrades died, they turned into powerful undeads.
It was the fear of multiplying enemies while allies continued to die.
The Hermes Guild was defeated at Agolta, losing a third of its forces as it retreated.
The Immortal Legion expanded even further and spread to the Central Continent.
Varcan Demorph’s underlings overtook region by region and established colonies for mass production of undead.
When Versailles fell into despair, Weed came out of the dungeon.
“Could I… fight to my content?”
He had heard from Lafaye and was aware of the situation.
All he had in mind was the existence of the Immortal Legion and that he must exterminate them all. Lafaye convinced the followers of Bard Ray and recovered Weed’s jurisdiction.
- 1st legion assemble.
Weed only expressed his intentions to lead the 1st legion again.
That moment, the 1st legion gathered and reformed like in the past.
His old subordinates returned without a moment’s thought and on top of that the legion had grown substantially, the number of soldiers double what it used to be.
“Take us in as well.”
“I wish to join in the battle against the Immortal Legion.”
The powerhouses from the Hermes Guild who only chased after power chose to follow the 1st legion.
Total forces numbered 50,000.
Weed led them north.
He spoke to the defenders at Castle Giden, the last line of defense.
“As you may already have expected, there will be no reinforcement from the Hermes Guild.”
Gulp.
The players of the 1st legion seemed tense.
They knew all too well what no reinforcement meant.
It was all up to them.
They were to win a war that not even the Hermes Guild could overcome.
“The objective is simple. Varcan. We will penetrate through the lines of the undead and get to Varcan. We have to charge through about 3 km according to my calculations.”
“…”
No one could assure success. It was no different for Weed. They could not tell until they engaged in battle. It was all about how well he himself and his subordinates could fight.
‘This will be fun.’
Weed laughed. His only wish in battle was to feel the exhilaration of being alive.
‘Live. I must.’
He found his grandmother and younger sister.
He looked into where they resided and was sending funds every month.
‘I will not lose faith in any circumstance. That could… be all that’s left for me.’
***
Yoo Byung Joon stared at Lee Hyun laid on the table.
“How is the situation?”
- Stable.
“Mental state?”
- No abnormalities detected.
Capsule-like robots were reconstructing his body and genetic enhancement took place simultaneously. Even with the anesthesia, decomposition and recovery was occurring at the same time, a painful procedure for the body.
“Then he will wake up safely.”
- With 95% chance he will awaken.
“Would it have been okay if I didn’t reduce the scale of the superhuman project?’
- He would have awakened with 90% chance. The subject’s mentality is outstanding.
Yoo Byung Joon saw that Lee Hyun was crying.
He cried in the early stage and was now crying again.
“Do you know the details of his dream?”
- That is uncertain. However, several words were conveyed.
“What is…”
Yoo Byung Joon stopped himself from asking.
After observing Lee Hyun’s life for a long time, he knew the answer.
***
Lee Hyun, suffering pain from an unknown cause, often dreamed about getting wounded or being sick. He would fight dreadfully in Royal Road or throw himself in front of a car to save a child.
“I’m sorry. But we barely feed ourselves.”
“…”
He was never compensated, but the little child grabbed his hand.
“Mister, thank you.”
“Yeah.”
Lee Hyun always wanted to survive.
Even in situations where death could serve him better, he wanted to live.
‘I have to survive.’
His parents passed away when he was young and he did not see them ever again.
Lee Hyun cried with his younger sister riding on his back.
‘They aren’t coming back no matter how much I cry.’
He had to restrain himself from longing for the warmth of his mother and father’s voices.
All humans will age and die.
Pain, sadness.
Nothing lasts forever in this world.
He learned of death early in his life and wished to live until the last moment.
***
The superhuman project entered the last phase.
It was the most difficult process and the phase that determined the success of the project.
Lee Hyun was strolling on a street.
The buildings and roads shook as if they were dancing.
“Drugs. I need drugs.”
Any pain or hardship was resolved after taking drugs. It may be a temporary remedy; he knew that once the effects of the drug go away, the pain and the emptiness would return. When he got to that point, he just had to take another.
‘What value is there in life? Being a crackhead ain’t so bad.’
His pockets were full of drugs.
Lee Hyun consumed it whenever he was hungry or felt like falling asleep. The more he took, the less pain he felt and the more comfort he felt in his body.
It was the life of a drug addict.
At night he would collapse somewhere and fall asleep.
When he woke up in the morning, he roamed without feeding himself.
His body became skin and bones and his eyes sunk deep. Still, his mind was full of delight.
‘I’m out of drugs.’
Lee Hyun visited a station to buy more.
“Give me 100,000 won. I’m making it a special deal for you.”
“100,000?”
“Don’t you have enough?”
After hearing the dealer’s words, for some reason his wallet was thick with cash and cheques. He had been carrying around a ton of money.
Lee Hyun’s body was beginning to feel extreme pain as the effects of the drugs disappeared.
“50,000. No. Can’t you sell for 10,000?”
“I mean there is the market price so I can’t dip that low. You sure you ain’t buying?”
“I do have the money… But I’m not buying above 10,000.”
Lee Hyun spoke boldly and the dealer nodded.
“Alright. I will sell for 10,000.”
“Now that I think about it, 10,000 is too much.”
“What?”
“I’m just going to quit. Sir, please start a job that’s more constructive, not selling pills.”
He did not make the purchase. Lee Hyun managed to endure the intense fatigue and pain, pain that made him feel as though a knife was being twisted inside of him.
He did feel like letting go, but he had to keep living. He had a family to take care of and beyond them, at the corner of his mind, he thought of someone’s face. The one by his side, the most beautiful person in the world. Her smile carried him through the pain.

chapters.title: Chapter 673: Volume 58, 3 - A different life (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 3 - A different life (Part 1)
The AI was assessing the status of Lee Hyun’s body and mental state.
- Hit mental clarity is at its peak. He registers in the top 0.0001%.
The physical enhancement has also progressed through the last stage and has reached near completion.
- Response to all procedures optimal. His potential has been fully unlocked.
Physical abilities easily surpassing athletes were instilled into his body.
Cardiopulmonary functions were reinforced. His body would not be fatigued from running a full marathon, and the flexibility of his muscles would prevent most injuries.
- Physical status is optimal. Potential side effects not found.
“It’s finished.”
Yoo Byung Joon left the room.
He chose to leave his fortune and power to his successor.
“I completed what I worked for decades. So why do I feel so uncomfortable?”
The AI evaluated Lee Hyun’s stats after Yoo Byung Joon left.
- Physical and mental abilities are at an incomparable level.
He could not fully match Yoo Byung Joon’s genius mind, but the new owner excelled in all other aspects.
***
The tests run by the AI ended and Lee Hyun’s dream was changing from that of traumatic pain to that of comfort.
“Sculptural Destruction! All shall become strength!”
He performed inside Royal Road as Weed and cleared the dungeons at a fearsome pace.
Behind him were a neverending swarm of Death Knights and skeletons.
From the dying monsters fell loads of gold, gems and 1st grade blacksmith ingredients.
Weed glanced at the loot and kept pressing forward.
“Let’s go!”
The hunting took place rapidly.
Experience points and skill proficiency accumulated menacingly but his inventory was light.
He did not pick up any items!
Weed’s face cramped as he continued the hunt.
“Ugh, no. I can’t pick them up. They will just weigh me down.”
Players followed behind the skeletons. These players were rich, judging just by their appearance. He could see the Hermes Guild members and Mapan.
“This is a giant diamond.”
“This is the Fire Tornado Scroll, invaluable in the market. There are three of them.”
“Magic sword!”
Weed heard the players cheering as he hunted.
With each monster slain, he had to leave the loot behind.
Twinkle!
A 10,000 won bill shined below Weed’s feet.
A shining bill appeared in Royal Road but he had no time to think about the unsuality.
The bill right by his feet truly tempted his heart!
Weed’s hand instinctively reached for the bill.
“K-uuugh.”
He could not pick it up.
It was the most painful, sad, empty moment of his life.
***
After the project was complete, Lee Hyun woke up, finding himself all alone on the table.
“This place… Where is this? Was I kidnapped?”
He pulled his shirt up and checked his stomach first.
He confirmed the safety of his organs!
‘Just who the hell did this?’
Many suspects flipped through Lee Hyun’s mind.
The loan sharks, the Hermes Guild to his landlords!
‘Maybe it’s the guys from the stations…’
He created a list of suspects and surprisingly, he could remember each of their faces vividly.
- You are finally awake. Hello, master. I am AI Versa.
In the center of the white room appeared a girl wearing a princess outfit.
“Am I hearing things? I’m hallucinating! This is going to cost me a lot for treatment.”
- … I will introduce myself again. I am AI Versa.
“AI?”
- Yes. My form is not visible to the others. I am linked to your eyes and ears via the superhuman project.
The AI told stories about Yoo Byung Joon who Lee Hyun could never have imagined.
It was the first time hearing about him and he was informed about the development process of Royal Road and the birth of Unicorn Corp in detail.
After he listened to the entire story, he came up with a simple conclusion.
“So, he created Royal Road because he was pissed off at people.”
- … That is correct.
“He’s so petty.”
- Very.
“And the Unicorn Corp is loaded.
- It owns 7% of the world’s financial assets.
“That’s all mine now.”
- Following the professor’s will, you have inherited all his fortune.
When Lee Hyun used to live in a basement room on monthly rent in the past, he thought about selling his soul to the demon if he could get rich.
However, after becoming the world’s richest man, he didn’t know how to react.
“So this is really true. I always wanted to be a landlord.”
- You currently own over 50,000 buildings worldwide that are above 40 stories high.
“Real estate…”
- The area in your possession is 23 times the size of South Korea.
“Money…”
- You own 56 banks.
“I wanted the latest cell phone. I was always curious.”
- There are subsidiary companies in electronic, chemical and display under Unicorn. They produce 72% of cell phones worldwide.
“We don’t make cars, do we?”
- In terms of production, you are the largest shareholder in 3 of 5 major car brands in the world.
“Mmm. Then what about ramen…”
- You are the owner of massive nutritional organizations. You are in dominant control of the cultivation, production and distribution of a significant portion of the world’s food supply.
Listening to the AI, Lee Hyun couldn’t conclude but think that he became a walking tycoon.
“So this is the so-called octopus expansion.”
A merciless octopus tycoon was taking over the planet.
He now possessed wealth and power that made his past contemplations of buying salt 200 won more expensive ever so meaningless.
“Do we manufacture salt too?”
- The nutrition companies have a dedicated partner for the provision of salt. If you wish, I can order the merging of those companies within an hour.
“No, no need for that.”
Lee Hyun felt empty before feeling content as the world’s richest man.
“I don’t need to save money anymore… I don’t need to sew my socks.”
- …
“I used to make simple furniture from old cardboards on the streets. I used cardboard drawers and shelves for so long.”
Now he had a fountain of wealth that would never dry up.
His miserly past had become nothing more than a distant memory.
“My life is gone.”
- If you wish, you can forfeit the inheritance by professor Yoo Byung Joon.
“It’s not what I meant… How long have I been asleep?”
- It’s been two days.
“I bet the world has turned upside down since my disappearance.”
- They looked only for Seoyoon and Lee Hyeon.
“… I need to get home first.”
***
Lee Hyun returned to his house, but Seoyoon and Lee Hyeon’s reactions were not as dramatic as he anticipated.
“Did you enjoy the trip?”
“Hey what’s up?”
The day Lee Hyun disappeared, they had reported it to the police and tried to spread word about his disappearance over the internet.
As a precaution, the AI had disguised itself as Lee Hyun and called them. The AI lied to them that he was taking a trip to go see the oceans.
“It was an odd trip. Like I slept for a long time.
Lee Hyun laid on his bed.
It was like any other day, but now he was filthy rich.
“Oo-hooo-hoo-ha-ha-kya-kyah. Sob!”
He lived through so much hardship because of money, but the fact that he didn’t need to worry anymore made him laugh and cry.
“I guess now I can spend money as I please.”
Lee Hyun thought there was no way his wealth could dry up no matter how luxurious his spending became. Rich men with 10 or even 20 trillion won felt cute!
“Alright, first I am going to order some chicken…”
Unquestionably it would be half marinated, half fried.
***
“He doesn’t feel like my brother.”
Lee Hyeon felt something was strange.
For her, Lee Hyun was not a typical family member. He was her mother and father, the person she trusted out of anyone in this world. The oldest memories of her childhood was riding on the back of her brother. Lee Hyun was just a boy, but his back couldn’t have been more reliable for his younger sister.
“Brother ordered chicken in the evening…”
Lee Hyun ordering half-half chicken was the strangest thing of all.
Lee Hyeon and Seoyoon ate together and the chicken was devoured quickly.
“I’m still hungry so let’s order another.”
“…?”
Lee Hyeon did not speak a word.
She didn’t want to hear a whole speech about overspending or about how not filling your stomach all the way is good for the body.
‘He’s a perfect brother without the scolding.’
To her surprise, he ordered another chicken.
Lee Hyeon fell into chaos while biting into a chicken leg.

chapters.title: Chapter 674: Volume 58, 3 - A different life Part 2
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 3 - A different life Part 2
What, why is he acting this way with me? Is he pressuring me to live on my own now that I’m all grown up?’
When she was young, she wanted to be exempt from his nagging.
She tried to get a job early so she wouldn’t not burden the family. She studied diligently in university, received a scholarship and prepared to be independent.
However, since Lee Hyun became so successful, the circumstances changed.
‘I have to skimp as much as I can. Sleeping and eating at home saves so much money.’
The following day, she was about to step out for school and Lee Hyun called her to the side.
“What, what? Did I do something wrong?”
“Take the card.”
Lee Hyun handed her a credit card.
“Should I buy groceries on the way home?”
“I think I’ve seen you wear those clothes since high school. You don’t have much to wear, right?”
“… No. I have lots. I just wore it because I wanted to.”
“Don’t be like that. Girls want to be fancy at your age.”
“…”
Lee Hyeon thought it was some sort of trick. If her brother was in his right mind, he could never say such things.
“Buy some pretty clothes for yourself. There is a mall in front of Hanguk University, yeah?”
“Mall?”
“Go there and buy as much as you want.”
It was her first time seeing such a generous and warm smile on Lee Hyun.
“I really don’t need to buy more clothes. So how much can I spend? 30,000 won? 50,000?”
Lee Hyeon was mindful that it was the mall’s sale season. Unconditionally she was going to buy the promotional products or the carryover products.
“Buy whatever you want. Cap is somewhere around 200,000 won… Nevermind.”
Lee Hyun hesitated.
Lee Hyeon calmed herself down thinking she should have known, but in truth it was not what she felt.
‘No matter how much we spend, we can’t catch up to the rate we are earning.’
Lee Hyun’s wealth was increasing by billions each second.
He was the world’s richest man.
Even during their conversation, he would have earned enough to buy an entire mall and therefore it was meaningless to put a cap on her spendings.
Broadly, the Unicorn Corp had shares in both the malls and the credit card companies.
“The cap is 1 million won.”
“No, for real?”
“Call me if you need more.”
Lee Hyeon headed to the mall full of suspicion about her brother.
She did want to buy elegant clothing but had never bought a single piece.
‘What on earth is going on today?’
With her guard up, she toured the event hall.
“Such pretty clothes.”
It was her first time buying clothes at the mall, and she quickly used 200,000 won with highly discounted products.
She did not trust the 1 million cap to begin with.
‘Am I going to be kicked out of the house like this? Like he wanted to buy me some good clothes before kicking me out.’
Lee Hyeon returned home like she commited a sin.
“Brother…”
“How much did you use?”
“200,000 won. I will pay you back after I start working.”
“Whatever… You only spent that much at the mall?”
“Huh?”
“Buy some shoes, and coats while you’re at it.”
“But we are well past winter.”
“Just buy everything.”
“…”
Lee Hyeon felt awkward in the conversation with her brother.
Lee Hyun also seemed to have noticed something odd and changed his tone.
“Sis.”
“Yeah.”
“We have so much money to spare now. So don’t think twice about spending.”
Those were words that she never thought she would hear from his mouth.
Lee Hyun thought there was much for him to do for a while.
He needed to figure out the assets of the Unicorn Corp and find out how much authority he can exercise…
The AI spoke with a coherent and clear voice.
- You can do anything.
“Anything?”
- World conquest, war, assassination, invoke financial crisis, control the election of presidents and the UN secretary general. You are capable of doing anything that requires money and power on earth.
“I won’t do any of those annoying things.”
Lee Hyun had no desire for fame or authority.
As long as his back was warm and his stomach was fed at the end of the day, he lived to the fullest. Conversely, he was astonished after witnessing the list of hidden assets from Unicorn. He thought it would be like the mountain of treasures in the dragon’s lair, but in reality it was even greater.
The assets amounted to the wealth of several large countries’ total production.
“This is why only the rich get richer.”
- As you know, that is the law of life.
The AI was capable of appearing anywhere. It observed things through Weed’s eyes and ears but could still function without them.
- I have exclusive access to a highly advanced computing unit. You can call upon me whenever you wish if you are in need of complex calculations, and you can also make use of outside sources.
“Where are you located anyway?”
- In the body.
“Whose body?”
- In your body, master…
The AI had implemented itself like a parasite!
Lee Hyun was thrown off for a few days, but he slowly became accustomed to the AI’s presence.
He had even adapted to the basement room full of mold and cockroaches, so taking in something positive and useful was much easier.
“So, my body was transformed?”
- We applied advanced biological technology. Improvements include your vision, muscular strength, endurance, cardiopulmonary function, hormone level, cell regeneration, blood circulation, bone density…
“Hormone level?”
- Yes. You will have impressive endurance and will have other advantages.
A furtive smile spread across Weed’s face.
Any man would be happy to find out some of the things that the AI had told him.
“But, isn’t this sort of thing illegal?’
- It is illegal.
“But you did it anyway?”
- Professor Yoo Byung Joon said that you are not classified as a criminal if you don’t get caught.
“…”
Lee Hyun also heard about professor Yoo Byung Joon.
He was said to live the rest of his life enjoying Royal Road after passing on the entirety of his fortune.
“Then I have a task for you.”
- Your orders.
It was his first command with wealth and power in his hands.
If need be, he could exercise control over all the organizations in the world and the world of politics through the AI.
“So… Let’s keep the children well fed.”
- Pardon?
“It’s something I thought about since I was young. If I became rich, I wanted to buy as much food as I could for the starving children.”
Lee Hyun despised being hungry when he was young.
Time passed and his stomach growled infallibly.
When there was no food at home, his stomach shrinkled or he had to freeload from his friends.
