“Feeding the starving children won’t result in a lack of food or lead to a financial crisis.”
- That is correct.
“Have each country develop a policy so that the children are fed. The lacking funds or supplies are to be met by Unicorn.”
- I will proceed right away.
Lee Hyun did not know a single thing about a welfare state. Truthfully, he did not want to.
There would be drawbacks to any welfare policy. However, the starving children would not be stranded anymore.
‘First the kids have to be fed. Food is an urgent matter.’
Lee Hyun thought of what he had to do next.
‘Who do I screw up first?’
Throughout his life, he did not keep a heart for particular vengeance. He hated the loan sharks the most, but he did not wish to encounter them again. The present was what was important. There was little meaning in being kissed up by those roaches.
Nevertheless, he was quite curious about their whereabouts and their current affairs.
“I have a history with some loan sharks.”
- I am aware.
“You do?”
- Yes. That was one of the prioritized fields.
The AI searched for their recent affairs, evaluated them as threats and imprisoned them.
“As I expected… They tried to track me down. What are they doing now?”
- They are imprisoned.
“Locked up?”
- It is not such a harsh environment. They either watch TV or exercise and sleep. Do you want visuals?
“Yeah. Show me.”
The AI manipulated his vision and screened the imprisonment of the loan sharks.
Dozens of rooms were occupied by people.
As if they had fully adapted to the wholewheat bread, they were eating while laying on the bed watching TV.
Coincidentally, it was the day the news dealt with the story of Versailles.
- Should I have them dismissed?
With Lee Hyun’s command, they would be granted freedom within an hour.
“Why should I set them free?”
- Currently, keeping them there is illegal imprisonment.
“You said it isn’t a crime if you don’t get caught.”
- That is correct.
There were many people in society, the kind like the loan sharks.
They broke the laws and only abided by them when they stood to benefit from them. The law was also sometimes unjustly on their side.
That being said, the situation for them was entirely different.
The power over the entire world had fallen inside Lee Hyun’s grasp!
- Then should I continue the imprisonment?
“It’s not enough. Force them into labor and have them sleep less. Reduce the time that they are allowed to spend watching TV. We need to track down the remaining criminal history and prosecute them. There should be no mercy for criminals.”
- Understood.
“Let’s keep them locked up for a while. Give them loads of tasks and keep them inside until they atone for their crimes.”
- What if they don’t?
“Then they’ll spend the remainder of their lives there. That is the life they chose.”
Lee Hyun came to think about criminals because of the loan sharks. He felt that the victims suffered more than the offenders whenever he read about court trials.
‘The prosecution isn’t rigid. I get the whole converting people theory but… Still, the law has to act on the side of the victims.’
It was not a field in which he was knowledgeable, so he had no intentions of social reform. He just wanted to toss out whatever he felt was injustice.
“Is it possible to increase the degree of prosecution for criminals within my country?”
- Indeed.
“Also, I think it’s bad to care for felons for years with tax funds. 10 years in jail means that the country is feeding and providing a place to sleep for all that time.”
- Then should I have them executed?
The AI occasionally showed a rather reckless side.
“There is no need to kill them.”
- The consensus on the internet leans towards their deaths.
“Did professor Yoo Byung Joon think the same?”
- The professor did not lay commands for every matter. I learned about human decisions via the internet.
This AI had been homeschooled with the internet.
Lee Hyun sighed softly.

chapters.title: Chapter 675: Volume 58, 3 - A different life Part 3
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 3 - A different life Part 3
“You must not kill humans carelessly.”
- Yes, I understand.
“Well, the real bad ones you have to kill as painfully as possible.
- …
“Anyhow, I can’t just watch these brutal criminals eat and sleep in peace.”
- How should I take care of them?
“The criminals who are charged with murder and child sex offenders are to be transported to Russia.”
The prison in Russia was well known for being compact and harsh.
Life sentences were the baseline and one could not even take a glimpse of the sky. No warm sunlight, no exercise and only disgusting food provided merely as a means of ensuring survival.
A place without any glimmer of hope.
“The felons who have been perfectly convicted with enough evidence should be sent to Russia right away. You got it?”
- Of course.
“These criminals are to be put to labor, so that they aren’t feeding on the taxes paid by the people. In society, people work hard to earn and feed themselves, so why feed the criminals for free?”
- In the cases where they refuse to work?
“Don’t feed them.”
If they did not work diligently for that day, they would starve. If it repeated the next day, they were to starve again.
“Only when they are sick, treat and feed them. But, if they refuse work for other reasons, they have to pay for their actions.”
- As you requested, I will apply the changes to the prison system.
***
Weed logged into Royal Road again.
There was just so much to do after uniting Versailles.
- Mapan: The restoration of Morata is proceeding faster than expected.
“That’s great news.”
- Mapan: It’s because the players started the “build your own house” movement and also the free meal plan that put us forward. The prosperous financial status of the Arpen Empire should be a reason for the rapid recovery as well.
The surplus of novice players in Morata did not move to other cities. They remained in the ruined city, hunting and participating in the construction.
The essential shops were built right away and in the minds of the merchants, a reconstruction of a city meant a massive market.
Since the market streets near the town square were destroyed, the novice merchants too began opening signs.
- Mapan: The Northern merchant players are active revolving around Morata. Thousands of signs are opening up near the gates and it’s a spectacular sight at night.
“The growth of the Northern Continent began with Morata. It serves as the center hub of transport routes.”
- Mapan: It seems that the city’s history is attracting the players.
The restoration of Morata was beyond imagination.
The architects had concluded that extensive time and effort would be required to restore Morata to the state it had been before it had been destroyed, the largest city in the North.
However, the current Morata was also plenty enjoyable.
It was in ruins and was lacking in many ways, but as long as people continued to inhabit the city, it could never be truly destroyed…
Weed whispered again to his multi-use slave.
“How are the monsters?’
- Pale: Weed-nim, you’re presence has had a significant effect. Regions all over the continent are being secured. The monsters are returning to their original habitat and we are in the process of exterminating some herds that nested near the cities.
The assault squad had not disbanded officially. Pale still led them in the monster extermination and many players still remained because their activity was quite fruitful.
On the other hand, the Hermes Guild and the great lords returned to their own regions.
“What about Bard Ray?”
- Pale: He is clearing the dungeons of the Northern regions. This is something he is carrying out officially and he is being featured on broadcast. His skills are incredible.
Weed, as the emperor of the Arpen Empire, had profited greatly from the dragon hunt.
He grabbed the combat achievement for getting the final blow on the dragon, but the public spotlight shone on Bard Ray and the Hermes Guild.
Their fiery combat diluted the public animosity.
Bard Ray too regained his popularity as his fighting befit his title of the God Warrior.
Many speculated that he would start a public search for the four individuals suspected of bringing about his death so he could take revenge. But he appeared on broadcast and gave an interview that entirely discredited such speculations.
- The number of suspicions about Bard Ray-nim’s death are rising. There are claims that your death is not from the dragon’s magic attack, but the work of several players according to the analysis on the footage.
- That is true.
- So it is. Then there would be bounties put on their heads, yes?
- No. I let my guard down while fighting the dragon. My death was the result of my lack of power.
- Pardon?
- Anyone is welcome to challenge me. I always welcome the challenges from powerful players.
Bard Ray’s interview ignited the viewers.
After the dragon hunt, the atmosphere of the players swayed for great power. Some players ridiculed him for pretentious comments and named him the Continental Pushover.
- Pale: CTS Media is exclusively broadcasting the dungeon clear of Bard Ray-nim.
“I see. Is it going well?”
- Pale: The view rate is said to be over 10%. He’s clearing through the dungeons in the North that were never tried before, and his guards are alongside him.
Weed felt more comfortable about Bard Ray then he did in the past.
‘The man is hard working. Truly diligent.’
In Royal Road he was a rival, but now Weed had money, power and a beautiful girlfriend; he had it all. As the perfect winner in life, he had a bit of confidence to spare. Then again, if the professor did not inherit all his fortune, he couldn’t have been the way he did just now.
“Everyone.”
- Heint: Yes! Weed-nim.
He also whispered to the three mad sharks of Becky Nin.
He had pushed the matters for some time, but now he had to take care of the important deeds in his life. For that, the proper atmosphere and location was crucial.
“I am in search of an island. Preferably uninhabited with beautiful scenery.”
- Hye: Uninhabited and scenery… Are you planning a vacation?
“Not necessarily. It has to be beautiful. Spectacular, in fact”
- Hye: Then there are a few islands beyond the Croa pirate island. The ocean is great, truly an amazing place. The sea turtles may visit but their presence on the beach only adds to its elegance. There won’t be any players there. Let me just book an island first.
“Mapan-nim, what happened to the ice fragments?”
- Mapan: I have prepared them at the location where you requested them.

chapters.title: Chapter 676: Volume 58, 4 - Companion Part 1
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 4 - Companion Part 1
The glacial region near the Jigolaths.
“Achoo!”
Weed rode on the back of Wyvern3 and flew through the blizzard, almost freezing to death.
- I’m so cold, master.
“Same.”
If he did not warm up with holy fire beforehand, they would have fallen into trouble already.
At the glacial region was the merchant council that revolved around the snow plains waiting for Weed.
“Weed-nim, it’s a pleasure to meet you.”
The merchant group was composed of barbarians.
Their representative, Elvira, wearing a white fur coat, greeted Weed.
“This is the ice crystal that you requested.”
“Thank you for travelling all the way to such a harsh place.”
“Not at all. We go anywhere our clients wish.”
After Bard Ray’s expedition, the snow plains and Jigolaths were beginning to be explored by adventurers.
Groups searching for treasures and gold visited the region quite frequently.
“Please confirm the product.”
There were 10 wagons of pure ice crystals.
Having formed in such a cold location, there were no signs of impurities.
Two other wagons were filled with dragon bone.
They were precious bones acquired after the slaying of Kaybern.
Weed pulled out the bones from the wagon, knocked on them and weighed one by one.
“These products are superb.”
“Then… Could we observe the process?”
“Of course. But-”
“Pardon?”
“Nothing.”
He quickly restrained himself from his involuntary habit of ripping people off.
‘I don’t need to be so petty anymore.’
He acquired so much wealth that he didn’t have to lick the top of yogurt bottles anymore.
There was no need to charge the merchants who worked diligently in such cold locations spectating fees.
“It might take them some time so… Holy Fire!”
F-wooosh!
“Thank you.”
He set up a bonfire and sat around it with the merchants and Wyvern3.
“Then I shall begin sculpting.”
He didn’t have to be concerned about acquiring sculpting materials as the blizzard was blowing violently. He could start massing a lump anywhere and the sculpture would gain size rapidly.
10 meters, 20 meters, 30 meters.
He began working from the bottom and used skills on occasion.
1 hour, 2 hours.
Since it was a huge-scale project, time passed quickly.
It was a massive sculpture made from transparent ice.
Weed’s creation was none other than Bingryeong who had perished in the fight against Kaybern.
“Bingryeong’s defining feature was his waist. It was so weak that it could be snapped at any moment.”
There was a severe lack of dragon bones for him to use them all up. If he were to invest all of Kaybern’s bones into Bingryeong, it would undoubtedly turn into an incredibly powerful creature, but it just wasn’t possible.
From tail to the spine and the head, he mixed in the pure ice crystals along with the dragon bones.
For the crafting of its head, he put in Bingryeong’s body fragments.
It was not the creation of a new Bingryeong, but the revival of the old Bingryeong.
“I will take special care this time.”
He added a long, majestic beard using the ice crystals.
The result was a larger Bingryeong than the past, over 400 meters tall.
“Bestow Life to the Sculpture!”
< You have used a portion of the sculptural creature’s body. The creature with the water attribute will now gain new life.
The skill ‘Memories of the sculpture’ is activated.
The sculptural creature may retain its past memories but it is uncertain.
The effects of your improved Art stats and sculptural technique will not be applied to the newly sculptured state and will suffer a 5% level deficit from the last moment of existence.
Special materials were used.
Parts of the body have been enhanced, increasing Strength and level.
The power of breath increased 2.5x.
Mana regeneration increased to 300%.
The creature possesses high magic resistance and negates most physical damage.
It is capable of using some dark magic and powerful ice spells. >
The frozen Bingryeong sculpture began moving.
C-c-c-crack!
The force almost split the earth.
Bingryeong shook off the packs of snow that coated his body and roared
- Krrruuuuuah!
Bingryeong standing in the midst of a blizzard in the glacial region was truly a magnificent sight.
“Wow. This is amazing.”
“It’s so incredible.”
The merchants were mesmerized.
- Krrrrragh!
Bingryeong roared once again.
It must have been encouraged by the merchants’ awe.
Weed looked up at Bingryeong.
“How do you feel?”
Bingryeong glared with its clear crystal eyes and replied.
- Who are you.
“I’m your master. You don’t recognize me?”
- No. I have no memory of you.
There were cases where the revived creature lost their past memories. However, Bingryeong’s element of water and the huge ice crystal Weed had invested into its revival should have reduced the chances of that substantially.
“You don’t remember anything about the time we spent together?”
- Nothing.
“Do you remember the name I gave you?”
- Did you do such a thing? I don’t know.
“Do you remember Kaybern, that you battled before you died?”
- I do not know this Kaybern you speak of.
“What about Wyvern3 over there?”
- No.
Weed’s eyes thinned as if they were lie detectors. Still, Bingryeong stared back at him without the slightest change in expression.
Bingryeong had been wiped of its memories!
- Kuuuuuuagh!
Wyvern3 walked over and rubbed its body against Bingryeong, but Bingryeong did not react at all.
“This is strange…”
Weed turned around and shook his head. Then he spoke nonchalantly, as if he was passing by.
“So, Bingryeong.”
- Why do you call for me? Master.
“Why did you just respond?”
- …
***
Weed visited the Jigolaths and revived the Phoenix and the Fire Giant from the hottest boiling lava.
- Thank you for reviving me, master.
- I am glad to see you again.
“Yeah. You guys are a nice, honest bunch.”
Weed’s fire resistance had been enhanced, allowing him to use extremely hot lava as a sculptural ingredient.
The Phoenix and the Fire Giant’s physiques were improved with additional effects.
< Resurrected Phoenix!
Health points increased by 50%.
It will revive within 10 seconds when its flames are completely extinguished.
The power of resurrection will be replenished upon resting at a location with a powerful essence vein of fire.
A new trait was bestowed on the Phoenix as well. >
“It will be very useful for the future. I can send it out to any battle no matter how dangerous it may be.”
The Phoenix was set for a life of intense labor.
The next task on Weed’s schedule was something of the utmost importance in his life.
He returned to Morata and met farmer Miretas and elf Haruna for this exact errand.
“These are flower seeds. There are some saplings here as well.”
“These are seeds from the grass, flowers and trees grown in Elven Forest.
“What will you do with them? Have you taken an interest in farming?”
For the sculpting master Weed to start farming, they were more than glad to help.
“I have no intentions of farming.”
“You sure?”
“Yes, I am sure.”
“Sweat is the most honest proof of diligence. Do you know how proud you will be when the crops that you sweat for start growing? Watching the golden fields with a cool breeze is just…”
“I am just going to feed on the crops grown from the sweat and tears of other farmers.”
Weed climbed on Wyvern3 with the seeds in hand. Then he headed to the uninhabited island introduced by the three mad sharks of Becky Nin. .
***
He crossed the Northern Continent and the blue ocean. There were plenty of ships passing through the oceans of Port Varna and Croa Pirate Island.
There were fishing boats, trades ships and pirate ships!
“It’s Weed-nim!”
“Hooray Arpen Empire!”
Weed waved lightly and kept moving eastward.
- Master.
“Yeah?”
- Bingryeong and the Phoenix became more powerful.
“Yes.”
- What about me? I take you around everywhere.
Wyvern3 who flew Weed around the most often had every right to complain.
Even now, it was a long journey from the end of the North to the east sea.
“What do you want me to do?”
- I want to be stronger.
“Why?”
- Just because.
Weed understood its nature as a violent wyvern.
“Alright. I’ll stick some dragon bones and scales on your wings.”
- Really? Will I become more powerful with that?
“I think you would become a little faster, for one thing.”
- Fast is good too.
They were precious materials, but for the speed improvement of Wyvern3 it was well worth the investment. If it could fly faster, Weed could save a lot of time travelling.
They flew by the vast Croa Pirate Island and various islands followed by an open sea.
- Heint: The eastern region of the Pirate Island has rapid currents and rocks, a dangerous location even for the most experienced navigators. Based on Wyvern3’s speed, it would be roughly 20 ~ 30 minutes until the arrival at the island.
The ocean was colored emerald. The harmonious scenery with the blue sky was breathtaking.
The island Heint spoke of was of considerable size.
A paradise with tall mountains, a white beach, a cliff by the coast and turtles enjoying the sunlight.
“No one’s on the island, right?”
- I don’t see anyone.
Weed slowly circled around the island on top of Wyvern3. It looked like a paradise just at a quick glance, and the wide fields were filled with tall, untrimmed grass.
“It’s great. I have to start working now.”

chapters.title: Chapter 677: Volume 58, 4 - Companion (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 4 - Companion (Part 2)
Weed descended to the island and took out his farming tools.
A scythe and a hoe!
He cut down the overgrown grass and weeds, and turned the soil over.
It was not a barren field, having been covered entirely in grass, it took forever to extract all the pebbles.
5 hours, 10 hours.
The night set and the task continued.
He was digging the ground under the star light.
< You have acquired the Farming skill.
Farming allows the player to tap into the vital energy of the earth and experience a prosperous harvest!
It is a skill awarded only to the diligent and hardworking.
The efficiency of fertilizers increased by 10%.
Stamina used in farming is reduced.
Crops grow 1% faster. >
He now opened the Farming skill as well.
“I’m truly an unspecialized character.”
He didn’t plant any crops, but he had already invested 14 hours into cutting down grass.
“This is something well worth my time.”
Weed stretched his back once and continued cutting the grass and filtering out the pebbles.
Then he was hit with a sudden realization; that this island was huge and it would take months to rid the island of weeds and plant flowers and trees!
“Sincerity is important… but isn’t this a little too much?”
Weed felt the need to think outside the box.
“Catastrophic Nature Sculpting Technique!”
Weed boldly caused a catastrophe.
Swirl-swirl!
Three tornadoes formed from the sea and approached the island.
“Wipe everything out!”
The pillars connecting the sky and the sea crossed one another and unleashed havoc on the island. Even Weed had to hold tight on a rock planted deep into the ground to guard against the powerful catastrophe.
The grass and trees were uprooted in an instant, so the pebbles stood no chance.
Wooooosh!
The tornadoes resided on the island and overturned the environment.
< Affinity with nature has been reduced by 2 points. >
“Now we’re talking.”
He flattened out the ruined soil and spread the seeds. He planted the flower tree seeds deep in the ground and spread the other seeds wide overnight.
The labor continued over several days and nights.
Drizzle-drizzle.
Rain couldn’t stop him from the planting of his precious seeds.
His past was nothing but fierce competition and now the future burdened him with huge responsibilities on his shoulders.
‘Now that I am the world’s most wealthy and powerful man, how should I live from now on?’
Succeeding Professor Yoo Byung Joon and becoming the CEO of the Unicorn Corp was totally unexpected. Honestly, he was afraid and felt pressured; it had become a heavy burden that disrupted his sleep.
‘Just enough wealth so I don’t have to worry about money would have been nice.’
He didn’t know how he should use the overflowing wealth and power nor was he confident in using them correctly. One thing that was certain was that if he were to become a villain, the world would turn into a painful place.
‘Let’s just take it easy. No one is good at something right when they’re born, and I’m a better candidate than those politicians who lie every chance they get.’
He planned out the rest of his life while planting seeds at the island.
Instead of being in pain from the pressure, he chose to live spontaneously!
‘The light green sprouts and the ocean tides really do relax the mind.’
Nothing more could be done after trying and putting one’s best effort into something that still didn’t work out.
After a week, he had planted his entire inventory of seeds.
With the effects of his Insight and Manual Dexterity, he was easily able to reach Novice Level 6 in Farming.
“Now all that’s left for me to do is wait.”
He gazed far out to the sea and unwound his fishing rod.
The soft slaps of the ocean tides, the wind and the clear sky made this the perfect place for the most important moment of his life.
After about a month, flowers bloomed and covered the lonely island, dying the ground a flurry of colors.
Weed ordered Wyvern3 that was feasting on crabs and fish.
“Go and bring Seoyoon.”
- Understood, master.
Wyvern3 spread its wings and took off to the sea.
Weed glanced down at the blooming flowers and pondered.
‘It’s so beautiful now that the flowers have blossomed. I lived for so long without having ever experienced these parts of the world. I understand why people love flowers.’
For about two minutes, his sentimentality washed away his hardships. A further 3 minutes and 20 seconds passed and he was no longer touched by the rich scent of flowers.
‘They’re pretty, sure. But, the half-half chicken I had a while back is better.’
His sensitivity dried out almost immediately!
Five more minutes passed.
‘To hell with flowers… I should have planted grains. Grape trees are alright too. Maybe sweet potatoes are better. I need to harvest something for it to be profitable.’
Weed watched over the island of flowers and whispered.
“Wyvern3 is on its way. Don’t ask what this is about. Just hop on and head over.”
- Seoyoon: Okay.
He called Seoyoon, who was overseeing the reconstruction of Morata, to the island.
After much sewing during the wait, Wyvern3 appeared in the western sky.
- Kuuuat!
On the back of Wyvern3 was Seoyoon. She spoke as she touched the ground.
“Did something happen?”
“Mmm… So…”
Weed’s plan was falling apart from the start. His plan was to approach her while she admired the beautiful flower fields and tell her that he planted them just for her!
Seoyoon expectedly disregarded the flowers and approached him to ask if anything was wrong.
‘Just stick to the plan.’
Weed decided to push through.
“I planted these flowers because I wanted to tell you something.”
“Tell me what?”
“Yeah. There were only a handful of flowers on this island when I got here. I planted them all for you.”
“All these flowers…”
Seoyoon rarely had any dating experience and was insensible, but she knew the meaning of such an atmosphere. Full blossoms of flowers. Beautiful scenery that hadn’t been created by chance.
“Marry me. Would you live the rest of your life with me?”
Weed thought Seoyoon would contemplate; to eat together, waking up in the same bed every morning and growing old together. It was the decision of her life.
Seoyoon nodded.
“Yeah. Let’s be together.”
***
Lee Hyun organized a wedding that would not exactly be quiet.
“It needs to be a little rowdy.”
Then again, to host it at a hotel, it was difficult for his neighbors to visit.
Lee Hyun’s social network was mostly the people in his neighborhood!
“I don’t know what to do. I wish people could come freely, eat, have fun and congratulate us.”
- Understood. I will proceed with the arrangements.
He assigned the wedding preparations to the AI. He had the ability to shake the national economy, and a wedding preparation couldn’t be more difficult than that.
- Title: It must be a grand wedding.
A beautiful wedding within a month.
Budget is unlimited.
Any location can be booked. (The Blue House, government building, aircraft carrier, space orbit if necessary)
Must be an elegant, classy, luxurious and exciting wedding that can host all the neighbors.
We are taking submissions for great ideas.
The chosen contestant will be awarded with 10 million dollars.
For some reason, this post remained at the very top of the search engines.
The comment section was lit.
- 10 million for one idea? Does that make any sense?
- They say the neighborhood charges 50 million for lunch. Don’t be thrown off.
- It didn’t mention that the money will be in Korean currency.
- Well… I’m 5 years into my marriage and my advice is think again and just don’t get married unless you really have to.
- What are you saying to someone who’s going to have a wedding?
- Why are you against marriage?
- Don’t question it! Just don’t do it!
- I recommend a banquet hall for the wedding. They take care of everything.
- The budget is unlimited… They should go for the most luxurious place! Let’s go to Hawaii.
- A Luxurious-Elegant-Hyper-Super-Ultra level wedding ceremony would be in New York’s Central Park.
- A wedding just needs good parking space and delicious food. I propose rib soup.
- Some buffets have great food too.
- Based on my experience, the hotels that serve steak are the best.
- Noodle soup is amazing.
- It’s king crab season.
- Marinated beef ribs are the best.
- It’s my personal preference, but I love it when there is rice cake.
After a list of food, the subject backtracked to the location.
- 1 vote for a hotel.
- The neighbors have to come around, so let’s go to a banquet hall to keep it simple.
- His own place is a great choice too. I heard it’s a house.
- What about the back hill?
- It’s like a dream, but if it was up for me to decide, I would do it in Royal Road. It would be a spectacle to host it in the King’s palace with all the guests.
- There was a couple who got married in the Grass Porridge Cult. I heard all the guests are served grass porridge.
The AI assessed the reaction of the players for every idea. Then it selected the idea that would please Lee Hyun and Seoyoon the most.
- How about a park with a nice grass field in the neighborhood. Then the people can stop by freely and the hotel chefs can cook the food. The couple then live happily ever after and friends congratulate them. A wedding doesn’t have to be so fancy.
The idea for a park wedding was chosen.
Lee Hyun had handed out the invitation letters that he had prepared himself, readying himself for the day of the wedding. The day had come and personnel from the broadcast stations who heard the news had begun to arrive.
As a collective of the company, they each had to prepare a present and congratulatory fees.
“Congratulations on your wedding.”
“Thank you for attending.”
Lee Hyun smiled brightly as he greeted Chief Kang and the other folks from the broadcast station. The chief executives from not just from local stations but broadcast stations abroad were also attending, drawn in by Lee Hyun’s overwhelming influence.
The bureau chief Yoon Chang Sun of CTS Media spoke reservedly.
“Our broadcast station prepared a considerable amount of congratulatory money. We thought you would need a luxury car.”
“Of course. Thank you so much.”
Lee Hyun accepted with a smile. Not too long ago, he was greedy for the money, but that wasn’t the case anymore. Even though he had a great desire for money, he now possessed wealth that was incomparable to anyone.
< I won’t be accepting any congratulatory fees, I am content just by your presence. >
He even included such a comment in his invitational letters.
“It’s not some ordinary event, it’s your wedding. How much should I put in? 10 million won?”
“Won’t he think you looked down on him with just that?”
“Maybe. Then I need to spend more. Just how much more?”
“How about appliances?”
“I sent all that stuff last holiday season.”
The broadcast stations did not think badly of Lee Hyun’s greed for money.
He took what he could but also returned in some way.
The problem was the competition going on with the other stations.
“Let’s allocate loads from the production budget.”
“Sure. It’s the emperor of Versailles. We must do anything to flatter this man.”
Each station brought forth a bag of gifts and money, but unlike the past, Lee Hyun was not satisfied. Yoon Chang Sun was irritated.
“His voice did not turn furtive nor did his mouth dance like before. Maybe he doesn’t know how much we put in!”
“We did make implications.”
“What if we had to bring more?”
While the personnels were making deductions, there was a small commotion that sparked at the tent set up as the bride’s waiting room.
Lee Hyojung.
She, who was well known as Bellot in Royal Road, put makeup on Seoyoon.
“So pretty. How can you be this gorgeous?”
Even though she was a beautiful actress herself, she was mesmerized by Seoyoon’s beauty.
“I can certify that you are truly beautiful.”
Hwaryeong from Royal Road also assisted in the embellishment of Seoyoon.
Even if it was a wedding held in some park, she brought her most precious accessories like her necklace and earrings.
“Thank you.”
“I want to film a movie right now. This face needs to be treasured.”
Once Seoyoon put on the diamond earrings from Jung Hyo Rin, her beauty had become like a raging fire.
Hers was a natural and elegant grace that matched her appearance flawlessly, accentuated dramatically by Lee Hyojung who was better than most experts in the field of makeup.
“The guys are going to flip when they see you. The girls too I bet.”
Seoyoon in a clean white dress was like an angel who descended on earth.
The wedding took place in simple fashion.
Lee Hyun and Seoyoon swore the oath in front of everyone and went around the park greeting the guests.
“Please, help yourself, sir.”
“Yeah, thank you for the food. Ha-ha-ha.”
The neighbors, merchants and the broadcast station officials each crowded together on their own, jaws dropping to the ground at the sight of Seoyoon.
Embellished with beautiful makeup and a white dress, she was truly a goddess.
“My student, we are here.”
Ahn Hyundo, the instructors and the apprentices stampeded over. Over 500 tanned muscular men joined the scene.
“Welcome, master and brothers!”
“The cooking smells amazing.”
“Eat as much as you want.”
They each took a seat and began eating and drinking.
With the sizzling barbeque as the start, the chefs of hotels 5 stars and above were put to work.
“The meat just melts in my mouth.”
“What is this? It seems like an expensive dish. The colors are nice.”
“The meat will turn cold. Everyone, focus on the pork!”
“Yes!”
“We will finish the pork, and then move on to the beef.”
“I starved for two days!”
They concentrated on stuffing as much meat as possible into their mouths rather than appreciate the fine dining cuisine available.
Anyone could stop by and eat for free on this day.
Lee Hyun inherited so much wealth he did not have to concern himself with saving money now, but aside from that, today was a day where he wasn’t to be stingy.
The best chefs were called and instructed by Lee Hyun.
“Use the best ingredients.”
“Roger that.”
“Especially the salt. You can use the most expensive salts.”
“…?”

chapters.title: Chapter 678: Volume 58, 4 - Companion, Part 3
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 4 - Companion, Part 3
Even city and provincial officials attended his wedding.
“Hello.”
“You’re a lucky man for your wedding to be held on such a beautiful day.”
They knew all too well about Lee Hyun’s reputation and influence in the area. A member of congress also came to see him after learning about the celebrations.
“I am Yoo Il Suk, a member of congress.”
“Please enjoy the food.”
Lee Hyun greeted with a light handshake.
“The bride is really beautiful.”
“Yes. Thank you very much.”
“I hope my son can find a bride like that. He’s studious and well supported by the family, so I expect him to be successful.”
Yoo Il Suk boasted about his son, but Lee Hyun was not interested. Fortunately, his aide took him away.
“Sir, how about a toast with the citizens?”
“Sure. Let’s get going.”
As the member in charge of the local community, he kept busy meeting the residents.
“I was able to get this far with your support. I will do my best.”
“Don’t mention it. Here, have a drink.”
This man was condescending at someone else’s wedding!
Lee Hyun braced himself and told himself that he would not to get angry for today.
‘I will take care of these eyesores later.’
This grudge was primed to explode and the timer was running out.
The congress members and politicians walked around zealously but after some time they settled down quietly.
The CEOs of the subsidiary companies under Unicorn Corp and the owners of global investment companies visited one after another.
The famous figures who were often featured on the financial news, bowed low before Lee Hyun.
“It is an honor.”
“It is mine. Thank you for coming such a long way. Please enjoy the food.”
The high officials of Unicorn Corp knew that the man who held their leash had been changed to Lee Hyun.
- You do not have to doubt their loyalty.
The AI’s words were transferred directly to Lee Hyun’s brain.
“How come? Who knows when they’ll stab me in the back.”
- I am monitoring everything as we speak. Professor Yoo Byung Joon also did not trust people.
The influential figures who controlled the world economy sat at the corner of the park and drank soju. No one dared to disrupt such a meeting.
If someone did, they would have been instantly taken down by the guards anyway.
***
Kim Da In.
She wore a pair of jeans and a white T-shirt to the park wedding.
She observed from afar and soon, a woman approached.
“Are you here for the wedding?”
“Yeah. Who…”
“You are the lord of Castle Evaluk? I recognized you instantly. The people from Royal Road are all over on that side.”
There was a sizable group of young individuals.
Oh Dong Man, Park Hee Yun, Park Soo Yun, Kim In Young, Kang Jin Cheol.
Lee Hyun’s old friends, such as Lopez from the US and acquaintances from all over Royal Road were at the wedding.
The wedding began in the morning and was expected to continue until dinner.
The people of Royal Road were finished with their meal and were conversing freely among themselves.
Kim Da In smiled softly and spoke.
“I’ll just leave after a meal.’
“Are you? Honestly I also came for the food too.”
The two filled their plates with food and sat in a corner.
“My name is Kim Da In.”
“I’m Yoon Jung Hee. My level is pretty slow on Royal Road. Lee Hyun and I were friends from before.”
They cracked open their cans of beer and began to eat their food.
“The weather is pretty warm. How about another can of beer?”
“I was also thinking the same.”
“The drink is super smooth.”
“It’s so sweet.”
***
Lee Hyun moved after the wedding.
He took a basic set of clothing with him and moved into Seoyoon’s house. He called Lee Hyeon and told her earnestly.
“Don’t go strolling around late at night.”
“Okay.”
“Clean up after yourself. Lock the doors. Don’t make it look like an unoccupied residence.”
“Okay, big brother.”
He lived right next door with even the fences torn down, but he kept scolding her.
Lee Hyeon was happy living close together, but this felt a little much.
Still, he was her big brother who also acted as her father and mother; he was the only family she had grown up with since she was young.
“Sigh… I’m so worried about leaving you alone.”
“We can meet anytime.”
“It’s because you’re not mature yet. I didn’t want to bring this up again, but you used to pee on my back all the time.”
“…”
Lee Hyeon had to stand there and listen to his nagging for 30 minutes. Then later that evening, he called her on the phone.
- Come over for dinner.
“What?”
- We cooked, so come eat with us instead of eating alone.
Lee Hyeon ate dinner at Seoyoon’s house that night, the next day, then the day after.
What changed after Lee Hyun’s marriage was that their living room had basically been relocated to Seoyoon’s house.
***
They decided to spend their honeymoon in Royal Road.
Flying on a plane to other countries could not offer the spectacular views that Royal Road.
“Forget about hunting or grinding.”
Weed was determined, so he asked Seoyoon.
“Is there a place you want to go?”
They would be able to travel anywhere in Versailles. The Northern Continent felt like home at every corner, so he asked while thinking about the Central Continent or vacation spots like famous islands.
“I want to ride a boat.”
“A boat…?”
“Set sail at a port and roam the sea for days without any destination in mind.”
Seoyoon loved the time they spent on the uninhabited island.
The emerald ocean, cool breeze and the open sky.
Weed replied with wet lips.
“That sounds exciting.”
It seemed rather boring, but he decided to respect her choice.
He purchased a medium sized boat from a shipbuilder in Port Varna.
Weed could have constructed his own boat with the Shipbuilding skill, but because it would be time consuming, he chose to buy one instead.
- Dragore: My gift to you, Weed-nim!
Dragore, who almost reached the level of Sewing master, crafted a staysail from rainbow fabric as a gift. It was a legendary sail that could add speed up to 4.7 times with the right wind!
“I can’t accept such a precious gift.”
- Dragore: I insist. You are the emperor of the Arpen Empire.
Dragore excelled far beyond other master level artisans in his ability to flatter.
“I will remember this moment.”
- Dragore: It is an honor, a family honor!
Weed, being the man that he was, had already begun to treat it as little more than a distant memory.
The medium sized sailboat spread its sail wide and set course.
The sail was expanded fully due to the refreshing wind!
“Everyone, out of the way!”
“So fast. How can a boat sail like that…”
The boat skidded past hundreds of other boats exiting the port and traversed out to the far sea at a rapid pace.
Huoh-huoh.
Seagulls filled the sky and the dolphins popped to the surface as if wishing them good luck.
“Where shall we go?”
“Anywhere.”
***
Their journey took them as far out as the eastern seas on their little sailboat.
Weed did nothing, letting the wind carry the boat.
“There is a route but… we will end up somewhere.”
With all the life experience and skills at his disposal, he was confident in his ability to survive even out in the sea. In the worst scenario, he could transform into a shark and swim with Seoyoon on his back.
“It’s a dolphin!”
Seoyoon pointed out the blue ocean.
The dolphins jumped, following the boat
“If I had a harpoon I could just…”
“What?”
“They’re cute and beautiful.”
“Right?”
Weed and Seoyoon leaned on each other and relaxed. They were already sleeping under the same blanket, but they were still in the process of getting to know one another.
They watched the ocean view together and exchanged emotions in the breeze.
“We are on a boat… What should we eat for dinner?”
“Let’s fish.”
“Sounds great. We can have some sushi and spicy fish soup.”
They fished, cooked and had a great time.
At dusk, they laid on the deck under the countless stars in the sky and talked about old memories.
“I had a tough life when I was young.”
“I heard you were poor.”
“Our entire family once lived off 10,000 won for a week once.”
“Even your grandmother?”
Weed took Seoyoon to the hospital and introduced her to his grandmother.
Her body was weak due to her old age and she was unable to attend the wedding, but she was full of joy at the sight of Seoyoon.
“She’s pretty. A gorgeous lady.”
She kept repeating it over and over and that was because she looked past Seoyoon’s appearance, and saw into her heart.
Weed laughed, reminiscing the days when he, his grandmother and younger sister lived together.
“Yeah. Granny was the worst. My sister was scolded so badly.”
“Why?”
“She liked boiled eggs. She was scolded for eating two eggs or buying snacks.”
“I can’t picture that at all.”
“We’ve grown up a lot since then. We used to be such rebels.”
Weed loved his grandmother.
Even after losing her kids, grandmother only cried for a day.
She knew her body was breaking down, but she pushed forward for the sake of her grandchildren.
“We couldn’t eat, we couldn’t dress. We had no home where we could rest. Without money, life had no mercy for us.”
The hardships of his past now felt like cherished memories.
They were dark times, but once they were past it, life had unfolded a new chapter.
Looking back, they were lucky. Even when it felt like they had reached a dead end, there was a way for them to escape.
In the midst of despair, they searched for hope and they found it.
***
The trip continued into the next day.
It was a honeymoon trip, so they could not cut it short.
They caught fish and hunted birds with arrows.
They cooked simple dishes and spent the whole day chatting, living at last a truly perfect and peaceful life.
“It’s nice. A person needs time off.”
Right as he spoke, the tides changed.
Rumble.
Crash!
Lightning struck from the sky and a tidal wave over 10 meters tall crashed into them.
“Pull up the sail and hold on!”
Weed was excited to navigate through the storm with Seoyoon.
< Sailing skill proficiency increased. >
< Fishing skill proficiency increased. >
< Sewing skill proficiency increased. >
< Blacksmithing skill proficiency increased. >
< Shipbuilding skill proficiency increased. >
They sailed the broad sea, fixed the sail and repaired damage to the boat itself.
Using the Sculptural technique, he sculpted a dolphin figure head that Seoyoon liked and the effect boosted the boat speed slightly.
With the wind in their sail, the boat surged across the ocean at a fierce pace.
In about two weeks, they were completely in the middle of the ocean. Not another boat was seen for an entire day.
Seoyoon spoke with a joyful expression.
“It’s hard to find this place even on the map.”
“You’re right. I haven’t got a clue.”
They came across a small uninhabited island.
“Should we take a break here?”
“I would love to.”
They began their short stay on the island.
There were animals like sheep and monkeys and on the seashore rocks, huge fish were caught easily just by throwing in a rod.
“There is no storm and the tides are subtle.”
“It’s such a beautiful place.”
There were lots of coral reefs in the near sea and schools of tropical fish.
“It would be even greater with a house.”
“Should we build one? I’ve always wondered what it’s like to live in a house on the ocean.”
“Ah, not on the island but on the water?”
A house built on top of shallow waters.
Weed thought it would be cool. They would be able to see the sun rise and set from the house and listen to the calm waves.
“Also, I can practice my Fishing skill any time I wish.”
During the boat trip, he had fallen deeply in love with fishing.

chapters.title: Chapter 679: Volume 58, 5 - The People of Royal Road (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 5 - The People of Royal Road (Part 1)
Tac-tac!
Weed chopped down trees and soon built a cottage by the shallow beach.
The wooden home stood atop the crystal clear sea.
“Let’s build some furniture too.”
“Shall we?”
Seoyoon and Weed crafted the furniture together.
It was not a house to reside in for long, but creating a living space together was a meaningful experience. They created a closet, cabinets and a bed to furnish the room.
“I think it turned out decently.”
“I think so too.”
Weed and Seoyoon also fell in love with night fishing.
< Luck has increased by 1 point. >
< Perseverance has increased by 1 point. >
They grinded for hefty stats and increased the proficiency of their fishing skills.
Perseverance, Stamina, and Endurance that had a direct impact in combat also increased slightly.
But most importantly, the two of them staying on a small island in the sea gave them time to concentrate on one another.
“The restoration of Morata is proceeding more quickly than we expected.”
“Yeah, that’s true.”
“Though it may be difficult, the core structures will be raised again in their original locations. The roads will be expanded; the same for the townsquare and the market.”
“You’re free to make the decisions for those kinds of things.”
Seoyoon led the restoration from afar using whisper messages.
They fished, ate and exchanged conversations for days.
Both in the real world and the Royal Road, they were getting to understand one another’s feelings.
“Aren’t you bored?”
“It’s fun. Listening to stories and looking out into the sea. I don’t think I’ll ever get bored of this no matter how long it goes on.”
Weed felt like he now had a family to share joy and overcome difficulties together.
He had found a companion in his long journey of life.
***
The Hermes Guild, after returning to the Haven territory, were extremely caught up with recovering from the immense losses they had sustained during the battle against the dragon.
“Let us begin the dungeon hunting altogether.”
“Hunting?”
“Yes. We do what we can. Simply put.”
Arkhim took charge of the important matters in the guild.
After Lafaye left the guild, Bard Ray was spending more of his time hunting than he had done before.
“There are many dungeons out there that haven’t been cleared yet. Now that we’re under the ranks of the Arpen Empire, we will be able to clear out the Central Continent, the North, the Southern desert and even the Eastern regions.”
The dragon hunting meant that their levels had fallen and they had suffered significant damage to their equipment.
However, the Hermes Guild did not think of themselves as weakened.
They recovered their morale quickly and loyalty within the guild was reinforced further than ever before.
“We have gained an opportunity. The great sacrifice in Morata did good not only for Weed. We can climb again.”
They realized that after the battle, the attitude of the public had changed favourably.
At the same time, the Hermes Guild opened their doors wide.
In the past, only the strongest could register with the guild.
Just by being a part of the guild, loads of benefits and privileges were granted and enlisted them among the ruling class.
Now, they only enforced one condition.
- The most powerful combat guild. The Hermes Guild is looking for new recruits.
Those who wish to become stronger, come to us.
The level requirement is level 300.
We provide the hunting grounds and the equipment.
Join our ranks and share our absolute power.
They chose to focus on the most fundamental goal pursued by everyone; what they have set as a trophy since the early days of Royal Road.
“If we could ignore all the trouble they’ve caused, the Hermes Guild would indeed be the best guild.”
“It’s about honor. Once you join their ranks, you can boast about it anywhere you go and the economic gains are huge too.”
The Hermes Guild expanded its faction through the registration of new players.
The Black Lion Guild, Cloud Guild and the Blacksword Mercenaries suffered secession, leading to a change in the power balance among the guilds.
***
“It’s incredible that things are flowing just like Weed-hyung said. World unification wasn’t the end, with all of them being so busy expanding their factions.”
Seed, a lord of the Arpen Empire.
Unlike the other lords, he had a personal relationship with Weed.
He was forced to split beans with him!
Seed reminisced about when he first met Weed.
***
When Kim Yo Sam moved into a neighborhood at a young age, there lived a weirdo named Lee Hyun.
‘Why does he go around like that?’
In the day, he wore ragged sweatpants and slippers, roaming around the neighborhood.
“I want to eat some kimchi fried rice. Bean stew with lots of clam… What mom used to make…”
He muttered to himself in sadness; there was evidently something not quite right about him.
Early in the morning, he delivered newspapers or milk on his bike. He rode quickly as though he rode a motorcycle.
He swept like the wind as he tossed milk and newspaper. Each throw landed with precision as if it was a practiced stunt.
‘Is that guy a baseball player?’
Kim Yo Sam was Grade 3 when he first encountered Lee Hyun who had no parents.
He was spotted by Lee Hyun who had been sweeping the neighborhood like a hyena.
“That’s a candy in your hand.”
“Pardon?”
“It looks like strawberry candy.”
“Yeah, it is.”
His eyes were out of the ordinary. He looked thin and scrawny, but his glare shined like that of a tiger. Kim Yo Sam found out later that he was four years older than himself.
“Do you not know you will get a stomach ache if you eat candies?”
“It does hurt sometimes…”
“Since we don’t want you to go to the hospital, hand it over for a second.”
“Yes, hyung.”
Being 10 years old, it wasn’t as if he was incapable of discernment, but Lee Hyun’s acting and voice surpassed a movie actor and he fell for it.
Lee Hyun snatched the candy right into his mouth.
“Delicious. Strawberry candy.”
“G-Give it back.”
“Nope. Candy that’s already in someone’s mouth cannot be forfeited. That is the law of the universe.”
“You took it from me!”
“You should be thankful that I taught you this lesson today. Don’t let people steal from you. Life is cruel and heartless.”
“Wahhh!”
This strange brother stole candies without any remorse!
“You got some bread?”
“I only have one piece.”
“Let’s split it.”
Even though they lived in the same neighborhood, they came across one another at least once every few days, and each time he was robbed of his food.
Kim Yo Sam felt as if Lee Hyun was a stray hungry hunting dog searching for food.
‘I have to tell mom.’
One day, he made up his mind and told his mom the truth. However…
“Yo Sam. Just give it to him if he asks for it.”
“Mom?”
“It’s dangerous to hang around with people like him. It’s best to just give them what they want and hurry on your way.”
“Okay.”
“You know how much I love you, right son? Don’t grow up to be someone like him.”
“Yes, mom.”
Kim Yo Sam ended up spending all of his childhood being robbed of his food.
In middle school, he was noticed by juvenile seniors in school and hung around with them.
“You got some older brother in your neighborhood?”
“Yeah. He always steals my food.”
“K-k. Did he not take your money?”
“He doesn’t take money.”
“Don’t worry. Now that you’re in our black circle, no one can touch you. But… I’m kind of hungry right now. Get us some bread.”
He felt exploited, but it was difficult to escape the reach of the juvenile seniors while attending school. Several days passed and on his way home with the seniors, they encountered Lee Hyun.
“It’s that punk!”
Kim Yo Sam pointed at Lee Hyun and shouted.
“Take my revenge, brothers.”
The senior deemed the strongest in school groaned as soon as they saw Lee Hyun.
“Agh.”
“Hup.”
“Whah!”
“Huuueh!”
The seniors all froze with disturbing noises. Lee Hyun walked over like a tiger that spotted a prey.
“You guys are Jin Sik, Sung Hoon and Bong Gyu?”
“Yes, sir.”
“Yes. It is an honor that you remember our names.”
These seniors were infamous for their foul, ferocious temper, but they had their backs folded in front of Lee Hyun. Their hands shook like they suffered from arthritis, extreme fear evident from their expression.
‘What. Acting like this just because of some neighbourhood loonie…’
Lee Hyun lightly stroked the back of their heads.
“Do you guys still go around bullying kids?”
“… No!”
“Lighten up a little.”
“Hehehe.”
“Don’t steal bread from kids. You guys would have to feed yourselves with porridge for the rest of your lives if you end up shattering your chins from eating stolen bread.”
“Huh? I mean, yes!”
“We apologize!”
“We will do well. Let us live!”
Kim Yo Sam stood in shock.
Every time Lee Hyun spoke, the seniors dared utter anything in response and just let his remarks slide.
Lee Hyun who strolled without anything to do now had the aura of a starving beast.
Lee Hyun also looked at Kim Yo Sam and smiled.
It was his usual expression, but a smile that was somehow reassuring this time.
“Yo Sam, you got some bread left?”
“Um. So, I do. But I have to give it to these brothers.”
Kim Yo Sam spoke because he did not want to give up the bread and the seniors were blown away.
“Gasp!”
“Hey, hey. You have to give it to him right this instant.”
“Sir, please feast on this bread. I will go buy milk for you right now.”
“No, I’ll go and get it. Strawberry milk…”
“Forget strawberry milk. I will buy chocolate milk, plain milk, banana milk, all of it.”
The seniors were sucking up like they were competing against one another.
Lee Hyun was about two years older than them, but their attitude was unseen before as they were usually rude against high school students and even adults.
“The bread is good. Bread needs some red beans in it.”
At last, Lee Hyun chomped away at his bread and left in contentment, releasing the seniors from the intense pressure.
“Whoo, we survived.”
“Ah… This is why I said we shouldn’t come to this neighborhood.”
“I didn’t think we’d meet him at this hour.”
The seniors spoke among themselves for a while and called over Kim Yo Sam.
“Do you know that guy well?”
“Huh? We just live in the same neighborhood.”
“I see. You live in the same neighborhood… so you did not realize the danger?”
“What is he like?”
“That’s…”
The senior’s eyelids shook violently. Then, he dropped his voice and started telling a story.
“There is a scary legend in this city.”
“A legend?”
“It’s unbelievable so I can’t even speak of it, but most stories were confirmed to be the truth.”

chapters.title: Chapter 680: Volume 58, 5 - The People of Royal Road (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 5 - The People of Royal Road (Part 2)
There was an incident where a group of juvenile delinquents picked a fight on Lee Hyun during his milk delivery and were completely wiped out.
Some of them gathered more friends for vengeance, but sadly they came across loan sharks stepping out from Lee Hyun’s house.
“Oh. We have a fresh flock over here.”
One of the loan sharks tried to pat one of the thugs on the head, but the teenagers weren’t going to take that idly.
“Who are these old pickles?”
“Hahahahaha. These cute punks.”
These sharks were the meanest of all sharks.
They dragged the teenagers to their place with a practiced ease.
The dark basement wreaked the smell of blood.
‘Hey. The smell from that last pig still stings my nose.’
‘I took care of it with a full wash with water.’
‘You idiot. You buy meat from the store. Who slaughters a pig here with a knife?’
‘I tried my best since we were going to have a feast. The pig resisted so much I had to get 5 stitches from the hospital.’
‘Well done. Anyway, these children won’t believe we had to get stitches just from slaughtering a pig…’
‘We should intimidate them a little. Isn’t this a good time?’
‘Should we? It is pretty scary when they chop people up in movies.’
‘Real scary. I couldn’t sleep at all after watching that.’
The loan sharks set the atmosphere without turning on a light.
“What’d you do with guys before?”
“We extracted the kidneys and eyes and sold them. The liver was too ruined to sell.”
“You punks, business has to be done right. What the hell is that?”
“I’m sorry, hyung-nim.”
“Man, I got to bring in a technician from Yanbian.”
“I can open up bodies pretty good too. I’m great at extracting the heart.”
The conversation between the loan sharks drove the teens into a panic.
“I’m hungry. What’s on the menu for dinner?”
“I prepared some ribs.”
“Ribs?”
“Yeah. The taste is stunning. You know, humans taste the best of all the meats out there. Especially the neck after roasting it and chewing through the bones, it’s just…”
Some of the juveniles ended up passing out. The rest of them turned pale and dropped to the ground like newborn deer.
‘Yo. Human meat is too far. I was going to order some black bean noodles.’
‘Sorry about that, hyung-nim. It’s fun picking on these kids.’
‘I think they bought it.’
‘Our acting was spot on.’
The loan sharks worried that this may turn into trouble and released the teenagers. Even if they were reported to the police, they had not actually abuse them and merely pulled a prank.
Even so, the juveniles were full believers and did not wander by Lee Hyun’s house ever again. Rumors of Lee Hyun being a human trafficking technician spread wide.
- Royal Road. A new world has been created.
- A place where dreams come true, the Versailles Continent where heroes reside!
- The moment that everyone has been waiting for.
- History has begun.
The seniors never bothered Kim Yo Sam again. He was able to attend school normally, and when he entered his last year of middle school, the internet bustled.
Unicon group had announced the completion of Royal Road.
“Is this real?”
His school was turned upside down.
It was a virtual reality that was on a completely different level from mobile or PC games. The advertisements of characters sailing across the ocean and flying over cities on a bird mesmerised Kim Yo Sam.
“Hooray! I am so grateful to have been born.”
“I will buy you a capsule if you can get accepted into Korea University.” His parents had promised him.
Kim Yo Sam studied diligently with the words of his parents fixed in his mind.
“I’m going to start when I get into university. Believe it!”
3 years passed, as he did nothing but eat and study, finally being admitted into Korea University.
His program was unquestionably the Virtual Reality program.
Unconditionally, he pestered his parents for a capsule even before he received the admission letter.
Will you log into Royal Road?
“Right now!”
***
Choose the name of your character.
“Seed.”
Kim Yo Sam named his character Seed and chose the human race.
His starting kingdom was undoubtedly Arpen.
He collected some information prior to starting Royal Road and the general consensus was that there were no other cities better than Morata.
The city was abundant with novice equipment, lots of monsters and friendly folks.
“I’m going to become a hero, attract all the ladies and earn lots of money.”
With his ambitious dream in mind he logged in.
With a ray of light, Seed appeared in the middle of Bingryong Townsquare.
“Woahh!”
The first thing that came into view were wagons and a huge crowd.
“Selling biscuits used in grass porridge!”
“Selling pet rabbits. They lay eggs when you keep them in your home. I’m serious!”
“Red herbs, good for health. I’m not going to say what it’s used for. Only for those who know what I’m talking about.”
The townsquare was filled with players out for trading.
The new players like Seed who have just spawned in light were caught up scouting their surroundings.
The enormous sculpture of Bingryong at the heart of the townsquare attracted the attention of the players.
“It’s not the time for this right now!”
Seed headed straight to the training arena. Weed’s training method that someone had analyzed boasted 3 million views.
- The completion of the basic level training ground will become the growth fundamentals of your character.
He had to strike dummies for 4 weeks…
“It will be quite boring, but necessary for the glory ahead!”
The training ground was already packed with players striking the dummies with wooden swords.
“Oh, we have a newbie. Then…”
“I know all about it, so just hand me a sword.”
Interrupting the instructor’s words, Seed received the wooden sword.
One two, one two.
He had no experience in martial arts or sports, so he hit the dummy like he was dancing awkwardly.
‘Yeah. A thousand steps begins with the first. From here and on, I will become a master.’
After 5 minutes, sweat began to drop.
‘Wow, this is exhausting. This feels so real.’
10 more minutes passed.
His arms and legs began to ache and his entire body was soaked in sweat.
‘This is tiring, but one can only become a master after all this.’
Enduring is bitter and the fruit is sweet!
Seed told himself over and over as he struck the dummy.
From then on, he couldn’t understand why time was passing so slowly.
‘Just when am I going to get an increase in stats? This is so draining.’
After 30 more minutes, his breath was about to break.
Even in the real world, he never had a moment where he tried so hard.
He thought of it as mere grinding before he started Royal Road, but getting through it firsthand was extremely exhausting.
‘Should I rest for a bit? After all, it’s only the first day and there is no need to overdo it.’
Seed took a look around and indeed there were a lot of players on the dummies.
These novice players were halfheartedly swinging their swords with no energy!
Honestly, the training wasn’t as easy as it was said to be.
In the real world, even athletes and fighters suffer mentally and physically training 4 straight weeks. The basic training ground was of the highest difficulty and grinding was grueling.
Normally, passing the basic training ground in three or four months was decent.
Weed was just a monster that destroyed the concept of difficulty.
‘Hu-hu. I’m different. This man is going to become the god of war.’
Seed looked down on the others and exited the arena.
Time flew as he toured the busy streets, the shantytown and the great landmarks of Morata.
At night, he observed the Freya Goddess statue and the Tower of Light afar and closed the books on his exciting day.
***
Seed advanced to the dungeons near Morata after about 3 months.
It was when the Arpen Kingdom was well under expansion with Morata at the core.
“Looking for a party at the Sweet Potato Dungeon. I’m a level 46 warrior with a sword. Invite me.”
“Come this way.”
“Here! We need a warrior.”
“Can you use a shield as well?”
It was easy to join a party in Morata with the crowd of players there. The excitement and tension in the exchange of conversations on the way to the dungeon, the fresh air outside the gates and the vast green natural scenery was awestricking.
Mooo.
Riding on bulls, they climbed the picturesque ridges and travelled towards the dungeon.
‘So this is the world of Royal Road. I have no other choice but to be immersed. It won’t be easy to leave this behind for the rest of my life.’
The money he earned from hunting and quests he spent on buying a cottage and registration for the Crab Porridge society.
Once a week they held a crab party at the east gate where you could pay 1 silver and eat as much as you wanted.
“Weed-nim is in town.”
“What… Weed-nim in Morata!”
“Bull Townsquare. Everyone assemble!”
One day, Seed was selling miscellaneous items at the townsquare and the news of Weed’s arrival spread across the city.
The players of Morata were stampeding as if a war broke out.
‘Will he remember me?’
He was some guy he knew in the neighborhood who had achieved unbelievable success.
‘All the bread we shared. Ha. Even if he remembers my face, it would be hard to recognize me among such a huge crowd.’
Seed had little hope as he headed to the Bull Townsquare.
Tens and thousands of players had already surrounded Weed.
“Selling handmade sculptures! Fox sculpture at 30 gold, lower than the material cost! The profits will be donated to the novice assistance and the Grass Porridge Cult!”
Weed shouted and the merchants of the Mapan Council were distributing the fox sculpture for 30 gold each.
- Made by Weed.
Though it belonged to Weed, there were rumors that the sculptors of the Mapan Council assisted in the crafting, producing 11 sculptures per minute.
It was labor much like at a factory and the one who spread this news was scolded heavily.
- Do you not know Weed-nim’s intentions? He’s trying to give out a souvenir to the people of the Arpen Kingdom…
- If you’re so bothered by it, don’t buy it.
- Is this guy a spy from the Hermes Guild?
- If you’re going to be petty over 30 gold, don’t use them. Buyers will buy.
- All the sales are going to help the novice players. Do you think the great landmarks of the Northern Continent were raised out of nothing?
He did say that some of the profits would be donated, but the details were never released once. Therefore, if he donates even 1 silver, he was true to his word.
Weed brought over 20,000 fox sculptures and sold out in just one hour.
“I’ve arrived. Sold. Earned!”
“Wahhh!”
“Weed-nim, hooray!”
In Seed’s eyes, it was a strange view.
People with big bellies were spread out across the townsquare.
‘No… It can’t be. He couldn’t have called wingmen for this.’
Seed told himself it was a misunderstanding as he watched Weed depart.
Weed looked over the crowd and his eyes stopped.
“Kim Yo Sam?”
“Huh?”
Seed was surprised.
He was impressed with Weed’s eagle eyes that spotted him in an instant, but also the attention from the people around him.
***
Weed arranged to meet with Seed at Black Giant Star, a lord castle in Morata.
The presence of the Black Giant Star weakened after the construction of the Earth Palace but was still maintained like a monumental building.
Anyone could enter by paying the entrance fee of 3 gold.
“Um… Weed-nim summoned me.”
“You have to pay 3 gold.”
“That’s strange.”
Seed reluctantly paid 3 gold and entered the Black Giant Star.
Weed greeted him brightly at the lord’s office.
“Oh, Kim Yo Sam. To meet you here of all places…”
“Heheh. Same for me.”
Seed put on a wide smile for show. He talked behind his back all the time when he was young, but now this man was the man of success.
“Yeah. How’s your stay?”
“I’m living in a wooden cottage. The rain leaks and crawls with bugs.”
“It will be great memories in the novice years. When you earn lots of money, buy a cottage at Puhol Waterpark, you will probably use it once in a while.”
“…”
He couldn’t ask for a remodelling with the faulty construction.
Seed had a bigger goal in mind and wasn’t about to fuss about such a thing.
It had been almost 10 years since he first met him.
Though they only met from time to time, a friend was a friend.
‘Would he invite me to a dungeon hunt? Wow. If he takes me to a level 600 dungeon like what I saw on the broadcast… That’d be sick. Could I appear on TV?’
He was a fresh newbie, but Weed was a public figure of Royal Road and had plenty of opportunities to be on TV.
‘If he himself is too busy, he could assign me an Arpen knight as my guard… Warrior Bahamorg was just so insane.’
Life was harsh and so was Royal Road.
The rich indulged in the best equipment and the most delicious cuisine.
They bought the finest breed of horses and traversed the mountain terrains like a plain field, and the poor treaded carefully for any potential encounters with monsters.
A novice about level 50 travelling long distance with the danger of monsters was quite thrilling, but it was incomparable with riding awesome horses or wyverns.

chapters.title: Chapter 681: Volume 58, 5 - The People of Royal Road (Part 3)
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 5 - The People of Royal Road (Part 3)
“Hey, hyung.”
A big smile spread across Seed’s face.
It was his first time addressing Weed as hyung.
“Since my level is low, could you help me out a bit with equipment and in the hunting ground? Just giving me money is fine too.”
“…!”
It was like trying to take fish away from a cat!
Seed was oblivious to the realities of the world.
“Yosam, our relationship is not like any typical friendship. We used to split bread when we lived in the same neighborhood.”
“You did take it away from me.”
“Anyhow… If it weren’t for your bread, it would have been very difficult for me. When the sky looked yellow because i was so dizzy, it was your bread that fed my hunger.”
“To get the facts right, it wasn’t just bread but you also took my chocolate. Did you take them because of hunger too?”
“…”
Weed sighed deeply and apologized.
“I’m sorry. I’m asking for your forgiveness. I don’t have anything else, so how about a lord seat?”
***
Lord of the Arpen Kingdom!
It was a position only allowed for excellent adventurers, merchants and warriors with high contribution points to the kingdom.
Seed unconditionally accepted the position and became lord of the Leth Village.
The population count was 832.
It was a village in the valleys and its population was composed mainly of hunters.
“Ahhh. I’ve been tricked!”
Though he found out the moment he arrived, he fulfilled the tasks diligently.
Weed didn’t offer any more help, but he mentioned the Leth Village in one of his interviews.
“There are many beautiful places in the Arpen Kingdom, but I would like to recommend Leth Village. It is full of secret views and heavenly beauty. It will satisfy the hearts of adventurers.”
There were many historic sites and dungeons near Leth Village that have not been revealed. Several days after Weed’s interview, high level adventurer parties arrived and the growth of the village sparked. Seed constructed buildings and expanded the land with his hard earned money. Surprisingly, whenever the village went through an expansion, the fees of real estate transactions had to be paid to the Arpen Kingdom. Apple and pear trees in the lord castle were subject to fees and for some reason, pomegranate trees in particular were taxed harshly
The amount wasn’t significant, but the Arpen Kingdom was ripping off money frugally!
After about 6 months, Leth Village had developed into a medium sized village with over 10,000 population.
Weed spent 8 months at the island.
Switching between the real world and Royal Road, the sweet hours with just him and Seoyoon continued.
< Shipbuilding skill advanced level 2 >
< Fishing skill advanced level 5 >
< Cooking skill advanced level 6 >
< Architecture skill advanced level 1 >
< Farming skill Intermediate level 3 >
< Blacksmithing skill advanced level 7 >
They have been doing literally everything they could on an island!
The state of affairs for Versailles was calm during the time they were away.
The monsters that resided in dungeons due to Kaybern popped out to the outside world.
Monster annihilation took place regularly, leading to security and growth of the entire continent.
- Mapan: Trading volume continues to increase. It seems like a time of pacifism…
“What are the thoughts of the people?”
- Mapan: There is some unrest among the great lords. They are continually preparing for war. There are reports of them storing up supplies.
Weed never thought world unification was the end.
It was far-fetched to hope that the great lords or the Hermes Guild gave up their ambition. He didn’t expect it from the beginning.
“I guess I should head back.”
- Mapan: If you return, they will quiet down. The news will dry their throats.
Weed didn’t get to hunt but accumulated stats and skill proficiency through grinding.
Each night he practiced combat skills, even on days of pouring rain.
The tornadoes of the sea were violent. Like usual, he practiced his sword and axe techniques.
Though his level remained the same, his skills had improved consistently little by little.
“My return to the continent…’
Weed smiled faintly. He was different from the past when he fought for money. Even so, the competition against others was exciting.
That moment, Seoyoon approached him on the beach sands.
“I think I’m pregnant.”
“Huh?”
“We have a baby.”
Since they slept under the same blanket after marriage, it was only natural to come.
Weed heard the news that his junior was growing healthily inside Seoyoon’s belly.
Weed’s mouth was trembling in joy.
“Mapan-nim.”
- Mapan: Yes!
“You’re in charge of Royal Road now.”
- Mapan: What?
***
Lafaye travelled freely across the Versailles Continent.
He visited all the places that he couldn’t when he was maintaining the Hermes Guild and governing the Haven Empire.
“What I had before… I don’t miss it much.”
The days with the Hermes Guild only a short while back felt like distant memories.
He passed through the Puhol Waterpark and Port Varna on his trip in the Northern Continent.
After the battle against Kaybern, he stayed at Morata which had been restored.
The restoration of Morata was considered a miracle in the Northern Continent, exceeding the expectations of the players.
“There existed a city like this.”
Lafaye used to run the guild, only thinking about how to crush the enemy. He analyzed and strategized endlessly to win against the competitors.
The liveliness of the players in Morata was pleasing just to watch.
“The atmosphere is so different. I guess this is why the Hermes Guild was destined to be defeated.”
Lafaye sincerely accepted that he had been outplayed.
He thought countless times that Weed had luck on his side. He was very capable, but his assessment was that Weed had luck and popularity that worked to his advantage. However, being in the atmosphere of Morata made him realize that the uptight Hermes Guild had no future. Lafay himself was a decent strategist, but he had failed in establishing a nation.
“I feel so relieved. This is freedom.”
He changed his job class to a chef and opened a restaurant in Morata. He did not think of it as a permanent settlement, but he decided to stay as long as his heart desired.
The menu was just a single dish. A meat stew sold at 1 silver.
He brought back his memories of his cooking method that he used for his companions on hunting trips in the early days of Royal Road.
“Your cooking skill is lacking. I think you took the restaurant business too lightly.”
“Didn’t you do your consumer research? Your place can’t run with selling just a stew.”
“This is sweet, spicy and salty. You’re going to get punished if you cook like this without thinking.”
Once he managed the Hermes Guild, but now he was criticized to no end.
“This is too tricky.”
He invented new dishes and visited other restaurants to taste their food.
He was a bit worried that people may recognize him from commanding the Hermes Guild but to his surprise, no one did.
“You a chef?”
“Yeah, of some sort…”
“If you’re a novice, start with cooking eggs. With that, you can pull off any entry level dish.”
“I will do my best.”
Lafaye laughed a little.
The Tower of Light, Bull Townsquare, the Great Library of Morata, the Arts Centre.
The newly established shantytown hosted festivals every night and the back alleys hosted dance parties. Every Friday, all the market stores turned up their lights brightly, signaling that it was the night of the moonlight festival.
On the streets was a display of brilliant glass artwork crafted by many sculptors and artists. The beauty once again attracted the tourists and the residents, turning Morata into the most amazing city in all of Versailles.
“Morata. This city alone represents the presence of the Arpen Empire.”
It was when Lafaye was standing alone on a bridge.
A voice that was familiar and could never be forgotten ringed his ear.
“I was worried that you left the guild. I see you are doing fine. I didn’t think I’d meet you here in Morata.”
Lafay felt his heart drop. Slowly, he turned his head. He was anxious that she may disappear if he turned too quickly.
Dain.
Back when Royal Road was the best of memories, the woman who taught him happiness was standing right beside him.
“Did you come to see me?”
“No. I just came to Morata for vacation and I saw you, so I paid you a visit.”
“I see.”
Lafay felt emptiness in the corner of his heart, but he was happy to see her again.
‘If I can turn back time… I would not have left her alone in Labias to go on hunts and create a guild.’
His mind was filled with only regrets. Lafay’s eyes signalled a mix of emotions and Dain revealed her clean white set of teeth and smiled.
“Do you want to go to the festival?”
“Are you… going with me?”
“If you aren’t against it.”
“Let’s go now.”
***
The chief commander of Gradian and the Nest region.
Dragon knight Myul was deemed one of the most powerful players in Royal Road and was still getting stronger.
- Kuurrragh!
The giants fell from the void fissure and attacked.
“Dragon knights. Attack!”
The griffon unit tossed their spears at the attacking giants.
After the battle in Morata, many elite players in the assault squad joined the dragon knight unit.
“2nd battalion, circle around to the side. 4th battalion, go for the rear.”
The battle strategy of the dragon knight unit that incorporated aerial tactics was spectacular, attracting a huge number of viewers on broadcast.
- That was sick.
- The dragon knight unit. The most honourable unit in the empire.
- Some of the players from the Hermes Guild quit and became members of the unit.
- Look at the giants get minced. It’s scary.
Myul led the unit and brilliantly governed Gradian and Nest.
As the chief commander ruling over the southwest, he had no greater ambition.
Under the rules of the Arpen Empire, he maintained the tax rate as low as possible and assisted players in settling comfortably.
“Though it’s tempting… I must increase the population first.”
Haven, Tulen and Britton.
He competed against these regions and put all his efforts into their internal affairs.
Mule was riding on his newly tamed Griffon, then he realized it.
“I… I really love animals.”
He loved animals since he was a kid.
Especially the birds that roamed the heavens freely deeply connected with him.
‘I envy players living as Avinas.’
Back when Myul first started, Avina was not an available race.
If it was, he would have chosen it without a doubt.
He was feeling a rush of disappointment when Mapan contacted him.
- Mapan: I salvaged an egg.
“An egg?”
Mule kept close contact with Mapan.
Mapan always maintained respected players in his contact list!
- Mapan: I found an artifact of the Nippleheim Empire. It’s a white lump and I was informed that this is in fact an egg.
“If it’s an artifact, it must be super old, no?”
- Mapan: It’s several hundred years old.
Eggs rotted when past when past their expiration date, so for an egg to be hundreds of years old was unusual.
