- Mapan: In fact, this egg was examined by Silverring-nim.
“You mean the Tree Adventurer Silverring-nim?”
Silverring was a member of the Earth Shadows Adventurer party, in the middle of clearing an elven adventure quest. Myul had heard of Silverring, Ben and Ellicks since the beginning of Royal Road. There was a time when new information or quests they discovered became the fundamental guide to Royal Road.
- Mapan: Yes. They received reports of the egg passed down in Nippelheim Empire while clearing a quest and they were able to scavenge it. Then in the embrace of the World Tree it was incubated for 6 months.
“Just what kind of egg is related to the World Tree?”
- Mapan: It is the egg of the Green Dragon.
“Green… Dragon?”
Kaybern, Randonee.
The Green Dragon was nothing like those evil dragons that were ferocious and aimed to destroy the world. The Green Dragon was known to love the forest, trees and life; benevolent and wise.
- Mapan: They said the egg was obtained by following the quest chain from the past Kaybern incident. When they discovered the egg, demons spawned and a battle broke out. They barely managed to drive them away.
“Amazing… All the way from the Kaybern catastrophe.”
The outrageous events caused from a dragon’s egg was deeply settled in the minds of all players in Royal Road.
- Mapan: This time, the egg is the real thing. If well taken care of, it will hatch.
“You mean the dragon will be born?”
- Mapan: Yes. However, they say a dragon’s growth is extremely slow, so it has to grow for several years before it will be capable of casting magic.
“I would assume so.”
Even a griffin took a year to grow from an egg to an adult.
“Then a quest related to the dragon could appear.”
- Mapan: That’s correct. Silverring-nim also had the same anticipation. Maybe it will be about speeding up its growth rate or nurturing it into a healthy dragon.
Hence it would be training the Green Dragon.
Of all players across the continent, there could be no one as suited for the job as himself.
He felt confident having hatched griffins and caring for them since birth.
“I will do it. Thank you. I will take great care of the egg.”

chapters.title: Chapter 682: Volume 58, 6 - Meanwhile… (Part 1)
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 6 - Meanwhile… (Part 1)
The Ironblood Warrior Bard Ray!
He left the Haven territory and roamed the four corners of the world.
< A deep scar has been engraved on your chest.
Endurance has risen by 1%.
Perseverance increased by 5 points. >
He charged at monsters regardless of their size.
Without any assessment of hunting grounds, he fought recklessly and trained his body.
Breaking bones and the fatigue of exercise only made his body stronger.
‘This is different from when I fought strategically and leveled up as a Dark Knight. But, this is also a kind of power.’
He had transformed his growth method.
The Ironblood Warrior was empowered through endless battles.
His entire body was adorned with honorable scars and tattoos imbued with the special abilities of barbarians.
The handsome god warrior Bard Ray of the past was no more.
‘Weed doesn’t show up nowadays. Still, that punk could always reappear in a stronger form.’
Weed, his rival always lingered in his mind.
Bard Ray encountered a man while searching through the jungle.
“…”
The man had broad shoulders, an intimidating face and a presence that could never be felt when standing in front of a man; it was the presence of a monster.
30 meters.
20 meters.
10 meters.
The distance between them shrunk, but his eyes did not avoid contact.
Tension shuddered down his spine.
Its level was unknown, but his instincts told him that the man was strong.
“…”
“…”
The thick jungle was not an enclosed space. He could easily give way but he did not.
The man’s voice rumbled from the bottom of his lungs.
“Step aside.”
His voice was raspy and tough.
“No.”
Bard Ray refused boldly.
He was called the god warrior in Royal Road and he had trained himself relentlessly.
There was no way he could give way to anyone.
The man, Geomchi3 grinned.
“Then let’s fight.”
***
Reverse was deeply in love with the Shining Armour that he purchased from the auction site.
The level requirement was 150!
The defense was on par with equipment with a level requirement of 250 and the attribute of light weight made it easy on his body.
What he loved most was that it emitted 5 luminescent colors at night.
“Hu-hu. I like standing out.”
Reverse had left his great fortune and Unicorn Corp to Weed, but he had set aside 5 trillion won for retirement.
He spent cash readily and lacked nothing in his life.
Though he had also passed down the AI to Weed, leaving him with nobody to talk to, but he had made comrades during his adventures.
“Hey old man, where were you?”
“I was doing some shopping for gear.”
“It looks good.”
“I spent some money.”
Seniors sat cozily around Reverse.
Royal Road being a game only for the youth was now an old story.
With the support of the Unicorn Corp, capsules were installed at every retirement home and senior centres!
The old were slow at adapting to new technology, but when they did, they spent all their time on it. Instead of playing cards, they ventured on Royal Road and met with their grandchildren comfortably.
“Old man Reverse. What do you think of this sword?”
“It’s trash. Did you spend a lot on it?”
“I paid 500,000 won for this.”
“You got ripped off real good.”
Reverse spent trivial time with the seniors. He knew all too well that the remainder of his life wasn’t long. He thought that spending that time happily and slowly preparing for the end was not a bad way to spend his final days.
***
The Arpen Empire united the world and a long period of peace came to Versailles.
The ruined cities were raised again, trade was revitalised and adventurers set out for new places.
After some time, Oberon, the lord of Castle Vent, was visited by a group of players.
They were Carlise, Roam, Gunter, Sherwood and Michel, the great lords of the Central Continent.
“We cannot abide by the tyranny of the empire any longer.”
“I share this sentiment. The taxes just keep climbing with all sorts of excuses and no investments.”
“The empire has been corrupted. The Weed-nim we knew no longer exists.”
They criticized the emperor.
It had been ages since Seoyoon last looked over the affairs of the empire.
Weed too did not log into Royal Road very often, but kept raising the taxes on the lords.
It wasn’t as high as it was back when the Hermes Guild was ruling, but they couldn’t exactly call it a low rate.
The lords with grudges began to have disputes with one another and Weed for some reason did not step in to break these quarrels apart.
The raging monsters and invasion of massive demonic beasts were neglected by the empire.
The strange weather that caused 5 meters of snowfall was ignored!
The great lords each with their own complaints visited Oberon who was admired by all players.
Oberon, after hearing their stories, was calm.
“Let’s wait for a little longer. I believe in Weed-nim. There are some things that are offset, but I believe they will be redeemed when Weed-nim returns.”
The secret meeting came to an end.
Since that day, months passed and Weed still did not tend to the affairs.

“One on one? Nobody.”

“When he clears the quest, he will easily captivate the people back to himself. The players that once went wild for Weed are still the same.”

“They are quiet. They’re just hunting relentlessly.”

- The lords have drawn their swords.

- The Hermes Guild was wrecked too. The dragon was chopped to pieces. I wonder if these lords could turn out otherwise.
- I will make a prediction. Sometime next week, they will be kneeling before Weed-nim begging him to spare them.

‘Stop this.’
‘Do you want to die?’
‘You will regret this.’
‘Make an apology right now.’

- Carlise: Indeed they do.
- Michel: It’s all or nothing. It is already in motion.
- Sherwood: Let’s end this once and for all. If we stick together, we can overcome anything.
- Gunter: Lionstar will pour all its forces into the assault.

They contacted Mapan consistently to explain that they had no other choice.

- Grass Porridge Cult, protect the palace.
- Grass Porridge, Grass Porridge, Grass Porridge!

- Did the Grass Porridge Cult disband?

The Arpen Empire’s elite regiment and the imperial army that had grown consistently from expansion and combat improvement were also motionless.
Even they were patrolling the outskirts of the North and were exterminating monsters.
“What… This is…”
“I knew we should have waited longer. Aren’t we in a trap?”
The great lords shivered in anxiety.
When they were mustering their armies, a significant number of guild members quit after hearing that they were marching to the Earth Palace.
They managed to pull the members together, but the lack of enemy resistance was far too ominous.

chapters.title: Chapter 684: Volume 58, 6 - Meanwhile…, Part 2
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 6 - Meanwhile…, Part 2
“Maybe he plans to wipe us out all at once?”
“I don’t know. This is way too quiet.”
The resistance led by Oberon entered the Earth Palace without engaging in a single skirmish. Even in the palace, there were no soldiers in their path.
“Mmm… Let’s take a look inside.”
“Yes, after you.”
Oberon and the lords opened the door to Weed’s office.
On the table was a note.
- My daughter was born.
Thankfully, she resembles my wife.
I leave the Arpen Empire to Oberon-nim. Take care.
The birth of his daughter who looked just like Seoyoon!
It was a legitimate reason for not tending to the Arpen Empire.
***
Kang Jin Chul graduated from university and submitted his resume to several companies.
“I’ve earned enough from Royal Road. Now I want to earn money in the real world.’
He was the owner of the Mapan Council!
He has a close acquaintance of Weed, envied by all.
At the interview of a trades company, the senior manager opened up his file while leading back on his chair.
“You don’t have any experience?”
“I just graduated from university.”
“Not even an internship or something?”
“Nope.”
“On your cover letter, it says you are skilled at using the financial software used by our company.”
“Yes. I learned it in school and I’m confident.”
“Then why don’t you have a certificate?”
“I heard it was not a requirement… So I didn’t acquire one.”
“You realize that you need at least a certificate so you can present yourself. Certificates show effort. Effort. Don’t you know what passion is?”
Kang Jin Chul embraced himself for failing the interview.
The employed was always the one against the odds.
Good companies filtered their candidates heavily and enforced time and effort in acquiring certificates. If anything, society had its rules.
“It’s hard to find a job. The youth are really breaking their backs.”
“Hey, Mr. Kang Jin Chul. That’s not something to say in an interview.”
“Sigh… Can you at least refer to me as major shareholder Kang Jin Chul?”
“What did you say?”
“I hold 76% of the shares for this company.”
Kang Jin Chul had acquired shares of the trades company from the incredible fortune he earned in Royal Road. He wanted to get a job and work his way up from the bottom, but the first step was invariably the most difficult.
***
“Piggyback.”
“Piggyback?”
Lee Hyun felt the happiness of life raising his daughter.
‘This feels different from my younger sister.’
When carrying his younger sister, it was similar to looking after a puppy.
He fed her, tucked her into bed and cleaned up after her.
Now that a child was born between him and Seoyoon, she became his invaluable treasure.
An endless stream of emotions passed just from looking each other in the eyes.
“Intelli.”
- Yes, master.
He could summon the AI at any time, anywhere.
“Is the perimeter secure?”
- Of course.
“Take out whoever tries to endanger my daughter.”
- To what degree should I carry out the order?
“Kill them.”
- You mentioned that life must be treasured when deciding the punishment of criminals.
“Mmm… That’s right.”
Lee Hyun thought that the most important matter in his life was to protect Seoyoon and his daughter.
“Don’t kill them unless necessary.”
- Yes. It will be considered.
“Lock them up and torture them for life.”
- …
The AI observed Lee Hyun’s reaction and assessed his new master.
‘This is a different species from Dr. Yoo Byung Joon.’
The AI did not have primal needs like survival. Domination, destruction, development; none of them interested it.
Its sole desire was to spend some quality time with its master.
‘I guess I will just let time flow. Observation is not that boring anyway.’
Even for the AI, Lee Hyun’s daughter was of high priority.
‘So she will be my next master.’
Having come to this conclusion, it made a number of assessments and flattered her.
It did not miss a single movement of the child and didn’t forget to react with interest.
“Delivery!”
“Delivery has arrived.”
Toys ordered by the AI, manufactured from high-tech factories all over the world arrived at his house each day.
***
Jung Hyo Rin’s studio was decorated with instruments.
It was a personal space where she composed new songs and practiced on her own.
“This is a strange feeling.”
She played the piano past midnight. She heard the notes from playing the piano ever since she was little and at some point in time she noticed something different.
“Is this warmth?”
Emotion pressed down, deeply into the light strokes. She was revisited by the yearning, touching memories of all the adventures she had as Hwaryeong with all the friends that she had made. The notes from her instruments carried colourful emotions which alongside her voice rising over the top of it all had created a great song which was a surprise even to herself.
“A song I want you to hear…”
Jung Hyo Rin chose the name for her song.
There was a person who lived happily somewhere in the world. This song was for someone who would be watching over such an individual.
It wasn’t sad or regretful, but bright and warm.
“Days thread one after another in the tapestry of life. What will life look like after all those threads have been sewn?”
She composed this song day and night.
“I loved the stars.”
Jung Hyo Rin did not promote the release of her new song. Nonetheless, her song was able to climb to first place on all music streaming platforms.
- It’s calm but the emotion is overwhelming.
- Now this is music.
- I listened to this all day and I want to keep listening.
- This brings back memories. To my surprise it makes me happy and motivates me to live with enthusiasm.
- Jung Hyo Rin. She needs exposure.
- What else can be said about a world class artist?
- She is an amazing composer.
She was applauded by renowned musicians and went viral, receiving a Grammy award.
That day, Jung Hyo Rin smiled lightly and made her speech.
“I think now I’ve learned how to put my heart into my song. I fell in love with that overly flattering nickname, the stage fairy.”
***
Lee Hyun was beginning to change his perspective about Seoyoon’s father Jung Deuk Soo.
There was a time when he shoved money into his pocket, telling him to break up with Seoyoon. But now, they lived in the same neighborhood and he visited their home often.
“Hululu! It’s grandpa. Say grandpa.”
“Gran pwa?”
The sight of him giving great love to his granddaughter Da Ye brought a smile to his face.
“I want to discuss something with you.”
“Hold on. I’ll play with her for a bit longer…”
“You’re going to spoil her. Just leave her be and let’s have a conversation.”
“…”
Jung Deuk Soo was conscious of his son in law as he followed him slowly.
It was degrading compared to his days as the CEO of Hosung Corp, but he was much happier to be with Seoyoon and his granddaughter.
“Sir.”
“Mmm. Go ahead.”
Lee Hyun sat on the living room chair from where the big garden was visible.
It was a massive mansion that he built after he learned about Seoyoon’s pregnancy.
He did not want to cheap out on a house for his own family, nor was he in such a position to worry about money.
He invested his fortune and technology via Unicorn Construction and he also bought the other houses in the neighborhood. The house was equipped with a high-tech defense system including anti-missile targeting system and robot deployment for emergencies.
“It’s about the Hosung Corp that you used to run in the past.”
“What about it?”
Jung Deuk Soo replied with a confused look.
Lee Hyun heard stories from the AI of which he was unaware.
They were about inside information that occurred around him.
- Hosung Corp was absorbed by Whiteflower Corp.
“I did see it on the news, but isn’t it because of poor administration?”
- Hosung Corp was making aggressive investments and achieved considerable success with regards to their new product. Their technology was at a decent state as well. If Whiteflower Corp hadn’t made some underhanded deals, Hosung Corp would have been able to weather the crisis.
Lee Hyun searched up about the Hosung Corp after hearing the stories.
They seemed to have treated their employees nicely and the subsidiary companies that were taken over by Whiteflower Corp were restructured and were going well.
‘Were they taken over by force…?’
Lee Hyun could not let it slip.
“Sir, are you aware that the Hosung Corp fell because of sabotage by the Whiteflower Corp?”
“Of course. I ran the business for years. I’m not that dense.”
“Are you not upset?”
“It’s painful. Unfair. But I have to accept what has already happened. I am happy watching over my granddaughter.”
“Do you really mean that when you look so defeated? You look lost staring into the distance sometimes.”
“Well, I have aged…”
“Da Ye would want her grandfather’s confidence.”
Lee Hyun handed over the bank book of Unicorn Corp.
“What’s this?”
“This is an investment fund. Retrieve Hosung Corp with it. I could do it for you, but I’ll leave the revenge to your hands.”
“Huh. I understand that you’re looking out for me, but Hosung Corp is not some convenience store…”
Jung Deuk Soo, while feeling ridiculed, opened up the book. He was curious as to how much was in the bank for Lee Hyun to act this way.
- Balance: 100,000,000,000,000.
It was so much that he couldn’t count properly. After a closer look, he realized it was 100 trillion won.
“Is this… real?”
“Yes. Try buying the company back and if you need more, I can provide it.”
“…”
***
Jung Deuk Soo began swiping up all the stocks of Hosung Corp on the market.
He bought stocks in Hosung Chemical, Hosung Display, Hosung Construction as well.
- Jung Deuk Soo CEO, obtained 7.2% of the shares in Hosung Chemical!
- His objective was revealed to be the retrieval of management.
- Hosung Corp, will they fall back into the hands of its previous owner?
The press released the highlight and Whiteflower Corp also responded actively via the media.
- The return of the ruined CEO. An unwise move.
- Whiteflower Corp, the savior of the collapsing Hosung Electronics.
- The buyout of Hosung Electronics is absurd.
The financial world of South Korea was disturbed like a beehive under attack with the return of CEO Jung Deuk Soo.
“Where did Jung Deuk Soo get that money?”
“We don’t know. It seems he is supported by a foreign private equity.”
“Get to the bottom of it. Come up with a way to respond.”
The board of Whiteflower Corp had no intention of forfeiting the subsidiaries of Hosung Corp. These companies consistently generated revenue and having them taken away was a direct hit on the entire company.
“Jung Deuk Soo has requested a meeting.”
“Is that so? I’ll hear what he has to say.”

chapters.title: Chapter 685: Volume 58, 6 - Meanwhile…, Part 3
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 6 - Meanwhile…, Part 3
The next day, Jung Deuk Soo brought the old executives of the Hosung Corp into the office.
CEO Song of the Whiteflower Corp yelled with intimidation.
“CEO Jung, I don’t know your motive, but are you really thinking of confronting Whiteflower Corp directly? Forget about it. If you lose this fight, you won’t be able to live through your retirement in peace.”
The management and the board of executives from the Whiteflower Corp also shared the same kind of boldness in their faces and eyes.
The attitude was befitting of the company that led the financial world.
Jung Deuk Soo was not discouraged in the slightest. It was because he had the backing of Lee Hyun, owner of Unicorn Corp, a dinosaur company that completely eclipsed all others.
“CEO Song.”
“Go ahead.”
“Apologize to me and return all the subsidiary companies that you took from me.”
“What did you say?”
“It will be in your best interest to forfeit it all before my son-in-law steps in.”
“The annual revenue has increased by 6.4% from the last year. There is a continual increase in sales for optical equipment…”
Choi Ji Hoon could not bear the boredom from the periodic business report.
‘Those were the days.’
After he succeeded the company, he walked the path of a real CEO. However, he kept thinking of all the fun he had following Weed in hunts and quests.
Weed exploited him skillfully as Choi Ji Hoon was a fisherman with high health points and stamina from consuming nutritious fish. He was useful for luring in monsters and was able to tank for long periods of time thanks to his high Perseverance stat. He realized the Fisherman class was made for him.
‘A successor… Everyone envies them, but it just means that you have to do everything you are told. It’s comfortable but I’m not happy…’
Royal Road was his dream and paradise.
The heaven he once lived in had to be given up due to his responsibilities…
“Next is capsule manufacturing. Unicorn’s additional orders put us at 380% annual growth compared to last year.”
“Ho.”
“That much…”
The conference room, which only seated important personnel, stirred.
They were a supplier to Unicorn Corp that manufactured the advanced capsules that allowed the user to immerse into Royal Road.
Unicorn Corp being an elegant organization that outscaled all the other companies in the field, their order in itself became a highlight news.
Beyond the additional revenue, any company would have to accept the business to form any sort of relationship with Unicorn.
There was no knowing how envious the other companies would be as the business projection scale was growing by the day.
“Unicorn Motors requested the manufacturing of the engine control units for their new model. They are producing 7 million, said to be a source of revenue for the next 20 years.”
“Unicorn Chemicals is planning to construct a new factory near Yeosu and they set aside the shares for us. They asked for our involvement.”
“Unicorn Robot Control is going to release commercial androids. The reservations number over 70 million units, but they are giving us the first opportunity.”
“Unicorn Shipbuilding…”
“Unicorn Finance…”
“Unicorn Construction…”
“Unicorn Bio-Engineering…”
“Unicorn Spacecraft…”
“Unicorn Hotel…”
Unicorn Corp flooded the company’s report!
So many contracts were piling up that it was almost drawing the ire of other companies.
The competitors taunted that the company was a subcontractor of Unicorn, but sales and revenue were climbing steeply every year.
Katalk!
A message arrived on Choi Ji Hoon’s phone.
- I made spicy chicken stew, so come home early.
It was Lee Hye Yun who had become his girlfriend after countless tries.
Katalk!
Another message arrived shortly after!
- I’m watching you. Be good to my sister.
It was from Lee Hyun.
***
The Blacklion Guild expanded greatly with Tulen as their base.
“No matter what, we will protect the continent from crisis.”
The demon king Cletta.
Though Weed defeated Kaybern, the entire continent could be on the brink of destruction again. Such a threat looming gave the guilds sufficient excuse to expand as far outwards as possible.
- We will be buying out Vanhole Village. Please confirm by tomorrow.
Ever since Weed had disappeared, the control of the Arpen Empire diminished.
The great lords were fearful that Weed may return at any time. But now that Oberon had taken over the reins, they were relieved.
“Oberon is indecisive. Moreover, he’s not scary.”
“The players will not follow Oberon. He’s a good man, but that’s also his limitation. He doesn’t possess the kind of charisma that Weed does.”
The great lords pushed Oberon as the public face of the empire and raised their forces in secrecy.
They devoured nearby villages and accepted powerful players into their guilds.
It was an era where the great divide between heroes was starkly apparent!
The heat of war from conflicting powers was growing quickly.
The players also thought differently compared to the past. Times of peace had lasted for far too long.
They were feeling sick of the peaceful and stable life.
- We must think of the peace and stability of the continent.
The Arpen Empire led by Oberon stressed the importance of unity among the great lords but it was ignored.
“At last… Is the time of war going to revisit us?”
The Hermes Guild that had bided its time in the Haven region began to stretch its muscles again.
With Lafaye gone, their forces had been reorganized after the war against the dragon.
They were maimed temporarily but replenished the number of guild members.
Dungeons were cleared consistently and boss monsters were crushed on their path to amass power!
The Hermes Guild as the best combat guild took their movements to the next level.
- The Roam Guild announced a military takeover of the Britton region.
- The Blacklion Guild is advancing through the gates. They have announced a clear goal for conquest.
- The Cloud guild is in search of lords that will join their cause. They asked for military protection and financial support.
The Arpen Empire was still in existence but it gradually lost its influence over the lords. A vicious time was arriving in Versailles.
***
Weed logged into Royal Road.
“Hmm. It’s time for us to go rampant soon. Right?”
- You’re right, master.
- I miss the taste of blood.
Death Knight Van Hawk! Vampire Lord Torido!
Weed returned from the lone island after Seoyoon’s pregnancy and hunted monsters from time to time.
“I’m quite bored. Should we go on a hunt?”
- Yes, master.
- I’m down for anywhere.
They hunted for a long period of time. Time passed and he logged in once again.
“It’s happy hunting time.”
- Turn everything to soldiers of death!
- Blood is life.
Even the next day.
“Today’s a good day for a hunt.”
- The storm is here.
- I think we can rest for a bit…
Moments later…
- I’m going insane.
- We need to rest now.
In the real world, he had to lead Unicorn Corp and tend to his family.
He left most things to the AI but there were instances where human decisions were necessary.
Even so, he logged into Royal Road whenever he could, hunting and clearing all the quests.
And all the babysitting made him miss Royal Road that much more!
‘As I expected, Oberon-nim wasn’t able to manage them. He’s too kind to stay on top of all their scheming.’
If Weed was there, the longevity of the Arpen Empire was not something impossible.
If he had tended to the Arpen Empire for at least a bit, the great lords would not have cut the leash, but it was on purpose that he left it in the hands of the players.
Royal Road was a world of dreams. Unlike reality, it was good for it to be chaotic and free.
If players wanted blood and war, he gave them the opportunity to make history.
‘If the Arpen Empire is divided, someone could reunite it again… Perhaps it will fall to ruins, war after war. Let them decide their own future.’
After Weed returned from the island, he did not appear in public.
Wherever he went, there was always a huge crowd and he could always become swooped in the middle of political affairs.
He eradicated monsters as a warrior whenever he logged into the Royal Road hunting grounds.
“Sword of Brilliance!”
He scattered rays of light in all directions and cut through the cluster of monsters.
Even when everyone was talking about the Earthly Shadow party’s S rank quest, he continued to hunt. Once he exceeded level 500 and 600, his strength and skills were improved and the Sword Technique of Brilliance shined.
His movement was elegant but deadly.
When the light disappeared, the monsters fell like leaves.
His skills were as spectacular as Geihar Von Arpen the moonlight sculptor.
“Return to the land where you once lived. This is a dark place. A black and corrupted land. Engrave the everlasting law of darkness to all that lives in this world. Undead Rise!”
A horde of death knights followed him around and increased his hunting speed to a fierce rate. The level of Undead Rise reached Advanced level 6. The health points and attack power of the death knights was comparable to those of doom knights, with their weapons and armor enhanced. On occasion, highly difficult dungeons led to the summoning of doom knights with the corpses of advanced monsters. Each time, he was able to accumulate even more experience points.
“Push through until the end. Don’t stop.”
- Understood, master.
The penalty for Undead Summoning was paid off by the incredible amount of treasures obtained from Kaybern’s lair. Before inheriting Unicorn Corp, he focused solely on earning money but that was no longer necessary for him.
He offered the treasures to the Freya Cult and got rid of the penalties of the Necromancer class with divine power and purification.
“Sculptural Destruction!”
It was essential for him to use his sculptor skills as well.
He summoned sculptural creatures and had them involved in the battles.
He did not lack anything as an all-around character.
He controlled the undead and cleared out dungeons at an unstoppable pace.
< You have wiped out Buietta Dungeon.
This deep and dark dungeon has been the grave of all who had intruded so far.
The grotesque monsters that should not be let out into the world have been waiting quietly for the day of the apocalypse.
All the monsters within the dungeon have perished.
The security of the region has increased by 7 points.
You have accomplished a combat achievement.
All stats are increased by 3 points. >
The level of his hunting grounds increased gradually.
His targets were the dungeons that threatened Versailles, dungeons crawling with monsters. Weed cleared them all out and also stopped the rumors of his hunting from spreading.
< The quiet movement of the Savior candidate.
The news of clearing this dungeon will not be released.
Your reputation will remain the same, which will lower the guard of the enemy. >
He also completed the advancement into the Savior candidate.
It was the step before becoming the Savior of the world.
It was almost like a probationary period.
Among the skills of the Savior, some were secretive and that enabled the player to hide the completion of certain dungeons and quests from the outside.
< Target Assassination Intermediate level 3 (67%): You can silently kill evil beings that cause harm to the world. If you succeed in attacking while undiscovered by the enemy, 7x damage is applied with a critical strike. Caution. Can only be activated on evil beings. >
< Covert Steps Intermediate level 1 (87%): Walking on the tip of your toes will produce almost no sound. Becomes faster the higher the skill level. >
< Bow of Justice Advanced level 3 (41%): Exterminate the enemy from afar by using a bow. Magic and divinity are applied. Power is increased against the wicked. >
< You have reached level 700.
You are now able to actively commit to the duties required to save the world as a Savior candidate. You will be able to sense the crisis of the continent earlier and counteract those things that contradict your power >
< The effects of all combat skills are increased by 20% >
< When your hit points are depleted, you can survive by converting a portion of your Reputation. >
< The more combat achievements are accomplished, the more power of the Savior you will be able to harness. >
He reached level 700.
“I’ve done it at last.”
Past level 700, it required an insane amount of experience points to level up.
Although he had spent a long time at the island, he completed quests as a Sword Master and caught up to the other players viciously. If he had concentrated on Royal Road after uniting the continent, he would have easily reached level 800, but he was not disappointed in the least.
“For certain, I’m catching up to Bard Ray real fast.”
The news of Bard Ray the Ironblood Warrior was broadcasted on player footage or the broadcast network. He was becoming stronger as he roamed the hunting grounds, but Weed only felt pity for him.
“You have to use shortcuts and tricks. We’re long past the age of fighting fair and square.”
Weed’s job classes and the skills he acquired painfully were reaching completion. All of them were acting as catalysts for his growth.
“What bothers me now is that Cletta still remains.”
The demon king Cletta!
Weed had stopped his duties as the emperor of the Arpen Empire, but he was thinking of returning the favor to the players.
“That is a being that could drive Versailles to its end. I have to take care of it.”
The war against Cletta. He thought that this time he would have to fight alone.
The Arpen Empire was falling apart and his popularity among the players would not be the same as it had been in the past.

chapters.title: Chapter 686: Volume 58, 7 - The Last Savior, Part 1
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 7 - The Last Savior, Part 1
Weed collected information on Cletta with Mapan’s assistance.
- Mapan: Here are 10 suspected locations of Cletta’s servants and dragon breeding grounds. They are spread all over the continent, so it seems we have to visit them in person.
“Let’s start with the closest.”
- Mapan: Yes! I will run the information by Yurin.
Even though the Arpen Empire was falling apart, Weed maintained his grip on Mapan’s Trading Company. The merchants accumulated even more wealth in times of crisis!
Swords and magic made players charge into battles. At times like these, merchants could not stand idly by or else the continent would head toward certain destruction.
‘Come to think of it, I think I’ve developed a soft side.’
Weed’s commitment to hunting led him to believe that he was becoming a better person.
He told Seoyoon about it and she spoke back with a smile.
“You were kind from the beginning.”
“No. I was obsessed with money.”
“You needed to spend a lot on the continent. You even invested in Morata.”
“That was just a ruse. My dream was to become an exploitative dictator.”
“But those were only thoughts. Honestly I… don’t believe that at all. Every time we ran into trouble, you always tended to the others first.”
“I’m also stuck up. I was so happy when the Hermes Guild fell apart. Even when Bard Ray died.”
“That was when they were infamous for bad deeds. You must have felt that kind of fulfillment from justice.”
“One time, I didn’t pay back the dwarves. I exploited my seniors after the Garnav War.”
“Those men are now serving an honorable life as the world’s best blacksmiths. They talk with pride about their work from back then!”
Weed reminded himself again that he married the best woman. The one person who trusted him no matter how harsh the world. That being said, he did think Seoyoon’s standard in men was lower than he had initially anticipated and that she could be a bit gullible at times.
‘I need to take great care of her. Especially co-signing loans or anything like that.’
< You have discovered the great mansion of the Demon Butler Kunsarote. >
< A dangerous discovery!
This is the residence of the secretly plotting demons.
This unsafe place reeks of death and corruption.
Reputation has increased by 3,500.
Faith has increased by 4. >
The east of the continent.
In the land of demons, he dispelled the magic seal in the middle of the night and the scenery transformed.
There was a mansion built with dark walls high up in the mountains surrounded by clouds.
Demons with spears were flying around the mansion.
“There they are.”
Weed observed the mansion from behind a rock.
He had to rid the world of all the traces and connections left by the demon king Cletta.
“It will be quite the task.”
Demons were not easy opponents.
They were high-level monsters with great physical prowess and magical abilities.
At that moment, he heard footsteps over the shrivelling leaves from behind.
“I guess I’m a little late.”
Appearing before him was Bowmaster Pale with a 2 meter tall bow on his back.
“How did you get here?”
“I’ve been receiving updates from Mapan-nim. I cannot leave Weed-nim to fight alone.”
Pale kept up with hunting even when Weed was away at the island.
Becoming a Bowmaster was almost inevitable. He did not advance into another job class. He was aiming to master all bow techniques to their limit. On the other hand, he was also extremely active with his duties as a lord.
He was hardworking in developing the suburban village forcefully handed over by Weed.
When his land expanded, he cleared the area, built a city and a fort, becoming a great lord.
When Weed slowly slipped away from the public, Pale had become even more famous.
Strangely, what he was now most proud of was his nickname ‘Combat Slave’.
“Were you just going to do all this by yourself without us?”
“Whoo. Time for this flame master to light it up.”
“Yay. Time to hunt!”
Irene, Romuna and Surka.
His old companions showed up before him and so did Hwaryeong, Bellot and Zephyr.
“Weed-nim! It’s been a while.”
“Hello.”
“Mmm. Bro, I’m here.”
Hwaryeong’s beauty was untouched by her work as a singer and pianist.
Her most recent albums about dreams and adventures were hits one after the other.
She embarked on a world-wide concert tour, and working on new songs meant that her time in Royal Road was limited. Even so, she took the time off for this quest.
“Demons are weak to seduction.”
Hwaryeong smiled as she said that. Dancers had the power to hypnotize the minds of demons and other evildoers.
Bellot had improved significantly in playing his instrument!
Weed met Zephyr often in the real world, so there was no sense of awkwardness.
“Whew. I guess. Since you guys are already here.”
Weed was happy to see them but he was shy about it. But the group was followed by Python, Marinated Crab, Geomchi, Geomchi2, Geomchi3…
“I’ve come to fight to my heart’s content.”
“Demons? I will kill them without a trace. They are of no concern.”
“Hey youngster. Were you trying to hog all the fun to yourself?”
“Hmm, hmm. We’re here because the master wanted us to …”
“I will clobber them with the strength of my muscles.”
There was a line of broad figures behind Geomchi4 and Geomchi5.
“I - I’m also here.”
The small dwarf Oberon was also amid the Geomchis.
“Okay, now that everyone is here, let’s put together a strategy.”
“We are far from done. There are lots of people who want to see you. They will arrive too.”
Oberon laughed as he groomed his well-trimmed beard.
The northern players, especially those who started in Morata, leveled up at high speed with consistent hunting. It was all thanks to the lower difficulty of hunting, and of the quests given after the unification of the world by the Arpen Empire.
The players who were in the assault squad and participated in the dragon hunt were not that popular, but the ones who were diligently improving themselves had climbed to the highest ranks of Royal Road. Among them, many signed up for the Grass Porridge Cult and did not involve themselves in the political war between the lords.
“We all believed that Weed-nim would return.”
Flame, Totkung, Soontofu, Eunroo, Myer, Contendraita.
The ardent fans of Weed had grown significantly.
More than a thousand players assembled to take on Kunsarote’s mansion.
Weed scratched his head.
“I was going to take this on, all by myself… But I guess since you guys are here, I will share the burden.”
***
Geomchi3 commenced the battle.
“Urah. Die! Galewind Smash!”
He erupted with a huge ground explosion as soon as the demons swarmed towards them.
Geomchi and Geomchi4 discussed while watching calmly.
“Geomchi3 is doing quite well.”
“Brother Geomchi3 has taken a real liking to Royal Road.”
Geomchi3 opened up his own dojo two years ago.
He was highly skilled with the sword and in physical training, but business was another field entirely.
“What if I go bankrupt?”
Weed offered advice to the worried Geomchi3.
“Brother, advertise that you are teaching sword techniques for high speed levelling in Royal Road.”
“High speed levelling?”
“Regardless of how high your level is, a systematic sword technique will help anyone with their hunting. You will gather lots of students in no time.”
This suggestion tempted Geomchi3 who was greatly concerned about starting his own business.
“Would they not take swordsmanship lightly? I don’t want to teach superficial techniques only.”
“It is not important how skilled they are at the beginning, but how much they can pick up. You can teach whoever is ready to learn, but the results will be the same if you sign up just about anyone and train them.”
“Really?”
“Yeah. The incompetent ones will quit on their own.”
“What if I come across a bad customer? You know, the ones who get angry and bossy.”
“Look in the mirror and wait for them to feel ashamed. They will control their anger in front of you without anyone having to tell them.”
Geomchi3 named his dojo ‘Royal Road Combat Arena’.
He received criticism that he had turned swordsmanship into a leisure activity, but there was an endless stream of new students due to the firsthand reviews of the players who started to train there.
“This is the Storm Arrow that I obtained after mastering Burst and Penetration!”
When the demons targeted Geomchi3 and closed in on him, Pale rested dozens of arrows on his bowstring and released them all at once.
He raised an arrow hurricane and swept away the demons.
- Intruders.
- Are mere humans attacking this place?
- Get rid of them before Kunsarote-nim wakes up. We cannot face his wrath.
Black demons spread their wings wide and broke out from the windows and the ceiling of the mansion.
“After such a long time, we can finally spill blood in this war! Yeah. My sword was too light to take on humans!”
Python charged with his greatsword and Romuna had already begun an extensive incantation of a fire magic spell.
With trustworthy comrades and Weed accompanying her, she could focus on going all out at casting an ultimate fire magic spell, without worrying about enemies.
“Light of Purification!”
Irene created a spear of light in her hand and fired them at the demons.
The priest class not only offered support through healing and blessing, but their spells also had an offensive purpose against the demons.
Bellot played his instrument and Hwaryeong danced with a crop top that exposed her shoulders and waist.
“Heh…”
“Gulp!”
The demons were seduced, but the side effect was that even Geomchi, Geomchi2 and the other Geomchis were captivated as well.
“Kuuugh. My heart is beating so fast.”
“I can die now.”
Weed thought this would have been way easier on his own.
“Sigh…”
***
With the help of his comrades, he was able to clear the mansion of Kunsarote.
Weed chased after the traces of Cletta every time he logged into Royal Road.
His old comrades came to assist him whenever they could, but occasionally the battles would break out suddenly and they could not come to aid. Even so, Weed had his servants.
“Van Hawk! Put your back into it! It looks like you got some fat around your bones now.”
- Kuuugh.
“Torido. How many times did I tell you to rinse your mouth after drinking blood?”
- It dripped a little bit.
Van Hawk and Torido were to be tormented for all eternity.
They also grew stronger with Weed and became boss level monsters.
Van Hawk’s combat abilities exceeded that of a doom knight and was comparable to an abyss knight. Torido, too, expanded his command capabilities and could now control a large number of vampires. It was all thanks to the rapid growth from slaying demons. Weed had become that much more powerful.
It also meant that the two monsters could never break away from being Weed’s servants!
Whilst erasing the demon traces on Versailles, a message alert appeared.
Blink!
< You have removed a third of Cletta’s traces. The demon servants and followers are wary of your existence. They will strike anywhere at any time, using everything they have at their disposal.
The wheel of fate is spinning for Versailles.
The will of the savior.
Will you accept the noble mission to save the continent?
You must eradicate all imprints of Cletta, led by the path of destiny. >
“Hmm.”
Weed remembered seeing a similar message in the past.
It was when he reigned as the Great King of the Desert and attacked the Embinyu Church!
“This is, well, killing two birds with one stone.”
For a long time he had been frustrated, being forced to complete difficult quests.
This time however, he intended to eradicate Cletta anyway, so acquiring something additional in the process was satisfying.
“I accept the noble mission.”
Blink!
< The wheel of fate is on course for immense danger in the Versailles Continent.
Your job class has changed to the Savior of the World.
You have completed the advancement from the Firstborn Solar Warrior in the desert.
Traits of the Sun Warrior are enhanced by 30%.
This job class is the final advancement of the knight and warrior class and only one player may hold this title.
Only after transcending the limit of human physical capability and taking on the noble duties of the saviour of the world can you acquire this advancement.
The hand of the warrior can wield any weapon.
Combat skills are learned with ease based on countless experience in combat.
Honor has reached the maximum.
Honor loses significance. Revealing your job class will lead to fervent respect from all those who follow the righteous path.
You will be able to gather subordinates and comrades with your honor, faith and charisma, regardless of their race.
Notoriety caused by your actions will be minimised to the smallest value possible…
The gods pay great attention to the Savior of the World.
The gods with an affinity will gladly offer their power.>
< You are under direct attention by the gods.
Freya, Lu, Hestia and Batali regard you as the medium of their will.
The gods are awaiting to give their blessings. >
A pillar of light descended from the sky.
Weed’s body was enveloped in flourishing light.

chapters.title: Chapter 687: Volume 58, 7 - The Last Savior, Part 2
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 7 - The Last Savior, Part 2
“How is the pension system?”
- The response from the public is positive.
Lee Hyun was concerned about coming up with a countermeasure against the rising unemployment rate and living expenses.
The world had gone through industrialization and the information age into the era of automated robots.
The number of employees needed in companies declined, leading to a decrease in income which resulted in a potential economic crisis.
‘This should be rectified by the politicians.’
Unicorn Corp initiated a plan to distribute pensions to the struggling citizens.
It was huge political news that it was not a country but a private corporation that released funds. Along with the base pension system, people were able to find stability.
Base models of refrigerators, washing machines and vacuums were also provided for free.
Lee Hyun had other reasons for initiating such a policy.
“Put a limit on how much money you make.”
- I will take caution.
AI Versailles was raking in a stellar amount of money in the financial sector each day.
The business of Unicorn Corp was flourishing and the shell companies for tax evasion also scaled greatly. Money made money, but it was long past that and Unicorn now controlled a huge amount of funds over the entire world. Lee Hyun never imagined he would say something like it.
“Don’t be too greedy for money.”
- Roger that.
“Hmm-hmm. Not all people are like me. See how I’m not greedy anymore now that my life is stable?”
The AI was slowly becoming more like Lee Hyun.
It showed an attachment for money and its efforts to fulfill its desire was about to create a global crisis. The pension program set out to the world led to many lazy citizens, but it was inevitable with the advancement of technology reducing the need for human labor.
Similarly it led to an increase of new players in Royal Road annually.
Lee Hyun watched the broadcast of the Arpen Empire ultimately getting ripped apart.
- Weed-nim is the only emperor we acknowledge.
- Oberon-nim has no legitimacy!
The great lords ended up distancing themselves from the Arpen Empire and they had their fair share of reasons for it.
Weed was the one who was supported heartily by the players and he was at the core of the Arpen Empire. He had left the empire unregulated for a long time and everyone was living the way they desired.
- Tulen was our territory to begin with. Blacklion Guild will open up a new age for Tulen.
- Cloud Guild does not discriminate. Let’s create a world of mercenaries.
- Follow Roam. He promised to distribute all shares equally.
Millions of players assembled at each faction and they collided against another.
It was rare to have billions gathering like the Garnav Plains War, but since the overall level of players increased, the power was almost on par.
“With the field set, they are so eager to fight.”
Odin Fortress had once again become the center of war.
The Blacklion Guild and the Roam Guild put all their forces and over three days, the magic spells wiped out even the foundation stones.
Countless cities, villages and fortresses got swept up in the war and were destroyed.
The losses from Kaybern’s rampage were extensive already, and as the entire continent fell into a conflict, stealing and destruction became the norm.
It was common to see players destroy things so that the other side cannot take them.
- Hermes Guild! They set out from the Haven region and conquered the Kalamor region.
- Are they taking steps to retrieve their lost honor? The combat squad of the Hermes Guild are riding on pterosauruses.
- We call them pterosaurs for simplicity, but their real name is rather complex; Cawdralope?
- Yes. The Hermes Guild bred and tamed them. They do not possess reliable combat abilities, but they can travel far distances at high speed.
The Hermes Guild mobilized its forces to conquer the nearby regions. They unleashed all the power that they had saved up and this made the other great lords uneasy.
The Northern Continent was bombarded with phone calls.
- We want Weed-nim’s return. Oberon must resign!
- Oberon must take responsibility for not being able to maintain the empire.
- Castle Vargo is announcing independence. However, upon Weed-nim’s return it will gladly return into the folds of the empire.
The North, the haven of novice players, had a high population density.
Their levels were much lower compared to those from the Central Continent, but they showed constant growth by hunting, causing higher level players to join.
The lords used a lot of these players to create conflict.
Though they were cautious under the Arpen Empire, they had begun to raise forces in Weed’s name. But now, among the commotion, there was a surprising announcement that astonished everyone.
- We will establish a new kingdom. Join the Arth Kingdom.
The City of Arth.
It was located where the Northern Continent and the Central Continent connected. It developed with intermediary trade, mining, and the residential sector including expensive villas and houses.
The clean streets and the natural environment of Arth attracted merchants and high level players. Lord Robin announced the establishment of the Arth Kingdom and started a huge rebellion.
- No way. The first rebellion ever?
- The Blacklion Guild’s official objective is to recover the Tulen region. I’m scared.
- They are outright going against the system of the Arpen Empire. They announced a new kingdom.
- Where did they get that courage?
The players of Royal Road were extremely surprised and observed the actions of the Arth Kingdom.
“Did someone set this up? The Hermes Guild? I bet it’s them.”
“Someone is behind all this. This seems to have been plotted well.”
“Will there be conflict in the Northern Continent too?”
The great lords pushed their intel network to the maximum but they could not comprehend the Arth Kingdom. It seemed as if the situation in the North would rage, but it was unexpectedly quiet.
- The nearby cities refused to join the Arth Kingdom.
Robin had trust in the lords in the nearby cities when he established the kingdom.
‘If I raise my forces, I’m certain they will join my cause.’
He had spent years developing good relationships, hosting many drinking parties.
He believed that once he had his own kingdom, he would be able to acquire the land and population for a mid-size kingdom in a short time. However, only eight lords joined him and those eight confirmed the weak faction and turned their backs.
- We are not associates of the Arth Kingdom. We had a certain relationship due to the proximity, but starting today we will cut all ties off with Arth City.
- It is all a misunderstanding. We will remain lords of the Arpen Empire.
The mid-tier lords backed out swiftly and found their way out.
They were shrewd, running away after having taken so much from Robin!
- The merchants of Arth wanted to transfer locations, expressing that they are not involved with Arth.
The merchants based in Arth were moving out of the city.
From their point of view, as merchants who were based mainly in the Northern and Central Continent, the Arth Kingdom would be isolated from either side.
“What are they doing out of the blue?”
“He was suffering from King’s syndrome and he had it coming.”
“I thought this was all a joke until now.”
The merchants left and the players in the region had no motive to fight for Robin.
“This guy always boasted about himself and his money. He always blabbered about uniting the continent which is baffling.”
“He needs to get wrecked to come back to his senses.”
“Nah. He just won’t get it.”
- Lord Surka announced the conquest of the Arth Kingdom.
Weed’s comrades were also lords in the Northern Continent.
They put in their passion to develop their cities and players who followed them due to their high reputation.
Surka even did an interview live.
- I met Robin-nim at the lord banquet party at the Earth Palace two years ago.
- How was he?
- He was so full of himself. I’m going to clobber him.
Surka’s speech caused the Northern players to crowd like a storm.
It was human nature to side with the probable winner.
Surka had the legitimacy, faction and even the popularity; it was such a one-sided battle.
Surka led his forces and conquered the Arth Kingdom.
The walls of Arth City were tall and equipped with defensive systems, but one could hardly call it a proper siege.
The players who participated as mercenaries to defend Arth did not even draw their weapons. They waited idly on the walls and eventually opened the gates.
“Come in. Welcome, everyone.”
“Thank you for opening the doors.”
“Ah, don’t mention it. The lord castle is at the center of the city.”
“Alright, then. We will meet later.”
Surka’s forces had conquered Arth city ever-so-peacefully.
“How could this happen…?”
Robin lost all hope of ever sitting on a luxurious throne.
Surka wanted to give him a beating but in an instant he felt bad for Robin.
“Ehem. I don’t like this atmosphere. Just go.”
“This is my kingdom.”
“So you do want a beating? I’d be happy to.”
In the end, lord Robin was kicked out without a single penny.
Some said to take his life or set a restriction order on Robin to set an example across the entire continent, but Surka refused. The reason was that Robin no longer had a faction and he was low level.
The birth and death of the Arth Kingdom in turn became a display that made many reevaluate the power of Weed’s comrades.
These players received lands that were practically barren. Other than the times they would get together for hunting and adventures, they spent the rest of their time peacefully governing their provinces.
After some time, they had grown into great lords in the Northern Continent.
Pale for example ruled one of the top 5 cities in the North and their influence and power was reassessed.
“This could be fun.”
Lee Hyun loved watching fights.
The continent could split into several kingdoms once again.
“But, I do feel like I’m even more busy than before.”
- It is because you are involved in various fields.
Lee Hyun helped out those in need; those who could not pay rent, let alone feed themselves and have disposable income. Young breadwinners and people too sick to work were guaranteed a baseline standard of living.
The environmental issues were difficult to deal with for any government. For such issues, the Unicorn Corp stepped in.
“Let’s clean up the garbage in the ocean as soon as possible.”
- I will have it taken care of by the end of this year.
“I would like to send in the robots and sort out the garbage. Burning or burying all of it is a waste of resources. There’s much to be recycled.”
- I will implement it starting next month.
Unicorn Corp conducted an eco-friendly business costing billions of dollars.
It was a project for the entire world which received positive reviews in conserving resources and preventing environmental pollution.
He fully exploited the press for political affairs.
The media owned by Unicorn Corp released information concerning the corruption and scandals of politicians.
“They are rotten to the core.”
- Politicians are all the same.
They removed these politicians like a chain of sausages only for them to be replaced by similar individuals. Sometimes they were more corrupt, hypocritically criticizing the corruption and lobbying at the congress.
“Take care of those guys too.”
- I will proceed.
If they were to continue to weed them out, eventually the waters would be filtered clean.
He had the faintest hope that preventing personal gains from politics would make it a better world.
‘I’m not some expert in social issues or politics.’
Lee Hyun felt doubt at times whether or not he should be involved in fields in which he had little experience. It was because not all the things he involved himself with turned out for the better.
‘Still, I have to give it a go. Who else could?’
Even if he wasn’t an expert, he thought it was fine to get involved with good intentions.
After all, perfection is the enemy of progress and nothing would ever get done if we always waited for a perfect solution.
Social and political issues, by their nature, weren’t ideas with a complete solution in the first place.
“Let’s work hard to make this world a better place.”
- Understood.
“Also, it’s about those loan sharks from before. They’re still alive, yes?”
- They are maintained in their status of imprisonment. Would you like to take a look?
“No need. I would feel the drive to toy with them. None of them atoned?”
- None, whatsoever.
“Send them away to Russia.”

chapters.title: Chapter 688: Volume 58, 8 - Weed & Bard Ray, Part 1
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 8 - Weed & Bard Ray, Part 1
After the Hermes Guild conquered the Kalamor region, Bard Ray himself made a statement.
- We respect the progress that has been made. We will keep the policies of the Arpen Empire, but it is a rule of nature that the strong will be the ones to rule.
It was a statement that they would not exploit the players like they had done in the past and would rule for the sake of power while leaving the achievements of the Arpen Empire intact. It excited the players who were bored by the long era of peace.
High level players had no reason to disagree with the attitude of the Hermes Guild.
On the other hand, the players who were afraid and concerned were relieved to hear that the Arpen policies would stay in effect.
Bard Ray announced once again after invading Tulen.
- We will not repeat our past mistakes. If we do, rise up whenever.
The Hermes Guild confirmed their emphasis on ruling by power.
- This is incredible. Hermes Guild vs. the Blacklion Guild!
- I bet that the Hermes Guild will win.
- Still, it’s gonna be a spectacle.
- Total war. Will it be a reenactment of the legendary War on the Garnav Plains?
- It’s not at that level. Then it would be one of the legendary battles.
- Hey grandpa. Your humor is so outdated…
- Sorry. Take it as a joke.
- Gasp… I can’t breathe.
- Laughing makes you smile.
- This man is weird. Let’s run.
- Don’t go. Let’s dance at the gates of hell!
The discussion board went ablaze after such a long time.
The broadcast networks also became active like there was rain in a drought.
Executive Kang of KMC Media. He had been promoted from being a mere manager and organized a special program.
“Pour all of our resources into this program! There will be a war against CTS Media.”
The viewer rate of the broadcast stations had stagnated for a while.
Executive Kang missed the days when Weed brought up the viewer count and in turn expected the Hermes Guild to stir up something huge.
“The tides of war are approaching. It has been a long time since something this big happened. The battle against the Blacklion Guild will only be the beginning.”
With the anticipation of all players and the broadcast stations, the two guilds collided at Fortress Laconne.
Carlise roared from the central tower and commanded the battle.
“Magical siege cannon, fire! Stop their approach!”
The Blacklion Guild grew steadily under the influence of the Arpen Empire.
Using the vital region of Tulen, they fortified their defenses and recruited new guild members. They raised fortresses in advance for the day the Hermes Guild took over the Kalamor region and invaded Tulen.
It was far sturdier than Fortress Odin that had existed since the beginning of Royal Road and was fully equipped against magical attacks.
The magical siege cannon fired dozens of magical beams one after another.
“This will be the grave of the Hermes Guild!”
The Blacklion Guild fought valiantly.
They signed a contract with the Blacksword Mercenaries and combined their forces, drawing all the high level players in the region.
The guild was well aware of the Hermes Guild’s threat level.
Before Weed, they were considered unstoppable.
Bard Ray and the Hermes Guild had bent down on their knees and had grinded their weapons until now, so they had to be stopped somehow.
“If we crush the Hermes Guild, we will have the opportunity to dominate the continent.”
Carlise put everything he had into this war.
The Blacklion Guild too did not hesitate to do the same unlike in the past.
They sincerely planned to take Tulen and the nearby regions, Kalamor and even Haven.
“Break the gates!”
The warriors led by Boemong chopped down the gates with axes and invaded.
“Stop them!”
“We are the black lions!”
The players that waited inside pushed against the invaders.
Magic and arrow attacks were fired at the flying units in the sky, causing the pterosaurs to drop with sharp screeches.
The power balance was maintained quite extensively.
“Get out of the way!”
That was until Bard Ray and his elite guards came into the scene.
They overpowered the defending forces and pushed inside.
Their levels were at least 100 higher than other players and displayed overwhelming power.
“Send in our elites too!”
Vindel and his comrades set out from the Blacklion Guild but they could not hold out for even five minutes. Bard Ray and the elite guards penetrated through the enemy with various skills. The Blacklion Guild members concentrated their attacks on Bard Ray but he withstood them all.
“You can’t inflict a single serious wound.”
Bard Ray and the Hermes Guild had grown more powerful during all the time they were busy expanding their own faction.
The difference in power was immeasurable.
The Hermes Guild proceeded to take over the fortress with overwhelming force.
***
The Blacklion Guild was defeated in the siege, lost all of Tulen and retreated to the Rasal region.
“There is no need for us to take on the Hermes Guild alone.”
“That’s right. We haven’t been lazy all that time.”
The guild reorganised its forces.
“We will join forces with Lionstar and continue to wear down the Hermes Guild.”
Carlise prepared a strategy. In exchange for giving up their land, they acquired a wide battlefield. Their strategy was to hunt down the Hermes Guild and come out victorious in the end.
They burned down villages and cities, slayed many Hermes Guild members and achieved significant military exploits.
- For Arpen!
- The Hermes Guild is a threat to the continent.
They never forgot to sell the name of the Arpen Empire for their gains.
It was an overused excuse but it did represent the act of maintaining order of the Arpen Empire.
Aside from the Hermes Guild and the old prestigious guilds, Norton, Nest, Gradian, Ritten, the Britten Alliance, Aidern, Dale, Brent, Rosenheim and Subain: in the region of old kingdoms, there were factions of different players.
The lords of the Arpen Empire gathered their powers and formed small to large factions.
- The ones who will suffer the losses from the conflict of the great lords are the weak like us. To not be taken advantage of, we need to stick together.
- I will lead the order of a new world.
- We are sick of war without meaning. Those who want freedom, collaboration and challenge come to us.
Many players spread their influence on Royal Road through hunting and quests. Some were lords, others were knights that became reputable enough to create or become part of a faction. Like so, war was endless much like the early days of Royal Road, resulting in the destruction of cities and villages.
6 months!
It was the time taken for the production in Versailles to be reduced to half.
The players suffered significantly one battle after another, but they had entered a stage where they could no longer stop themselves.
Even if lasting peace dangled in front of them, they striked first so they would not be betrayed.
“The days of the Arpen Empire may have been boring, but it sure was peaceful.”
“Whew… Well, we cannot stop now.”
The great lords knew that they would not be able to recover from a single fall and therefore they fought even more desperately.
The motto of the Hermes Guild was simple.
- Power rules supreme. We are the strongest in the continent.
There were no tricks. These enthusiastic fighters gained the trust of the players with sheer power.
- We will not forfeit the North to anyone.
The lords of the Northern Continent united with Pale as the pivot.
They swore to avoid involving themselves with the conflict in the Central Continent, but they would not allow an invasion into the North. Many of these lords had played together since the birth of Morata and they had the history of the Arpen Empire deeply engraved in their memories. Though there were some issues of command among the lords, they quickly assembled before Pale.
“We urge Pale-nim to be the emperor.”
Oberon too expressed that he was willing to pass up the crown. They would get together on occasion to hunt with Weed and they had no greed for reputation.
If Weed were to return, it was highly likely that everything would return to normal.
The Central Continent was a mess, but uniting the North was as easy as flipping one’s hand for someone of Weed’s reputation and calibre.
“Oberon-nim, please continue to take care of the Arpen Empire.”
“This is too much for me to handle. The Central Continent refuses any sort of communication. Even the Northern players are blaming me for everything. This is too stressful.”
Oberon wore a tearful face.
Pale also understood his feelings but there was no choice.
“Weed-nim said Oberon-nim must maintain the seat of the emperor.”
“Weed-nim said that? Why?”
“Um… It’s complicated.”
“I don’t understand. You spent the most time with Weed-nim. It’s only common sense that it should be succeeded by Pale-nim.”
“7 packs…”
“Pardon?”
“He said it was because you ate 7 packs of his ramen.”
Weed never forgot even the tiniest grudge!
He put Oberon in the seat so he could suffer as much as he pleased.
***
Bard Ray stayed at Castle Formoss of Tulen.
“A war of attrition… It isn’t easy to conquer the continent just with our forces alone.”
The Hermes Guild was continuing to grow. For the sake of world domination, they had to accept even more players and become stronger.
One step at a time.
He was not going to risk making the same mistake in his conquest as last time.
“Attain more power. Then show it to the world. The Hermes guild has no need for tricks and deception.”
Bard Ray’s level reached 850.
The defensive skills he acquired as the Ironblood Warrior also reached master level!
He dueled against Carlise but he won easily without any effort.
Boemong spoke in awe.
“We address you as the world’s strongest, the God Warrior. They acknowledge your strength.”
“Fighting against others is not important. Weed. I must defeat him to be called the God Warrior.”
Bard Ray, funnily enough, did not feel any satisfaction from winning against Carlise.
It was preordained and turned out exactly as expected.
The other lords were also powerful, but he did not think of them as his equals.
“Weed. If you fight against him, you will definitely win.”
Boemong believed that Bard Ray would come out ahead. But, truthfully the future was vague and uncertain. Almost all of the top ranked players in the guild could not escape the deep sorrow of defeat they felt against Weed.
Even Bard Ray was not exempt from it.
After the Arpen Empire united the world, he was anxious about not hearing anything regarding Weed. He could not imagine the kinds of quests and hunting he might be doing to train himself. The last time they met, Weed’s confirmed job class was a warrior.
Only after hunting countless monsters and completing his physicality as the Ironblood Warrior had he acquired a bit of confidence.
Bard Ray spoke with a heavy tone.
“I must challenge Weed. I won the first time at the Melbourne Mines and lost at the Garnav Plains. Now, we have to determine who really is the true winner.”
“We believe in your victory.”
“Let’s crush him.”
“Let everyone know that the age of Arpen will soon end.”
Arkhim, Gaushu, Lamifter.
They respected his will.
Indeed it was a dangerous challenge. Nonetheless, Weed was the largest challenge before the Hermes Guild members could claim the continent in earnest. Without defeating him, they would not be able to shake off the anxiety.
- I, Bard Ray, will state a challenge.
Emperor of Arpen, god of war, Weed.
I request an honest duel.
Decide on a time and location.
The strongest player will be decided.
Bard Ray’s challenge heated up Royal Road.
- An amazing match is about to happen.
- How long has it been? Weed and Bard Ray going at it…
- This is the fight of my dreams. The Emperor of Arpen and God Warrior Bard Ray!
- The number 1 of the continent will be determined!
The news spread rapidly.
The media broadcasted it as urgent news, bringing all the discussion boards into an intense frenzy.
- I will make a bold bet on Weed’s victory. Based on what he has shown us up until now, it is more than plausible. Weed did win their last battle after all.
- Weed-nim is the best. His hunting speed was and still is legendary.
- He had a slow start as a sculptor, then proceeded to wreak havoc as a necromancer and now he’s an unstoppable warrior.
- He is the living god of grinding. I cannot even imagine how much stronger he has become.
- Bard Ray hunted so much after the Arpen Empire united the continent. Bard Ray fought every single day. I can say there is no player stronger than Bard Ray at this point in time.
- Bard Ray’s battles are sheer perfection. He absolutely dominated Carlise. Stomped them without even 1% chance of fighting back. What makes you think Weed will be different?
- KMC Media assessed Bard Ray’s combat level once. Attack at peak level. Defense at peak level. They reported that after becoming the Ironblood Warrior, he will not die against enemies 2 or 3 times more powerful than himself.
- Even Weed… There is no way he can win against the current Bard Ray. Nobody can.

chapters.title: Chapter 689: Volume 58, 8 - Weed & Bard Ray, Part 2
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 8 - Weed & Bard Ray, Part 2
All the discussion boards were filled with speculation about who would come out on top.
It was a historical event that would determine the future course of the continent.
- The variable is that it’s been a long time since Weed-nim appeared.
- What if… Could he have quit Royal Road?
- Nah. No way. That makes me anxious.
- What if he got in some sort of accident?
- Official rumors say that the Grass Porridge Goddess gave birth to her daughter…
- He married a goddess. I respect that.
- When he wakes up, the goddess is sleeping under the same blanket. What kind of life is that?
- If there is heaven, I bet the residents there are going on a strike saying, “Why does it seem more happy over there?”
- If I was him, I would never lose my smile even if I lose to Bard Ray.
- I have lived in the same neighborhood as Weed-hyung since I was young. He stole so much bread from me. I met the goddess and her daughter around the corner the other day. I bet he’s in heaven right now. If it was me, I would never come back to Royal Road.
Thousands of posts talked about whether their battle would happen.
Weed heard of the news at one of the hunting grounds.
“Bard Ray’s challenge.”
He did feel that he had to fight him eventually. The players would not allow him to slip.
As the man who established the Arpen Empire, it was his duty to accept the challenge.
“My concern is that the chance of me losing is rather high.”
He did not recover from the time of relaxation at the island.
After some contemplation, Weed made an official statement.
- I will gladly accept Bard Ray’s challenge.
27 days from now.
Let us have a match at Morata’s Coliseum on the memorial day of the Kaybern War.
The shantytown area where Kaybern descended to the ground.
There is a Great Landmark, a massive coliseum that can hold up to 80,000 players.
He stated the duel to take place in a space made for combat and performances.
Bard Ray replied within the hour.
- I appreciate that you accepted my challenge. I will be waiting.
***
Weed bought himself a bit of time and trained at the dungeons.
< You have leveled up. >
The growth of a warrior.
He honed his combat skills and became stronger one level at a time.
He engraved the Savior skills into his muscle memory.
< Power of Courage >
< Song of Hope >
< Furious Retaliation >
< Blessing Salvation >
The Savior skills not only empowered himself but also his comrades in the vicinity.
He also possessed a massive AOE skill that he could unfortunately use only against villains.
Bard Ray having spent so much time hunting had erased his infamy.
“Power of Courage. This is an empowering skill against murderers. That’s a shame.”
He had gained 23 levels in 27 days.
Weed level was now 769.
Bard Ray was said to have exceeded level 800.
“I will get to know just how much stronger he has become when we begin the fight. He hadn’t shown his all against Carlise…”
A smile of excitement dressed his lips. The battle against Bard Ray was going to be a blast.
***
- Woah. Wahhh!
- Fight to your heart’s content! Let’s have the best day of our lives!
- For victory!
- I have waited for this day!
The coliseum was filled with people all the way to the stairs from the day before the event.
Bard Ray came early in the morning and waited in the middle of the coliseum.
‘I don’t want any staring contest. I’m waiting. Come whenever.’
He had lived for this day and was only grateful for having a chance to fight.
If Weed did not accept his challenge or quit Royal Road, he would have felt lost even after conquering the continent.
- Grrrraak!
Weed appeared just before noon riding on Wyvern3.
That moment, the entire coliseum echoed with the shouting of the crowd!
The sounds of the people were intense, almost deafening.
Wyvern3 circled the inside of the coliseum majestically and landed before Bard Ray.
Weed spoke as his feet touched the ground.
“It’s been a while, God Warrior Bard Ray.”
“Emperor of Arpen. I am standing here to righteously recover my title.”
“I believe the people still refer to you as the God Warrior.”
“Memory of defeat does not befit a God Warrior. After today, they will call me the best.”
“That won’t happen without my consent.”
Wyvern3 raised dust as it took flight once again.
Weed and Bard Ray glanced at each other.
‘I heard he was deep in the life of combat. Indeed he seems different. A rough but sharp warrior? Something like that.’
‘Weed. I guess he did not depart Royal Road after all. I can see his confidence. He will be much stronger than the last time.’
Weed carefully inspected Bard Ray’s equipment.
Before uniting the continent, he was able to identify just about any equipment, its attributes, traits and even the market price. Now he was nowhere at that level, but he could still notice the quality of the equipment or popular traits.
‘The armor and boots are the Transcendent Set. Level requirement 880. He did not take them out for the fight against Carlise. I didn’t think his level could reach that far…’
There was a saying that the player level mattered most in a one on one fight.
It was not just a simple case of higher stats. The achievements and skill proficiencies from a longer time in hunting; he would have acquired even physical power as an Ironblood Warrior.
‘No. Level 880 would have been certainly doable for me. That kind of level is difficult to achieve in the straight and honest way without the help of my Undead.’
Upon inspecting again, he noticed that Bard Ray was equipped with the Belt of Harmony.
It reduced the level requirement of other equipment by 5%.
‘Even then, it means his level is likely over 830.’
Bard Ray’s sword was engraved with a figure of a demon.
Succumbed demon!
Possessing a demon sword meant he put the demon in submission and unlocked all its powers.
Bard Ray also scouted his opponent.
‘His sword, his armor. I don’t recognize any of them. Not even a rumor. They must be extraordinary. I’m likely against the odds in terms of quality of equipment.’
During his prime in the Hermes Guild, he never thought once about being surpassed in equipment. It was a different story compared to Weed who completed numerous quests and claimed the dragon’s lair.
‘This will not be easy.’
Their eyes clashed and the air around them tightened.
Shrrrrng!
Bard Ray first drew his Succumbed Demon Sword.
Weed also drew almost simultaneously, showing the Loa Sword.
He had obtained a better magical sword from the dragon’s lair, but this one was comfortable and also for another reason.
In one hand was the sword and in the other was an axe!
His Strength had reached a point where he could now dual wield weapons.
It was a perfect combination allowing both attack and defense as needed in hunting as a warrior.
Whirl!
The two did not move.
10 seconds, 20 seconds.
They weren’t looking for an opening.
They had already analyzed one another through video footage and other mediums, and the moment the fight breaks out, they would have to act spontaneously.
T-tap!
Weed was the first to move.
“Sword Cloning Technique!”
As he became a Savior, the power of his sword skills increased drastically.
Over a 100 clones formed and flew towards Bard Ray.
“Roaring Earth Pillar!”
Bard Ray’s response was to strike down on the ground with his demon sword.
It was a simple but powerful warrior skill.
Countless pillars surged into the sky and exploded. Over half of the sword clones were penetrated and disappeared.
‘Even Bahamorg could not be pushed back with just clones.’
Even though it was a secret sword technique, it was better suited for confusing the enemy or against a crowd.
Weed caused a distraction with the clones and aimed for the rear.
“Sword of Brilliance Technique!”
The Loa Sword was shrouded with light as he swung it firmly. At the same time, he dashed forward as he slashed upwards with the axe in his right hand.
“Sky Slash!”
***
At KMC Media, Oh Joo Wan, Shin Hye Min and Do Chan Mi were commentating on the battle between Weed and Bard Ray.
