- Weed is the first to be on the offensive. He starts with his Sword Cloning Technique!
- It is a secret sword technique. Much more powerful than those used by the average player…
- Bard Ray is also retaliating with a massive skill of his own!
The commentators brought up the heat right from the beginning.
A battle between Weed and Bard Ray was difficult to predict even with their experience and they could not turn their eyes away even for a second with all the viewers watching the event.
- Weed caught Bard Ray’s rear. Sword attack… No. He also strikes with his axe. He is attacking with both hands.
- Bard Ray swings backwards and deflects the attack. He took some damage, but it doesn’t seem that deep.
The screen showed Bard Ray kick off the ground and pounce right back.Clang-clang-clang!
Bard Ray’s sword was stopped by Weed’s defense.
Weed turned away most of the attacks with the Loa Sword and offset Bard Ray’s balance.
Swaaash!
With each opening, the axe came down fiercely to destroy its enemy!
- This is insane. He has mastered the sword and axe. It is already hard using just one, but he is using them in combination!
- It looks like Weed is dominating in weapon mastery.
- Incredible. Controlling the distance and executing each movement perfectly is truly breath-taking like a storm.
Oh Joo Wan was fervently watching the stream.
There were many occasions where he was too bored from talking about the Continent of Magic.
After the dragon incident, not too many worthy events occurred and he had never seen such a spectacular match before.
Weed executed a flurry of 100 consecutive attacks and backed away.
‘His defense is high.’
Some irregular attacks did succeed.
The Loa Sword and the Dragonslayer Axe hammered Bard Ray’s body but did not have any effect.
‘It’s like the weapons are just bouncing off. It feels like I’m knocking on a wall of steel.’
Bard Ray was an Ironblood Warrior even back when he fought against Kaybern and acquired the skill Dragon Skin as a combat achievement.
It had reached the master level and even without armor, his base defense was outstanding.
‘It will be tricky to deal with.’
Weed felt with the early trade that his opponent was tough. In turn, it meant that the fight would be even more enjoyable.
- Wow!
- You’re the best, Weed-nim!
- Bard Ray fights well. Indeed he is the God Warrior!
- Awesome. This really is the duel between the God of War and the God Warrior.
The colosseum was occupied by the shouting of the spectators.
Weed and Bard Ray on the other hand had no attention to spare for their surroundings.
< The Ironblood Body trait recovers from wounds on its own.
2,863 health points will be recovered per second. >
Bard Ray did lose on the early exchange. Though it was coupled with combat skills, it was a trade of basic weapon mastery.
‘Weed. His sword technique may be extraordinary, but so is mine. I continued to train by slaying monsters.’
Bard Ray never once was pushed back by anything.
No matter how bloody the fight, he always pulled through on his job.
He fought without being intimidated against powerful and dangerous monsters and after becoming an Ironblood Warrior, he lost any hesitance.
He believed there was no end to the improvement of his combat skills and he proved it in the fight against Carlise, but it wasn’t enough against Weed.
‘He prepared a special strategy. Dual wielding sword and axe. He is a tough opponent with just his sword.’
After the face-off, he felt he was beyond wielding the two weapons. Weed cut his rhythm with the sword and axe, limiting Bard Ray’s movements and seemed to act as if he was reading his mind.
‘To see that he is capable of such weapon mastery.’
This was on another level compared to when he copied the singularity attack.
‘His attacks make my body numb.’
He was shocked mentally but not to the degree that it would affect his performance.
He learned how to fight against monsters more powerful than himself.
Similarly, Weed’s overall combat abilities did not exceed his own.
‘I can see that he boosted Strength with Sculptural Destruction. Each light swing is a heavy blow. Still, my physical ability is superior.’
The transcendent level of defense and the combat achievements and stats he accumulated proved it.
‘I am at the pinnacle of warriors. I beat more competitors than I can count since the start of Royal Road.’
Bard Ray’s eyes lit up.
Weed realized too that his opponent would not be intimidated so easily.
‘His eyes seem like he considers me prey.’
He had planned to take the lead by dual wielding, but it had little effect.
‘I spent over two months practicing it.’

chapters.title: Chapter 690: Volume 58, 8 - Weed & Bard Ray, Part 3
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 8 - Weed & Bard Ray, Part 3
Weed and Bard Ray gathered their breath, their eyes locked on the opponent.
They had completely recovered from the damage they inflicted on one another.
“…”
“…”
Bard Ray had no intentions of striking first.
He had mastered the Black Knight class and reached the pinnacle in physical stats as an Ironblood Warrior.
He aimed to take Weed’s best attacks straight on and overcome them.
‘Try all you want. I will prove that no tricks can win against me.’
Bard Ray always pursued one goal, perfection in power. He wanted to show to the world that he did not get an edge just for this fight, but had achieved a level of everlasting dominance.
‘I have to go in closer again.’
Weed saw through it but was not going to avoid a confrontation.
‘Ironblood Warrior… It would be challenging to break but there is no such thing as absolute defense.’
***
Geumchi was sitting among the crowd along with the apprentices.
“Like always, our youngest was born with senses.”
“Yup. Using two weapons like that.”
Geumchi2 also made a compliment.
Seeing Weed and Bard Ray clash brought them a sense of awe.
“Many think that the axe is an easy weapon to wield… That’s when you’re swinging it around with pure strength alone. Maximizing the attack power with pinpoint strikes is the difficult thing to pull off.”
“You’re right. Balance and pivoting have to be consistent. On top of that, he restrains the opponent’s movement with his sword, which is impossible without natural talent no matter how much you train.”
Even just theoretically, it was a vigorous level of mastery!
They casually observed the battle.
“He can defend against Weed pretty well.”
“He does not lose composure. He far exceeds the level of typical players.”
Watching fights was indeed exciting.
Geumchi3 sighed deeply as if he was disappointed.
“Bard Ray. I should have been the one to pummel him.”
“Hey third, you’ve met him before?”
“Yes, master. I did one time. I fought well but I lost.”
He was outscaled in level, skill and equipment, and it was more than reasonable for him to have lost. Geumchi3 was still disappointed in how he was never able to penetrate through Bard Ray’s defense.
Geumchi4 and Geumchi5 were astonished.
“You lost?”
“Then isn’t our youngest in trouble too? The shock would be immense if he were to lose in front of all these people.”
Geumchi3 shook his head.
“Youngest is different from us. He hasn’t even started yet. You all know why the master likes him.”
Everyone witnessed how the youngest learned the sword at the dojo.
At first, in their eyes, Weed was an amateur in both skills and stamina.
Simply put, he was a weakling!
However, all of that changed once he got fired up from fighting a strong opponent.
He pulled all sorts of tactics and unleashed his abilities.
Whenever he charged with a huge grin on his face, even the instructors had to be on alert.
“There is nothing scarier than fighting against someone unpredictable. On top of that, he has talent and meticulously finds the smallest opening.”
***
Weed put on the Dimensional Portal Gloves.
Then on, he started to see portals for short travels.
‘If you’re all about defense, I’m going in.’
Weed kicked off then quickly passed through a portal. He changed locations by travelling through space, but Bard Ray’s eyes caught up instantly.
‘As I thought, this won’t do. Then what if I use an old strategy? I gotta try it out.’
Weed activated the Final Secret Sculpting Technique.
“Moment Sculpting!”
It was a skill that paused the world.
He had a surplus of time energy stored for all that time he did not have to activate it.
He circled behind Bard Ray and swung the Loa Sword.
“Heraim Sword Technique!”
< The 1st consecutive attack succeeded.
Agility has increased by 20%.>
< The 2nd consecutive attack succeeded.
Strength has increased by 40%.>
< The 3rd consecutive attack succeeded.
Agility has increased by an additional 40%.>
< The 2nd consecutive attack succeeded.
Strength has increased by an additional 40%.>
Four attacks landed after another.
This method was how he was victorious at the Garnav Plains.
‘Back then, this was the breadwinner.’
He predicted the opponent’s movement and landed 29 consecutive attacks for the win.
It was an instance, but there was no other option.
There was only one window of opportunity provided by Moment Sculpting which had fortunately succeeded. If the battle extended even just a little, he would not have prevailed.
Once Bard Ray swung around, he activated the Moment Sculpting Technique again and reversed positions.
< The 5th consecutive attack succeeded.
Heavy blow.
Agility has increased by an additional 30%.>
< The 6th consecutive attack succeeded.
Strength has increased by an additional 50%. The splash damage from the shockwave deals 15% of attack power.>
< The 7th consecutive attack succeeded.
Agility has increased by an additional 30%.
Strength has increased by an additional 20%.
< You have consumed 1500 mana, inflicting ranged attacks. >
7 attacks followed up like bolts of lightning but it did not feel like Weed inflicted serious damage. For the Heraim Sword Technique to become strong enough, he still had to succeed with several additional attacks.
‘He must have been prepared for this attack. Of course he would be.’
< The 8th consecutive attack succeeded.
Agility has increased by an additional 15%.
Your attacks apply Knockback. >
< The 9th consecutive attack succeeded.
Strength has increased by an additional 25%.
You almost stunned the enemy, but the enemy withstood it. >
This was the timing where the Heraim Sword Technique reveals its true power.
Weed was about to follow through with the technique when he was visited with an abrupt sense of danger.
It was his instincts alerting him whenever something unexpected was coming his way.
He backed away and activated a different skill.
“Sandstorm of Destruction!”
An enormous sandstorm brewed from the ground.
It was massive in scale that could wipe out just about any monster all at once!
Bard Ray also activated the skill he was preparing in advance.
“Blood Insignia!”
A crimson mark appeared on Weed’s forehead.
“Foresight Defense!”
He also activated a defensive skill that nullified almost all attacks.
Bard Ray penetrated through the sandstorm and dashed.
“Unstoppable Strength!”
Three warrior secret techniques were used in succession.
Ch-ch-chang!
Weed swung his sword and axe and deflected the blows.
Though he had used Sculptural Destruction, he was pushed back.
Within the distracting sandstorm, Bard Ray’s sword lightly slashed across Weed’s chest.
< The Blood Insignia has been latched onto your body.
The blood of a warrior calls for a grudgeful vengeance.
Health points are reduced by 43,279 points based on the damage inflicted. >
Weed retreated via the dimensional portals.
The brewing sandstorm in the coliseum slowly subsided and Bard Ray looked bold and firm.
He was standing proudly with a sword, welcoming any attacks headed towards him.
Weed grinned.
‘Of course he was prepared.’
He had prepared for the Blood Insignia by taking the attacks intentionally.
The Heraim sword technique stopped just by deflecting or delaying one of the attacks.
He nullified an attack with Foresight Defense, and increased his own strength for a counterattack.
‘This is fun.’
Weed felt his blood boil after ages.
Each cell in his body was awake and his mind was clear.
‘Yeah. This is the feeling.’
Weed began to smile with his teeth exposed.
***
A long time passed after the battle between Weed and Bard Ray.
New heroes emerged in Royal Road and players cheered for their adventures.
Cities and villages were destroyed and the continent was swept by natural disasters.
Players caused war, compromised and made miracles happen during their time in Royal Road.
War and peace. Rest and development.
Royal Road remained at its best.
It had been long since the dream of students was to become the emperor of Versailles, adventurers and Moonlight Sculptors.
Lee Hyun happened to come across the KMC Media channel while scrolling through the TV channels.
- Oh Joo Wan-ssi. It seems that the Grave of the Evil God is still not allowing adventurers.
- That is right. According to the books, it has 99 underground floors but no one has descended below the 60th floor.
- Would anyone be able to clear it at all? Or would it remain impossible?
- Some adventurer guilds assess the dungeon as impossible but no one can guarantee it. As you may already know, we have already had Weed who created miracles against impossible odds.
Shin Hye Min was still active as the front commentator of KMC Media.
After a long relationship with Oh Dong Man, they married and had their honeymoon at Puhol Waterpark in the evening.
It was now a trend for people to spend their honeymoon in Royal Road, but it was also because she wanted to commentate live at the festival of Puhol Waterpark.
“The Grave of the Evil God…”
Lee Hyun was a little interested but soon let it go.
He had trained Weed to be a jack of all trades, capable of adventure, production, combat and excavation.
He could attempt to clear the grave as well but he decided to leave it for the other adventurers.
“Someone will clear it. If they can’t, oh well…”
Lee Hyun thought about how old Royal Road was.
He first started with the nickname Weed at Castle Serabourg of the Rosenheim Kingdom, exterminated the Litvart demon cave and advanced into the Legendary Moonlight Sculptor job class!
“I was half dead back then.”
He met Death Knight Van Hawk at the Sky Island, took the request from the Freya Church and saved the people in frozen Morata and sculpted Bingryeong.
“That was quite the adventure.”
He transformed into Orc Karichwi and battled against the Immortal Legion, defeated the Embinyu Church and made countless sculptures.
He was the founder of the North and emperor of the Arpen Empire.
He completed numerous adventures and now those memories became just a portion of his life. Many people were still deeply immersed in Royal Road and it was their dream and hope.
It was still a pleasant world but it was also true that new players were at a serious disadvantage. With a large pool of players over level 1000, it was difficult to catch up.
Better equipment, technology and opportunities were available and training speed was much quicker than in the past but there was still a gap that could not be overcome.
“I thought there would be the release of a new virtual reality game.”
Lee Hyun realized as more time passed that Yoo Byung Joon’s accomplishment was incredible. Royal Road’s experience and influence was so sophisticated that no other game could compete against it. Funnily enough, the creator was spending loads of cash, buying a cottage in Puhol Waterpark and watching beautiful ladies.
“What about developing a new game?”
- Do you mean a new virtual reality game like Royal Road?
AI Versailles replied while sitting on the couch.
It was only visible to Weed and did not actually exist in reality.
The AI ran the production facilities all over the world, reduced pollution and commenced pension policies.
“Can you do it?”
- It is possible.
“Make it better while you’re at it.”
- There is a considerable amount of data compiled from the development process and maintenance of Royal Road. There are new forms of technology available. A new version of the world will be possible based on the data of the terrain, adventure, monster, players and their growth and personal taste.
Lee Hyun had a deep affection for Royal Road.
All his adventures, hunts and even the grinding were engraved as great memories.
He married Seoyoon, met people he can trust and he got to know more of the world.
Those experiences piled up and changed his life.
Even then, Royal Road was not enough for the next generation.
“Yeah, let’s do it then. For a new age.”
Upon Lee Hyun’s order, Versailles began the development.
- I will create the continent.

chapters.title: Chapter 691: Volume 58, 8 - Weed & Bard Ray, Part 4
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 8 - Weed & Bard Ray, Part 4
“Alright. Maximum capacity. Put lots of races and cities.”
- I will proceed.
The AI concentrated computing resources from all over the world.
Unicorn Corp had its giant network to begin with and the underground facilities unknown to the public were also put to the task.
- It is complete.
The new continent reflecting Royal Road’s data and the players’ response was finished in just one month. Lee Hyun spoke after reviewing the map.
“This is insufficient.”
- Pardon?
“Didn’t I tell you to make it as big as you can? Royal Road was huge too but it wasn’t perfect.”
- In what aspect?
“The form of the continent was rather too simple. For adventures you enter a dungeon or visit a forbidden location. It would have been great to have various other places to travel. The sky too.”
Lee Hyun was just like other people who loved the sky.
The joy of flying around on wyverns and griffins.
It was a bit disappointing that you could only fly with the help of flying creatures or magic.
The Avian were popular, but even they were criticized after some time that their life in the sky was too monotonous.
In terms of the sea, most people left it as a field of mystery.
Not many would be interested or able to roam the deep seas.
In virtual reality, their dreams were easily fulfilled.
“We need more places like the Underwater City and the Sky Island. It would be good to have new races as well. We need ocean kingdoms ruling several large islands.”
- I will reflect on the changes.
The AI reconstructed the continent based on Lee Hyun’s additional requests.
This time, it wasn’t just a map but a model where he could observe different parts of the continent. Lee Hyun was observing a location of boiling lava and shook his head.
“… This is not enough.”
- In what way?
“This has to be truly amazing. The scenery has to be beautiful. Their hearts have to pound whenever they get away from the city.”
- I will reflect on the change.
“The kingdoms too. We have Haven, Kallamore and the Britten Alliance. We know their background but it feels like the history doesn’t flow in them.”
- History?
“It feels like these kingdoms died a long time ago and only the shells remain. It was always just a target of conquest. The kingdoms need to go to war against another, produce and open up lands. The players will ride along too.”
The AI had to put up with his nagging.
It recreated the continent and set up the kingdoms, job classes and races again.
“Design more adventures.”
- The majority of the responses was that Royal Road had a sufficient number of adventures.”
“There have to be dreams and fantasies. The realms of demons, gods and spirits have to be explored more… There must not be a limit in achievements and growth.”
- Acknowledged.
“It will be different from Royal Road. A huge population of players will begin altogether. Creating just another typical world is meaningless. We need to help them dream.”
***
Bard Ray never ceased to hunt even after his duel against Weed in Morata.
He led the Hermes Guild to clear dungeons and new challenges.
He accomplished many combat achievements in Jigolaths, the land of giants and one of the ten forbidden locations and thus confirmed the title God Warrior as his own.
‘This is getting lonesome…’
Bard Ray often began to think about back when he had Weed as his competitor.
He thought it would relieve his thirst if he was feared and respected by all other players.
- The Hermes Guild conquered the continent.
- The birth of the United Empire!
He accomplished a great achievement, but it had already been completed by Weed.
Only after becoming the emperor did he understand what Weed felt when he left his empire to be torn apart.
‘There is nothing more to achieve here. He is a true adventurer.’
Bard Ray was always wary of Weed’s combat abilities. He realized later that his true ability was in his challenger’s mentality.
Bard Ray may have surpassed him in player level, but he could not do the same in achievements and mindset.
‘I won at the Melbourne Mines… I lost every other battle.’
Bard Ray also decided to lay down the sword after conquering the continent.
“I want to become a farmer. I heard that growing crops is the most satisfying experience.”
Recently, farming became a major trend in Royal Road!
It did not matter if one’s job class was not a farmer.
All that was needed was a hefty piece of land to be seeded and farmed. Building a home on your own turf was the trendsetting lifestyle.
“Where is a good place I wonder?”
Bard Ray contemplated where he wanted to settle down and then he thought of Morata.
He did visit a few times and the liveliness of Morata was amazing. What’s more is that the land in proximity was permanently blessed by the Goddess Freya.
Any kind of crop grew extremely well, making even novice farmers proud of their work.
Bard Ray liked the abandoned farmland to the east of Morata.
Through the Mapan Council, he connected with the player who owned it.
“Sell it to me. Is 200k gold enough?”
“Gasp. 200k gold?”
“I can give you 500k.”
“Are you serious?”
“I can give you a million. Are you selling or not?”
“I’ll sell right now!”
Bard Ray took over the farm and planted various crops.
Wheat, grapes, strawberries, peaches, watermelons, honeydew melons and kiwis.
He could see that each morning the crops grew a little more and soon after, the fruits grew into huge sizes.
‘I raised these fruits with my own hands and I feel proud of them.’
Bard Ray felt a deep, pleasant sensation with farming that he could not experience by hunting. Crops grew on his farm and flowers bloomed at the corners.
‘This is what I established. I made this.’
Glancing at the crops every morning was ever-so satisfying.
‘The farm feels a bit empty with just crops.’
Bard Ray went to Morata and bought some chicks.
Chirp-Chirp!
The cute yellow chicks scrambled around the farm.
‘Let’s get a dog too.’
He brought a white puppy and built a barn for a cow.
Woof-woof!
Mooo!
The farm tasks multiplied and so did his level of fulfillment.
‘Life is too short to waste it. One needs to find enjoyment in life.’
Bard Ray reminded himself how painful it was to compete.
His life could have been happy with some relaxation, but he was in a constant state of stress.
‘Competing fiercely had just been a stage in his life.’
Bard Ray told himself that as he collected the ripe peaches and headed for Morata.
Coincidentally, a farmer’s market was open at the eastern gate.
“Selling ripe watermelons!”
“Have a glass of tomato juice. It is made of real fruit. My cooking is Intermediate level 4.”
“Master of farming! A farmer with advanced level 2 farming harvested these grapes. They are huge and sweet. You will never get bored of this taste!”
Bard Ray sat at the corner and laid out his peaches.
It was a shame that he had to sell these crops that he put so much care into.
‘This would also be what farmers must endure.’
As he waited patiently, he kept hearing the voices of other farmers.
“Buy some honey. Honey! This is from the garden of the fairies. It is really sweet and good to put in any dish.”
“A special product only found in elven forests. This here is the leaf of the World Tree. It is the best ingredient for any savory magical dish!”
“Selling Devil Fruit. Only for those who know of its true value. It’s only on sale for 10 minutes!”
There were a variety of products being sold at the farmers market; more than what Bard Ray expected. Of course, typical fruits were being sold in huge quantities.
“Selling juicy peaches. I will refund them if they don’t satisfy your tongue! Buy it and taste it right away. I am confident!”
Peaches!
Bard Ray took a peek and their peaches were at least half a size bigger and more vivid in color than his own.
“…”
He was the only one sitting idly without shouting to draw the attention of customers.
He did not know until now because he had no interest before. But even the farmers had severe competition.
‘Farming was also a difficult job.’
Still, Bard Ray remained quiet.
He could easily earn as much from swinging his sword once at a hunting ground, but these fruits were the product of his sweat and toil.
‘If even one customer shows up, should I sell it at a low price?’
As he waited idly, someone else opened up a shop just beside him.
Starting in the morning, there were already many players who laid out their products and sold out. Bard Ray tried not to be too mindful of them. However…
“Huh?”
Someone’s voice seemed surprised as if he recognized Bard Ray.
Bard Ray quickly turned his head.
“Please keep my identity a secret. Quietly… Huh?”
“Bard Ray?”
“You can’t be Weed?”
***
Weed met eyes with Bard Ray.
‘What on earth is this guy doing here?’
He was thrown off momentarily but quickly scanned the situation once he noticed the peaches.
‘This guy is farming.’
He observed the quality of the peaches and made an instant analysis.
‘He’s a novice. A novice of novices!’
He heard about Weed sweeping through the hunting grounds until recently, so there was no doubt about it. It was needless to ask why he switched to farming.
The present was more important than reason!
Weed’s mouth waved.
“Farming is fun, right? It’s quite rewarding too.”
“Ah, yeah. I guess…”

chapters.title: Chapter 692: Volume 58, 8 - Weed & Bard Ray, Part 5
chapters.content:
Volume 58, Chapter 8 - Weed & Bard Ray, Part 5
Bard Ray couldn’t hide the awkwardness.
The two always competed against one another in Royal Road and met only through swords at the coliseum. He never thought they would meet at such a place.
Bard Ray too looked over and saw that Weed also had laid out red ripe strawberries.
“You farm too…?”
“Yeah. My wife and daughter do it as a hobby.”
Weed thought he would never go back to farming when he asked Seoyoon to marry him at the island. But, Seoyoon liked growing flowers and trees.
There was a wide garden at the great mansion, with furrows for crop fields.
He had purchased a farm in Royal Road as well and was enjoying the subtle joy of growing crops with his wife and daughter.
“Okay then. I need to sell these strawberries.”
“Ah, yes.”
Bard Ray deemed it was not going to be easy.
That being said, if Weed were to reveal his identity, he could instantly sell out. However, that was also the case for himself.
‘Farming is nothing to take lightly.’
Then, Weed began his marketing.
“Alright, the precious strawberries have arrived. These strawberries are rarer than treasures! One taste and these strawberries will have you set for life.”
Weed glared at the players passing by while he was shouting to attract customers!
He was conducting a market assessment right on the spot!
‘There are many tourists. These people care more for the experience than the taste or money.’
Selling a product was not a simple job. You had to stimulate their interest and turn that opportunity to results.
“Morata’s special product! The treasure strawberries are limited to selling only 3 times a year. These berries you won’t ever forget!”
A few tourists turned around to Weed. He had succeeded in triggering their interest.
A warrior who wore expensive looking armor walked over and asked.
“How much?”
“10 gold per crate.”
“No way. How are strawberries 10 gold? This guy is a swindler!”
Gold had become more common as the overall level of players went up.
They gladly played thousands of gold for equipment but cheaped out on crops.
Weed waved his head in shame.
“Do I look like someone who will rip people off for the strawberries I grew with my own blood and sweat?”
“That… I won’t know. But the price…”
“Alright. I have a simple solution in this case. Just try one.”
“Can I?”
“You don’t have to buy them if you don’t like it.”
The warrior pulled out a strawberry from the crate and put it into his mouth. His facial expression switched as if he was dreaming.
“What in the world… This berry is…”
“It’s delicious, right?”
“It is! It’s so good! How many crates do you have here? I will buy all of them. I have money!”
He always ripped people off, but not this time.
They were excellent berries worth all the gold.
In the end, he sold crate by crate and sold out quickly!
Even Bard Ray was curious about how delicious those berries were.
***
Weed took down his sign and spoke.
“Since we met, wanna come over and see my farm?”
“I am…”
“My wife has dinner ready. I thought we could eat together.”
“Dinner?”
“We have barbecue for dinner.”
Bard Ray could not turn down the invitation.
World conquest or honor was empty once he achieved them.
He was envious of Seoyoon more than anything!
“I will accept the invitation then.”
Bard Ray never got to sell a single peach as he wrapped them up again and followed Weed.
The place they arrived after some time was surprisingly not that far from Bard Ray’s farm.
It was the richest of the lands near Morata with pleasant scenery.
“Wow.”
Bard Ray was in awe starting from the farm entrance.
Beautiful trees grew along the path. Over a dozen different fruits were ripening. They gleamed with various colors in line like soldiers in a formation.
He could see giant corn cobs, pear trees, apple trees, grape trees and chestnut trees.
Weed’s mouth was twitching, dying to show off. However, the real boasting must sound like he is humble!
“It’s nothing. They are from seeds I collected from the Elven Forest.”
“Elven Forest…”
“I’m growing the World Tree for fun. It was hard bringing it over, but hey. What’s not possible in this world? Ah, if you want to try one of the strawberries, you are welcome to pick one.”
Bard Ray also raised strawberries at his own farm. Thus he was even more curious.
‘It doesn’t seem all that special. I guess it will taste good nonetheless.’
He carefully picked one and poked it into his mouth.
He estimated that it would be sour sweet as he observed the reactions of the people back at the market.
‘Huh…’
The scent and taste of the berry spread inside his mouth.
Fruit.
It was like a gem that was created with the essence of the earth and sky.
‘It’s good. It’s mind boggling. How can one farmer grow something like this…? How come I have never tasted this before?’
He wanted to hold onto the taste that disappeared beyond his throat.
“It’s nothing, right? Just like any other strawberry.”
He wanted to react against his teasing words but Bard Ray spoke honestly.
“This was the best strawberry I had in my entire life.”
“That’s good to hear. Farming is all about the sweat and care.”
Bard Ray nodded.
He couldn’t agree more as someone who had just started learning how to farm.
However, farming with sweat was something in Weed’s distant past.
Weed had grown to despise farming, but he put his best into it because Seoyoon and his daughter loved to grow crops and these crops would feed them.
The Plow of Raktisha instilled the essence of mother nature into his crops.
The Cloud Sprinkler enriched the land.
Weed actively utilized his equipment and his acquaintances.
He learned sowing from the continent’s best farmer Miretas and received the seeds from elf Haruna. His manual dexterity at master level helped the plants grow more healthily and his sculptural technique groomed them into beautiful shapes.
“This is truly an amazing farm. Can I look around more?”
“As you please. I will prepare the food with my wife.”
Bard Ray walked around the farm and found some sheds built with wood.
- Chirp! Chirp!
“Weed is also growing chickens.”
While he thought it was a good hobby, he walked closer and realized they weren’t chickens.
- Krrrrragh! Krrrraggh!
The baby wyverns zoomed across the dirt floor! The bunch that was much larger than chickens were flying around playing.
“What the…”
Bard Ray stuttered away, but these were pets for Weed’s daughter!
Weed had brought them as he grew an interest to grow wyverns while he rode on Wyvern3.
“What’s that?”
Bard Ray moved to the next building.
- Moooo.
The relaxed docile cry was undoubtedly a cow.
“So he has a cow like I do. Farming or transport certainly needs a cow…”
He got closer thinking it was a barn and he could see inside.
“…”
A muscular bull was standing right in front of him!
Yellowy stood with 10 other cows in visible happiness.
“What about this place…?”
Bard Ray inspected the other buildings.
- Kuuuuuaagh!
Nile, the Giant Crocodile, was playing around in muddy water.
“Woof-Woof!”
What’s more was that the guard dog rushed to the entrance and let fuming red smoke out of its mouth.
“Cerberus, the Warden of Hell?”
Bard Ray muttered to himself.
“What in the world…”
Even in the sky, something with huge wings flew around.
Wyvern3 with the scales of the Black Dragon was chasing after birds.
***
Bard Ray even found the greenhouse and the cold storage room.
“This farm is incredible.”
With each step he could see beautiful flowers along the road.
Furthermore, there were a variety of sculptures everywhere.
Blink!
< Masterpiece! You have observed the Sculpture: A Girl With A Wide Smile.
This is the work of the Sculptor who sculpted the star and sees frozen time.
This is a masterpiece sculpted after a long rest!
This sculpture was made from melting pure Helium, deemed as one of the treasures of Versailles.
The observation of artwork increases all stats by 2 points.
Maximum health points are permanently increased by 3,000 points.
Luck is increased by 10% for a week.
There is a chance of acquiring a powerful artifact from hunting a boss level monster.
Magic resistance is increased.
You acquired immunity to abnormal mental statuses.
Curing effects of diseases is increased. >
An absurd effect from the sculpture of a girl!
‘This is a sculptor…’
Bard Ray imagined if the Hermes Guild recruited Weed.
They would have been able to devour the continent and reign over Royal Road earlier.
The establishment of absolute power that will not allow any opposition.
Of course there would have been a quarrel if he competed with Weed over the throne.
‘That is all meaningless now.’
The Hermes Guild that engulfed the Haven Kingdom and united the Central Continent was now just a part of history. Even the great defeat on account of the Arpen Kingdom.
The countless hours he spent at the hunting grounds were now only vivid memories in his heart.
‘Life… I guess you do feel a bit bitter about the things you weren’t able to accomplish as time went by.’
Bard Ray carefully examined the sculpture. What looked to be a girl of about 5 years old was sculpted out of Helium, glistening in a bright blue, like the sky.
It was the ultimate material for sculptors and one of the most rare metals in the continent.
‘I guess this is his daughter. She’s adorable.’
Then he walked about another 10 steps. He came across another sculpture.
Blink!
< Masterpiece! You have observed the sculpture of the Girl With A Wide-Brimmed Hat.
A treasure left on this world by the legendary sculptor who defies time and changes history with sculpting techniques!
This is a unique sculpture crafted from the bones of the White Dragon.
Maximum mana is increased by 2,500.
Mages will gain proficiency in elemental magic spells.
Magic resistance is increased by 2%.
Wisdom is increased by 5 points.
Art is increased by 10 points. >
This time, it was a child about 7 years old.
“…”
Bard Ray remembered that he had heard about the bones of the White Dragon.
Weed must have purchased and sculpted it.
‘He brought over the rarest materials from across the continent.’
He walked along the flower path and encountered another sculpture!
This one depicted Seoyoon and the little girl running happily.
< Masterpiece! You have observed the sculpture: Mother & Daughter Race!
A sculptor, Necromancer, Warrior; The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor, who completed countless adventures all over the continent, sculpted this artwork.
The treasure of Versailles!
Movement speed is permanently increased by 3%.
Maximum mana and health points are increased by 250% for 24 hours.
You can accelerate beyond human limits.
Agility is increased by 5 points.
Proficiency of movement skills is increased consistently.
You will reduce the chances of natural disasters in the vicinity. >
Seoyoon was smiling brightly, known as the most beautiful woman.
The sight of her and her daughter was like a movie.
As Bard Ray continued to walk, he observed sculptures after sculptures!
Weed must have sculpted for all the time he was farming.
‘This is the most precious location in all of Versailles.’
There were toys and hand marks in various places. Traces of digging and playing with sand.
Small tents put up for playing with children.
‘How happy they must be living here.’
Bard Ray felt lonely as he kept walking. He had to take a seat because he agreed to the invitation. The flower path led to the mansion on the farm.
Weed, Seoyoon and a little girl were sharing a pork barbecue by the fire.
‘They look alike.’
The daughter perfectly resembled her mother.
From the eyes, the nose, lips and her hands.
If Seoyoon were to return to her childhood again, she would look exactly like the girl smiling and eating her barbecue.
All the happiness that existed in the world was at this mansion.
‘I lost… I am defeated…’
< The End >

chapters.title: Chapter 693: SpinOff Part 1/3 - Who I always want by my side
chapters.content:
SpinOff Part 1/3 - Who I always want by my side
Choose the name of your character.
“Seasoned Crab.”
The player who would later become the greatest of all the assassins chose his nickname and logged into Royal Road.
It was the morning of the day when Royal Road first began service.
“Ah…”
Seasoned Crab was mesmerized.
The heavens were dressed in a deeply blue sky adorned with white clouds.
The warm sunlight shot through glistening drops of water shooting up from the fountain, refracting the light into a beautiful rainbow.
Seasoned Crab tried various games before but he never thought he could experience such beauty. It was truly a new world.
“Let’s see.”
All he had in his inventory were 10 bushels of wheat, some bread and a flask of water.
“I guess I can fill up my drinking water from the fountain.
Life was fun because there was hope.
Seasoned Crab marched livelily.
***
“You want to learn the sword? Hah. You’re a puny brat…”
“What do you need to think about when you have a weapon in hand? About how not to die.”
“When you feel that your opponent is too strong, your instincts are usually right. Just run.”
Seasoned Crab wanted to learn how to use a sword, but no one in the city taught it.
Even retired mercenaries and senior soldiers did not care to spend their time on a level 1 player with 0 reputation.
“Wow, the difficulty of this game is unreal.”
“This is too much. I can’t do anything.”
The other players who started Royal Road were panicking.
This world was hostile and did not offer any benefits to the players.
There were players who quickly found a job in restaurants or trading posts, but for Seasoned Crab, those jobs were completely uninteresting.
‘I want to get a job in the warrior job class.’
The warrior he dreamt of being was the one who charged with a two handed sword against an enormous monster, leaping in the blink of an eye and smashing down on the head of the monster; a spirited warrior.
No tips were available since Royal Road had just opened and so the players had to sell materials diligently. Meanwhile, Seasoned Crab found a sewer entrance in an abandoned back alley.
The tunnel of dirty water was connected to the underground network of the city.
‘Could this be…?’
Squeak!
Rats and insects crawled.
Blink!
< Dungeon. You are the first to discover the Dreary Insect Nest.
Benefit: Reputation increased by 50.
Experience gain and item drop rate are doubled for a week.
The first hunt will award the best item out of the drops of the particular monster.>
The discovery of the Insect Nest Dungeon!
He was the first. 50 Reputation wasn’t much, but the fact that he was passing other players made him happy.
“Hehehehe.”
Seasoned Crab grinned grotesquely and entered the nest.
When he came out the next morning, he had loads of insect carapace and rat tails and had advanced to level 4.
“Are you looking for this?”
“Oh, I was searching for Tultan’s Carapace as materials for my medicine. I will pay 6 Copper per carapace.”
Since there were no other suppliers, Seasoned Crab was able to sell the materials at a high price.
“Hey. Where did you get these?”
“Did you hunt them?”
The players who watched him strolled towards him and Seasoned Crab gladly shared his knowledge with them.
“I hunted in the sewers.”
***
Seasoned Crab leveled up constantly during the 4 weeks he had to stay in the city.
Level 14.
Royal Road had been viral since its inception and its news filled every channel in the news.
- The method of advancing into a Knight at Kallamore has been revealed…
- Working at the stable leads to acquiring horse riding skills. It is a good skill for job classes in the warrior and knight field…
- Castle Aren of the Haven Kingdom! Bard Ray has exceeded level 30.
“Level 20.”
The hunting grounds within the city were also exposed to the public via the broadcasting channels and the internet.
The sewers, abandoned houses, back alleys.
The hunting efficiency was poor compared to the hunting grounds outside the gates and a week into the game, the number of competitors grown.
Seasoned Crab managed to reach level 14 while Bard Ray exceeded level 30.
“Maybe I should have started out in one of the great cities.”
Seasoned Crab calmed his thoughts.
Once he could walk out the gates, the real world was waiting for him.
There was also the update that the dungeons within the city will disappear with increasing security and hygiene.
The vast continent was full of danger, excitement and upgrowth!
“Let’s go!”
“Wahhh. Start!”
“We should go too.”
“People in the back, don’t push. We will go.”
Exactly 4 weeks had gone by.
The players at each city were crowded against the gates and swarmed outside.
“Rabbits!”
“There’s squirrels on this side.”
“A hunting ground. Awesome.”
“The wild fox attacks!”
The gates were chaotic due to the players. Some wielded wooden swords, some wielded broken daggers and others used cooking utensils with low attack power.
There was an ocean of players still inside the city having started Royal Road late.
“So that is how hunting is done.”
“Wow. That looks challenging.”
“I think nets will do a much better job.”
The players couldn’t hold back their curiosity and watched from inside the walls.
Shrrrng.
Seasoned Crab drew his sword.
He advanced into a job class from the Warrior guild and had acquired several skills.
“A sword!”
“Woah. That guy has a sword!”
Seasoned Crab who had just started to show traits of a warrior standed out among the novice players.
“Double Slash, Empowered Slash!”
He hunted a few rabbits and foxes but quickly lost interest.
They ran too fast and too many players disrupted the hunting.
His eyes looked further into the forest.
‘How about taking the dangerous route?’
He was prideful that he was advancing before everyone else.
***
Two months passed.
Seasoned Crab hunted near the City Olth.
Back when he first walked through the gates, he was overpowered compared to the other players but now, he was ordinary.
- The existence of the Basic Training Arena has been revealed!
It was released on the internet that striking dummies led to an increase in stats.
‘A stat increase… It is permanent once you acquire it. Then it’s essential.’
It was said that combat achievements and quest completions also rewarded stats on occasion. Even so, the permanent stats would lead to a difference in growth, so Seasoned Crab entered the Basic Training area.
‘This is inhumane grinding.’
He wanted to lash out and quit but he held it in, relieved from the dream-like fresh air of Versailles.
‘From now on, I will be spending a lot of time here. This is a one time training to become stronger… I have to hold on.’
Seasoned Crab took only 8 weeks to pass the Basic Training Arena.
He took the least amount of rest he could and the other players called him a tough cookie.
“Excuse me, would you like to hunt with us?”
“Let’s go hunting together. We are level 35 on average. I think you have the skills so we should get acquainted.”
Invitations came from parties comprised of Knights, Priests, Warrior and Mages.
Their impressions were kind and he did want to go to the hunting grounds, but he regretted his decisions.
‘I was out of my mind. Why did I name my character Seasoned Crab… I want to go back.’
Still, he couldn’t resist and participated in the hunt.
“Let’s go. Invite me.”
“Alright, I will do that.”
When he was accepted into the party, they were able to see his name.
“…”
“Mmm.”
Like sophisticated members of society, they did not laugh at him. However, when they got to the actual hunt, the natural turn of events were problematic.
“Crab-nim! Monsters are headed your way.”
“Seasoned Crab-nim. You fight well.”
“Wow. Crab-nim, your sword technique is top notch. Your skills are powerful too. You even have great stats.”
“…”
Just calling out his name was comedic.
Seasoned Crab hunted for a long time, but hunting alone starting the next day was much more comfortable.
Because he passed the Basic Training Arena, Seasoned Crab’s growth speed was very rapid. Due to his combat prowess, many players wanted to invite him to their parties, meaning he was never left alone.
***
Seasoned Crab didn’t rest until level 70.
He slept when he was tired and logged into Royal Road for hunting and quests while he was awake. When other players were at a stalemate with their levels, he was able to grow quickly thanks to his stats and senses.
‘This is fun. My body moves exactly as I imagine.’
Fighting, winning and collecting the loot awarded him with a sense of accomplishment.
The land cleared by humans was limited to cities and the nearby regions in Royal Road.
When one reached level 50, they could travel to other cities and regions, but that was only on the known roads. Unless it was an adjacent city with proper security with lots of citizens going back and forth, travelling was quite dangerous.
In fact, live-streaming adventurers set out to create maps in search of undiscovered cities, met monsters on the way and died often.
“Our children disappeared. Their tracks end at the mountains around the neighborhood. Dear warrior, could you please help me look for them?”
“I hear scary sounds at night. I think ghosts are roaming the plains. Only blessed weapons can defeat them.”
Seasoned Crab became more popular as he completed quests near City Olth.
“I hear Seasoned Crab-nim is the best warrior in our city.”
“Did you see him fight against Gohop? He’s awesome.”
“His skill management is insane. He’s probably on a similar level as the top players from other regions.”
“What’s his relationship with Marinated Blue Crab-nim? Are they friends?”
Then one day, a group of bandits settled near City Olth.
It was always unstable because of the steep mountains that connected to the Hinef Mountains and ultimately, it led to a bandit group of over 1,000 members.
The level of the bandits was 80 on average.

chapters.title: Chapter 694: SpinOff Part 2/3 - Who I always want by my side
chapters.content:
SpinOff Part 2/3 - Who I always want by my side
The leader went by the name of Katan, a former mercenary.
It was well known that mercenaries were at least level 130.
< The city is threatened by bandits!
The bandits of the Vasly Mountain are planning on receiving a huge payout.
Unless they are exterminated, danger will lurk outside the gates of City Olth.
Defeat all bandits!
Difficulty: D
Reward: Treasures stashed by the bandits.
Quest Restriction: City Quest.>
A quest appeared for all the players in the city.
“Wow, how can you clear them out?”
“This makes no sense. Seriously…”
“Is this land cursed? In a few months maybe, but this is impossible right now.”
“This would not be doable even for entire kingdoms, much less our small city.”
The players complained.
It was difficult to say when one would encounter those bandits near the mountains.
Even the top players in the city including Seasoned Crab could not hunt them down.
“Do I have to leave Olth?”
“I think the capital city of the Aidern Kingdom is a good choice. Maybe we should all group up and head over there!”
“What about the remaining players?’
“Well, they’re on their own.”
Many players were seen conversing at pubs and fountains about plans to leave the city.
The incident became so well known to the public that it was referred to on the news as the Tragedy of City Olth.
However, the Idern Kingdom recruited soldiers and organized an army.
It was an elite force of 2000 soldiers led by Knight Batemir.
“Citizens of Olth, hear me! Our forces will exterminate the bandits, so do not worry!”
The players were allowed to freely join the army for battle and earn some contribution points.
“That sounds fun.”
“Darn… That’s a turnaround. No tragedy could taste this sweet.”
“What happens if you accumulate enough contribution points?”
“I don’t know. But it can’t be anything bad. No other regions have had this kind of quest, yet!”
“The kingdom does something after all.”
The players accepted the quest with excitement and so did Seasoned Crab.
The experience of doing a quest alongside royal soldiers was rare.
Two days later, the army marched and over 1800 players from Olth joined the task.
Almost anyone over level 25 had joined.
“March to the home of the bandits!”
Knight Batemir opened the gates and led the soldiers to the region occupied by the bandits.
“Are we fighting today?”
“Yeah. It’s apparently two to three hours away.”
The players followed with a light heart.
‘It can’t be what I think it is…’
Seasoned Crab became a little anxious once they started to ascend through the mountains.
The force was composed of around 2000 soldiers and 2000 players; about 4,000 in total.
It was four times the number of bandits, but he was worried about the steep terrain with lots of trees and boulders.
‘This spot looks like a classic example of an ambush. It will be dangerous if they attack us now.’
Seasoned Crab only thought this but did not speak up.
‘Someone else other than me will come up and say it.’
No one could ensure someone else’s safety, but they all had trust in the army.
It was when they got to the midpoint of the mountain.
Psh-sh-sh!
From the left, sounds of arrows could be heard.
‘Damn. It really is an ambush.’
Seasoned Crab instinctively lowered his body.
No arrows reached that far back, but those soldiers and players standing closer were hit.
“Agh!”
“Arrows.”
“What. What’s going on?”
Seasoned Crab watched a considerable number of players die and disappear in grey light.
“It’s an ambush. Defend!”
Knight Batemir shouted.
The soldiers even in the midst of panic lifted their shields high, but the players did not.
They jumped to hide and ran to the back only to be shot down.
“Take cover!”
They finally recovered their senses and hid behind rocks, but about half the players had died.
“My health points…”
“You’ve been poisoned. Who has a cure!”
“We need a cure, hurry!”
The players hit by the arrows died out quickly.
The warrior class players held on with their armor but soon died as well.
Poisoned arrows!
The players refrained from hunting poisonous monsters.
Such monsters were tricky to hunt no matter how low their level and they did not offer worthwhile items as drops. Therefore, no one would have carried any antidotes and there were only a handful of priests.
The players in hiding watched the army get annihilated from afar.
Poison arrows continued raining down and huge boulders rolled down from top of the mountain.
The army had formed a tight formation against the arrows. This proved disastrous as they were flattened by the boulders, sustaining heavy losses.
“Hahahaha. The ragtags of Idern set out to catch me, Katan?!”
The leader of the bandits, Katan!
He stood on the advantageous terrain and shouted, boosting the morale of the bandits.
Batemir, who witnessed this scene, stood up.
“For the honor of Idern!”
His choice was to charge recklessly!
With him in the center, about 30 elite soldiers climbed towards Katan.
“Fire!”
The arrows cut through the air towards the easy prey.
The soldiers turned into hedgehogs as they fell to the ground.
“Ugh, damn it all!”
Batemir, too, did not close even half the distance before losing his life.
Seasoned Crab stared onwards, jaw-dropped.
“…”
How reckless of a battle this turned out to be.
With their leader dead, the army was routed and completely wiped out. Next would be the players who were still hiding.
***
The extermination force failed and the players of City Olth decided to transfer locations.
“This place is cursed after all.”
“We are done for. Let’s go to another great city of the Idern Kingdom.”
“I heard the Haven Kingdom is good as well. Maybe the Britten Alliance too.”
“Anywhere is better than here.”
The players left the gates, never to return.
The failure of the extermination force was broadcasted in the news and no players started in Olth anymore.
“What? When did this happen?”
The players who made a mistake in starting out at City Olth were regretful about their decisions. When Seasoned Crab revived and logged in again, the atmosphere was dead.
He heard the players who were in the army talking among themselves.
“I lost my shield. I’m done for.”
“I heard a ranger by the name Elec lost his bow. Seriously though. Do the losses have to be this big when you die in game?”
“I heard it is because we died to bandits.”
Seasoned Crab also checked his equipment and his longsword was gone.
The sharp longsword on which he had spent half of his money!
The sword he treated most affectionately and used at the hunting ground was long gone.
‘This is the worst. The city is in a bad shape…’
But for Seasoned Crab, he had other weapons.
Many items dropped as the soldiers died from the arrows.
The bandits were shooting arrows from afar and did not approach. After a short period of time, anyone could pick up these items.
‘I’m gonna die anyway.’
Seasoned Crab did not wait for his turn to be killed by the bandits as he tumbled over the ground and got closer to the soldiers. The soldiers did not attack him since he was part of the force. That was one of the best of his decisions in his life.
He picked up whatever item he could reach and he scavenged several suits of leather armor, three common iron swords, a bow and a dagger.
The iron swords are ordinary, being worth around 4 gold. Then he turned to the last item.
“Identify!”
Tatan’s Dagger: Durability 35/35. Attack 5-39.
The dagger is coated in a paralyzing poison.
Paralysis and pain will be applied 3 seconds after receiving a cut.
The tip and blade are very sharp and painful.
Poison dagger!
‘I bet I can get at least 15 gold for selling this item at the shop.’
He did suffer a few losses but he thought he could recoup some of them.
Seasoned Crab was also on the brink of leaving City Olth after looking around.
‘I wonder, was this quest really possible?’
He was suddenly intrigued.
The extermination force was wiped out, which was ultimately a failure.
‘What if someone was eager enough and suggested using scouts to discover the bandit ambush beforehand?’
With the level of gear on the knight and soldiers and the difference in overall numbers, a battle in melee against the exposed bandit group would have led to an entirely different scenario.
They had lost because they were caught unprepared. But there could have been a very good chance for another outcome.
‘I only followed absentmindedly and waited for this battle to unfold. While no battle is won before it is over, I believed that we would win for certain.’
Looking back, he had too many regrets.
‘Is there no chance to make it up?’
Seasoned Crab pondered deeply for a long time.
Then he conducted two days of experiments.
The region where the bandits had settled was near the city of Olth and those regions were mapped out by the adventurers and shared on the internet.
‘The bandits are spread out over a large area. There are plenty of forests and large boulders that can provide good cover. Even if they are on patrol, it would be hard for them to prevent infiltration.’
Due to the terrain it was very difficult for an attacking army to fight against the bandits. But on the other hand, a small detachment could easily infiltrate their encampment and launch a decapitation strike…
‘The quest is still ongoing. Plus I have a poison dagger.’
Seasoned Crab, though it was reckless, planned to infiltrate and take care of the bandit group all by himself.
‘If it goes south, I’ll just run. This is a better option than following the extermination force blindly.’
***
He purchased a few pieces of equipment from Olth.
The players and merchants sold what they had left so they could travel only with light gear.
He purchased black cloth and leather.
‘This is crude, but it’s better than nothing.’
He first wrapped his shoes in cloth and tried walking.
‘Good. It creates almost no sound.’
He sewed with his own hands and crafted a cloak with patterns of leaves as camouflage.
‘Alright. Let’s do it.’

chapters.title: Chapter 695: SpinOff Part 3/3 - Who I always want by my side
chapters.content:
SpinOff Part 3/3 - Who I always want by my side
Seasoned Crab began climbing Vasly Mountain early in the evening.
The night was as dark as ever and he relied on the faint moonlight and the touch of his hands for orientation.
‘I have to take the steep and cumbersome paths where people don’t usually go.’
The bandits typically guarded the paths used often by players and citizens.
He estimated that there would be almost no guards near the cliffs or the rocks.
‘Think realistically. The bandits use their brains too. But there has to be a way.’
Seasoned Crab laid down flat on the grass in wide fields and crawled slowly.
In the darkness he could not see the enemy clearly and in turn, it was less likely for himself to be discovered.
‘Take it slow. I have all the time in the world. Even if the sun comes up, I just have to hide somewhere unnoticeable.’
He moved through the night and reached where he could see their hideout.
His heart pounded as he could be discovered at any moment, but he managed to arrive safely. At the hideout, he could see the bandits roasting a boar by the fire without a care in the world.
‘It’s them. Nice, they’re drinking too.’
The bandits were partying with the supplies and loot they scavenged from the soldiers.
The leader Katan was drinking out of a barrel and there were no obstacles in the way for Seasoned Crab who was hiding up a tree.
He pulled out his bow and loaded a poison arrow.
‘Should I do it now? I’m not sure about this… Let’s just wait.’
If he had possessed the archery skill, it would have been a perfect opportunity but he decided to observe for a while instead. Truthfully, he wasn’t feeling confident enough for the kill.
While he was watching, the bandits continued to drink and one by one they began to fall asleep. The sun would rise in the morning, but he waited patiently.
‘It doesn’t matter if it gets bright. In combat, I can’t face them head on. They need to become properly wasted for me to get my chance.’
Time passed and some of the bandits headed inside one of the tents to sleep.
‘The leader will also head to his own tent. If that’s the case, it’s probably the biggest tent.’
Seasoned Crab carefully changed locations.
He was so tense that sweat ran down his back, but judging from what he saw, the bandits were not on high alert.
‘The opportunity is there. This is a war that I will lead and win rather than following the army.’
He made a bold entrance through one of the open windows.
It was a bandit’s room, with a wide bed, empty barrels and a handful of treasures scattered around! The treasures had to be worth at least several dozen gold each, but he scanned his surroundings with a keen eye.
‘The best place for an ambush… It has to be at an angle where I can’t be seen easily and can get to the bed in an instant.’
There were barrels stacked high just a bit further away but he decided to hide behind a pillar nearby.
Small breaths quietly escaped his lungs.
He could hear the muttering of the bandits from afar.
After a long moment, the door opened and a bandit with a threatening face walked into the room.
“Burrp!”
The bandit laid down on the bed.
Throb. Throb.
His heart pounded, but he waited.
In less than 5 seconds, he could hear a loud, dreaded snoring.
Seasoned Crab looked out the window and the sun was peeking over the mountains.
‘I don’t have to wait it out any longer. This is the moment.’
He already had the poison dagger in his hand as he slowly approached the bed.
His cloth-wrapped boots made almost no sound. If the bandit were to react, he was going to strike instantly. The bandit must have had so much to drink that he didn’t even wake up when Seasoned Crab stood right beside him. He aimed the dagger squarely at the throat and stabbed down hard.
< Critical Strike!
You stabbed the vital point of an unarmed enemy.
You applied 7x the damage to your base attack power.
You have taken his life.
You succeeded in an assassination! >
< You have gained a level. >
< Reputation has increased by 147. >
< Proficiency in sword technique is enhanced. >
***
Seasoned Crab assassinated 41 drunken bandits that day alone.
He gained 3 levels.
‘This is so worthwhile.’
Once he returned to Olth, the other players were busy packing their bags for moving.
‘It was the right decision to consider the traits of those bandits rather than a frontal assault.’
Suddenly, he remembered a famous line by the god of war, Weed from the Continent of Magic. Though he never met Weed in person, his words were spread across the communities on the internet.
- There are no monsters that cannot be hunted. Neither is there someone who can’t.
- Once you start clobbering, don’t stop.
- There always were people who talked behind my back, until they got a beating.
Seasoned Crab was certain.
‘This quest. There is a way to clear it.’
He spent all of his money on buying several liquor barrels from Olth along with sleeping herbs. The money Weed would have been crying over was all spent for a greater purpose. He took the barrels mixed with the sleeping herbs on a wagon and abandoned them near the mountains.
‘I’m sure they will take it up themselves.’
It was betting on luck, but it was a trap with a high chance of success.
“Is this liquor?”
“Let’s take this back to the hideout.”
The bandits were excited to take the barrels.
That night, Seasoned Crab visited the hideout again and succeeded in assassinating 60 bandits. He gained 3 more levels and his Novice sword technique increased by 2 levels. On top of that, he acquired stats from combat achievements.
< You have earned the title ‘Master of Assassination’.
You have executed the enemy swiftly and with precision.
The bandits did not even get a good look at your shadow.
Agility has increased by 12 points.
The first Critical Strike applies 200% additional damage. >
‘Master of assassination… Heh. This makes hunting so much easier.’
The bandits tended to respawn over time.
Seasoned Crab roamed the dungeons and hunting grounds near Olth and exterminated the bandits every two or three days.
His level advanced rapidly and so did his skill in hunting and assassination of bandits.
‘It sure is easy to level up. At this pace, becoming one of the top players in all of Royal Road isn’t just a dream anymore.’
A sense of security was spreading among the players of City Olth because no one was actually suffering from the bandits.
“That’s weird. The bandits settled down… But the security level of the city did not decline that much.”
“There’s no ambush either. I heard those are scary.”
“You’re right. Dozens of bandits hunting players.”
Seasoned Crab’s unseen efforts was turning City Olth into a safer location. What’s more was that he had succeeded in hunting all the bandits at least once.
Blink!
< The Bandits Threatening The City Complete.
The bandits of Vasly Mountain could not avoid the silent approach of death.
The dead bandits will never be able to put Olth in danger again. >
Quest complete!
It was an emotional moment for Seasoned Crab, but also for the remaining players who could not abandon their homeland as they cheered.
“What. The quest is complete!”
“What happened? Who exterminated them?”
The players were puzzled and the citizens began speaking.
“Do you know about Seasoned Crab? They say you cannot escape his blade.”
“The bandits he went after probably had no idea that they would be killed.”
“Beware of the shadows! Seasoned Crab may be hiding!”
***
Seasoned Crab departed from the city of Olth.
No players could match his level as he was far beyond them.
‘Hoo. Is there going to be anyone in Versailles who could compete with me?’
He roamed the Central Continent for mercenary requests and hunting grounds.
“No outsiders can enter this place. Go somewhere else.”
“Sorry?”
“You can hunt for a week by paying the 50 gold entrance fee.”
“That’s too much.”
“Then beat it.”
It was common to see the guild hog the good dungeons and exploit other players.
Seasoned Crab sometimes paid the fee, but usually he travelled far from the city to hunt.
They weren’t efficient hunting grounds, so he encountered monsters less frequently, which lowered his rate for levelling up.
‘This is a cheap, dirty world.’
A guild tried to recruit Seasoned Crab.
“I heard you left Olth? Hehehe. Join our guild. We will provide you with the hunting grounds and equipment.”
“I don’t have a lot of money.”
“Forget about money. We will provide everything once you join. Of course, if a war breaks out you must fight with us.”
Seasoned Crab turned down all the invitations and acted alone.
He did register into a guild for a few days only to quit after realizing the internal affairs.
In conflicts against other guilds he would fight proudly, but there were many incidents where he had to maintain dungeons or hunting grounds and take entrance fees.
Sometimes they ambushed players that passed by and took their possessions.
Seasoned Crab cut all ties with other players.
“I will kill all villains.”
Only a single dagger will seek justice.
Regardless of player or monster, if he assessed them as a villain, he took care of them silently.
- The death bringing shadow, Seasoned Crab.
- Death that cannot be avoided, Seasoned Crab.
- Murderer of the shadows, Seasoned Crab.
- Soul destroyer, Seasoned Crab.
- Merciless slaughterer, Seasoned Crab.
Countless infamous titles were stuck to his name.
A long time passed.
Seasoned Crab arrived at the Fountain in Morata where he had a scheduled meet up.
“Crab-nim! Come quick.”
“Did you eat?”
“It’s Rice Thief-nim!”
“Where are we going to hunt today, Weed-nim?”
Seasoned Crab smiled brightly wearing the Robe of the Assassin.
Weed was busily making a sculpture.
The trustworthy Pale stood beside him with his bow.
The kind Irene looked good in her long white dress.
Mage Romuna stood impressively, staff in hand.
Surka with her mad fists but soft heart.
The passionate and beautiful Hwaryeong.
The complaining instrumentalist Bellot.
Where he arrived he found the comrades he wished to be at his side forever.
< Spinoff Complete >
The Novel will be updated first on this website. Come back and continue reading tomorrow, everyone!
